auxiliary_declarations.statement:
∀ {A : Type u_3} {B : Type u_4} {C : Type u_2} {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : Fintype B]
  [inst_2 : Fintype C] [inst_3 : DecidableEq A] [inst_4 : DecidableEq B] (s : Finset ι) (Pμ : ι → Matrix A A ℂ)
  (Pν : ι → Matrix C C ℂ) (V : Matrix (A × B) C ℂ) (k : B),
  (∀ i ∈ s, IsStarProjection ((fun (i : ι) => V * Pν i * V.conjTranspose) i)) →
    (∀ i ∈ s,

          ((fun (i : ι) =>
              FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k * Pμ i *
                (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k).conjTranspose)
            i)) →
      ∀ i ∈ s,
        (V.conjTranspose *
              ((fun (i : ι) => V * Pν i * V.conjTranspose) i *
                  (fun (i : ι) =>
                      FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k * Pμ i *

auxiliary_declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CartanCloning.ofWeightBlocks._proof_5
auxiliary_declarations.statement:
∀ {A : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} {C : Type u_4} {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : Fintype B]
  [inst_2 : Fintype C] [inst_3 : DecidableEq A] [inst_4 : DecidableEq B] (s : Finset ι) (e : ι → ℝ)
  (Pμ : ι → Matrix A A ℂ) (Pν : ι → Matrix C C ℂ) (V : Matrix (A × B) C ℂ) (k : B),
  (∀ i ∈ s,
      ‖V * Pν i * V.conjTranspose -
              FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k * Pμ i *
                (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k).conjTranspose‖ ^
          2 ≤
        e i) →
    (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k).conjTranspose * FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k = 1 →
      (∀ i ∈ s, IsStarProjection ((fun (i : ι) => V * Pν i * V.conjTranspose) i)) →
        (∀ i ∈ s,
            IsStarProjection
              ((fun (i : ι) =>
                  FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k * Pμ i *
                    (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k).conjTranspose)
                i)) →
          ∀ i ∈ s,
            (1 - e i) • Pμ i ≤
              (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k).conjTranspose *
                  ((fun (i : ι) =>
                          FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k * Pμ i *
                            (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k).conjTranspose)
                        i *
                      (fun (i : ι) => V * Pν i * V.conjTranspose) i *
                    (fun (i : ι) =>
                        FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k * Pμ i *
                          (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k).conjTranspose)
                      i) *
                FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k

auxiliary_declarations.statement:
∀ {A : Type u_3} {B : Type u_4} {C : Type u_2} {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : Fintype B]
  [inst_2 : Fintype C] [inst_3 : DecidableEq A] [inst_4 : DecidableEq B] [inst_5 : DecidableEq C] (s : Finset ι)
  (e : ι → ℝ) (Pμ : ι → Matrix A A ℂ) (Pν : ι → Matrix C C ℂ) (V : Matrix (A × B) C ℂ),
  V.conjTranspose * V = 1 →
    ∀ (k : B),
      (∀ i ∈ s,
          ‖V * Pν i * V.conjTranspose -
                  FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k * Pμ i *
                    (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k).conjTranspose‖ ^
              2 ≤
            e i) →
        (∀ i ∈ s, IsStarProjection ((fun (i : ι) => V * Pν i * V.conjTranspose) i)) →
          (∀ i ∈ s,
              IsStarProjection
                ((fun (i : ι) =>
                    FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k * Pμ i *
                      (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k).conjTranspose)
                  i)) →
            ∀ i ∈ s,
              (1 - e i) • Pν i ≤
                V.conjTranspose *
                    ((fun (i : ι) => V * Pν i * V.conjTranspose) i *
                        (fun (i : ι) =>
                            FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k * Pμ i *
                              (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k).conjTranspose)
                          i *
                      (fun (i : ι) => V * Pν i * V.conjTranspose) i) *
                  V

auxiliary_declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CartanCloning.ofWeightBlocks._proof_7
auxiliary_declarations.statement:
∀ {A : Type u_3} {B : Type u_4} {C : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : Fintype B]
  [inst_2 : Fintype C] [inst_3 : DecidableEq A] [inst_4 : DecidableEq B] [inst_5 : DecidableEq C] (s : Finset ι)
  (pμ : ι → ℝ) (Pμ : ι → Matrix A A ℂ) (Pν : ι → Matrix C C ℂ) (V : Matrix (A × B) C ℂ),
  V.conjTranspose * V = 1 →
    ∀ (k : B) (din dout : ℝ) (hdin : 0 < din) (hdout : 0 < dout)
      (hbalance : FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.partialTrace (V * V.conjTranspose) = (dout / din) • 1),
      (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ pμ i) →
        (∀ i ∈ s,
            V * V.conjTranspose *
                  (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k * Pμ i *
                    (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k).conjTranspose) *
                (V * V.conjTranspose) =
              V * Pν i * V.conjTranspose *
                  (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k * Pμ i *
                    (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k).conjTranspose) *
                (V * Pν i * V.conjTranspose)) →
          (∀ i ∈ s, (Pμ i).PosSemidef) →
            ((din / dout) •
                FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s pμ fun (i : ι) =>
                  V.conjTranspose *
                      ((fun (i : ι) => V * Pν i * V.conjTranspose) i *
                          (fun (i : ι) =>
                              FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k * Pμ i *
                                (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k).conjTranspose)
                            i *
                        (fun (i : ι) => V * Pν i * V.conjTranspose) i) *
                    V) ≤
              (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.cartanChannel V din dout hdin hdout hbalance).toFun
                (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s pμ Pμ)

auxiliary_declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CartanCloning.ofWeightBlocks._proof_8
auxiliary_declarations.statement:
∀ {A : Type u_1} {B : Type u_3} {C : Type u_4} {ι : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : Fintype B]
  [inst_2 : Fintype C] [inst_3 : DecidableEq A] [inst_4 : DecidableEq B] [inst_5 : DecidableEq C] (s : Finset ι)
  (pν : ι → ℝ) (Pμ : ι → Matrix A A ℂ) (Pν : ι → Matrix C C ℂ) (V : Matrix (A × B) C ℂ) (hV : V.conjTranspose * V = 1)
  (k : B),
  (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ pν i) →
    (∀ i ∈ s,
        (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k).conjTranspose * (V * Pν i * V.conjTranspose) *
            FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k =
          (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k).conjTranspose *
              (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k * Pμ i *
                    (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k).conjTranspose *
                  (V * Pν i * V.conjTranspose) *
                (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k * Pμ i *
                  (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k).conjTranspose)) *
            FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k) →
      (∀ i ∈ s, (Pν i).PosSemidef) →
        (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s pν fun (i : ι) =>
            (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k).conjTranspose *
                ((fun (i : ι) =>
                        FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k * Pμ i *
                          (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k).conjTranspose)
                      i *
                    (fun (i : ι) => V * Pν i * V.conjTranspose) i *
                  (fun (i : ι) =>
                      FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k * Pμ i *
                        (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k).conjTranspose)
                    i) *
              FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k) ≤
          (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.reverseChannel V hV).toFun (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s pν Pν)

  (∀ i ∈ s,
      FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.depth (delta i) ≤ g →
        ∀ (j : Fin (d - 1)),
          delta i j ≠ 0 →
            ↑g ≤
              (M.row + N.row) (FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.left j) -
                (M.row + N.row) (FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.right j)) →
    ∀ i ∈ s,
      FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.depth (delta i) ≤ g →
        (↑g + 2) •
            (FreeEntropy.WeightSectors.weightProjector (FreeEntropy.WeightSectors.totalWeight M.weight N.weight)
                (M.row + N.row - FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.offset (delta i)) -
              W.embedding W.top *
                  FreeEntropy.WeightSectors.weightProjector (W.constituent W.top).weight

                (V * Pν i * V.conjTranspose)) →

  V.conjTranspose * V = 1 →
    ∀ (k : B),
      (∀ i ∈ s, IsStarProjection (Pμ i)) →
        (∀ i ∈ s, IsStarProjection (Pν i)) →
          (∀ i ∈ s, FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr (Pμ i) = ↑(m i)) →
            (∀ i ∈ s, FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr (Pν i) = ↑(n i)) →
              ∀ (K S : ι → Matrix (A × B) (A × B) ℂ) (gap deficit : ι → ℝ),
                (∀ i ∈ s, e i < 1 → m i = n i) →
                  (∀ i ∈ s, e i < 1 → 0 < gap i) →
                    (∀ i ∈ s, e i < 1 → gap i • (S i - V * Pν i * V.conjTranspose) ≤ K i) →
                      (∀ i ∈ s,
                          e i < 1 →
                            FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k * Pμ i *
                                    (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k).conjTranspose *
                                  S i *
                                (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k * Pμ i *
                                  (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k).conjTranspose) =
                              FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k * Pμ i *
                                (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k).conjTranspose) →
                        (∀ i ∈ s,
                            e i < 1 →
                              FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k * Pμ i *
                                      (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k).conjTranspose *
                                    K i *
                                  (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k * Pμ i *
                                    (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k).conjTranspose) ≤
                                deficit i •
                                  (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k * Pμ i *
                                    (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k).conjTranspose)) →
                          (∀ i ∈ s, e i < 1 → deficit i / gap i ≤ e i) →
                            (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k).conjTranspose *
                                  FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k =
                                1 →
                              ∀ i ∈ s,
                                FreeEntropy.CasimirTrace.traceDeficit
                                      ((fun (i : ι) =>
                                          FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k * Pμ i *
                                            (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k).conjTranspose)
                                        i)
                                      ((fun (i : ι) => V * Pν i * V.conjTranspose) i) ≤
                                    e i * FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr (Pμ i) ∧
                                  FreeEntropy.CasimirTrace.traceDeficit ((fun (i : ι) => V * Pν i * V.conjTranspose) i)
                                      ((fun (i : ι) =>
                                          FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k * Pμ i *
                                            (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k).conjTranspose)
                                        i) ≤
                                    e i * FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr (Pν i)

        Pi.single (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.permutedEnumeration s σ) 1

    nu i + (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.auxiliaryShift mu - mu i)

auxiliary_declarations.statement:

auxiliary_declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ) (a : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d →₀ ℕ)
  (hcapacity :
    ∀ (k : ℕ),
      Fintype.card
          { x : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.RootCopies a //
            FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootCopyHeight a x = k } ≤
        FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.heightFiber mu k)
  (c : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.Column mu)
  (hc :
    ∃ (x : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.RootCopies a),
      (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootColumnEmbedding mu a hcapacity) x = c),
  ↑(↑(Classical.choose hc).fst).1 + 1 = FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.columnHeight mu c

auxiliary_declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.monomialBasis.eq_1
auxiliary_declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ) (a : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d →₀ ℕ)
  (hcapacity :
    ∀ (k : ℕ),
      Fintype.card
          { x : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.RootCopies a //
            FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootCopyHeight a x = k } ≤
        FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.heightFiber mu k)
  (c : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.Column mu),
  FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.monomialBasis mu a hcapacity c =
    if hc :
        ∃ (x : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.RootCopies a),
          (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootColumnEmbedding mu a hcapacity) x = c then
      let x := Classical.choose hc;
      (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.indexCast ⋯)
        (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.replacementSubset (↑x.fst).2 (↑x.fst).1 ⋯)
    else FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.first ⋯

          (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.tensorFirst (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.columnHeight mu) ⋯) ≤

        zero_padded := zero_padded, normalized := normalized } =
      { rank_pos := rank_pos_1, rank_le := rank_le_1, eigenvalue := eigenvalue_1, positive := positive_1,

                                      positive := positive, decreasing := decreasing, zero_padded := zero_padded,
                                      normalized := normalized } =

  2 ≤ r →
    ∀ (encode : β → ℕ × ℕ →₀ ℕ),
      Function.Injective encode →
        (∀ (b : β), (encode b).support ⊆ FreeEntropy.Weyl.activeRoots r r) →
          ∀ (t : ℕ),

auxiliary_declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators.tensor._simp_1
auxiliary_declarations.statement:
∀ {α : Type u_3} {l : Type u_9} {m : Type u_10} {n : Type u_11} {l' : Type u_15} {m' : Type u_16} {n' : Type u_17}
  [inst : Fintype m] [inst_1 : Fintype m'] [inst_2 : CommSemiring α] (A : Matrix l m α) (B : Matrix m n α)
  (A' : Matrix l' m' α) (B' : Matrix m' n' α),
  Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun (x1 x2 : α) => x1 * x2) A A' * Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun (x1 x2 : α) => x1 * x2) B B' =
    Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun (x1 x2 : α) => x1 * x2) (A * B) (A' * B')

auxiliary_declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators.tensor.eq_1
auxiliary_declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : Fintype K] [inst_2 : DecidableEq H]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq K] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H)
  (S : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d K),
  R.tensor S =
    {
      E := fun (i j : Fin d) =>
        Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun (x1 x2 : ℂ) => x1 * x2) (R.E i j) 1 +
          Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun (x1 x2 : ℂ) => x1 * x2) 1 (S.E i j),
      adjoint := ⋯, commutator := ⋯ }

auxiliary_declarations.statement:

auxiliary_declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators.unitaryConjugate._proof_2
auxiliary_declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {A : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : DecidableEq A] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d A)
  (W : Matrix A A ℂ),
  W.conjTranspose * W = 1 →
    ∀ (i j k l : Fin d),
      W.conjTranspose * R.E i j * W * (W.conjTranspose * R.E k l * W) -
          W.conjTranspose * R.E k l * W * (W.conjTranspose * R.E i j * W) =
        (if j = k then W.conjTranspose * R.E i l * W else 0) - if l = i then W.conjTranspose * R.E k j * W else 0

      R.unitaryConjugate W hW = R_1.unitaryConjugate W_1 ⋯

auxiliary_declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.cyclicIntertwinerEquiv._proof_2
auxiliary_declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] [inst_2 : Fintype K]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq K] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H)
  (S : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d K) (lam : Fin d → ℂ) (v : H → ℂ),
  (∀ (i : Fin d), (R.E i i).mulVec v = lam i • v) →
    (∀ (i j : Fin d), i < j → (R.E i j).mulVec v = 0) →
      ∀ (f : (H → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] K → ℂ),
        (∀ (i j : Fin d) (x : H → ℂ), f ((R.E i j).mulVec x) = (S.E i j).mulVec (f x)) →
          f v ≠ 0 →
            FreeEntropy.LiePBW.cyclicSpan S (f v) = ⊤ →
              Function.Injective ⇑(f ∘ₗ (FreeEntropy.LiePBW.cyclicSpan R v).subtype) ∧
                Function.Surjective ⇑(f ∘ₗ (FreeEntropy.LiePBW.cyclicSpan R v).subtype)

auxiliary_declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.cyclicSpan.eq_1
auxiliary_declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H)
  (v : H → ℂ),

  (reverse : FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel (Fin target) (Fin source))
  (encoder : FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel (Fin source) (Fin memory))
  (decoder : FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel (Fin memory) (Fin source)),
  sizeOf
      { sourceState := sourceState, continuous_source := continuous_source, source_positive := source_positive,
        source_trace := source_trace, weights := weights, U := U, continuous_U := continuous_U, unitary := unitary,
        irreducible := irreducible, forward := forward, reverse := reverse, encoder := encoder, decoder := decoder } =
    1 + sizeOf continuous_source + sizeOf weights + sizeOf U + sizeOf continuous_U + sizeOf irreducible +
            sizeOf forward +

        sizeOf encoder +
      sizeOf decoder

auxiliary_declarations.statement:
{d r m : ℕ} →
  {s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r} →
    {n : ℕ} →
      {C : FreeEntropy.SchurAchievability.Code m} →
        {motive : FreeEntropy.SchurAchievability.Code.DiagramEstimate s n C → Sort u} →
          (t : FreeEntropy.SchurAchievability.Code.DiagramEstimate s n C) →
            ((row_injective : Function.Injective fun (a : Fin C.sectorCount) (i : Fin r) => C.row a ↑i) →
                (row_nonneg : ∀ (a : Fin C.sectorCount), ∀ i < r, 0 ≤ C.row a i) →
                  (row_le_n : ∀ (a : Fin C.sectorCount), ∀ i < r, C.row a i ≤ ↑n) →
                    (row_zero : ∀ (a : Fin C.sectorCount) (i : ℕ), r ≤ i → i < d → C.row a i = 0) →
                      (row_size : ∀ (a : Fin C.sectorCount), ∑ i : Fin r, C.row a ↑i = ↑n) →
                        (mem_typical :
                            ∀ (a : Fin C.sectorCount), a ∈ C.typical ↔ FreeEntropy.TypicalRows.Typical s n (C.row a)) →
                          (pointwise :
                              ∀ (a : Fin C.sectorCount),
                                C.probability a ≤
                                  (↑n + 1) ^ r.choose 2 *
                                    Real.exp
                                      (-↑n *
                                        FreeEntropy.FiniteConcentration.kl
                                          (FreeEntropy.FiniteConcentration.rowFrequency r n (C.row a))
                                          fun (i : Fin r) => s.eigenvalue ↑i)) →
                            motive ⋯) →

auxiliary_declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.restrictedGenerators._proof_1
auxiliary_declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} {A : Type u_1} (J : Matrix (Fin n → Fin d) A ℂ) (i j : Fin d),
  (J.conjTranspose * (FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.generators d n).E i j * J).conjTranspose =
    J.conjTranspose * (FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.generators d n).E j i * J

auxiliary_declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.restrictedGenerators._proof_2
auxiliary_declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} {A : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : DecidableEq A]
  (R : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ) →* Matrix A A ℂ) (J : Matrix (Fin n → Fin d) A ℂ),
  J.conjTranspose * J = 1 →
    (∀ (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)), (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalRepresentation d n) U * J = J * R U) →
      ∀ (i j k l : Fin d),
        J.conjTranspose * (FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.generators d n).E i j * J *
              (J.conjTranspose * (FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.generators d n).E k l * J) -
            J.conjTranspose * (FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.generators d n).E k l * J *
              (J.conjTranspose * (FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.generators d n).E i j * J) =
          (if j = k then J.conjTranspose * (FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.generators d n).E i l * J else 0) -
            if l = i then J.conjTranspose * (FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.generators d n).E k j * J else 0

∀ {d n : ℕ} {A : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : DecidableEq A]
  (R R_1 : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ) →* Matrix A A ℂ) (e_R : R = R_1) (J J_1 : Matrix (Fin n → Fin d) A ℂ)
  (e_J : J = J_1) (hJ : J.conjTranspose * J = 1)
  (hJR : ∀ (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)), (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalRepresentation d n) U * J = J * R U),
  FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.restrictedGenerators R J hJ hJR = FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.restrictedGenerators R_1 J_1 ⋯ ⋯

auxiliary_declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.restrictedGenerators.eq_1
auxiliary_declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} {A : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : DecidableEq A]
  (R : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ) →* Matrix A A ℂ) (J : Matrix (Fin n → Fin d) A ℂ) (hJ : J.conjTranspose * J = 1)
  (hJR : ∀ (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)), (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalRepresentation d n) U * J = J * R U),
  FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.restrictedGenerators R J hJ hJR =
    { E := fun (i j : Fin d) => J.conjTranspose * (FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.generators d n).E i j * J, adjoint := ⋯,
      commutator := ⋯ }

  {B : ι → Type u_5} [inst_3 : (i : ι) → Fintype (B i)] [inst_4 : (i : ι) → DecidableEq (B i)] [inst_5 : Nonempty M]
  (typical : Finset ι) (F : (i : ↥typical) → FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel (B ↑i) M),
  ∀ i ∉ typical,
    FreeEntropy.AtypicalChannels.extendForward typical F i = FreeEntropy.AtypicalChannels.defaultReplacement

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.AtypicalChannels.extendReverse
declarations.statement:
{ι : Type u_3} →
  {M : Type u_4} →
    [DecidableEq ι] →
      [inst : Fintype M] →
        [DecidableEq M] →
          {B : ι → Type u_5} →
            [inst_2 : (i : ι) → Fintype (B i)] →
              [(i : ι) → DecidableEq (B i)] →
                [∀ (i : ι), Nonempty (B i)] →
                  (typical : Finset ι) →
                    ((i : ↥typical) → FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel M (B ↑i)) →
                      (i : ι) → FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel M (B i)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.AtypicalChannels.extendReverse_of_mem
declarations.statement:
∀ {ι : Type u_3} {M : Type u_4} [Fintype ι] [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype M] [inst_2 : DecidableEq M]
  {B : ι → Type u_5} [inst_3 : (i : ι) → Fintype (B i)] [inst_4 : (i : ι) → DecidableEq (B i)]
  [inst_5 : ∀ (i : ι), Nonempty (B i)] (typical : Finset ι)
  (G : (i : ↥typical) → FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel M (B ↑i)) (i : ι) (hi : i ∈ typical),
  FreeEntropy.AtypicalChannels.extendReverse typical G i = G ⟨i, hi⟩

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.AtypicalChannels.extendReverse_of_not_mem
declarations.statement:
∀ {ι : Type u_3} {M : Type u_4} [Fintype ι] [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype M] [inst_2 : DecidableEq M]
  {B : ι → Type u_5} [inst_3 : (i : ι) → Fintype (B i)] [inst_4 : (i : ι) → DecidableEq (B i)]
  [inst_5 : ∀ (i : ι), Nonempty (B i)] (typical : Finset ι)
  (G : (i : ↥typical) → FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel M (B ↑i)),
  ∀ i ∉ typical,
    FreeEntropy.AtypicalChannels.extendReverse typical G i = FreeEntropy.AtypicalChannels.defaultReplacement

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.AtypicalChannels.replacementChannel
declarations.statement:
{H : Type u_1} →

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.AtypicalChannels.replacementChannel_apply
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} {T : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : Fintype T] [inst_2 : DecidableEq H]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq T] (target : T) (X : Matrix H H ℂ),
  (FreeEntropy.AtypicalChannels.replacementChannel target).toFun X =
    X.trace • FreeEntropy.SpectralProjector.coordinateProjection target

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.AtypicalChannels.replacementChannel_state
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} {T : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : Fintype T] [inst_2 : DecidableEq H]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq T] (target : T) (X : Matrix H H ℂ),

    (FreeEntropy.AtypicalChannels.replacementChannel target).toFun X =

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.AtypicalChannels.replacementKraus
declarations.statement: {H : Type u_1} → {T : Type u_2} → [DecidableEq H] → [DecidableEq T] → T → H → Matrix T H ℂ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.AtypicalChannels.replacementKraus_normalization
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} {T : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : Fintype T] [inst_2 : DecidableEq H]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq T] (target : T),
  ∑ a : H,
      (FreeEntropy.AtypicalChannels.replacementKraus target a).conjTranspose *
        FreeEntropy.AtypicalChannels.replacementKraus target a =

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.AtypicalChannels.single_eq_coordinateProjection
declarations.statement:
∀ {T : Type u_2} [Fintype T] [inst : DecidableEq T] (target : T),

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.AtypicalChannels.typical_subtype_roundtrip_error
declarations.statement:
∀ {ι : Type u_3} {M : Type u_4} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] [inst_2 : Fintype M]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq M] {B : ι → Type u_5} [inst_4 : (i : ι) → Fintype (B i)] [inst_5 : (i : ι) → DecidableEq (B i)]
  {A : ι → Type u_6} [inst_6 : (i : ι) → Fintype (A i)] [inst_7 : (i : ι) → DecidableEq (A i)]
  [inst_8 : ∀ (i : ι), Nonempty (A i)] [inst_9 : ∀ (i : ι), Nonempty (B i)] [inst_10 : Nonempty M] (typical : Finset ι)
  (F : (i : ↥typical) → FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel (B ↑i) M)
  (G : (i : ↥typical) → FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel M (B ↑i)) (q : ι → ℝ) (hq0 : ∀ (i : ι), 0 ≤ q i)
  (hq1 : ∑ i : ι, q i = 1) (σ : (i : ι) → Matrix (B i) (B i) ℂ),
  (∀ (i : ι), (σ i).PosSemidef) →
    (∀ (i : ι), (σ i).trace = 1) →
      ∀ (τ : Matrix M M ℂ),
        τ.PosSemidef →
          τ.trace = 1 →
            ∀ (ε : ℝ),
              0 ≤ ε →
                (∀ (i : ↥typical), FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance ((F i).toFun (σ ↑i)) τ ≤ ε) →
                  (∀ (i : ↥typical), FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance ((G i).toFun τ) (σ ↑i) ≤ ε) →
                    FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance
                        ((FreeEntropy.SchurProtocol.decoder (FreeEntropy.AtypicalChannels.extendReverse typical G) q hq0
                              hq1).toFun
                          ((FreeEntropy.SchurProtocol.encoder
                                (FreeEntropy.AtypicalChannels.extendForward typical F)).toFun
                            (FreeEntropy.SchurProtocol.sourceState q σ)))
                        (FreeEntropy.SchurProtocol.sourceState q σ) ≤
                      2 * ε + 2 * FreeEntropy.Protocol.outsideMass Finset.univ typical q

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CanonicalMonomials.canonical_monomial_relative
declarations.statement:
∀ {d r : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r) (mu : Fin d → ℕ),
  Antitone mu →
    ∀ (a : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex mu),
      ∏ i : Fin d, s.eigenvalue ↑i ^ FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeight mu a i =
        (∏ i : Fin d, s.eigenvalue ↑i ^ mu i) *
          (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeightModel mu).relativeWeight
            (fun (j : Fin (d - 1)) => s.adjacentRatio ↑j) a

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CanonicalMonomials.highest_monomial_pos
declarations.statement:
∀ {d r : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r) (mu : Fin d → ℕ),
  (∀ (i : Fin d), r ≤ ↑i → mu i = 0) → 0 < ∏ i : Fin d, s.eigenvalue ↑i ^ mu i

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CanonicalMonomials.monomial_factor
declarations.statement:
∀ {d r : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r) (w : Fin d → ℕ),
  ∏ i : Fin d, s.eigenvalue ↑i ^ w i =
    (s.eigenvalue 0 ^ ∑ i : Fin d, w i) *
      ∏ j : Fin (d - 1), s.adjacentRatio ↑j ^ FreeEntropy.CanonicalMonomials.suffix w j

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CanonicalMonomials.monomial_relative
declarations.statement:
∀ {d r : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r) (mu w : Fin d → ℕ) (c : Fin (d - 1) → ℕ),
  ((fun (i : Fin d) => ↑(mu i)) - fun (i : Fin d) => ↑(w i)) = FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.offset c →
    ∑ i : Fin d, mu i = ∑ i : Fin d, w i →
      ∏ i : Fin d, s.eigenvalue ↑i ^ w i =
        (∏ i : Fin d, s.eigenvalue ↑i ^ mu i) *
          FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.rootWeightMonomial (fun (j : Fin (d - 1)) => s.adjacentRatio ↑j) c

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CanonicalMonomials.normalized_diagonal_factor
declarations.statement:
∀ {A : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : DecidableEq A] [Nonempty A] (k : ℝ),
  k ≠ 0 →
    ∀ (w : A → ℝ),
      ∑ a : A, w a ≠ 0 →
        FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.normalizedBlock (Matrix.diagonal fun (a : A) => ↑(k * w a)) =
          Matrix.diagonal fun (a : A) => ↑(w a / ∑ b : A, w b)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CanonicalMonomials.prefixProduct
declarations.statement: {d : ℕ} → (Fin (d - 1) → ℝ) → ℕ → ℝ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CanonicalMonomials.prefixProduct_succ
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (q : Fin (d - 1) → ℝ) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < d - 1),
  FreeEntropy.CanonicalMonomials.prefixProduct q (i + 1) = FreeEntropy.CanonicalMonomials.prefixProduct q i * q ⟨i, hi⟩

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CanonicalMonomials.spectrum_prefixProduct
declarations.statement:
∀ {d r : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r),
  ∀ i < d,
    s.eigenvalue i =
      s.eigenvalue 0 * FreeEntropy.CanonicalMonomials.prefixProduct (fun (j : Fin (d - 1)) => s.adjacentRatio ↑j) i

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CanonicalMonomials.spectrum_recurrence
declarations.statement:
∀ {d r : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r) (i : ℕ),
  i + 1 < d → s.eigenvalue (i + 1) = s.eigenvalue i * s.adjacentRatio i

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CanonicalMonomials.suffix
declarations.statement: {d : ℕ} → (Fin d → ℕ) → Fin (d - 1) → ℕ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CanonicalMonomials.suffix_eq_of_cone
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu w : Fin d → ℕ) (c : Fin (d - 1) → ℕ),
  ((fun (i : Fin d) => ↑(mu i)) - fun (i : Fin d) => ↑(w i)) = FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.offset c →
    ∑ i : Fin d, mu i = ∑ i : Fin d, w i →
      ∀ (j : Fin (d - 1)), FreeEntropy.CanonicalMonomials.suffix w j = FreeEntropy.CanonicalMonomials.suffix mu j + c j

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CartanBalance.balance_of_cyclic_weight
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {A : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} {C : Type u_3} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : DecidableEq A] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq B] [inst_4 : Fintype C] [inst_5 : DecidableEq C] [Nonempty A]
  (M : FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.CyclicWeightModel d A) (N : FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.CyclicWeightModel d B)
  (S : FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.CyclicWeightModel d C) (J : Matrix (A × B) C ℂ),
  J.conjTranspose * J = 1 →
    (∀ (i j : Fin d), (M.generators.tensor N.generators).E i j * J = J * S.generators.E i j) →
      FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.partialTrace (J * J.conjTranspose) = (↑(Fintype.card C) / ↑(Fintype.card A)) • 1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CartanBalance.balance_of_irreducible
declarations.statement:
∀ {G : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} {C : Type u_4} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : Fintype A] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  [inst_3 : Fintype C] [inst_4 : DecidableEq A] [inst_5 : DecidableEq B] [inst_6 : DecidableEq C] [Nonempty A]
  (U : G →* Matrix A A ℂ) (W : G →* Matrix B B ℂ) (Z : G →* Matrix C C ℂ)
  [(FreeEntropy.Twirling.matrixRepresentation U).IsIrreducible],
  (∀ (g : G), (U g).conjTranspose * U g = 1) →
    (∀ (g : G), (W g).conjTranspose * W g = 1) →
      (∀ (g : G), (Z g).conjTranspose * Z g = 1) →
        ∀ (V : Matrix (A × B) C ℂ),
          V.conjTranspose * V = 1 →
            (∀ (g : G), Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun (x1 x2 : ℂ) => x1 * x2) (U g) (W g) * V = V * Z g) →
              FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.partialTrace (V * V.conjTranspose) = (↑(Fintype.card C) / ↑(Fintype.card A)) • 1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CartanBalance.cartanChannelOfIrreducible
declarations.statement:
{G : Type u_1} →
  {A : Type u_2} →
    {B : Type u_3} →
      {C : Type u_4} →
        [inst : Group G] →
          [inst_1 : Fintype A] →
            [inst_2 : Fintype B] →
              [inst_3 : Fintype C] →
                [inst_4 : DecidableEq A] →
                  [inst_5 : DecidableEq B] →
                    [inst_6 : DecidableEq C] →
                      [Nonempty A] →
                        [Nonempty C] →
                          (U : G →* Matrix A A ℂ) →
                            (W : G →* Matrix B B ℂ) →
                              (Z : G →* Matrix C C ℂ) →
                                [(FreeEntropy.Twirling.matrixRepresentation U).IsIrreducible] →
                                  (∀ (g : G), (U g).conjTranspose * U g = 1) →
                                    (∀ (g : G), (W g).conjTranspose * W g = 1) →
                                      (∀ (g : G), (Z g).conjTranspose * Z g = 1) →
                                        (V : Matrix (A × B) C ℂ) →
                                          V.conjTranspose * V = 1 →
                                            (∀ (g : G),
                                                Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun (x1 x2 : ℂ) => x1 * x2) (U g) (W g) * V =
                                                  V * Z g) →
                                              FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel A C

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CartanBalance.cartanChannelOfIrreducible_apply
declarations.statement:
∀ {G : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} {C : Type u_4} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : Fintype A] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  [inst_3 : Fintype C] [inst_4 : DecidableEq A] [inst_5 : DecidableEq B] [inst_6 : DecidableEq C] [inst_7 : Nonempty A]
  [inst_8 : Nonempty C] (U : G →* Matrix A A ℂ) (W : G →* Matrix B B ℂ) (Z : G →* Matrix C C ℂ)
  [inst_9 : (FreeEntropy.Twirling.matrixRepresentation U).IsIrreducible] (hU : ∀ (g : G), (U g).conjTranspose * U g = 1)
  (hW : ∀ (g : G), (W g).conjTranspose * W g = 1) (hZ : ∀ (g : G), (Z g).conjTranspose * Z g = 1)
  (V : Matrix (A × B) C ℂ) (hV : V.conjTranspose * V = 1)
  (hintertwine : ∀ (g : G), Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun (x1 x2 : ℂ) => x1 * x2) (U g) (W g) * V = V * Z g)
  (X : Matrix A A ℂ),
  (FreeEntropy.CartanBalance.cartanChannelOfIrreducible U W Z hU hW hZ V hV hintertwine).toFun X =
    FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.sectorMap (↑(Fintype.card A)) (↑(Fintype.card C)) V X

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CartanBalance.lie_range_commutes
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {A : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} {C : Type u_3} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : DecidableEq A] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq B] [inst_4 : Fintype C] [DecidableEq C] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d A)
  (S : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d B) (T : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d C)
  (J : Matrix (A × B) C ℂ),
  (∀ (i j : Fin d), (R.tensor S).E i j * J = J * T.E i j) →
    ∀ (i j : Fin d), (R.tensor S).E i j * (J * J.conjTranspose) = J * J.conjTranspose * (R.tensor S).E i j

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CartanBalance.partialTrace_add
declarations.statement:
∀ {A : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [inst : Fintype B] [DecidableEq B]
  (P Q : Matrix (A × B) (A × B) ℂ),
  FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.partialTrace (P + Q) =
    FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.partialTrace P + FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.partialTrace Q

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CartanBalance.partialTrace_commutes_of_tensor
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {A : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : DecidableEq A] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq B] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d A)
  (S : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d B) (P : Matrix (A × B) (A × B) ℂ),
  (∀ (i j : Fin d), (R.tensor S).E i j * P = P * (R.tensor S).E i j) →
    ∀ (i j : Fin d),
      FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.partialTrace P * R.E i j = R.E i j * FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.partialTrace P

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CartanBalance.partialTrace_environment
declarations.statement:
∀ {A : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : DecidableEq A] [inst_2 : Fintype B] [DecidableEq B]
  (X : Matrix B B ℂ) (P : Matrix (A × B) (A × B) ℂ),
  FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.partialTrace (Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun (x1 x2 : ℂ) => x1 * x2) 1 X * P) =
    FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.partialTrace (P * Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun (x1 x2 : ℂ) => x1 * x2) 1 X)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CartanBalance.partialTrace_left
declarations.statement:
∀ {A : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [inst_2 : Fintype B] [inst_3 : DecidableEq B]
  (X : Matrix A A ℂ) (P : Matrix (A × B) (A × B) ℂ),
  FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.partialTrace (Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun (x1 x2 : ℂ) => x1 * x2) X 1 * P) =
    X * FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.partialTrace P

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CartanBalance.partialTrace_range_commutes
declarations.statement:
∀ {G : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} {C : Type u_4} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : Fintype A] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  [inst_3 : Fintype C] [inst_4 : DecidableEq A] [inst_5 : DecidableEq B] [inst_6 : DecidableEq C]
  (U : G →* Matrix A A ℂ) (W : G →* Matrix B B ℂ) (Z : G →* Matrix C C ℂ),
  (∀ (g : G), (U g).conjTranspose * U g = 1) →
    (∀ (g : G), (W g).conjTranspose * W g = 1) →
      (∀ (g : G), (Z g).conjTranspose * Z g = 1) →
        ∀ (V : Matrix (A × B) C ℂ),
          (∀ (g : G), Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun (x1 x2 : ℂ) => x1 * x2) (U g) (W g) * V = V * Z g) →
            ∀ (g : G),
              FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.partialTrace (V * V.conjTranspose) * U g =
                U g * FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.partialTrace (V * V.conjTranspose)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CartanBalance.partialTrace_range_scalar
declarations.statement:
∀ {G : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} {C : Type u_4} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : Fintype A] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  [inst_3 : Fintype C] [inst_4 : DecidableEq A] [inst_5 : DecidableEq B] [inst_6 : DecidableEq C]
  (U : G →* Matrix A A ℂ) (W : G →* Matrix B B ℂ) (Z : G →* Matrix C C ℂ)
  [(FreeEntropy.Twirling.matrixRepresentation U).IsIrreducible],
  (∀ (g : G), (U g).conjTranspose * U g = 1) →
    (∀ (g : G), (W g).conjTranspose * W g = 1) →
      (∀ (g : G), (Z g).conjTranspose * Z g = 1) →
        ∀ (V : Matrix (A × B) C ℂ),
          (∀ (g : G), Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun (x1 x2 : ℂ) => x1 * x2) (U g) (W g) * V = V * Z g) →
            ∃ (c : ℂ), FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.partialTrace (V * V.conjTranspose) = c • 1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CartanBalance.partialTrace_right
declarations.statement:
∀ {A : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [inst_2 : Fintype B] [inst_3 : DecidableEq B]
  (X : Matrix A A ℂ) (P : Matrix (A × B) (A × B) ℂ),
  FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.partialTrace (P * Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun (x1 x2 : ℂ) => x1 * x2) X 1) =
    FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.partialTrace P * X

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.balance_of_scalar
declarations.statement:
∀ {A : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} {C : Type u_3} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : Fintype B] [inst_2 : Fintype C]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq A] [DecidableEq B] [inst_5 : DecidableEq C] [Nonempty A] (V : Matrix (A × B) C ℂ),
  V.conjTranspose * V = 1 →
    ∀ (c : ℝ),
      FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.partialTrace (V * V.conjTranspose) = c • 1 →
        FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.partialTrace (V * V.conjTranspose) = (↑(Fintype.card C) / ↑(Fintype.card A)) • 1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
declarations.statement: {A : Type u_1} → {B : Type u_2} → [DecidableEq A] → [DecidableEq B] → B → Matrix (A × B) A ℂ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding_coisometry
declarations.statement:
∀ {A : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [inst_3 : DecidableEq B]
  [Subsingleton B] (k : B),
  FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k * (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k).conjTranspose = 1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding_isometry
declarations.statement:
∀ {A : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : Fintype B] [inst_2 : DecidableEq A]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq B] (k : B),
  (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k).conjTranspose * FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k = 1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding_phase
declarations.statement:
∀ {A : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : DecidableEq A] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq B] [Subsingleton B] (U : Matrix A A ℂ) (W : Matrix B B ℂ) (k : B),
  Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun (x1 x2 : ℂ) => x1 * x2) U W * FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k =

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CartanChoi.reverseProjector_highest_cyclic
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {A : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} {C : Type u_3} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : DecidableEq A] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq B] [inst_4 : Fintype C] [inst_5 : DecidableEq C] [Nonempty B] [Nonempty C]
  (M : FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.CyclicWeightModel d A) (N : FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.CyclicWeightModel d B)
  (S : FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.CyclicWeightModel d C) (V : Matrix (A × B) C ℂ),
  V.conjTranspose * V = 1 →
    (∀ (i j : Fin d), (M.generators.tensor N.generators).E i j * V = V * S.generators.E i j) →
      ∀ (lam : Fin d → ℂ) (v : B → ℂ),
        v ≠ 0 →
          (∀ (i : Fin d), (N.generators.dual.E i i).mulVec v = lam i • v) →
            (∀ (i j : Fin d), i < j → (N.generators.dual.E i j).mulVec v = 0) →
              FreeEntropy.LiePBW.cyclicSpan N.generators.dual v = ⊤ →
                ∃ (w : C × A → ℂ),
                  w ≠ 0 ∧
                    (FreeEntropy.CartanChoi.reverseProjector V).mulVec w = w ∧
                      (∀ (i : Fin d), ((S.generators.dual.tensor M.generators).E i i).mulVec w = lam i • w) ∧
                        (∀ (i j : Fin d), i < j → ((S.generators.dual.tensor M.generators).E i j).mulVec w = 0) ∧
                          FreeEntropy.LiePBW.cyclicSpan (S.generators.dual.tensor M.generators) w =
                            (FreeEntropy.CartanChoi.reverseProjector V).mulVecLin.range

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CartanChoi.reverseProjector_unique
declarations.statement:

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CartanCloning.ofWeightBlocks
declarations.statement:
{A : Type u_1} →
  {B : Type u_2} →
    {C : Type u_3} →
      {ι : Type u_5} →
        [inst : Fintype A] →
          [inst_1 : Fintype B] →
            [inst_2 : Fintype C] →
              [inst_3 : DecidableEq A] →
                [inst_4 : DecidableEq B] →
                  [inst_5 : DecidableEq C] →
                    (s : Finset ι) →
                      (m n : ι → ℕ) →
                        (pμ pν e : ι → ℝ) →
                          (Pμ : ι → Matrix A A ℂ) →
                            (Pν : ι → Matrix C C ℂ) →
                              (V : Matrix (A × B) C ℂ) →
                                V.conjTranspose * V = 1 →
                                  (k : B) →
                                    (din dout : ℝ) →
                                      0 < din →
                                        0 < dout →
                                          FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.partialTrace (V * V.conjTranspose) =
                                              (dout / din) • 1 →
                                            (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ pμ i) →
                                              (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ pν i) →
                                                (∀ i ∈ s, IsStarProjection (Pμ i)) →
                                                  (∀ i ∈ s, IsStarProjection (Pν i)) →
                                                    (∀ i ∈ s, FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr (Pμ i) = ↑(m i)) →
                                                      (∀ i ∈ s, FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr (Pν i) = ↑(n i)) →
                                                        (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s pμ Pμ).trace = 1 →
                                                          (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s pν Pν).trace = 1 →
                                                            (∀ i ∈ s,
                                                                ‖V * Pν i * V.conjTranspose -
                                                                        FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k *
                                                                            Pμ i *
                                                                          (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                              k).conjTranspose‖ ^
                                                                    2 ≤
                                                                  e i) →
                                                              (∀ i ∈ s,
                                                                  V * V.conjTranspose *
                                                                        (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k *
                                                                            Pμ i *
                                                                          (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                              k).conjTranspose) *
                                                                      (V * V.conjTranspose) =
                                                                    V * Pν i * V.conjTranspose *
                                                                        (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k *
                                                                            Pμ i *
                                                                          (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                              k).conjTranspose) *
                                                                      (V * Pν i * V.conjTranspose)) →
                                                                (∀ i ∈ s,
                                                                    (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                              k).conjTranspose *
                                                                          (V * Pν i * V.conjTranspose) *
                                                                        FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k =
                                                                      (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                              k).conjTranspose *
                                                                          (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k *
                                                                                  Pμ i *
                                                                                (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                                    k).conjTranspose *
                                                                              (V * Pν i * V.conjTranspose) *
                                                                            (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                                  k *
                                                                                Pμ i *
                                                                              (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                                  k).conjTranspose)) *
                                                                        FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k) →
                                                                  FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.BlockRealization s m n pμ
                                                                    pν e (din / dout) A C

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CartanCloning.ofWeightBlocksOfIrreducible
declarations.statement:
{A : Type u_1} →
  {B : Type u_2} →
    {C : Type u_3} →
      {ι : Type u_5} →
        [inst : Fintype A] →
          [inst_1 : Fintype B] →
            [inst_2 : Fintype C] →
              [inst_3 : DecidableEq A] →
                [inst_4 : DecidableEq B] →
                  [inst_5 : DecidableEq C] →
                    {G : Type u_6} →
                      [inst_6 : Group G] →
                        [Nonempty A] →
                          [Nonempty C] →
                            (UA : G →* Matrix A A ℂ) →
                              (UB : G →* Matrix B B ℂ) →
                                (UC : G →* Matrix C C ℂ) →
                                  [(FreeEntropy.Twirling.matrixRepresentation UA).IsIrreducible] →
                                    (∀ (g : G), (UA g).conjTranspose * UA g = 1) →
                                      (∀ (g : G), (UB g).conjTranspose * UB g = 1) →
                                        (∀ (g : G), (UC g).conjTranspose * UC g = 1) →
                                          (s : Finset ι) →
                                            (m n : ι → ℕ) →
                                              (pμ pν e : ι → ℝ) →
                                                (Pμ : ι → Matrix A A ℂ) →
                                                  (Pν : ι → Matrix C C ℂ) →
                                                    (V : Matrix (A × B) C ℂ) →
                                                      V.conjTranspose * V = 1 →
                                                        (k : B) →
                                                          (∀ (g : G),
                                                              Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun (x1 x2 : ℂ) => x1 * x2) (UA g)
                                                                    (UB g) *
                                                                  V =
                                                                V * UC g) →
                                                            (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ pμ i) →
                                                              (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ pν i) →
                                                                (∀ i ∈ s, IsStarProjection (Pμ i)) →
                                                                  (∀ i ∈ s, IsStarProjection (Pν i)) →
                                                                    (∀ i ∈ s,
                                                                        FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr (Pμ i) = ↑(m i)) →
                                                                      (∀ i ∈ s,
                                                                          FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr (Pν i) = ↑(n i)) →
                                                                        (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s pμ
                                                                                Pμ).trace =
                                                                            1 →
                                                                          (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s pν
                                                                                  Pν).trace =
                                                                              1 →
                                                                            (∀ i ∈ s,
                                                                                ‖V * Pν i * V.conjTranspose -
                                                                                        FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                                              k *
                                                                                            Pμ i *
                                                                                          (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                                              k).conjTranspose‖ ^
                                                                                    2 ≤
                                                                                  e i) →
                                                                              (∀ i ∈ s,
                                                                                  V * V.conjTranspose *
                                                                                        (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                                              k *
                                                                                            Pμ i *
                                                                                          (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                                              k).conjTranspose) *
                                                                                      (V * V.conjTranspose) =
                                                                                    V * Pν i * V.conjTranspose *
                                                                                        (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                                              k *
                                                                                            Pμ i *
                                                                                          (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                                              k).conjTranspose) *
                                                                                      (V * Pν i * V.conjTranspose)) →
                                                                                (∀ i ∈ s,
                                                                                    (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                                              k).conjTranspose *
                                                                                          (V * Pν i * V.conjTranspose) *
                                                                                        FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                                          k =
                                                                                      (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                                              k).conjTranspose *
                                                                                          (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                                                    k *
                                                                                                  Pμ i *
                                                                                                (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                                                    k).conjTranspose *
                                                                                              (V * Pν i *
                                                                                                V.conjTranspose) *
                                                                                            (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                                                  k *
                                                                                                Pμ i *
                                                                                              (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                                                  k).conjTranspose)) *
                                                                                        FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                                          k) →
                                                                                  FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.BlockRealization
                                                                                    s m n pμ pν e
                                                                                    (↑(Fintype.card A) /
                                                                                      ↑(Fintype.card C))
                                                                                    A C

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.CyclicWeightModel.actual_orbit_memory_bound
declarations.statement:
∀ {d r : ℕ} {A : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : DecidableEq A] [Nonempty A] [inst_3 : Fintype B]
  [DecidableEq B] {G : Type u_3} [inst_5 : Group G] [inst_6 : TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
  [CompactSpace G] [inst_9 : MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G] (M : FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.CyclicWeightModel d A)
  (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r),
  2 ≤ d →
    ∀ (haar : MeasureTheory.Measure G) [haar.IsMulLeftInvariant] [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure haar]
      (U : G →* Matrix A A ℂ),
      Continuous ⇑U →
        (∀ (g : G), (U g).conjTranspose * U g = 1) →
          ∀ [(FreeEntropy.Twirling.matrixRepresentation U).IsIrreducible] (E : FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel A B)
            (D : FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel B A),
            ↑(Fintype.card A) *
                (1 -
                  (∫ (g : G),
                      FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance
                        (D.toFun
                          (E.toFun
                            ((U g * M.relativeState fun (j : Fin (d - 1)) => s.adjacentRatio ↑j) *
                              (U g).conjTranspose)))
                        ((U g * M.relativeState fun (j : Fin (d - 1)) => s.adjacentRatio ↑j) *
                          (U g).conjTranspose) ∂haar) /
                    (1 - s.qx) ^ (d.choose 2 + 1)) ≤
              ↑(Fintype.card B)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.CyclicWeightModel.actual_uniform_gap
declarations.statement:
∀ {d r : ℕ} {A : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : DecidableEq A] [Nonempty A]
  (M : FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.CyclicWeightModel d A) (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r),
  2 ≤ d →
    0 < (1 - s.qx) ^ (d.choose 2 + 1) ∧
      (1 - s.qx) ^ (d.choose 2 + 1) ≤
        (1 / M.relativeNormalizer fun (j : Fin (d - 1)) => s.adjacentRatio ↑j) -
          s.qx * (1 / M.relativeNormalizer fun (j : Fin (d - 1)) => s.adjacentRatio ↑j)

declarations.statement:

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.CyclicWeightModel.orbitWeights_normalizer
declarations.statement:

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.TensorDecomposition.local_gap
declarations.statement:
∀ {A : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : Fintype B] [inst_2 : DecidableEq A]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq B] {d : ℕ} {κ : Type u_3} [inst_4 : Fintype κ] [inst_5 : DecidableEq κ] {T : κ → Type u_4}
  [inst_6 : (i : κ) → Fintype (T i)] [inst_7 : (i : κ) → DecidableEq (T i)]
  (M : FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.CyclicWeightModel d A) (N : FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.CyclicWeightModel d B)
  (W : FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.TensorDecomposition M N κ T) (delta : Fin (d - 1) → ℕ) (g : ℝ),
  0 ≤ g →
    (∀ (j : Fin (d - 1)),
        delta j ≠ 0 →
          g ≤
            (M.row + N.row) (FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.left j) -
              (M.row + N.row) (FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.right j)) →
      (g + 2) •
          (FreeEntropy.WeightSectors.weightProjector (FreeEntropy.WeightSectors.totalWeight M.weight N.weight)
              (M.row + N.row - FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.offset delta) -
            W.embedding W.top *
                FreeEntropy.WeightSectors.weightProjector (W.constituent W.top).weight
                  (M.row + N.row - FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.offset delta) *
              (W.embedding W.top).conjTranspose) ≤
        FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.casimir (M.row + N.row) • 1 - (M.generators.tensor N.generators).casimir

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.canonicalCartanIsometry_spec
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {A : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} {C : Type u_3} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : DecidableEq A] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq B] [inst_4 : Fintype C] [inst_5 : DecidableEq C] [inst_6 : Nonempty A] [inst_7 : Nonempty B]
  [inst_8 : Nonempty C] (M : FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.CyclicWeightModel d A)
  (N : FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.CyclicWeightModel d B) (S : FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.CyclicWeightModel d C)
  (hrow : S.row = M.row + N.row),
  (FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.canonicalCartanIsometry M N S hrow).conjTranspose *
        FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.canonicalCartanIsometry M N S hrow =
      1 ∧
    (∀ (i j : Fin d),
        (M.generators.tensor N.generators).E i j * FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.canonicalCartanIsometry M N S hrow =
          FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.canonicalCartanIsometry M N S hrow * S.generators.E i j) ∧
      FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.partialTrace
          (FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.canonicalCartanIsometry M N S hrow *
            (FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.canonicalCartanIsometry M N S hrow).conjTranspose) =
        (↑(Fintype.card C) / ↑(Fintype.card A)) • 1

                            (s : Finset ι) →
                              (delta : ι → Fin (d - 1) → ℕ) →
                                (pμ pν : ι → ℝ) →
                                  (D g : ℕ) →
                                    1 ≤ D →
                                      FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.l1 N.row ≤ ↑D →
                                        (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ pμ i) →
                                          (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ pν i) →
                                            (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s pμ fun (i : ι) =>
                                                    FreeEntropy.WeightSectors.weightProjector M.weight
                                                      (M.row - FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.offset (delta i))).trace =
                                                1 →
                                              (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s pν fun (i : ι) =>
                                                      FreeEntropy.WeightSectors.weightProjector
                                                        (FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.constructedTopModel M N).weight
                                                        (M.row + N.row -
                                                          FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.offset (delta i))).trace =
                                                  1 →
                                                (∀ i ∈ s,
                                                    FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.depth (delta i) ≤ g →
                                                      FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.weightMultiplicity M.weight
                                                          (M.row - FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.offset (delta i)) =
                                                        FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.weightMultiplicity
                                                          (FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.constructedTopModel M N).weight
                                                          (M.row + N.row -
                                                            FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.offset (delta i))) →
                                                  (∀ i ∈ s,
                                                      FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.depth (delta i) ≤ g →
                                                        ∀ (j : Fin (d - 1)),
                                                          delta i j ≠ 0 →
                                                            ↑g ≤
                                                              (M.row + N.row) (FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.left j) -
                                                                (M.row + N.row) (FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.right j)) →
                                                    FreeEntropy.TraceCloning.TraceBlockRealization s
                                                      (fun (i : ι) =>
                                                        FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.weightMultiplicity M.weight
                                                          (M.row - FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.offset (delta i)))
                                                      (fun (i : ι) =>
                                                        FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.weightMultiplicity
                                                          (FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.constructedTopModel M N).weight
                                                          (M.row + N.row - FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.offset (delta i)))
                                                      pμ pν
                                                      (fun (i : ι) =>
                                                        min 1
                                                          (2 * ↑(FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.depth (delta i)) * ↑D /
                                                            (↑g + 2)))
                                                      (↑(Fintype.card A) /
                                                        ↑(Fintype.card
                                                            (FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.ConstructedTopSpace M N)))
                                                      A (FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.ConstructedTopSpace M N)

                [inst_4 : Fintype C] →
                  [inst_5 : DecidableEq C] →
                    [Nonempty A] →
                      [Nonempty B] →
                        [Nonempty C] →
                          {ι : Type u_4} →
                            (M : FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.CyclicWeightModel d A) →
                              (N : FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.CyclicWeightModel d B) →
                                (S : FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.CyclicWeightModel d C) →
                                  S.row = M.row + N.row →
                                    (s : Finset ι) →
                                      (delta : ι → Fin (d - 1) → ℕ) →
                                        (pμ pν : ι → ℝ) →
                                          (D g : ℕ) →
                                            1 ≤ D →
                                              FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.l1 N.row ≤ ↑D →
                                                (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ pμ i) →
                                                  (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ pν i) →
                                                    (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s pμ fun (i : ι) =>
                                                            FreeEntropy.WeightSectors.weightProjector M.weight
                                                              (M.row -
                                                                FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.offset (delta i))).trace =
                                                        1 →
                                                      (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s pν fun (i : ι) =>
                                                              FreeEntropy.WeightSectors.weightProjector S.weight
                                                                (M.row + N.row -
                                                                  FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.offset (delta i))).trace =
                                                          1 →
                                                        (∀ i ∈ s,
                                                            FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.depth (delta i) ≤ g →
                                                              FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.weightMultiplicity M.weight
                                                                  (M.row -
                                                                    FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.offset (delta i)) =
                                                                FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.weightMultiplicity S.weight
                                                                  (M.row + N.row -
                                                                    FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.offset (delta i))) →
                                                          (∀ i ∈ s,
                                                              FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.depth (delta i) ≤ g →
                                                                ∀ (j : Fin (d - 1)),
                                                                  delta i j ≠ 0 →
                                                                    ↑g ≤
                                                                      (M.row + N.row)
                                                                          (FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.left j) -
                                                                        (M.row + N.row)
                                                                          (FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.right j)) →
                                                            FreeEntropy.TraceCloning.TraceBlockRealization s
                                                              (fun (i : ι) =>
                                                                FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.weightMultiplicity M.weight
                                                                  (M.row - FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.offset (delta i)))
                                                              (fun (i : ι) =>
                                                                FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.weightMultiplicity S.weight
                                                                  (M.row + N.row -
                                                                    FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.offset (delta i)))
                                                              pμ pν
                                                              (fun (i : ι) =>
                                                                min 1
                                                                  (2 * ↑(FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.depth (delta i)) *
                                                                      ↑D /
                                                                    (↑g + 2)))
                                                              (↑(Fintype.card A) / ↑(Fintype.card C)) A C

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.offsetCoefficient_ratio
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {A : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : DecidableEq A] {B : Type u_2} [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq B] [Nonempty A] (M : FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.CyclicWeightModel d A)
  (N : FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.CyclicWeightModel d B) (s : Finset (Fin (d - 1) → ℕ)),
  M.offsetSupport ⊆ s →
    N.offsetSupport ⊆ s →
      ∀ (ratio : Fin (d - 1) → ℝ),
        (∀ (j : Fin (d - 1)), 0 ≤ ratio j) →
          ∀ (delta : Fin (d - 1) → ℕ),
            N.offsetCoefficient s ratio delta =
              M.relativeNormalizer ratio / N.relativeNormalizer ratio * M.offsetCoefficient s ratio delta
