  (M : FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.CyclicWeightModel d A) (N : FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.CyclicWeightModel d B)
  (S : FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.CyclicWeightModel d C),
  S.row = M.row + N.row →
    ∀ (V : Matrix (A × B) C ℂ),
      V.conjTranspose * V = 1 →
        (∀ (i j : Fin d), (M.generators.tensor N.generators).E i j * V = V * S.generators.E i j) →
          ∀ (T : Matrix (A × B) C ℂ),
            (∀ (i j : Fin d), (M.generators.tensor N.generators).E i j * T = T * S.generators.E i j) →
              ∃ (c : ℂ), T = c • V

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.tensor_intertwiner_weight
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {A : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} {K : Type u_3} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : DecidableEq A] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq B] [inst_4 : Fintype K] [inst_5 : DecidableEq K]
  (M : FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.CyclicWeightModel d A) (N : FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.CyclicWeightModel d B)
  (S : FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.CyclicWeightModel d K) (J : Matrix (A × B) K ℂ),
  (∀ (i j : Fin d), (M.generators.tensor N.generators).E i j * J = J * S.generators.E i j) →
    ∀ (ab : A × B) (k : K), J ab k ≠ 0 → M.weight ab.1 + N.weight ab.2 = S.weight k

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.tensor_top_column_support
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {A : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} {K : Type u_3} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : DecidableEq A] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq B] [inst_4 : Fintype K] [inst_5 : DecidableEq K] [inst_6 : Nonempty A] [inst_7 : Nonempty B]
  [inst_8 : Nonempty K] (M : FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.CyclicWeightModel d A)
  (N : FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.CyclicWeightModel d B) (S : FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.CyclicWeightModel d K)
  (J : Matrix (A × B) K ℂ),
  (∀ (i j : Fin d), (M.generators.tensor N.generators).E i j * J = J * S.generators.E i j) →
    S.row = M.row + N.row → ∀ (ab : A × B), ab ≠ (M.highestBasis, N.highestBasis) → J ab S.highestBasis = 0

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.tensor_top_exists
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {A : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : DecidableEq A] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq B] [Nonempty A] [Nonempty B] {κ : Type u_3} [inst_6 : Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ]
  {T : κ → Type u_4} [inst_8 : (i : κ) → Fintype (T i)] [inst_9 : (i : κ) → DecidableEq (T i)]
  [∀ (i : κ), Nonempty (T i)] (M : FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.CyclicWeightModel d A)
  (N : FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.CyclicWeightModel d B)
  (S : (i : κ) → FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.CyclicWeightModel d (T i)) (J : (i : κ) → Matrix (A × B) (T i) ℂ),
  ∑ i : κ, J i * (J i).conjTranspose = 1 →
    (∀ (i : κ) (a b : Fin d), (M.generators.tensor N.generators).E a b * J i = J i * (S i).generators.E a b) →
      ∃ (i : κ), (S i).row = M.row + N.row

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.tensor_top_not_orthogonal
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {A : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} {K : Type u_3} {L : Type u_4} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : DecidableEq A]
  [inst_2 : Fintype B] [inst_3 : DecidableEq B] [inst_4 : Fintype K] [inst_5 : DecidableEq K] [inst_6 : Fintype L]
  [inst_7 : DecidableEq L] [Nonempty A] [Nonempty B] [Nonempty K] [Nonempty L]
  (M : FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.CyclicWeightModel d A) (N : FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.CyclicWeightModel d B)
  (S : FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.CyclicWeightModel d K) (T : FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.CyclicWeightModel d L)
  (J : Matrix (A × B) K ℂ) (F : Matrix (A × B) L ℂ),
  J.conjTranspose * J = 1 →
    F.conjTranspose * F = 1 →
      (∀ (i j : Fin d), (M.generators.tensor N.generators).E i j * J = J * S.generators.E i j) →
        (∀ (i j : Fin d), (M.generators.tensor N.generators).E i j * F = F * T.generators.E i j) →
          S.row = M.row + N.row → T.row = M.row + N.row → J.conjTranspose * F ≠ 0

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.tensor_top_vector_support
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {A : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : DecidableEq A] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq B] [inst_4 : Nonempty A] [inst_5 : Nonempty B]
  (M : FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.CyclicWeightModel d A) (N : FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.CyclicWeightModel d B)
  (u : A × B → ℂ),
  (∀ (i : Fin d), ((M.generators.tensor N.generators).E i i).mulVec u = ↑((M.row + N.row) i) • u) →
    ∀ (ab : A × B), ab ≠ (M.highestBasis, N.highestBasis) → u ab = 0

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.tensor_weight_deficit
declarations.statement:
∀ {A : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : Fintype B] [inst_2 : DecidableEq A]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq B] {d : ℕ} (M : FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.CyclicWeightModel d A)
  (N : FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.CyclicWeightModel d B) (k : B),
  N.weight k = N.row →
    ∀ (delta : Fin (d - 1) → ℕ),
      have Q :=
        FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k *
            FreeEntropy.WeightSectors.weightProjector M.weight (M.row - FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.offset delta) *
          (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k).conjTranspose;
      Q * (FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.casimir (M.row + N.row) • 1 - (M.generators.tensor N.generators).casimir) * Q =
        (2 * FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.dot (FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.offset delta) N.row) • Q

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.trace_weightProjector
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_5} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (w : H → Fin d → ℝ) (lam : Fin d → ℝ),
  FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr (FreeEntropy.WeightSectors.weightProjector w lam) =
    ↑(FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.weightMultiplicity w lam)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.trivial_environment_maps_identity
declarations.statement:
∀ {A : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : DecidableEq A] [Nonempty A] [inst_3 : Fintype B]
  [inst_4 : DecidableEq B] [Nonempty B] [Subsingleton B] (V : Matrix (A × B) A ℂ) (k : B) (a : ℂ),
  a * star a = 1 →
    V = a • FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k →
      ∀ (X : Matrix A A ℂ),
        FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.sectorMap (↑(Fintype.card A)) (↑(Fintype.card A)) V X = X ∧
          FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.reverseMap V X = X

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.weightDiagonal_mul_projector
declarations.statement:
∀ {A : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : DecidableEq A] {I : Type u_3} (w : A → I → ℝ) (lam : I → ℝ) (i : I),
  FreeEntropy.WeightSectors.weightDiagonal w i * FreeEntropy.WeightSectors.weightProjector w lam =
    lam i • FreeEntropy.WeightSectors.weightProjector w lam

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.weightMultiplicity
declarations.statement: {d : ℕ} → {H : Type u_5} → [Fintype H] → (H → Fin d → ℝ) → (Fin d → ℝ) → ℕ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.weight_multiplicity_add_le
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {A : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} {C : Type u_3} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : DecidableEq A] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq B] [inst_4 : Fintype C] [inst_5 : DecidableEq C] [Nonempty A] [Nonempty B] [Nonempty C]
  (M : FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.CyclicWeightModel d A) (N : FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.CyclicWeightModel d B)
  (S : FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.CyclicWeightModel d C),
  S.row = M.row + N.row →
    ∀ (wt : Fin d → ℝ), Fintype.card { a : A // M.weight a = wt } ≤ Fintype.card { c : C // S.weight c = wt + N.row }

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CartanTraceCloning.ofCappedCasimirWeightBlocks
declarations.statement:
{A : Type u_1} →
  {B : Type u_2} →
    {C : Type u_3} →
      {ι : Type u_4} →
        [inst : Fintype A] →
          [inst_1 : Fintype B] →
            [inst_2 : Fintype C] →
              [inst_3 : DecidableEq A] →
                [inst_4 : DecidableEq B] →
                  [inst_5 : DecidableEq C] →
                    [Nonempty A] →
                      [Nonempty C] →
                        (s : Finset ι) →
                          (depth m n : ι → ℕ) →
                            (pμ pν : ι → ℝ) →
                              (D g : ℕ) →
                                1 ≤ D →
                                  (Pμ : ι → Matrix A A ℂ) →
                                    (Pν : ι → Matrix C C ℂ) →
                                      (V : Matrix (A × B) C ℂ) →
                                        V.conjTranspose * V = 1 →
                                          (k : B) →
                                            FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.partialTrace (V * V.conjTranspose) =
                                                (↑(Fintype.card C) / ↑(Fintype.card A)) • 1 →
                                              (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ pμ i) →
                                                (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ pν i) →
                                                  (∀ i ∈ s, IsStarProjection (Pμ i)) →
                                                    (∀ i ∈ s, IsStarProjection (Pν i)) →
                                                      (∀ i ∈ s, FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr (Pμ i) = ↑(m i)) →
                                                        (∀ i ∈ s, FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr (Pν i) = ↑(n i)) →
                                                          (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s pμ Pμ).trace = 1 →
                                                            (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s pν Pν).trace = 1 →
                                                              (K S : ι → Matrix (A × B) (A × B) ℂ) →
                                                                (deficit : ι → ℝ) →
                                                                  (∀ i ∈ s, depth i ≤ g → m i = n i) →
                                                                    (∀ i ∈ s,
                                                                        depth i ≤ g →
                                                                          (↑g + 2) •
                                                                              (S i - V * Pν i * V.conjTranspose) ≤
                                                                            K i) →
                                                                      (∀ i ∈ s,
                                                                          depth i ≤ g →
                                                                            FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k *
                                                                                      Pμ i *
                                                                                    (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                                        k).conjTranspose *
                                                                                  S i *
                                                                                (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                                      k *
                                                                                    Pμ i *
                                                                                  (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                                      k).conjTranspose) =
                                                                              FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                                    k *
                                                                                  Pμ i *
                                                                                (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                                    k).conjTranspose) →
                                                                        (∀ i ∈ s,
                                                                            depth i ≤ g →
                                                                              FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                                          k *
                                                                                        Pμ i *
                                                                                      (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                                          k).conjTranspose *
                                                                                    K i *
                                                                                  (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                                        k *
                                                                                      Pμ i *
                                                                                    (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                                        k).conjTranspose) ≤
                                                                                deficit i •
                                                                                  (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                                        k *
                                                                                      Pμ i *
                                                                                    (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                                        k).conjTranspose)) →
                                                                          (∀ i ∈ s,
                                                                              depth i ≤ g →
                                                                                deficit i ≤ 2 * ↑(depth i) * ↑D) →
                                                                            (∀ i ∈ s,
                                                                                V * V.conjTranspose *
                                                                                      (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                                            k *
                                                                                          Pμ i *
                                                                                        (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                                            k).conjTranspose) *
                                                                                    (V * V.conjTranspose) =
                                                                                  V * Pν i * V.conjTranspose *
                                                                                      (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                                            k *
                                                                                          Pμ i *
                                                                                        (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                                            k).conjTranspose) *
                                                                                    (V * Pν i * V.conjTranspose)) →
                                                                              (∀ i ∈ s,
                                                                                  (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                                            k).conjTranspose *
                                                                                        (V * Pν i * V.conjTranspose) *
                                                                                      FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                                        k =
                                                                                    (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                                            k).conjTranspose *
                                                                                        (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                                                  k *
                                                                                                Pμ i *
                                                                                              (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                                                  k).conjTranspose *
                                                                                            (V * Pν i *
                                                                                              V.conjTranspose) *
                                                                                          (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                                                k *
                                                                                              Pμ i *
                                                                                            (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                                                k).conjTranspose)) *
                                                                                      FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                                        k) →
                                                                                FreeEntropy.TraceCloning.TraceBlockRealization
                                                                                  s m n pμ pν
                                                                                  (fun (i : ι) =>
                                                                                    min 1
                                                                                      (2 * ↑(depth i) * ↑D / (↑g + 2)))
                                                                                  (↑(Fintype.card A) /
                                                                                    ↑(Fintype.card C))
                                                                                  A C

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CartanTraceCloning.ofCappedCasimirWeightBlocksOfIrreducible
declarations.statement:
{A : Type u_1} →
  {B : Type u_2} →
    {C : Type u_3} →
      {ι : Type u_5} →
        [inst : Fintype A] →
          [inst_1 : Fintype B] →
            [inst_2 : Fintype C] →
              [inst_3 : DecidableEq A] →
                [inst_4 : DecidableEq B] →
                  [inst_5 : DecidableEq C] →
                    {G : Type u_6} →
                      [inst_6 : Group G] →
                        [Nonempty A] →
                          [Nonempty C] →
                            (UA : G →* Matrix A A ℂ) →
                              (UB : G →* Matrix B B ℂ) →
                                (UC : G →* Matrix C C ℂ) →
                                  [(FreeEntropy.Twirling.matrixRepresentation UA).IsIrreducible] →
                                    (∀ (g : G), (UA g).conjTranspose * UA g = 1) →
                                      (∀ (g : G), (UB g).conjTranspose * UB g = 1) →
                                        (∀ (g : G), (UC g).conjTranspose * UC g = 1) →
                                          (s : Finset ι) →
                                            (depth m n : ι → ℕ) →
                                              (pμ pν : ι → ℝ) →
                                                (D g : ℕ) →
                                                  1 ≤ D →
                                                    (Pμ : ι → Matrix A A ℂ) →
                                                      (Pν : ι → Matrix C C ℂ) →
                                                        (V : Matrix (A × B) C ℂ) →
                                                          V.conjTranspose * V = 1 →
                                                            (k : B) →
                                                              (∀ (g : G),
                                                                  Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun (x1 x2 : ℂ) => x1 * x2)
                                                                        (UA g) (UB g) *
                                                                      V =
                                                                    V * UC g) →
                                                                (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ pμ i) →
                                                                  (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ pν i) →
                                                                    (∀ i ∈ s, IsStarProjection (Pμ i)) →
                                                                      (∀ i ∈ s, IsStarProjection (Pν i)) →
                                                                        (∀ i ∈ s,
                                                                            FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr (Pμ i) =
                                                                              ↑(m i)) →
                                                                          (∀ i ∈ s,
                                                                              FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr (Pν i) =
                                                                                ↑(n i)) →
                                                                            (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s pμ
                                                                                    Pμ).trace =
                                                                                1 →
                                                                              (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s pν
                                                                                      Pν).trace =
                                                                                  1 →
                                                                                (K S : ι → Matrix (A × B) (A × B) ℂ) →
                                                                                  (deficit : ι → ℝ) →
                                                                                    (∀ i ∈ s, depth i ≤ g → m i = n i) →
                                                                                      (∀ i ∈ s,
                                                                                          depth i ≤ g →
                                                                                            (↑g + 2) • (S i - ⋯ * ⋯) ≤
                                                                                              K i) →
                                                                                        (∀ i ∈ s,
                                                                                            depth i ≤ g →
                                                                                              ⋯ * S i * (⋯ * ⋯) =
                                                                                                FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                                                      k *
                                                                                                    Pμ i *
                                                                                                  (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                                                      k).conjTranspose) →
                                                                                          (∀ i ∈ s,
                                                                                              depth i ≤ g →
                                                                                                ⋯ * ⋯ ≤ deficit i • ⋯) →
                                                                                            (∀ i ∈ s,
                                                                                                depth i ≤ g →
                                                                                                  deficit i ≤
                                                                                                    2 * ↑(depth i) *
                                                                                                      ↑D) →
                                                                                              (∀ i ∈ s, ⋯ = ⋯) →
                                                                                                (∀ i ∈ s, ⋯) →
                                                                                                  FreeEntropy.TraceCloning.TraceBlockRealization
                                                                                                    s m n pμ pν
                                                                                                    (fun (i : ι) => ⋯)
                                                                                                    (↑(Fintype.card A) /
                                                                                                      ↑(Fintype.card C))
                                                                                                    A C

declarations.statement:

                          (Pμ : ι → Matrix A A ℂ) →
                            (Pν : ι → Matrix C C ℂ) →
                              (V : Matrix (A × B) C ℂ) →
                                V.conjTranspose * V = 1 →

                                    (din dout : ℝ) →
                                      0 < din →
                                        0 < dout →
                                          FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.partialTrace (V * V.conjTranspose) =
                                              (dout / din) • 1 →

                                                                          Pμ i *
                                                                        (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                            k).conjTranspose) ≤

                                                                          (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k *
                                                                              Pμ i *
                                                                            (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                                k).conjTranspose) *
                                                                        (V * V.conjTranspose) =
                                                                      V * Pν i * V.conjTranspose *
                                                                          (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k *
                                                                              Pμ i *
                                                                            (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                                k).conjTranspose) *
                                                                        (V * Pν i * V.conjTranspose)) →
                                                                  (∀ i ∈ s,
                                                                      (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                                k).conjTranspose *
                                                                            (V * Pν i * V.conjTranspose) *
                                                                          FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k =
                                                                        (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                                k).conjTranspose *
                                                                            (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                                      k *
                                                                                    Pμ i *
                                                                                  (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                                      k).conjTranspose *
                                                                                (V * Pν i * V.conjTranspose) *
                                                                              (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                                    k *
                                                                                  Pμ i *
                                                                                (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                                    k).conjTranspose)) *
                                                                          FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k) →
                                                                    FreeEntropy.TraceCloning.TraceBlockRealization s m n
                                                                      pμ pν e (din / dout) A C

                                      0 < din →
                                        0 < dout →
                                          FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.partialTrace (V * V.conjTranspose) =
                                              (dout / din) • 1 →
                                            (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ pμ i) →
                                              (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ pν i) →
                                                (∀ i ∈ s, IsStarProjection (Pμ i)) →
                                                  (∀ i ∈ s, IsStarProjection (Pν i)) →
                                                    (∀ i ∈ s, FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr (Pμ i) = ↑(m i)) →
                                                      (∀ i ∈ s, FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr (Pν i) = ↑(n i)) →
                                                        (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s pμ Pμ).trace = 1 →
                                                          (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s pν Pν).trace = 1 →
                                                            (K S : ι → Matrix (A × B) (A × B) ℂ) →
                                                              (gap deficit : ι → ℝ) →
                                                                (∀ i ∈ s, e i < 1 → m i = n i) →
                                                                  (∀ i ∈ s, e i < 1 → 0 < gap i) →
                                                                    (∀ i ∈ s,
                                                                        e i < 1 →
                                                                          gap i • (S i - V * Pν i * V.conjTranspose) ≤
                                                                            K i) →
                                                                      (∀ i ∈ s,
                                                                          e i < 1 →
                                                                            FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k *
                                                                                      Pμ i *
                                                                                    (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                                        k).conjTranspose *
                                                                                  S i *
                                                                                (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                                      k *
                                                                                    Pμ i *
                                                                                  (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                                      k).conjTranspose) =
                                                                              FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                                    k *
                                                                                  Pμ i *
                                                                                (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                                    k).conjTranspose) →
                                                                        (∀ i ∈ s,
                                                                            e i < 1 →
                                                                              FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                                          k *
                                                                                        Pμ i *
                                                                                      (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                                          k).conjTranspose *
                                                                                    K i *
                                                                                  (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                                        k *
                                                                                      Pμ i *
                                                                                    (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                                        k).conjTranspose) ≤
                                                                                deficit i •
                                                                                  (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                                        k *
                                                                                      Pμ i *
                                                                                    (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                                        k).conjTranspose)) →
                                                                          (∀ i ∈ s, e i < 1 → deficit i / gap i ≤ e i) →
                                                                            (∀ i ∈ s,
                                                                                V * V.conjTranspose *
                                                                                      (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                                            k *
                                                                                          Pμ i *
                                                                                        (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                                            k).conjTranspose) *
                                                                                    (V * V.conjTranspose) =
                                                                                  V * Pν i * V.conjTranspose *
                                                                                      (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                                            k *
                                                                                          Pμ i *
                                                                                        (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                                            k).conjTranspose) *
                                                                                    (V * Pν i * V.conjTranspose)) →
                                                                              (∀ i ∈ s,
                                                                                  (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                                            k).conjTranspose *
                                                                                        (V * Pν i * V.conjTranspose) *
                                                                                      FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                                        k =
                                                                                    (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                                            k).conjTranspose *
                                                                                        (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                                                  k *
                                                                                                Pμ i *
                                                                                              (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                                                  k).conjTranspose *
                                                                                            (V * Pν i *
                                                                                              V.conjTranspose) *
                                                                                          (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                                                k *
                                                                                              Pμ i *
                                                                                            (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                                                k).conjTranspose)) *
                                                                                      FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                                        k) →
                                                                                FreeEntropy.TraceCloning.TraceBlockRealization
                                                                                  s m n pμ pν e (din / dout) A C

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CartanTraceCloning.ofWeightBlocksOfCasimirOfIrreducible
declarations.statement:
{A : Type u_1} →
  {B : Type u_2} →
    {C : Type u_3} →
      {ι : Type u_5} →
        [inst : Fintype A] →
          [inst_1 : Fintype B] →
            [inst_2 : Fintype C] →
              [inst_3 : DecidableEq A] →
                [inst_4 : DecidableEq B] →
                  [inst_5 : DecidableEq C] →
                    {G : Type u_6} →
                      [inst_6 : Group G] →
                        [Nonempty A] →
                          [Nonempty C] →
                            (UA : G →* Matrix A A ℂ) →
                              (UB : G →* Matrix B B ℂ) →
                                (UC : G →* Matrix C C ℂ) →
                                  [(FreeEntropy.Twirling.matrixRepresentation UA).IsIrreducible] →
                                    (∀ (g : G), (UA g).conjTranspose * UA g = 1) →
                                      (∀ (g : G), (UB g).conjTranspose * UB g = 1) →
                                        (∀ (g : G), (UC g).conjTranspose * UC g = 1) →
                                          (s : Finset ι) →
                                            (m n : ι → ℕ) →
                                              (pμ pν e : ι → ℝ) →
                                                (Pμ : ι → Matrix A A ℂ) →
                                                  (Pν : ι → Matrix C C ℂ) →
                                                    (V : Matrix (A × B) C ℂ) →
                                                      V.conjTranspose * V = 1 →
                                                        (k : B) →
                                                          (∀ (g : G),
                                                              Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun (x1 x2 : ℂ) => x1 * x2) (UA g)
                                                                    (UB g) *
                                                                  V =
                                                                V * UC g) →
                                                            (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ pμ i) →
                                                              (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ pν i) →
                                                                (∀ i ∈ s, IsStarProjection (Pμ i)) →
                                                                  (∀ i ∈ s, IsStarProjection (Pν i)) →
                                                                    (∀ i ∈ s,
                                                                        FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr (Pμ i) = ↑(m i)) →
                                                                      (∀ i ∈ s,
                                                                          FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr (Pν i) = ↑(n i)) →
                                                                        (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s pμ
                                                                                Pμ).trace =
                                                                            1 →
                                                                          (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s pν
                                                                                  Pν).trace =
                                                                              1 →
                                                                            (K S : ι → Matrix (A × B) (A × B) ℂ) →
                                                                              (gap deficit : ι → ℝ) →
                                                                                (∀ i ∈ s, e i < 1 → m i = n i) →
                                                                                  (∀ i ∈ s, e i < 1 → 0 < gap i) →
                                                                                    (∀ i ∈ s,
                                                                                        e i < 1 →
                                                                                          gap i •
                                                                                              (S i -
                                                                                                V * Pν i *
                                                                                                  V.conjTranspose) ≤
                                                                                            K i) →
                                                                                      (∀ i ∈ s,
                                                                                          e i < 1 →
                                                                                            ⋯ * ⋯ * S i *
                                                                                                (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                                                      k *
                                                                                                    Pμ i *
                                                                                                  (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                                                      k).conjTranspose) =
                                                                                              FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                                                    k *
                                                                                                  Pμ i *
                                                                                                (FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding
                                                                                                    k).conjTranspose) →
                                                                                        (∀ i ∈ s,
                                                                                            e i < 1 →
                                                                                              ⋯ * K i * (⋯ * ⋯) ≤
                                                                                                deficit i • (⋯ * ⋯)) →
                                                                                          (∀ i ∈ s,
                                                                                              e i < 1 →
                                                                                                deficit i / gap i ≤
                                                                                                  e i) →
                                                                                            (∀ i ∈ s, ⋯ * ⋯ = ⋯ * ⋯) →
                                                                                              (∀ i ∈ s, ⋯ = ⋯) →
                                                                                                FreeEntropy.TraceCloning.TraceBlockRealization
                                                                                                  s m n pμ pν e
                                                                                                  (↑(Fintype.card A) /
                                                                                                    ↑(Fintype.card C))
                                                                                                  A C

declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (nu chi lam : Fin d → ℝ) (c b delta : Fin (d - 1) → ℕ),
  nu - chi = FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.offset c →

      nu - lam = FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.offset delta → ∀ (j : Fin (d - 1)), c j ≤ delta j

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CasimirDecomposition.local_gap_of_cyclic_weight_decomposition
declarations.statement:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {H : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [inst_2 : Fintype H] [inst_3 : DecidableEq H]
  {B : ι → Type u_3} [inst_4 : (i : ι) → Fintype (B i)] [inst_5 : (i : ι) → DecidableEq (B i)] {d : ℕ}
  (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H) (Ri : (i : ι) → FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d (B i))
  (V : (i : ι) → Matrix H (B i) ℂ) (w : H → Fin d → ℝ) (wi : (i : ι) → B i → Fin d → ℝ)
  (highest : (i : ι) → Matrix (B i) Unit ℂ) (chi : ι → Fin d → ℝ) (nu lam : Fin d → ℝ) (coeff : ι → Fin (d - 1) → ℕ)
  (remaining : (i : ι) → B i → Fin (d - 1) → ℕ) (delta : Fin (d - 1) → ℕ) (top : ι) (g : ℝ),
  0 ≤ g →
    ∑ i : ι, V i * (V i).conjTranspose = 1 →
      (∀ (i : ι) (a b : Fin d), R.E a b * V i = V i * (Ri i).E a b) →
        (∀ (j : Fin d), R.E j j = FreeEntropy.WeightSectors.weightDiagonal w j) →
          (∀ (i : ι) (j : Fin d), (Ri i).E j j = FreeEntropy.WeightSectors.weightDiagonal (wi i) j) →
            (∀ (i : ι) (j : Fin d), (Ri i).E j j * highest i = chi i j • highest i) →
              (∀ (i : ι) (a b : Fin d), a < b → (Ri i).E a b * highest i = 0) →
                (∀ (i : ι), (Ri i).cyclicSpan (highest i) = ⊤) →
                  chi top = nu →
                    (∀ (i : ι), chi i = nu → i = top) →
                      (∀ (i : ι), nu - chi i = FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.offset (coeff i)) →
                        (∀ (i : ι) (k : B i), chi i - wi i k = FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.offset (remaining i k)) →
                          nu - lam = FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.offset delta →
                            (∀ (j : Fin (d - 1)),
                                nu (FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.right j) ≤ nu (FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.left j)) →
                              (∀ (i : ι) (j : Fin (d - 1)),
                                  chi i (FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.right j) ≤
                                    chi i (FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.left j)) →
                                (∀ (j : Fin (d - 1)),
                                    delta j ≠ 0 →
                                      g ≤
                                        nu (FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.left j) -
                                          nu (FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.right j)) →
                                  (g + 2) •
                                      (FreeEntropy.WeightSectors.weightProjector w lam -
                                        V top * FreeEntropy.WeightSectors.weightProjector (wi top) lam *
                                          (V top).conjTranspose) ≤
                                    FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.casimir nu • 1 - R.casimir

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CasimirDecomposition.local_gap_of_eigen_embeddings
declarations.statement:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {H : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [inst_2 : Fintype H] [inst_3 : DecidableEq H]
  {B : ι → Type u_3} [inst_4 : (i : ι) → Fintype (B i)] [(i : ι) → DecidableEq (B i)] (C S : Matrix H H ℂ)
  (V : (i : ι) → Matrix H (B i) ℂ) (P : (i : ι) → Matrix (B i) (B i) ℂ) (c : ι → ℝ) (top : ι) (gap : ℝ),
  0 ≤ gap →
    ∑ i : ι, V i * (V i).conjTranspose = 1 →
      (∀ (i : ι), C * V i = c i • V i) →
        (∀ (i : ι), S * V i = V i * P i) →
          (∀ (i : ι), IsStarProjection (P i)) →
            (∀ (i : ι), c i ≤ c top) →
              (∀ (i : ι), i ≠ top → P i ≠ 0 → gap ≤ c top - c i) →
                gap • (S - V top * P top * (V top).conjTranspose) ≤ c top • 1 - C

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CasimirDecomposition.local_gap_of_highest_weights
declarations.statement:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {H : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [inst_2 : Fintype H] [inst_3 : DecidableEq H]
  {B : ι → Type u_3} [inst_4 : (i : ι) → Fintype (B i)] [(i : ι) → DecidableEq (B i)] {d : ℕ} (C S : Matrix H H ℂ)
  (V : (i : ι) → Matrix H (B i) ℂ) (P : (i : ι) → Matrix (B i) (B i) ℂ) (chi : ι → Fin d → ℝ) (nu : Fin d → ℝ)
  (coeff : ι → Fin (d - 1) → ℕ) (top : ι) (g : ℝ),
  0 ≤ g →
    ∑ i : ι, V i * (V i).conjTranspose = 1 →
      (∀ (i : ι), C * V i = FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.casimir (chi i) • V i) →
        (∀ (i : ι), S * V i = V i * P i) →
          (∀ (i : ι), IsStarProjection (P i)) →
            chi top = nu →
              (∀ (i : ι), nu - chi i = FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.offset (coeff i)) →
                (∀ (j : Fin (d - 1)),
                    nu (FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.right j) ≤ nu (FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.left j)) →
                  (∀ (i : ι) (j : Fin (d - 1)),
                      chi i (FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.right j) ≤ chi i (FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.left j)) →
                    (∀ (i : ι), i ≠ top → P i ≠ 0 → ∃ (j : Fin (d - 1)), coeff i j ≠ 0) →
                      (∀ (i : ι),
                          i ≠ top →
                            P i ≠ 0 →
                              ∀ (j : Fin (d - 1)),
                                coeff i j ≠ 0 →
                                  g ≤
                                    nu (FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.left j) - nu (FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.right j)) →
                        (g + 2) • (S - V top * P top * (V top).conjTranspose) ≤
                          FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.casimir nu • 1 - C

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CasimirDecomposition.operator_eq_sum_of_eigen_embeddings
declarations.statement:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {H : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [inst_2 : Fintype H] [inst_3 : DecidableEq H]
  {B : ι → Type u_3} [inst_4 : (i : ι) → Fintype (B i)] [(i : ι) → DecidableEq (B i)] (C : Matrix H H ℂ)
  (V : (i : ι) → Matrix H (B i) ℂ) (c : ι → ℝ),
  ∑ i : ι, V i * (V i).conjTranspose = 1 →
    (∀ (i : ι), C * V i = c i • V i) → C = ∑ i : ι, c i • (V i * (V i).conjTranspose)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CasimirDecomposition.prefix_offset
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (c : Fin (d - 1) → ℕ) (j : Fin (d - 1)),
  ∑ i : Fin d with ↑i ≤ ↑j, FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.offset c i = ↑(c j)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CasimirDecomposition.sector_eq_sum_of_intertwining
declarations.statement:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {H : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [inst_2 : Fintype H] [inst_3 : DecidableEq H]
  {B : ι → Type u_3} [inst_4 : (i : ι) → Fintype (B i)] [(i : ι) → DecidableEq (B i)] (S : Matrix H H ℂ)
  (V : (i : ι) → Matrix H (B i) ℂ) (P : (i : ι) → Matrix (B i) (B i) ℂ),
  ∑ i : ι, V i * (V i).conjTranspose = 1 →
    (∀ (i : ι), S * V i = V i * P i) → S = ∑ i : ι, V i * P i * (V i).conjTranspose

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CasimirTrace.forward_traceDeficit_le_of_gap
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] {P Q A : Matrix H H ℂ},
  IsStarProjection P →
    IsStarProjection Q →
      FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr P = FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr Q →
        ∀ {gap deficit : ℝ},
          0 < gap →
            gap • (1 - P) ≤ A →
              Q * A * Q ≤ deficit • Q →
                FreeEntropy.CasimirTrace.traceDeficit P Q ≤ deficit / gap * FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr P

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CasimirTrace.forward_traceDeficit_le_of_local_gap
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [DecidableEq H] {P Q S A : Matrix H H ℂ},
  IsStarProjection P →
    IsStarProjection Q →
      FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr P = FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr Q →
        Q * S * Q = Q →
          ∀ {gap deficit : ℝ},
            0 < gap →
              gap • (S - P) ≤ A →
                Q * A * Q ≤ deficit • Q →
                  FreeEntropy.CasimirTrace.traceDeficit P Q ≤ deficit / gap * FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr P

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CasimirTrace.local_spectral_gap_of_eigenvalues
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] {A : Matrix H H ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (s t : Finset H),
  s ⊆ t →
    ∀ (gap : ℝ),
      (∀ (i : H), 0 ≤ hA.eigenvalues i) →
        (∀ i ∈ t, i ∉ s → gap ≤ hA.eigenvalues i) →
          gap • (FreeEntropy.CasimirTrace.eigenSector hA t - FreeEntropy.CasimirTrace.eigenSector hA s) ≤ A

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CasimirTrace.spectral_gap_of_eigenvalues
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] {A : Matrix H H ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (s : Finset H)
  (gap : ℝ),
  (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ hA.eigenvalues i) →
    (∀ i ∉ s, gap ≤ hA.eigenvalues i) → gap • (1 - FreeEntropy.CasimirTrace.eigenSector hA s) ≤ A

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CasimirTrace.traceDeficit
declarations.statement: {H : Type u_1} → [Fintype H] → Matrix H H ℂ → Matrix H H ℂ → ℝ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CasimirTrace.traceDeficit_eq
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [DecidableEq H] {P Q : Matrix H H ℂ},
  IsStarProjection P →
    FreeEntropy.CasimirTrace.traceDeficit P Q = FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr P - FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr (P * Q)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CasimirTrace.traceDeficit_eq_reverse_of_trace_eq
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [DecidableEq H] {P Q : Matrix H H ℂ},
  IsStarProjection P →
    IsStarProjection Q →
      FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr P = FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr Q →
        FreeEntropy.CasimirTrace.traceDeficit P Q = FreeEntropy.CasimirTrace.traceDeficit Q P

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CasimirTrace.traceDeficit_le_trace
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [DecidableEq H] {P Q : Matrix H H ℂ},
  IsStarProjection P → IsStarProjection Q → FreeEntropy.CasimirTrace.traceDeficit P Q ≤ FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr P

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CasimirTrace.traceDeficit_nonneg
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [DecidableEq H] {P Q : Matrix H H ℂ},
  IsStarProjection P → IsStarProjection Q → 0 ≤ FreeEntropy.CasimirTrace.traceDeficit P Q

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CasimirTrace.traceDeficit_sub_reverse
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [DecidableEq H] {P Q : Matrix H H ℂ},
  IsStarProjection P →
    IsStarProjection Q →
      FreeEntropy.CasimirTrace.traceDeficit P Q - FreeEntropy.CasimirTrace.traceDeficit Q P =
        FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr P - FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr Q

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CasimirTrace.traceDeficits_le_min_of_compression
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] {P Q A : Matrix H H ℂ},
  IsStarProjection P →
    IsStarProjection Q →
      FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr P = FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr Q →
        ∀ {gap deficit : ℝ},
          0 < gap →
            gap • (1 - P) ≤ A →
              Q * A * Q = deficit • Q →
                FreeEntropy.CasimirTrace.traceDeficit P Q ≤ min 1 (deficit / gap) * FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr P ∧
                  FreeEntropy.CasimirTrace.traceDeficit Q P ≤ min 1 (deficit / gap) * FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr Q

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CasimirTrace.traceDeficits_le_min_of_eigenvalues
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] {A Q : Matrix H H ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (s : Finset H),
  IsStarProjection Q →
    ∀ (gap deficit : ℝ),
      0 < gap →
        (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ hA.eigenvalues i) →
          (∀ i ∉ s, gap ≤ hA.eigenvalues i) →
            FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr Q = ↑s.card →
              Q * A * Q = deficit • Q →
                FreeEntropy.CasimirTrace.traceDeficit (FreeEntropy.CasimirTrace.eigenSector hA s) Q ≤
                    min 1 (deficit / gap) * FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr (FreeEntropy.CasimirTrace.eigenSector hA s) ∧
                  FreeEntropy.CasimirTrace.traceDeficit Q (FreeEntropy.CasimirTrace.eigenSector hA s) ≤
                    min 1 (deficit / gap) * FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr Q

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CasimirTrace.traceDeficits_le_min_of_local_eigenvalues
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] {A Q : Matrix H H ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (s t : Finset H),
  s ⊆ t →
    IsStarProjection Q →
      ∀ (gap deficit : ℝ),
        0 < gap →
          (∀ (i : H), 0 ≤ hA.eigenvalues i) →
            (∀ i ∈ t, i ∉ s → gap ≤ hA.eigenvalues i) →
              FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr Q = ↑s.card →
                Q * FreeEntropy.CasimirTrace.eigenSector hA t * Q = Q →
                  Q * A * Q ≤ deficit • Q →
                    FreeEntropy.CasimirTrace.traceDeficit (FreeEntropy.CasimirTrace.eigenSector hA s) Q ≤
                        min 1 (deficit / gap) * FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr (FreeEntropy.CasimirTrace.eigenSector hA s) ∧
                      FreeEntropy.CasimirTrace.traceDeficit Q (FreeEntropy.CasimirTrace.eigenSector hA s) ≤
                        min 1 (deficit / gap) * FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr Q

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CasimirTrace.traceDeficits_le_min_of_local_gap
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [DecidableEq H] {P Q S A : Matrix H H ℂ},
  IsStarProjection P →
    IsStarProjection Q →
      FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr P = FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr Q →
        Q * S * Q = Q →
          ∀ {gap deficit : ℝ},
            0 < gap →
              gap • (S - P) ≤ A →
                Q * A * Q ≤ deficit • Q →
                  FreeEntropy.CasimirTrace.traceDeficit P Q ≤ min 1 (deficit / gap) * FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr P ∧
                    FreeEntropy.CasimirTrace.traceDeficit Q P ≤ min 1 (deficit / gap) * FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr Q

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CasimirTrace.trace_mono
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [DecidableEq H] {A B : Matrix H H ℂ},
  A ≤ B → FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr A ≤ FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr B

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CasimirTrace.trace_projection_sandwich
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [DecidableEq H] {P : Matrix H H ℂ},
  IsStarProjection P → ∀ (A : Matrix H H ℂ), FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr (P * A * P) = FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr (P * A)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.casimir
declarations.statement: {d : ℕ} → (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.casimir_add
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (μ ω : Fin d → ℝ),
  FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.casimir (μ + ω) =
    FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.casimir μ + FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.casimir ω + 2 * FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.dot μ ω

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.casimir_deficit
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (μ ω δ : Fin d → ℝ),
  FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.casimir (μ + ω) - FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.casimir μ -
        FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.casimir ω -
      2 * FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.dot (μ - δ) ω =
    2 * FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.dot δ ω

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.casimir_deficit_bounds
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (μ ω : Fin d → ℝ) (c : Fin (d - 1) → ℕ),
  (∀ (j : Fin (d - 1)), ω (FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.right j) ≤ ω (FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.left j)) →
    0 ≤
        FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.casimir (μ + ω) - FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.casimir μ -
            FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.casimir ω -
          2 * FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.dot (μ - FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.offset c) ω ∧
      FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.casimir (μ + ω) - FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.casimir μ -
            FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.casimir ω -
          2 * FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.dot (μ - FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.offset c) ω ≤
        2 * ↑(FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.depth c) * FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.l1 ω

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.casimir_difference
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (ν χ : Fin d → ℝ) (c : Fin (d - 1) → ℕ),
  ν - χ = FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.offset c →
    FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.casimir ν - FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.casimir χ =
      ∑ j : Fin (d - 1),
        ↑(c j) *
          (ν (FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.left j) - ν (FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.right j) +
              (χ (FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.left j) - χ (FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.right j)) +
            2)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.casimir_gap
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (ν χ : Fin d → ℝ) (c : Fin (d - 1) → ℕ) (g : ℝ),
  0 ≤ g →
    (∃ (j : Fin (d - 1)), c j ≠ 0) →
      ν - χ = FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.offset c →
        (∀ (j : Fin (d - 1)),
            c j ≠ 0 → g ≤ ν (FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.left j) - ν (FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.right j)) →
          (∀ (j : Fin (d - 1)), χ (FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.right j) ≤ χ (FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.left j)) →
            g + 2 ≤ FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.casimir ν - FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.casimir χ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.casimir_gap_times_depth
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (ν χ : Fin d → ℝ) (c : Fin (d - 1) → ℕ) (g : ℝ),
  ν - χ = FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.offset c →
    (∀ (j : Fin (d - 1)),
        c j ≠ 0 → g ≤ ν (FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.left j) - ν (FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.right j)) →
      (∀ (j : Fin (d - 1)), χ (FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.right j) ≤ χ (FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.left j)) →
        (g + 2) * ↑(FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.depth c) ≤
          FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.casimir ν - FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.casimir χ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.coordinate_gap_le_l1
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (x : Fin d → ℝ) (j : Fin (d - 1)),
  x (FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.left j) - x (FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.right j) ≤ FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.l1 x

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.depth
declarations.statement: {d : ℕ} → (Fin (d - 1) → ℕ) → ℕ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.dot
declarations.statement: {d : ℕ} → (Fin d → ℝ) → (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.dot_offset
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (x : Fin d → ℝ) (c : Fin (d - 1) → ℕ),
  FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.dot x (FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.offset c) =
    ∑ j : Fin (d - 1), ↑(c j) * (x (FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.left j) - x (FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.right j))

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.dot_simpleRoot
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (x : Fin d → ℝ) (j : Fin (d - 1)),
  FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.dot x (FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.simpleRoot j) =
    x (FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.left j) - x (FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.right j)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.l1
declarations.statement: {d : ℕ} → (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.left
declarations.statement: {d : ℕ} → Fin (d - 1) → Fin d

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.offset
declarations.statement: {d : ℕ} → (Fin (d - 1) → ℕ) → Fin d → ℝ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.offset_dot_bounds
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (c : Fin (d - 1) → ℕ) (ω : Fin d → ℝ),
  (∀ (j : Fin (d - 1)), ω (FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.right j) ≤ ω (FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.left j)) →
    0 ≤ FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.dot ω (FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.offset c) ∧
      FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.dot ω (FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.offset c) ≤
        ↑(FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.depth c) * FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.l1 ω

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.right
declarations.statement: {d : ℕ} → Fin (d - 1) → Fin d

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.simpleRoot
declarations.statement: {d : ℕ} → Fin (d - 1) → Fin d → ℝ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.twiceRho
declarations.statement: {d : ℕ} → Fin d → ℝ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.twiceRho_gap
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (j : Fin (d - 1)),
  FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.twiceRho (FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.left j) -
      FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.twiceRho (FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.right j) =
    2

declarations.statement:
{α : Type u_2} →
  {β : Type u_3} → {κ : Type u_4} → (Matrix α α ℂ → Matrix β β ℂ) → Matrix (κ × α) (κ × α) ℂ → Matrix (κ × β) (κ × β) ℂ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Channels.amplify_krausMap
declarations.statement:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} {β : Type u_3} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : Fintype α] {κ : Type u_4}
  [inst_2 : Fintype κ] [inst_3 : DecidableEq κ] (K : ι → Matrix β α ℂ) (X : Matrix (κ × α) (κ × α) ℂ),
  FreeEntropy.Channels.amplify (FreeEntropy.Channels.krausMap K) X =
    FreeEntropy.Channels.krausMap (fun (i : ι) => Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun (x1 x2 : ℂ) => x1 * x2) 1 (K i)) X

declarations.statement:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} {β : Type u_3} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : Fintype α] (K : ι → Matrix β α ℂ)
  (X Y : Matrix α α ℂ),
  FreeEntropy.Channels.krausMap K (X + Y) = FreeEntropy.Channels.krausMap K X + FreeEntropy.Channels.krausMap K Y

FreeEntropy.Channels.krausMap_positive
declarations.statement:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} {β : Type u_3} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : Fintype α] [Fintype β]
  (K : ι → Matrix β α ℂ) {X : Matrix α α ℂ}, X.PosSemidef → (FreeEntropy.Channels.krausMap K X).PosSemidef

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Channels.krausMap_smul
declarations.statement:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} {β : Type u_3} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : Fintype α] (K : ι → Matrix β α ℂ) (c : ℂ)
  (X : Matrix α α ℂ), FreeEntropy.Channels.krausMap K (c • X) = c • FreeEntropy.Channels.krausMap K X

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Channels.krausMap_sub_branch_positive
declarations.statement:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} {β : Type u_3} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : Fintype α] [Fintype β]
  (K : ι → Matrix β α ℂ) (k : ι) {X : Matrix α α ℂ},
  X.PosSemidef → (FreeEntropy.Channels.krausMap K X - K k * X * (K k).conjTranspose).PosSemidef

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Channels.krausMap_trace
declarations.statement:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} {β : Type u_3} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : Fintype α] [inst_2 : Fintype β]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq α] (K : ι → Matrix β α ℂ),
  ∑ i : ι, (K i).conjTranspose * K i = 1 → ∀ (X : Matrix α α ℂ), (FreeEntropy.Channels.krausMap K X).trace = X.trace

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Channels.kraus_branch_trace_le
declarations.statement:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} {β : Type u_3} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : Fintype α] [inst_2 : Fintype β]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq α] (K : ι → Matrix β α ℂ),
  ∑ i : ι, (K i).conjTranspose * K i = 1 →
    ∀ (k : ι) {X : Matrix α α ℂ}, X.PosSemidef → (K k * X * (K k).conjTranspose).trace.re ≤ X.trace.re

declarations.statement:
{ι : Type u_1} →
  {α : Type u_2} →

            [inst_3 : DecidableEq α] →

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Channels.trace_krausMap_pairing
declarations.statement:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} {β : Type u_3} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : Fintype α] [inst_2 : Fintype β]
  (K : ι → Matrix β α ℂ) (X : Matrix α α ℂ) (Y : Matrix β β ℂ),
  (FreeEntropy.Channels.krausMap K X * Y).trace = (X * FreeEntropy.Channels.krausAdjoint K Y).trace

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Cloning.averaged_deficit_le
declarations.statement:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} (s : Finset ι) (depth mass : ι → ℝ) (D g K : ℝ),
  0 ≤ D →
    0 ≤ g →
      (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ mass i) →
        ∑ i ∈ s, depth i * mass i ≤ K → ∑ i ∈ s, min 1 (2 * depth i * D / (g + 2)) * mass i ≤ 2 * D * K / (g + 2)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Cloning.blockDeficit
declarations.statement: {ι : Type u_1} → Finset ι → (ι → ℕ) → (ι → ℕ) → (ι → ℝ) → ℕ → ℕ → ℝ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Cloning.blockDeficit_eq_zero_of_depth_zero
declarations.statement:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} (s : Finset ι) (depth m : ι → ℕ) (p : ι → ℝ) (D g : ℕ),
  (∀ i ∈ s, depth i = 0) → FreeEntropy.Cloning.blockDeficit s depth m p D g = 0

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Cloning.cloning_accuracy_of_finite_blocks
declarations.statement:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} (s : Finset ι) (depth m n : ι → ℕ) (p q : ι → ℝ) (D g : ℕ) (b N K Ef Er dimRatio Z : ℝ),
  0 ≤ b →
    b ≤ ↑g →
      0 ≤ N →
        0 ≤ K →
          (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ p i) →
            (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ q i) →
              (∀ i ∈ s, m i ≤ n i) →
                (∀ i ∈ s, depth i ≤ g → m i = n i) →
                  ∑ i ∈ s, p i * ↑(m i) = 1 →
                    ∑ i ∈ s, q i * ↑(n i) = 1 →
                      (∀ i ∈ s, q i = Z * p i) →
                        ∑ i ∈ s, ↑(depth i) * p i * ↑(m i) ≤ K →
                          ∑ i ∈ s, ↑(depth i) * q i * ↑(n i) ≤ K →
                            1 - dimRatio ≤ N * ↑D / (b + 1) →
                              (D = 0 → Ef = 0 ∧ Er = 0) →
                                Ef ≤ 1 - dimRatio + FreeEntropy.Cloning.blockDeficit s depth n q D g →
                                  Er ≤ 1 - Z + FreeEntropy.Cloning.blockDeficit s depth m p D g →
                                    Ef ≤ (N + 3 * K) * ↑D / (b + 1) ∧ Er ≤ (N + 3 * K) * ↑D / (b + 1)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Cloning.cloning_bounds_of_deficits
declarations.statement:
∀ (b g D N K Ef Er dimRatio Z Mμ Mν : ℝ),
  0 ≤ b →
    b ≤ g →
      1 ≤ D →
        0 ≤ K →
          Ef ≤ 1 - dimRatio + Mν →
            Er ≤ 1 - Z + Mμ →
              1 - dimRatio ≤ N * D / (b + 1) →
                1 - Z ≤ K / (g + 1) →
                  Mμ ≤ 2 * D * K / (g + 2) →
                    Mν ≤ 2 * D * K / (g + 2) → Ef ≤ (N + 2 * K) * D / (b + 1) ∧ Er ≤ 3 * K * D / (b + 1)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Cloning.deficit_cap_eq_one_of_deep
declarations.statement: ∀ (depth g : ℕ) (D : ℝ), 1 ≤ D → g < depth → min 1 (2 * ↑depth * D / (↑g + 2)) = 1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Cloning.eigenvalue_ratio_deficit
declarations.statement:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} (s : Finset ι) (depth m n : ι → ℕ) (p q : ι → ℝ) (Z K : ℝ) (g : ℕ),
  (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ q i) →
    (∀ i ∈ s, m i ≤ n i) →
      (∀ i ∈ s, depth i ≤ g → m i = n i) →
        ∑ i ∈ s, p i * ↑(m i) = 1 →
          ∑ i ∈ s, q i * ↑(n i) = 1 →
            (∀ i ∈ s, q i = Z * p i) → ∑ i ∈ s, ↑(depth i) * q i * ↑(n i) ≤ K → 0 ≤ 1 - Z ∧ 1 - Z ≤ K / (↑g + 1)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Cloning.product_loss_le_sum
declarations.statement:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} (s : Finset ι) (a : ι → ℝ),
  (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ a i) → (∀ i ∈ s, a i ≤ 1) → 0 ≤ 1 - ∏ i ∈ s, (1 - a i) ∧ 1 - ∏ i ∈ s, (1 - a i) ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, a i

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Cloning.rank_one_cloning_bounds
declarations.statement:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} (s : Finset ι) (depth m n : ι → ℕ) (p q : ι → ℝ) (D g : ℕ) (b N Ef Er dimRatio Z : ℝ),
  (∀ i ∈ s, depth i = 0) →
    Z = 1 →
      1 - dimRatio ≤ N * ↑D / (b + 1) →
        Ef ≤ 1 - dimRatio + FreeEntropy.Cloning.blockDeficit s depth n q D g →
          Er ≤ 1 - Z + FreeEntropy.Cloning.blockDeficit s depth m p D g → Ef ≤ N * ↑D / (b + 1) ∧ Er ≤ 0

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Cloning.tail_mass_le_mean_div
declarations.statement:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} (s : Finset ι) (depth mass : ι → ℝ) (B K : ℝ),
  0 < B →
    (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ mass i) →
      (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ depth i) → ∑ i ∈ s, depth i * mass i ≤ K → ∑ i ∈ s with B ≤ depth i, mass i ≤ K / B

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Cloning.weyl_product_deficit
declarations.statement:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} (s : Finset ι) (den inc : ι → ℝ),
  (∀ i ∈ s, 0 < den i) →
    (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ inc i) →
      0 ≤ 1 - ∏ i ∈ s, den i / (den i + inc i) ∧ 1 - ∏ i ∈ s, den i / (den i + inc i) ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, inc i / den i

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Cloning.weyl_product_deficit_le_card
declarations.statement:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} (s : Finset ι) (den inc : ι → ℝ) (b D : ℝ),
  0 ≤ b →
    (∀ i ∈ s, 0 < den i) →
      (∀ i ∈ s, inc i = 0 ∨ b + 1 ≤ den i) →
        (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ inc i) → (∀ i ∈ s, inc i ≤ D) → 1 - ∏ i ∈ s, den i / (den i + inc i) ≤ ↑s.card * D / (b + 1)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.BlockRealization.error_comparisons
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] {K : Type u_3} [inst_2 : Fintype K]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq K] {s : Finset ι} {m n : ι → ℕ} {pμ pν e : ι → ℝ} {a Z : ℝ}
  (R : FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.BlockRealization s m n pμ pν e a H K),
  (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ pμ i) →
    (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ pν i) →
      (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ e i) →
        0 ≤ a →
          a ≤ 1 →
            0 ≤ Z →
              Z ≤ 1 →
                (∀ i ∈ s, pν i = Z * pμ i) →
                  FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance
                        (R.forward.toFun (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s pμ R.Pμ))
                        (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s pν R.Pν) ≤
                      1 - a + ∑ i ∈ s, e i * (pν i * ↑(n i)) ∧
                    FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance
                        (R.reverse.toFun (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s pν R.Pν))
                        (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s pμ R.Pμ) ≤
                      1 - Z + ∑ i ∈ s, e i * (pμ i * ↑(m i))

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.capped_projector_blocks
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] {P Q : Matrix H H ℂ},
  IsStarProjection P →
    IsStarProjection Q →
      ∀ (depth D g : ℕ),
        1 ≤ D →
          (depth ≤ g → ‖P - Q‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * ↑depth * ↑D / (↑g + 2)) →
            (1 - min 1 (2 * ↑depth * ↑D / (↑g + 2))) • P ≤ P * Q * P ∧
              (1 - min 1 (2 * ↑depth * ↑D / (↑g + 2))) • Q ≤ Q * P * Q

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.coefficient_mono
declarations.statement: ∀ {H : Type u_1} [Fintype H] [DecidableEq H] {A : Matrix H H ℂ}, A.PosSemidef → ∀ {a b : ℝ}, a ≤ b → a • A ≤ b • A

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.compressed_projector_block_bound
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [Fintype H] [DecidableEq H] [inst : Fintype K] [inst_1 : DecidableEq K]
  (J : Matrix K H ℂ) {P Q : Matrix K K ℂ} {e : ℝ},
  IsStarProjection P →
    IsStarProjection Q → ‖P - Q‖ ^ 2 ≤ e → (1 - e) • (J.conjTranspose * Q * J) ≤ J.conjTranspose * (Q * P * Q) * J

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.forward_traceDistance_le
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (s : Finset ι) (p q e : ι → ℝ)
  (P C : ι → Matrix H H ℂ) (σ : Matrix H H ℂ) (a : ℝ),
  (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ p i) →
    (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ e i) →
      (∀ i ∈ s, p i ≤ q i) →
        (∀ i ∈ s, (P i).PosSemidef) →
          (∀ i ∈ s, (C i).PosSemidef) →
            0 ≤ a →
              a ≤ 1 →
                (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s p P).trace = 1 →
                  σ.trace = 1 →
                    (∀ i ∈ s, (1 - e i) • P i ≤ C i) →
                      a • FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s q C ≤ σ →
                        FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance σ (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s p P) ≤
                          1 - a + ∑ i ∈ s, e i * p i * FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr (P i)

declarations.statement: {H : Type u_1} → {ι : Type u_2} → Finset ι → (ι → ℝ) → (ι → Matrix H H ℂ) → Matrix H H ℂ

declarations.statement:

declarations.statement:

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.ratio_interval
declarations.statement:
∀ {ι : Type u_2} (s : Finset ι) (m n : ι → ℕ) (p q : ι → ℝ) (Z : ℝ),
  (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ q i) →
    (∀ i ∈ s, m i ≤ n i) →
      ∑ i ∈ s, p i * ↑(m i) = 1 → ∑ i ∈ s, q i * ↑(n i) = 1 → (∀ i ∈ s, q i = Z * p i) → 0 ≤ Z ∧ Z ≤ 1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.smul_mono
