declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.theorem2_from_rows
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} {ι : Type u_3} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] [inst_2 : Fintype K]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq K] (s : Finset ι) (depth m n : ι → ℕ) (pμ pν : ι → ℝ) (d r D g : ℕ) (b q Z : ℝ) (μ ω : ℕ → ℝ)
  (R :
    FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.BlockRealization s m n pμ pν (fun (i : ι) => min 1 (2 * ↑(depth i) * ↑D / (↑g + 2)))
      (FreeEntropy.Weyl.activeProduct d d μ / FreeEntropy.Weyl.activeProduct d d fun (i : ℕ) => μ i + ω i) H K),
  2 ≤ r →
    0 ≤ q →
      q < 1 →
        0 ≤ b →
          b ≤ ↑g →
            (∀ (i j : ℕ), i < j → j < d → μ j ≤ μ i) →
              (∀ (i j : ℕ), i < j → j < d → ω j ≤ ω i) →
                (∀ (i : ℕ), r ≤ i → i < d → ω i = 0) →
                  (∀ i < r, i + 1 < d → b ≤ μ i - μ (i + 1)) →
                    ↑D = FreeEntropy.Weyl.rowL1 d ω →
                      (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ pμ i) →
                        (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ pν i) →
                          (∀ i ∈ s, m i ≤ n i) →
                            (∀ i ∈ s, depth i ≤ g → m i = n i) →
                              (D = 0 → ∀ i ∈ s, m i = n i) →
                                (∀ i ∈ s, pν i = Z * pμ i) →
                                  (∀ i ∈ s, pμ i ≤ q ^ depth i) →
                                    (∀ i ∈ s, pν i ≤ q ^ depth i) →
                                      (∀ (t : ℕ),
                                          ∑ i ∈ s with depth i = t, m i ≤
                                            (t + r.choose 2 - 1).choose (r.choose 2 - 1)) →
                                        (∀ (t : ℕ),
                                            ∑ i ∈ s with depth i = t, n i ≤
                                              (t + r.choose 2 - 1).choose (r.choose 2 - 1)) →
                                          FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance
                                                (R.forward.toFun (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s pμ R.Pμ))
                                                (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s pν R.Pν) ≤
                                              FreeEntropy.Theorem2.cloningConstant d r q * ↑D / (b + 1) ∧
                                            FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance
                                                (R.reverse.toFun (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s pν R.Pν))
                                                (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s pμ R.Pμ) ≤
                                              FreeEntropy.Theorem2.cloningConstant d r q * ↑D / (b + 1)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.theorem2_of_block_realization
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] {K : Type u_3} [inst_2 : Fintype K]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq K] (s : Finset ι) (depth m n : ι → ℕ) (pμ pν : ι → ℝ) (d r D g : ℕ) (b q a Z : ℝ)
  (R :
    FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.BlockRealization s m n pμ pν (fun (i : ι) => min 1 (2 * ↑(depth i) * ↑D / (↑g + 2))) a H
      K),
  2 ≤ r →
    0 ≤ q →
      q < 1 →
        0 ≤ b →
          b ≤ ↑g →
            0 ≤ a →
              a ≤ 1 →
                (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ pμ i) →
                  (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ pν i) →
                    (∀ i ∈ s, m i ≤ n i) →
                      (∀ i ∈ s, depth i ≤ g → m i = n i) →
                        (D = 0 → ∀ i ∈ s, m i = n i) →
                          (∀ i ∈ s, pν i = Z * pμ i) →
                            (∀ i ∈ s, pμ i ≤ q ^ depth i) →
                              (∀ i ∈ s, pν i ≤ q ^ depth i) →
                                (∀ (t : ℕ),
                                    ∑ i ∈ s with depth i = t, m i ≤ (t + r.choose 2 - 1).choose (r.choose 2 - 1)) →
                                  (∀ (t : ℕ),
                                      ∑ i ∈ s with depth i = t, n i ≤ (t + r.choose 2 - 1).choose (r.choose 2 - 1)) →
                                    1 - a ≤ ↑(d.choose 2) * ↑D / (b + 1) →
                                      FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance
                                            (R.forward.toFun (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s pμ R.Pμ))
                                            (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s pν R.Pν) ≤
                                          FreeEntropy.Theorem2.cloningConstant d r q * ↑D / (b + 1) ∧
                                        FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance
                                            (R.reverse.toFun (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s pν R.Pν))
                                            (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s pμ R.Pμ) ≤
                                          FreeEntropy.Theorem2.cloningConstant d r q * ↑D / (b + 1)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.theorem2_rank_one_of_block_realization
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] {K : Type u_3} [inst_2 : Fintype K]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq K] (s : Finset ι) (depth m n : ι → ℕ) (pμ pν : ι → ℝ) (d D g : ℕ) (b a Z : ℝ)
  (R :
    FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.BlockRealization s m n pμ pν (fun (i : ι) => min 1 (2 * ↑(depth i) * ↑D / (↑g + 2))) a H
      K),
  (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ pμ i) →
    (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ pν i) →
      0 ≤ a →
        a ≤ 1 →
          (∀ i ∈ s, depth i = 0) →
            (∀ i ∈ s, m i = n i) →
              (∀ i ∈ s, pν i = Z * pμ i) →
                1 - a ≤ ↑(d.choose 2) * ↑D / (b + 1) →
                  FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance
                        (R.forward.toFun (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s pμ R.Pμ))
                        (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s pν R.Pν) ≤
                      FreeEntropy.Theorem2.cloningConstant d 1 0 * ↑D / (b + 1) ∧
                    FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance
                        (R.reverse.toFun (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s pν R.Pν))
                        (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s pμ R.Pμ) =
                      0

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.traceDistance_le_block_loss
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (s : Finset ι) (p e : ι → ℝ)
  (P C : ι → Matrix H H ℂ) (σ : Matrix H H ℂ) (a : ℝ),
  (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ p i) →
    (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ e i) →
      (∀ i ∈ s, (P i).PosSemidef) →
        0 ≤ a →
          a ≤ 1 →
            (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s p P).trace = 1 →
              σ.trace = 1 →
                (∀ i ∈ s, (1 - e i) • P i ≤ C i) →
                  a • FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s p C ≤ σ →
                    FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance σ (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s p P) ≤
                      1 - a + ∑ i ∈ s, e i * p i * FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr (P i)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.alternatingEmbedding_column
declarations.statement:
∀ {d k : ℕ} (s : ↑(FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.Index d k)),
  (fun (w : Fin k → Fin d) => FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.alternatingEmbedding d k w s) =
    FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.alternatingColumn s

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.alternatingEmbedding_gram
declarations.statement:
∀ {d k : ℕ},
  (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.alternatingEmbedding d k).conjTranspose *
      FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.alternatingEmbedding d k =
    ↑k.factorial • 1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.alternatingEmbedding_intertwines
declarations.statement:
∀ {d k : ℕ} (U : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ),
  FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.matrix k U * FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.alternatingEmbedding d k =
    FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.alternatingEmbedding d k * FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.exteriorMatrix k U

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.ambientGenerators
declarations.statement:
{d : ℕ} →
  (mu : Fin d → ℕ) → FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.AmbientIndex mu)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.ambientGenerators_diagonal
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ) (k : Fin d),
  (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.ambientGenerators mu).E k k =
    Matrix.diagonal
      fun (b : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.TensorIndex (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.columnHeight mu)) =>
      ↑(FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.tensorWeight (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.columnHeight mu) b k)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.ambientHighest_cyclic
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ),
  FreeEntropy.LiePBW.cyclicSpan (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.ambientGenerators mu)
      (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.highestVector mu).ofLp =
    Submodule.map (↑(EuclideanSpace.equiv (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.AmbientIndex mu) ℂ).toLinearEquiv)
      (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.highestSubspace mu)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.ambientHighest_cyclic_range
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ),
  FreeEntropy.LiePBW.cyclicSpan (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.ambientGenerators mu)
      (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.highestVector mu).ofLp =
    (Matrix.toLin' (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.irrepEmbedding mu)).range

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.ambientHighest_raise
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ) (i j : Fin d),
  i < j →
    ((FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.ambientGenerators mu).E i j).mulVec
        (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.highestVector mu).ofLp =
      0

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.ambientHighest_weight
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ) (k : Fin d),
  ((FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.ambientGenerators mu).E k k).mulVec
      (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.highestVector mu).ofLp =
    ↑(FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.tensorWeight (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.columnHeight mu)
          (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.highestBasisIndex mu) k) •
      (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.highestVector mu).ofLp

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.ambientRepresentation
declarations.statement:
{d : ℕ} →
  (mu : Fin d → ℕ) →
    ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ) →*
      Matrix (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.AmbientIndex mu) (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.AmbientIndex mu) ℂ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.ambientRepresentation_continuous
declarations.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ), Continuous ⇑(FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.ambientRepresentation mu)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.ambientRepresentation_unitary
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ) (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)),
  ((FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.ambientRepresentation mu) U).conjTranspose *
      (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.ambientRepresentation mu) U =
    1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.ambientTensorEmbedding
declarations.statement:
{d : ℕ} →
  (mu : Fin d → ℕ) →
    Matrix (Fin (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.tensorDegree mu) → Fin d)
      (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.AmbientIndex mu) ℂ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.ambientTensorEmbedding_intertwines
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ) (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)),
  (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalRepresentation d (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.tensorDegree mu)) U *
      FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.ambientTensorEmbedding mu =
    FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.ambientTensorEmbedding mu *
      (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.ambientRepresentation mu) U

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.ambientTensorEmbedding_isometry
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ),
  (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.ambientTensorEmbedding mu).conjTranspose *
      FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.ambientTensorEmbedding mu =
    1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.auxiliaryRow
declarations.statement: {d : ℕ} → (Fin d → ℕ) → (Fin d → ℕ) → Fin d → ℕ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.auxiliaryRow_antitone
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu nu : Fin d → ℕ),
  (Antitone fun (i : Fin d) => ↑(nu i) - ↑(mu i)) → Antitone (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.auxiliaryRow mu nu)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.auxiliaryRow_balance
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu nu : Fin d → ℕ),
  mu + FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.auxiliaryRow mu nu =
    nu + fun (x : Fin d) => FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.auxiliaryShift mu

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.auxiliaryRow_cast
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu nu : Fin d → ℕ) (i : Fin d),
  ↑(FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.auxiliaryRow mu nu i) =
    ↑(nu i) - ↑(mu i) + ↑(FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.auxiliaryShift mu)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.auxiliaryShift
declarations.statement: {d : ℕ} → (Fin d → ℕ) → ℕ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.basisPermutation
declarations.statement: {A : Type u_3} → {B : Type u_4} → [DecidableEq A] → A ≃ B → Matrix B A ℂ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.basisPermutation_adjoint
declarations.statement:
∀ {A : Type u_3} {B : Type u_4} [Fintype A] [inst : DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [inst_2 : DecidableEq B] (e : A ≃ B),
  (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.basisPermutation e).conjTranspose = e.toPEquiv.toMatrix

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.basisPermutation_coisometry
declarations.statement:
∀ {A : Type u_3} {B : Type u_4} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [inst_3 : DecidableEq B]
  (e : A ≃ B),
  FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.basisPermutation e *
      (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.basisPermutation e).conjTranspose =
    1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.basisPermutation_intertwines
declarations.statement:
∀ {A : Type u_3} {B : Type u_4} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : DecidableEq A] [inst_2 : Fintype B] [DecidableEq B]
  (e : A ≃ B) (M : Matrix A A ℂ) (N : Matrix B B ℂ),
  (∀ (a b : A), N (e a) (e b) = M a b) →
    N * FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.basisPermutation e =
      FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.basisPermutation e * M

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.basisPermutation_isometry
declarations.statement:
∀ {A : Type u_3} {B : Type u_4} [Fintype A] [inst : DecidableEq A] [inst_1 : Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (e : A ≃ B),
  (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.basisPermutation e).conjTranspose *
      FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.basisPermutation e =
    1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.basisPermutation_mulVec
declarations.statement:
∀ {A : Type u_3} {B : Type u_4} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (e : A ≃ B)
  (v : A → ℂ), (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.basisPermutation e).mulVec v = v ∘ ⇑e.symm

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.basisPermutation_single
declarations.statement:
∀ {A : Type u_3} {B : Type u_4} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [inst_3 : DecidableEq B]
  (e : A ≃ B) (a : A) (c : ℂ),
  (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.basisPermutation e).mulVec (Pi.single a c) = Pi.single (e a) c

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalAdjoint
declarations.statement:
{d : ℕ} →
  (mu nu : Fin d → ℕ) →
    Antitone mu →
      Antitone nu →
        (Antitone fun (i : Fin d) => ↑(nu i) - ↑(mu i)) →
          Matrix (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex nu) (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex nu)
              ℂ →ₗ[ℂ]
            Matrix (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex mu) (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex mu)
              ℂ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalAdjoint_eq_sectorAdjoint
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu nu : Fin d → ℕ) (hmu : Antitone mu) (hnu : Antitone nu)
  (hinc : Antitone fun (i : Fin d) => ↑(nu i) - ↑(mu i)),
  0 < d →
    ∀
      (Y :
        Matrix (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex nu) (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex nu) ℂ),
      (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalAdjoint mu nu hmu hnu hinc) Y =
        FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.sectorAdjoint (↑(Fintype.card (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex mu)))
          (↑(Fintype.card (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex nu)))
          (FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.specifiedCartanEmbedding
            (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeightModel mu)
            (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalAuxiliaryModel mu nu)
            (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeightModel nu) ⋯)
          Y

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalAdjoint_hilbertSchmidt
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu nu : Fin d → ℕ) (hmu : Antitone mu) (hnu : Antitone nu)
  (hinc : Antitone fun (i : Fin d) => ↑(nu i) - ↑(mu i)),
  0 < d →
    ∀
      (X :
        Matrix (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex mu) (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex mu) ℂ)
      (Y :
        Matrix (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex nu) (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex nu) ℂ),
      (((FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalForward mu nu hmu hnu hinc).toFun X).conjTranspose * Y).trace =
        (X.conjTranspose * (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalAdjoint mu nu hmu hnu hinc) Y).trace

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalAdjoint_unique
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu nu : Fin d → ℕ) (hmu : Antitone mu) (hnu : Antitone nu)
  (hinc : Antitone fun (i : Fin d) => ↑(nu i) - ↑(mu i)),
  0 < d →
    ∀
      (T :
        Matrix (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex nu) (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex nu)
            ℂ →ₗ[ℂ]
          Matrix (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex mu) (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex mu)
            ℂ),
      (∀
          (X :
            Matrix (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex mu) (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex mu)
              ℂ)
          (Y :
            Matrix (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex nu) (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex nu)
              ℂ),
          (((FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalForward mu nu hmu hnu hinc).toFun X).conjTranspose * Y).trace =
            (X.conjTranspose * T Y).trace) →
        T = FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalAdjoint mu nu hmu hnu hinc

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalAuxiliaryModel
declarations.statement:
{d : ℕ} →
  (mu nu : Fin d → ℕ) →
    FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.CyclicWeightModel d
      (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.auxiliaryRow mu nu))

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalAuxiliaryModel_hrow
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu nu : Fin d → ℕ),
  Antitone mu →
    Antitone nu →
      (Antitone fun (i : Fin d) => ↑(nu i) - ↑(mu i)) →
        (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeightModel nu).row =
          (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeightModel mu).row +
            (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalAuxiliaryModel mu nu).row

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalAuxiliaryModel_reverseWeightClosed
declarations.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (mu nu : Fin d → ℕ), (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalAuxiliaryModel mu nu).ReverseWeightClosed

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalAuxiliaryModel_row
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu nu : Fin d → ℕ),
  (Antitone fun (i : Fin d) => ↑(nu i) - ↑(mu i)) →
    (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalAuxiliaryModel mu nu).row = fun (i : Fin d) => ↑(nu i) - ↑(mu i)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalAuxiliary_dual_cyclic_highest
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu nu : Fin d → ℕ),
  (Antitone fun (i : Fin d) => ↑(nu i) - ↑(mu i)) →
    ∃ (v : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.auxiliaryRow mu nu) → ℂ),
      v ≠ 0 ∧
        (∀ (i : Fin d),
            ((FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalAuxiliaryModel mu nu).generators.dual.E i i).mulVec v =
              (↑(mu i.rev) - ↑(nu i.rev)) • v) ∧
          (∀ (i j : Fin d),
              i < j →
                ((FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalAuxiliaryModel mu nu).generators.dual.E i j).mulVec v =
                  0) ∧
            FreeEntropy.LiePBW.cyclicSpan
                (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalAuxiliaryModel mu nu).generators.dual v =
              ⊤

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalAuxiliary_dual_highest
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu nu : Fin d → ℕ),
  (Antitone fun (i : Fin d) => ↑(nu i) - ↑(mu i)) →
    ∃ (v : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.auxiliaryRow mu nu) → ℂ),
      v ≠ 0 ∧
        (∀ (i : Fin d),
            ((FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalAuxiliaryModel mu nu).generators.dual.E i i).mulVec v =
              (↑(mu i.rev) - ↑(nu i.rev)) • v) ∧
          ∀ (i j : Fin d),
            i < j →
              ((FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalAuxiliaryModel mu nu).generators.dual.E i j).mulVec v = 0

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalAverageError
declarations.statement:
{d r : ℕ} →
  FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r →
    (mu : Fin d → ℕ) →
      {B : Type u_1} →
        [inst : Fintype B] →
          [DecidableEq B] →
            FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex mu) B →
              FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel B (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex mu) → ℝ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalCartanForward
declarations.statement:
{d : ℕ} →
  (mu nu : Fin d → ℕ) →
    Antitone mu →
      Antitone nu →
        (Antitone fun (i : Fin d) => ↑(nu i) - ↑(mu i)) →
          FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex mu)
            (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex nu)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalCartanForward_covariant
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu nu : Fin d → ℕ) (hmu : Antitone mu) (hnu : Antitone nu)
  (hinc : Antitone fun (i : Fin d) => ↑(nu i) - ↑(mu i)),
  0 < d →
    ∀ (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ))
      (X :
        Matrix (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex mu) (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex mu) ℂ),
      (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalCartanForward mu nu hmu hnu hinc).toFun
          ((FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeightRepresentation mu) U * X *
            ((FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeightRepresentation mu) U).conjTranspose) =
        (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeightRepresentation nu) U *
            (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalCartanForward mu nu hmu hnu hinc).toFun X *
          ((FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeightRepresentation nu) U).conjTranspose

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalCartanReverse
declarations.statement:
{d : ℕ} →
  (mu nu : Fin d → ℕ) →
    Antitone mu →
      Antitone nu →
        (Antitone fun (i : Fin d) => ↑(nu i) - ↑(mu i)) →
          FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex nu)
            (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex mu)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalCartanReverse_covariant
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu nu : Fin d → ℕ) (hmu : Antitone mu) (hnu : Antitone nu)
  (hinc : Antitone fun (i : Fin d) => ↑(nu i) - ↑(mu i)),
  0 < d →
    ∀ (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ))
      (Y :
        Matrix (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex nu) (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex nu) ℂ),
      (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalCartanReverse mu nu hmu hnu hinc).toFun
          ((FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeightRepresentation nu) U * Y *
            ((FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeightRepresentation nu) U).conjTranspose) =
        (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeightRepresentation mu) U *
            (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalCartanReverse mu nu hmu hnu hinc).toFun Y *
          ((FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeightRepresentation mu) U).conjTranspose

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalCartan_self_apply
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ) (hmu : Antitone mu) (hinc : Antitone fun (i : Fin d) => ↑(mu i) - ↑(mu i)),
  0 < d →
    ∀
      (X :
        Matrix (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex mu) (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex mu) ℂ),
      (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalCartanForward mu mu hmu hmu hinc).toFun X = X ∧
        (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalCartanReverse mu mu hmu hmu hinc).toFun X = X

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalCharacter
declarations.statement: {d : ℕ} → (Fin d → ℕ) → MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℂ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalCharacter_eigen
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ),
  Antitone mu →
    0 < d →
      FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.laplacian
          (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.denominator d * FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalCharacter mu) =
        ↑(∑ i : Fin d, FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.shiftedHighest mu i ^ 2) •
          (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.denominator d * FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalCharacter mu)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalCharacter_eval_one
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ),
  (MvPolynomial.eval fun (x : Fin d) => 1) (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalCharacter mu) =
    ↑(Module.finrank ℂ ↥(FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.highestSubspace mu))

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalCharacter_highest_coeff
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ),
  Antitone mu →
    MvPolynomial.coeff (FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.exponent mu)
        (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalCharacter mu) =
      1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalCharacter_identity
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ),
  Antitone mu →
    0 < d →
      FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.denominator d * FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalCharacter mu =
        FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.alternant (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.ascendingHighest mu)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalCharacter_identity_all
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ),
  Antitone mu →
    FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.denominator d * FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalCharacter mu =
      FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.alternant (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.ascendingHighest mu)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalCharacter_numerator_below
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ),
  Antitone mu →
    FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.Below (fun (i : Fin d) => ↑(mu i) + FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.staircase i)
      (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.denominator d * FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalCharacter mu)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalCharacter_numerator_energy
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ),
  Antitone mu →
    0 < d →
      ∀ (m : Fin d →₀ ℕ),
        MvPolynomial.coeff m
              (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.denominator d * FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalCharacter mu) ≠
            0 →
          FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.exponentEnergy m = ∑ i : Fin d, FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.shiftedHighest mu i ^ 2

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalCharacter_numerator_highest_coeff
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ),
  Antitone mu →
    MvPolynomial.coeff (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.exponent (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.shiftedHighest mu))
        (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.denominator d * FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalCharacter mu) =
      ↑↑(Equiv.Perm.sign Fin.revPerm)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalCharacter_numerator_support_orbit
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ),
  Antitone mu →
    0 < d →
      ∀ (m : Fin d →₀ ℕ),
        MvPolynomial.coeff m
              (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.denominator d * FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalCharacter mu) ≠
            0 →
          ∃ (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin d)),
            m =
              Finsupp.mapDomain (⇑e) (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.exponent (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.shiftedHighest mu))

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalCharacter_radial
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ),
  Antitone mu →
    FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.denominator d *
        (MvPolynomial.C ↑(FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.casimir fun (i : Fin d) => ↑(mu i)) *
            FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalCharacter mu -
          FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.laplacian (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalCharacter mu)) =
      ∑ p ∈ FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.positiveRoots d,
        FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.rootProductExcept p * (MvPolynomial.X p.1 + MvPolynomial.X p.2) *
          ((FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.euler p.2) (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalCharacter mu) -
            (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.euler p.1) (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalCharacter mu))

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalCharacter_root_cone
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ),
  Antitone mu →
    ∀ (m : Fin d →₀ ℕ),
      MvPolynomial.coeff m (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalCharacter mu) ≠ 0 →
        ∃ (c : Fin (d - 1) → ℕ),
          ((fun (i : Fin d) => ↑(mu i)) - fun (i : Fin d) => ↑(m i)) = FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.offset c

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalCharacter_strictAnti_exponent
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ),
  Antitone mu →
    0 < d →
      ∀ (m : Fin d →₀ ℕ),
        MvPolynomial.coeff m
              (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.denominator d * FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalCharacter mu) ≠
            0 →
          (StrictAnti fun (i : Fin d) => m i) →
            m = FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.exponent (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.shiftedHighest mu)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalCharacter_support_degree
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ),

      MvPolynomial.coeff m (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalCharacter mu) ≠ 0 →
        ∑ i : Fin d, m i = ∑ i : Fin d, mu i

  FreeEntropy.LiePBW.cyclicSpan
      ((FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeightModel mu).generators.dual.tensor
        (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeightModel nu).generators)
      ((FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalChoiEmbedding mu nu hmu hnu hinc).mulVec

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalChoi_highest
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu nu : Fin d → ℕ) (hmu : Antitone mu) (hnu : Antitone nu)
  (hinc : Antitone fun (i : Fin d) => ↑(nu i) - ↑(mu i)),
  ∃ (v : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex mu × FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex nu → ℂ),
    v ≠ 0 ∧
      (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalChoiProjector mu nu hmu hnu hinc).mulVec v = v ∧
        (∀ (i : Fin d),
            (((FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeightModel mu).generators.dual.tensor
                        (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeightModel nu).generators).E
                    i i).mulVec
                v =
              (↑(nu i) - ↑(mu i)) • v) ∧
          ∀ (i j : Fin d),
            i < j →
              (((FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeightModel mu).generators.dual.tensor
                          (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeightModel nu).generators).E
                      i j).mulVec
                  v =
                0

  FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalReverseChoiEmbedding mu nu hmu hnu hinc *
      (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalReverseChoiEmbedding mu nu hmu hnu hinc).conjTranspose =
    FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalReverseChoiProjector mu nu hmu hnu hinc

          Matrix (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex nu × FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex mu)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalReverseChoiProjector_idempotent
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu nu : Fin d → ℕ) (hmu : Antitone mu) (hnu : Antitone nu)

declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu nu : Fin d → ℕ) (hmu : Antitone mu) (hnu : Antitone nu)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalReverseChoiProjector_unique
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu nu : Fin d → ℕ) (hmu : Antitone mu) (hnu : Antitone nu)
  (hinc : Antitone fun (i : Fin d) => ↑(nu i) - ↑(mu i))
  (W :
    Matrix (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex nu × FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex mu)
      (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.auxiliaryRow mu nu)) ℂ),
  W.conjTranspose * W = 1 →
    W ∈
        FreeEntropy.CartanChoi.reverseEmbeddings (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeightModel mu)
          (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalAuxiliaryModel mu nu)
          (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeightModel nu) →
      W * W.conjTranspose = FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalReverseChoiProjector mu nu hmu hnu hinc

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalReverseChoi_embedding_unique
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu nu : Fin d → ℕ) (hmu : Antitone mu) (hnu : Antitone nu)
  (hinc : Antitone fun (i : Fin d) => ↑(nu i) - ↑(mu i)),
  ∀
    W ∈
      FreeEntropy.CartanChoi.reverseEmbeddings (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeightModel mu)
        (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalAuxiliaryModel mu nu)
        (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeightModel nu),
    ∃ (c : ℂ), W = c • FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalReverseChoiEmbedding mu nu hmu hnu hinc

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalReverseChoi_highest_cyclic
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu nu : Fin d → ℕ) (hmu : Antitone mu) (hnu : Antitone nu)
  (hinc : Antitone fun (i : Fin d) => ↑(nu i) - ↑(mu i)),
  have V :=
    FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.specifiedCartanEmbedding (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeightModel mu)
      (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalAuxiliaryModel mu nu)
      (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeightModel nu) ⋯;
  ∃ (w : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex nu × FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex mu → ℂ),
    w ≠ 0 ∧
      (FreeEntropy.CartanChoi.reverseProjector V).mulVec w = w ∧
        (∀ (i : Fin d),
            (((FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeightModel nu).generators.dual.tensor
                        (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeightModel mu).generators).E
                    i i).mulVec
                w =
              (↑(mu i.rev) - ↑(nu i.rev)) • w) ∧
          (∀ (i j : Fin d),
              i < j →
                (((FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeightModel nu).generators.dual.tensor
                            (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeightModel mu).generators).E
                        i j).mulVec
                    w =
                  0) ∧
            FreeEntropy.LiePBW.cyclicSpan
                ((FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeightModel nu).generators.dual.tensor
                  (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeightModel mu).generators)
                w =
              (FreeEntropy.CartanChoi.reverseProjector V).mulVecLin.range

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalReverseChoi_multiplicity_one
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu nu : Fin d → ℕ),

      (Antitone fun (i : Fin d) => ↑(nu i) - ↑(mu i)) →

            ↥(FreeEntropy.CartanChoi.reverseEmbeddings (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeightModel mu)
                (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalAuxiliaryModel mu nu)
                (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeightModel nu)) =
          1

declarations.statement:

  (hinc : Antitone fun (i : Fin d) => ↑(nu i) - ↑(mu i)),
  0 < d →
    FreeEntropy.CartanChoi.choi (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalReverse mu nu hmu hnu hinc).toFun =
      (↑(Fintype.card (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex nu)) /
          ↑(Fintype.card
              (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex
                (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.auxiliaryRow mu nu)))) •

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalReverse_choiMap

∀ {d : ℕ} (mu nu : Fin d → ℕ) (hmu : Antitone mu) (hnu : Antitone nu)
  (hinc : Antitone fun (i : Fin d) => ↑(nu i) - ↑(mu i)),
  0 < d →
    ∀
      (Y :
        Matrix (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex nu) (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex nu) ℂ),
      FreeEntropy.CartanChoi.choiMap
          ((↑(Fintype.card (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex nu)) /
              ↑(Fintype.card
                  (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex
                    (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.auxiliaryRow mu nu)))) •
            FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalReverseChoiProjector mu nu hmu hnu hinc)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalReverse_covariant
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu nu : Fin d → ℕ) (hmu : Antitone mu) (hnu : Antitone nu)
  (hinc : Antitone fun (i : Fin d) => ↑(nu i) - ↑(mu i)),
  0 < d →
    ∀ (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ))
      (X :
        Matrix (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex nu) (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex nu) ℂ),
      (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalReverse mu nu hmu hnu hinc).toFun
          ((FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeightRepresentation nu) U * X *
            ((FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeightRepresentation nu) U).conjTranspose) =
        (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeightRepresentation mu) U *
            (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalReverse mu nu hmu hnu hinc).toFun X *
          ((FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeightRepresentation mu) U).conjTranspose

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalReverse_eq_cartan_apply
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu nu : Fin d → ℕ) (hmu : Antitone mu) (hnu : Antitone nu)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalReverse_eq_normalized_adjoint
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu nu : Fin d → ℕ) (hmu : Antitone mu) (hnu : Antitone nu)
  (hinc : Antitone fun (i : Fin d) => ↑(nu i) - ↑(mu i))
  (Y : Matrix (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex nu) (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex nu) ℂ),
  (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalReverse mu nu hmu hnu hinc).toFun Y =
    (↑(Fintype.card (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex nu)) /

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalReverse_orbit_error_eq
declarations.statement:
∀ {d r : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r),
  2 ≤ d →
    ∀ (mu nu : Fin d → ℕ) (hmu : Antitone mu) (hnu : Antitone nu) (hinc : Antitone fun (i : Fin d) => ↑(nu i) - ↑(mu i))
      (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)),
      FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance
          ((FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalReverse mu nu hmu hnu hinc).toFun
            (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalOrbitState s nu U))
          (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalOrbitState s mu U) =
        FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance
          ((FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalReverse mu nu hmu hnu hinc).toFun
            ((FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeightModel nu).relativeState fun (j : Fin (d - 1)) =>
              s.adjacentRatio ↑j))
          ((FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeightModel mu).relativeState fun (j : Fin (d - 1)) =>
            s.adjacentRatio ↑j)

declarations.statement:

  Fintype.card
      { a : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex mu //
        FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeight mu a = wt } =
    Module.finrank ℂ ↥(FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.actualWeightSpace mu wt)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeight_card_eq_rootFiber
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu wt : Fin d → ℕ),
  Antitone mu →
    ∀ (g rank : ℕ),
      (∀ (j : Fin d) (hj : ↑j + 1 < d), ↑j + 1 < rank → g + mu ⟨↑j + 1, hj⟩ ≤ mu j) →
        ∀ (a : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d →₀ ℕ),
          FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootDepth a ≤ g →
            (∀ (k : Fin d), ↑(wt k) - ↑(mu k) = FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootWeightShift a k) →
              (∀ (k : Fin d), rank ≤ ↑k → wt k = mu k) →
                Fintype.card
                    { b : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex mu //
                      FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeight mu b = wt } =
                  (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.lowerWeightFiber a).card

declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu wt : Fin d → ℕ),
  Antitone mu →
    ∀ (a : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d →₀ ℕ),
      (∀ (k : Fin d), ↑(wt k) - ↑(mu k) = FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootWeightShift a k) →
        Fintype.card
            { b : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex mu //
              FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeight mu b = wt } ≤
          (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.lowerWeightFiber a).card

    FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeight mu b =
      FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeight mu a ∘ ⇑e

      ∃ (c : Fin (d - 1) → ℕ),
        ((fun (i : Fin d) => ↑(mu i)) - fun (i : Fin d) =>
            ↑(FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeight mu a (e i))) =

      MvPolynomial.coeff m
            (FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.character (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeight mu)) ≠
          0 →
        ∀ (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin d)),
          ∃ (c : Fin (d - 1) → ℕ),
            ((fun (i : Fin d) => ↑(mu i)) - fun (i : Fin d) => ↑(m (e i))) = FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.offset c

declarations.statement:

  (MvPolynomial.rename ⇑e)
      (FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.character (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeight mu)) =
    FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.character (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeight mu)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonical_cloning_accuracy_bounds
declarations.statement:
∀ {d r : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r),
  2 ≤ d →
    ∀ (mu nu : Fin d → ℕ) (hmu : Antitone mu) (hnu : Antitone nu)
      (hinc : Antitone fun (i : Fin d) => ↑(nu i) - ↑(mu i)),
      (∀ (i : Fin d), r ≤ ↑i → nu i = mu i) →
        ∀ (D g : ℕ) (b : ℝ),
          0 ≤ b →
            b ≤ ↑g →
              (FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.l1 fun (i : Fin d) => ↑(nu i) - ↑(mu i)) ≤ ↑D →
                (∀ (j : Fin (d - 1)),
                    ↑j < r →
                      ↑g ≤ ↑(mu (FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.left j)) - ↑(mu (FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.right j))) →
                  FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance
                        ((FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalForward mu nu hmu hnu hinc).toFun
                          ((FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeightModel mu).relativeState
                            fun (j : Fin (d - 1)) => s.adjacentRatio ↑j))
                        ((FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeightModel nu).relativeState
                          fun (j : Fin (d - 1)) => s.adjacentRatio ↑j) ≤
                      FreeEntropy.Theorem2.cloningConstant d r s.qx * ↑D / (b + 1) ∧
                    FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance

          ↑(Module.finrank ℂ ↥(FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.highestSubspace fun (i : Fin d) => mu ↑i)) =

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonical_offsetMultiplicity_rank_depth_le
declarations.statement:

  Antitone mu →
    ∀ rank ≤ d,
      2 ≤ rank →
        ∀ (s : Finset (Fin (d - 1) → ℕ)),
          (∀ delta ∈ s, FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.SupportedSimpleOffset rank delta) →
            ∀ (t : ℕ),
              ∑ delta ∈ s with FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.depth delta = t,
                  (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeightModel mu).offsetMultiplicity delta ≤
                (t + rank.choose 2 - 1).choose (rank.choose 2 - 1)

          (∀ (j : Fin d) (hj : ↑j + 1 < d), ↑j + 1 < rank → g + nu ⟨↑j + 1, hj⟩ ≤ nu j) →

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonical_orbit_memory_bound
declarations.statement:
∀ {d r : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r) (mu : Fin d → ℕ),
  2 ≤ d →
    ∀ {B : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (haar : MeasureTheory.Measure ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ))
      [haar.IsMulLeftInvariant] [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure haar]
      (E : FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex mu) B)
      (D : FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel B (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex mu)),
      ↑(Module.finrank ℂ ↥(FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.highestSubspace mu)) *
          (1 -
            (∫ (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)),
                FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance
                  (D.toFun (E.toFun (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalOrbitState s mu U)))
                  (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalOrbitState s mu U) ∂haar) /
              (1 - s.qx) ^ (d.choose 2 + 1)) ≤
        ↑(Fintype.card B)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonical_pairs_group_intertwiner
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu omega nu tau : Fin d → ℕ),
  FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.tensorDegree nu + FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.tensorDegree tau =
      FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.tensorDegree mu + FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.tensorDegree omega →
    ∀
      (V :
        Matrix (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex mu × FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex omega)
          (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex nu × FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex tau) ℂ),
      (∀ (i j : Fin d),
          V *
              ((FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeightModel nu).generators.tensor
                    (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeightModel tau).generators).E
                i j =
            ((FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeightModel mu).generators.tensor
                    (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeightModel omega).generators).E
                i j *
              V) →
        ∀ (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)),
          V * (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalPairRepresentation nu tau) U =
            (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalPairRepresentation mu omega) U * V

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonical_signed_intertwiner_phase
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu omega nu : Fin d → ℕ),
  Antitone mu →
    Antitone omega →
      Antitone nu →
        ∀ (c : ℕ),
          0 < d →
            (mu + omega = nu + fun (x : Fin d) => c) →
              ∀
                (V :
                  Matrix
                    (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex mu ×
                      FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex omega)
                    (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex nu) ℂ),
                (∀ (i j : Fin d),
                    ((FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeightModel mu).generators.tensor
                              ((FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeightModel omega).generators.shift
                                (-↑c))).E
                          i j *
                        V =
                      V * (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeightModel nu).generators.E i j) →
                  ∀ (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)),
                    ∃ (a : ℂ),
                      a * star a = 1 ∧
                        Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun (x1 x2 : ℂ) => x1 * x2)
                              ((FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeightRepresentation mu) U)
                              ((FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeightRepresentation omega) U) *
                            V =
                          V * a • (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeightRepresentation nu) U

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.cardEmbedding
declarations.statement: {X : Type u_1} → {Y : Type u_2} → [inst : Fintype X] → [inst_1 : Fintype Y] → Fintype.card X ≤ Fintype.card Y → X ↪ Y

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.card_lowerAssignmentsAtDepth_le
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ},
  2 ≤ d →
    ∀ (t : ℕ),
      (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.lowerAssignmentsAtDepth t).card ≤ (t + d.choose 2 - 1).choose (d.choose 2 - 1)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.card_lowerRoot
declarations.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ}, Fintype.card (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d) = d.choose 2

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.card_rankLowerRoots
declarations.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ}, ∀ rank ≤ d, (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rankLowerRoots rank).card = rank.choose 2

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.cartanAmbientEquivalence
declarations.statement:
{d : ℕ} →
  (mu nu : Fin d → ℕ) →
    Antitone mu →
      Antitone nu →
        Matrix (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.AmbientIndex mu × FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.AmbientIndex nu)
          (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.AmbientIndex (mu + nu)) ℂ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.cartanAmbientEquivalence_highest
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu nu : Fin d → ℕ) (hmu : Antitone mu) (hnu : Antitone nu),
  (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.cartanAmbientEquivalence mu nu hmu hnu).mulVec
      (Pi.single (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.highestBasisIndex (mu + nu)) 1) =
    Pi.single (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.highestPair mu nu) 1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.cartanAmbientEquivalence_intertwines
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu nu : Fin d → ℕ) (hmu : Antitone mu) (hnu : Antitone nu) (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)),
  (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.pairAmbientRepresentation mu nu) U *
      FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.cartanAmbientEquivalence mu nu hmu hnu =
    FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.cartanAmbientEquivalence mu nu hmu hnu *
      (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.ambientRepresentation (mu + nu)) U

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.cartanAmbientEquivalence_isometry
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu nu : Fin d → ℕ) (hmu : Antitone mu) (hnu : Antitone nu),
  (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.cartanAmbientEquivalence mu nu hmu hnu).conjTranspose *
      FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.cartanAmbientEquivalence mu nu hmu hnu =
    1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.cartanAmbientEquivalence_supported
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu nu : Fin d → ℕ) (hmu : Antitone mu) (hnu : Antitone nu),
  FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.pairIrrepEmbedding mu nu *
        (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.pairIrrepEmbedding mu nu).conjTranspose *
      (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.cartanAmbientEquivalence mu nu hmu hnu *
        FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.irrepEmbedding (mu + nu)) =
    FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.cartanAmbientEquivalence mu nu hmu hnu *
      FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.irrepEmbedding (mu + nu)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.cartanAmbientSubspace
declarations.statement:
{d : ℕ} →
  (mu nu : Fin d → ℕ) →
    Submodule ℂ
      (EuclideanSpace ℂ
        (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.AmbientIndex mu × FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.AmbientIndex nu))

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.cartanAmbientSubspace_irreducible
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu nu : Fin d → ℕ),
  Antitone mu →

      FreeEntropy.UnitaryDecomposition.IrreducibleSubspace
        (FreeEntropy.UnitaryDecomposition.euclideanRepresentation

        (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.cartanAmbientSubspace mu nu)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.cartanEmbedding
declarations.statement:
{d : ℕ} →
  (mu nu : Fin d → ℕ) →

        Matrix (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex mu × FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex nu)
          (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex (mu + nu)) ℂ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.cartanEmbedding_balance
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu nu : Fin d → ℕ) (hmu : Antitone mu) (hnu : Antitone nu),
  FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.partialTrace
      (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.cartanEmbedding mu nu hmu hnu *
        (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.cartanEmbedding mu nu hmu hnu).conjTranspose) =
    (↑(Fintype.card (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex (mu + nu))) /
        ↑(Fintype.card (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex mu))) •
      1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.cartanEmbedding_intertwines
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu nu : Fin d → ℕ) (hmu : Antitone mu) (hnu : Antitone nu) (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)),
  Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun (x1 x2 : ℂ) => x1 * x2) ((FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.irrepMatrix mu) U)
        ((FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.irrepMatrix nu) U) *
      FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.cartanEmbedding mu nu hmu hnu =
    FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.cartanEmbedding mu nu hmu hnu *
      (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.irrepMatrix (mu + nu)) U

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.cartanEmbedding_isometry
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu nu : Fin d → ℕ) (hmu : Antitone mu) (hnu : Antitone nu),
  (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.cartanEmbedding mu nu hmu hnu).conjTranspose *
      FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.cartanEmbedding mu nu hmu hnu =
    1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.character
declarations.statement: {d k : ℕ} → (Fin d → ℂ) → ↑(FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.Index d k) → ℂ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.character_eq_weight_monomial
declarations.statement:
∀ {d k : ℕ} (z : Fin d → ℂ) (s : ↑(FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.Index d k)),
  FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.character z s = ∏ i : Fin d, z i ^ FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.weight s i

∀ {d r : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r),

    FreeEntropy.Theorem2.cloningConstant d r s.qx

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.columnEquiv

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.columnEquiv_height
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu nu : Fin d → ℕ) (hmu : Antitone mu) (hnu : Antitone nu)
  (c : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.Column (mu + nu)),
  FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.sumColumnHeight mu nu
      ((FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.columnEquiv mu nu hmu hnu) c) =
    FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.columnHeight (mu + nu) c

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.columnHeight
declarations.statement: {d : ℕ} → (mu : Fin d → ℕ) → FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.Column mu → ℕ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.columnHeight_le
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ) (c : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.Column mu),
  FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.columnHeight mu c ≤ d

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.columnHeight_mem
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ),
  Antitone mu →
    ∀ (c : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.Column mu) (i : Fin d),
      ↑i < FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.columnHeight mu c ↔ ↑c < mu i

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.column_fiber_card
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu nu : Fin d → ℕ),
  Antitone mu →
    Antitone nu →
      ∀ (k : ℕ),
        Fintype.card
            { c : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.Column (mu + nu) //
              FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.columnHeight (mu + nu) c = k } =
          Fintype.card
            { c : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.Column mu ⊕ FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.Column nu //
              FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.sumColumnHeight mu nu c = k }

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.constantWeightIndex_subsingleton
declarations.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (c : ℕ), 0 < d → Subsingleton (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex fun (x : Fin d) => c)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.constantWeight_dimension
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (c : ℕ),
  0 < d → Module.finrank ℂ ↥(FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.highestSubspace fun (x : Fin d) => c) = 1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.differenceNorm
declarations.statement: {d : ℕ} → (Fin d → ℕ) → (Fin d → ℕ) → ℕ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.differenceNorm_cast
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu nu : Fin d → ℕ),
  ↑(FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.differenceNorm mu nu) =
    FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.l1 fun (i : Fin d) => ↑(nu i) - ↑(mu i)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.differenceNorm_pos
declarations.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (mu nu : Fin d → ℕ), nu ≠ mu → 1 ≤ FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.differenceNorm mu nu

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.differenceNorm_zero_iff
declarations.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (mu nu : Fin d → ℕ), FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.differenceNorm mu nu = 0 ↔ nu = mu

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.dimensionRatio_eq_extended
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu nu : Fin d → ℕ),
  Antitone mu →
    Antitone nu →
      0 < d →
        ↑(Fintype.card (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex mu)) /
            ↑(Fintype.card (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex nu)) =
          FreeEntropy.Weyl.activeProduct d d (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.extendRow fun (i : Fin d) => ↑(mu i)) /
            FreeEntropy.Weyl.activeProduct d d fun (i : ℕ) =>
              FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.extendRow (fun (j : Fin d) => ↑(mu j)) i +
                FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.extendRow (fun (j : Fin d) => ↑(nu j) - ↑(mu j)) i

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.energy
declarations.statement: {d k : ℕ} → ↑(FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.Index d k) → ℕ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.energy_eq_first_iff
declarations.statement:
∀ {d k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ d) (s : ↑(FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.Index d k)),
  FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.energy s =
      FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.energy (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.first hk) ↔
    s = FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.first hk

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.energy_eq_weight_sum
declarations.statement:
∀ {d k : ℕ} (s : ↑(FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.Index d k)),
  FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.energy s = ∑ i : Fin d, ↑i * FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.weight s i

declarations.statement: {d k : ℕ} → ↑(FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.Index d k) → Fin k ↪o Fin d

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.enumerate_first
declarations.statement:
∀ {d k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ d) (i : Fin k),
  (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.enumerate (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.first hk)) i = Fin.castLE hk i

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.enumerate_replacement
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (i j : Fin d) (hji : j ≤ i) (t : Fin (↑j + 1)),
  (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.enumerate (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.replacementSubset i j hji)) t =
    (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.replacementEmbedding i j hji) t

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.enumerate_val_ge
declarations.statement:
∀ {d k : ℕ} (s : ↑(FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.Index d k)) (i : Fin k),
  ↑i ≤ ↑((FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.enumerate s) i)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.exists_constant_shift_unitary
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ),
  Antitone mu →
    ∀ (c : ℕ),
      ∃ (W :
        Matrix (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex fun (i : Fin d) => mu i + c)
          (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex mu) ℂ),
        W.conjTranspose * W = 1 ∧
          W * W.conjTranspose = 1 ∧
            ∀ (i j : Fin d),
              W * ((FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.irrepGenerators mu).shift ↑c).E i j =
                (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.irrepGenerators fun (i : Fin d) => mu i + c).E i j * W

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.exists_rootAssignment_of_actualWeight_ne_bot
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu wt : Fin d → ℕ),
  Antitone mu →
    FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.actualWeightSpace mu wt ≠ ⊥ →
      ∃ (a : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d →₀ ℕ),
        ∀ (k : Fin d), ↑(wt k) - ↑(mu k) = FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootWeightShift a k

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.extendRow
declarations.statement: {d : ℕ} → {R : Type u_1} → [Zero R] → (Fin d → R) → ℕ → R

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.extendRow_apply
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {R : Type u_1} [inst : Zero R] (w : Fin d → R) (i : Fin d),
  FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.extendRow w ↑i = w i

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.exteriorMatrix_adjoint
declarations.statement:
∀ {d k : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ),
  FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.exteriorMatrix k A.conjTranspose =
    (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.exteriorMatrix k A).conjTranspose

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.exteriorMatrix_apply
declarations.statement:
∀ {d k : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) (s t : ↑(FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.Index d k)),
  FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.exteriorMatrix k A s t =
    (A.submatrix ⇑(FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.enumerate s)
        ⇑(FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.enumerate t)).det

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.exteriorMatrix_continuous
declarations.statement: ∀ (d k : ℕ), Continuous (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.exteriorMatrix k)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.exteriorMatrix_diagonal
declarations.statement:
∀ {d k : ℕ} (z : Fin d → ℂ),
  FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.exteriorMatrix k (Matrix.diagonal z) =
    Matrix.diagonal (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.character z)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.exteriorMatrix_indexCast
declarations.statement:
∀ {d k l : ℕ} (h : k = l) (U : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) (x y : ↑(FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.Index d k)),
  FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.exteriorMatrix l U ((FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.indexCast h) x)
      ((FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.indexCast h) y) =
    FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.exteriorMatrix k U x y

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.exteriorMatrix_mul
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (k : ℕ) (A B : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ),
  FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.exteriorMatrix k (A * B) =
    FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.exteriorMatrix k A * FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.exteriorMatrix k B

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.exteriorMatrix_one
declarations.statement: ∀ (d k : ℕ), FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.exteriorMatrix k 1 = 1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.exteriorMatrix_unitary
declarations.statement:
∀ {d k : ℕ} {U : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ},
  U.conjTranspose * U = 1 →
    (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.exteriorMatrix k U).conjTranspose *
        FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.exteriorMatrix k U =
      1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.exteriorTensorEmbedding

declarations.statement:

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.exteriorTensorEmbedding_isometry
declarations.statement:

declarations.statement:
∀ {d k : ℕ} (z : Fin d → ℂ) (s : ↑(FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.Index d k)),

    FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.character z s • (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.wedgeBasis d k) s

declarations.statement:

    exteriorPower.toTensorPower ℂ (Fin d → ℂ) k ∘ₗ exteriorPower.map k (Matrix.toLin' U)

declarations.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype I] [inst_1 : DecidableEq I] (height : I → ℕ) (d : ℕ) (U : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ),

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.fiberCardEmbedding_preserves
declarations.statement:

declarations.statement:

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.flattenPermutation_isometry
declarations.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] (height : I → ℕ) (d : ℕ),
  (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.flattenPermutation height d).conjTranspose *
      FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.flattenPermutation height d =
    1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.flattenedTensor_entry
declarations.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] (height : I → ℕ) (d : ℕ) (U : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ)
  (x y : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.FactorWords height d),
  FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.matrix (∑ i : I, height i) U
      ((FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.factorWordEquiv height d) x)
      ((FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.factorWordEquiv height d) y) =
    FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rectProduct (fun (i : I) => FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.matrix (height i) U) x y

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.forwardCartanChannel
declarations.statement:
{d : ℕ} →
  (mu nu : Fin d → ℕ) →
    Antitone mu →
      Antitone nu →
        FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex mu)
          (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex (mu + nu))

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.forwardCartanChannel_apply
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu nu : Fin d → ℕ) (hmu : Antitone mu) (hnu : Antitone nu)
  (X : Matrix (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex mu) (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex mu) ℂ),
  (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.forwardCartanChannel mu nu hmu hnu).toFun X =
    (↑(Fintype.card (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex mu)) /
        ↑(Fintype.card (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex (mu + nu)))) •
      ((FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.cartanEmbedding mu nu hmu hnu).conjTranspose *
          Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun (x1 x2 : ℂ) => x1 * x2) X 1 *
        FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.cartanEmbedding mu nu hmu hnu)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.heightFiber
declarations.statement: {d : ℕ} → (Fin d → ℕ) → ℕ → ℕ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.heightFiber_add
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu nu : Fin d → ℕ),
  Antitone mu →
    Antitone nu →
      ∀ (k : ℕ),
        FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.heightFiber (mu + nu) k =
          FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.heightFiber mu k + FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.heightFiber nu k

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.heightFiber_adjacent

  Antitone mu →
    ∀ (j : Fin d) (hj : ↑j + 1 < d), FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.heightFiber mu (↑j + 1) + mu ⟨↑j + 1, hj⟩ = mu j

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.heightFiber_succ_add
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ) (k : ℕ),
  FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.heightFiber mu (k + 1) + FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.heightTail mu (k + 1) =
    FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.heightTail mu k

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.heightFiber_zero_add
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ),
  FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.heightFiber mu 0 + FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.heightTail mu 0 =
    ∑ i : Fin d, mu i

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.heightTail_eq
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ),

    ∀ (t : ℕ), FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.heightTail mu t = FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rowAt mu t

declarations.statement: {d : ℕ} → (mu : Fin d → ℕ) → FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.AmbientIndex mu

declarations.statement: {d : ℕ} → (mu : Fin d → ℕ) → Submodule ℂ (EuclideanSpace ℂ (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.AmbientIndex mu))

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.highestSubspace_irreducible

    (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.highestSubspace mu)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.highestVector
declarations.statement: {d : ℕ} → (mu : Fin d → ℕ) → EuclideanSpace ℂ (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.AmbientIndex mu)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.highestVector_ne_zero
declarations.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ), FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.highestVector mu ≠ 0

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.highestVector_weight
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ),
  Antitone mu →
    ∀ (z : Fin d → ℂ) (hz : ∀ (i : Fin d), ‖z i‖ = 1),
      ((FreeEntropy.UnitaryDecomposition.euclideanRepresentation
              (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.ambientRepresentation mu))
            (FreeEntropy.Occupation.diagonalUnitary z hz))
          (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.highestVector mu) =
        (∏ i : Fin d, z i ^ mu i) • FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.highestVector mu

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.indexCast_first
