∀ {d k l : ℕ} (h : k = l) (hk : k ≤ d) (hl : l ≤ d),
  (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.indexCast h) (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.first hk) =
    FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.first hl

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.indexCast_val
declarations.statement:
∀ {d k l : ℕ} (h : k = l) (s : ↑(FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.Index d k)),
  ↑((FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.indexCast h) s) = ↑s

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.intertwiner_range_projection_commutes
declarations.statement:
∀ {G : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : Fintype A] [inst_2 : DecidableEq A]
  [inst_3 : Fintype B] [inst_4 : DecidableEq B] (U : G →* Matrix A A ℂ) (V : G →* Matrix B B ℂ),
  (∀ (g : G), (U g).conjTranspose * U g = 1) →
    (∀ (g : G), (V g).conjTranspose * V g = 1) →
      ∀ (W : Matrix A B ℂ),
        (∀ (g : G), U g * W = W * V g) → ∀ (g : G), W * W.conjTranspose * U g = U g * (W * W.conjTranspose)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.irrepEmbedding
declarations.statement:
{d : ℕ} →
  (mu : Fin d → ℕ) →
    Matrix (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.AmbientIndex mu) (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex mu) ℂ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.irrepEmbedding_highest
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ),
  (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.irrepEmbedding mu).mulVec (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.irrepHighest mu) =
    (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.highestVector mu).ofLp

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.irrepEmbedding_intertwines
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ) (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)),
  (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.ambientRepresentation mu) U *
      FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.irrepEmbedding mu =
    FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.irrepEmbedding mu * (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.irrepMatrix mu) U

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.irrepEmbedding_isometry
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ),
  (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.irrepEmbedding mu).conjTranspose *
      FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.irrepEmbedding mu =
    1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.irrepEmbedding_lie_intertwines
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ) (i j : Fin d),
  (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.ambientGenerators mu).E i j *
      FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.irrepEmbedding mu =
    FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.irrepEmbedding mu * (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.irrepGenerators mu).E i j

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.irrepGenerators
declarations.statement:
{d : ℕ} →
  (mu : Fin d → ℕ) → FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex mu)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.irrepGenerators_compressed
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ) (i j : Fin d),
  (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.irrepGenerators mu).E i j =
    (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.irrepEmbedding mu).conjTranspose *
        (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.ambientGenerators mu).E i j *
      FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.irrepEmbedding mu

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.irrepGenerators_intertwines
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ) (i j : Fin d),
  (FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.generators d (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.tensorDegree mu)).E i j *
      FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.irrepTensorEmbedding mu =
    FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.irrepTensorEmbedding mu *
      (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.irrepGenerators mu).E i j

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.irrepHighest
declarations.statement: {d : ℕ} → (mu : Fin d → ℕ) → FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex mu → ℂ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.irrepHighest_cyclic
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ),
  FreeEntropy.LiePBW.cyclicSpan (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.irrepGenerators mu)
      (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.irrepHighest mu) =
    ⊤

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.irrepHighest_ne_zero
declarations.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ), FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.irrepHighest mu ≠ 0

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.irrepHighest_raise
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ) (i j : Fin d),
  i < j →
    ((FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.irrepGenerators mu).E i j).mulVec
        (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.irrepHighest mu) =
      0

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.irrepHighest_weight
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ),
  Antitone mu →
    ∀ (k : Fin d),
      ((FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.irrepGenerators mu).E k k).mulVec
          (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.irrepHighest mu) =
        ↑(mu k) • FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.irrepHighest mu

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.irrepMatrix
declarations.statement:
{d : ℕ} →
  (mu : Fin d → ℕ) →
    ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ) →*
      Matrix (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex mu) (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex mu) ℂ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.irrepMatrix_continuous
declarations.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ), Continuous ⇑(FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.irrepMatrix mu)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.irrepMatrix_irreducible
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ),
  (FreeEntropy.Twirling.matrixRepresentation (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.irrepMatrix mu)).IsIrreducible

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.irrepMatrix_unitary
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ) (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)),
  ((FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.irrepMatrix mu) U).conjTranspose *
      (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.irrepMatrix mu) U =
    1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.irrepProjection_commutant
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ),
  FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.ExteriorCommutant (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.columnHeight mu)
    (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.irrepEmbedding mu *
      (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.irrepEmbedding mu).conjTranspose)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.irrepProjection_highest
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ),
  (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.irrepEmbedding mu *
          (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.irrepEmbedding mu).conjTranspose).mulVec
      (Pi.single (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.highestBasisIndex mu) 1) =
    Pi.single (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.highestBasisIndex mu) 1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.irrepTensorEmbedding
declarations.statement:
{d : ℕ} →
  (mu : Fin d → ℕ) →
    Matrix (Fin (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.tensorDegree mu) → Fin d)
      (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex mu) ℂ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.irrepTensorEmbedding_intertwines
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ) (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)),
  (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalRepresentation d (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.tensorDegree mu)) U *
      FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.irrepTensorEmbedding mu =
    FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.irrepTensorEmbedding mu * (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.irrepMatrix mu) U

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.irrepTensorEmbedding_isometry
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ),
  (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.irrepTensorEmbedding mu).conjTranspose *
      FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.irrepTensorEmbedding mu =
    1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.irrep_cyclicSpan_eq_top
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ) (v : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex mu → ℂ),
  v ≠ 0 → FreeEntropy.LiePBW.cyclicSpan (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.irrepGenerators mu) v = ⊤

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.irrep_dimension_constant_shift
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ),
  Antitone mu →
    ∀ (c : ℕ),
      Module.finrank ℂ ↥(FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.highestSubspace fun (i : Fin d) => mu i + c) =
        Module.finrank ℂ ↥(FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.highestSubspace mu)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.irrep_dimension_pos
declarations.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ), 0 < Module.finrank ℂ ↥(FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.highestSubspace mu)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.le_auxiliaryShift
declarations.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ) (i : Fin d), mu i ≤ FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.auxiliaryShift mu

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.le_minimumRowGap
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ),
  Antitone mu →
    ∀ (rank : ℕ) (hd : 2 ≤ d) (hr : 0 < rank) (b : ℝ),
      (∀ (j : Fin (d - 1)),
          ↑j < rank → b ≤ ↑(mu (FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.left j)) - ↑(mu (FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.right j))) →
        b ≤ ↑(FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.minimumRowGap mu rank hd hr)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.lowerAssignmentsAtDepth
declarations.statement: {d : ℕ} → ℕ → Finset (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d →₀ ℕ)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.lowerRootMatrix
declarations.statement: {d : ℕ} → (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d → ℂ) → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.lowerRootMatrix_diagonal
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (x : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d → ℂ) (i : Fin d),
  FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.lowerRootMatrix x i i = 1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.lowerRootMatrix_root
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (x : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d → ℂ) (r : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d),
  FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.lowerRootMatrix x (↑r).2 (↑r).1 = x r

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.lowerRootMatrix_upper
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (x : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d → ℂ) (i j : Fin d),
  i < j → FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.lowerRootMatrix x i j = 0

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.lowerRootNatEquiv
declarations.statement: {d : ℕ} → FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d ≃ ↥(FreeEntropy.Weyl.activeRoots d d)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.lowerUnitriangular_first_minor
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (L : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ),
  (∀ (i j : Fin d), i < j → L i j = 0) →
    (∀ (i : Fin d), L i i = 1) →
      ∀ (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ d),
        FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.exteriorMatrix k L (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.first hk)
            (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.first hk) =
          1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.lowerUnitriangular_replacement_minor
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (L : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ),
  (∀ (a b : Fin d), a < b → L a b = 0) →
    (∀ (a : Fin d), L a a = 1) →
      ∀ (i j : Fin d) (hji : j ≤ i),
        FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.exteriorMatrix (↑j + 1) L
            (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.replacementSubset i j hji)
            (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.first ⋯) =
          L i j

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.lowerWeightFiber
declarations.statement:
{d : ℕ} →
  (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d →₀ ℕ) → Finset (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d →₀ ℕ)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.lowerWeightFiber_card_le_weight_finrank
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ) (hmu : Antitone mu) (g : ℕ)
  (hgap : ∀ (j : Fin d) (hj : ↑j + 1 < d), g + mu ⟨↑j + 1, hj⟩ ≤ mu j)
  (a₀ : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d →₀ ℕ)
  (ha₀ : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootDepth a₀ ≤ g),
  (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.lowerWeightFiber a₀).card ≤
    Module.finrank ℂ
      ↥(FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.actualWeightSpace mu
          (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.tensorWeight (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.columnHeight mu)
            (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.shallowMonomialBasis mu a₀ hmu g hgap ha₀)))

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.lowerWeightFiber_root_support
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (a b : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d →₀ ℕ) (rank : ℕ),
  (∀ (k : Fin d), rank ≤ ↑k → FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootWeightShift a k = 0) →
    b ∈ FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.lowerWeightFiber a →
      ∀ (r : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d), b r ≠ 0 → ↑(↑r).2 < rank

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.matrix_highest_mem
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ) (A : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ),
  (Matrix.toEuclideanLin
        (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.tensorMatrix (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.columnHeight mu) A))
      (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.highestVector mu) ∈
    FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.highestSubspace mu

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.mem_enumerate
declarations.statement:
∀ {d k : ℕ} (s : ↑(FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.Index d k)) (i : Fin k),
  (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.enumerate s) i ∈ ↑s

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.mem_first_iff
declarations.statement: ∀ {d k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ d) (i : Fin d), i ∈ ↑(FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.first hk) ↔ ↑i < k

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.mem_lowerAssignmentsAtDepth
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (a : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d →₀ ℕ) (t : ℕ),
  a ∈ FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.lowerAssignmentsAtDepth t ↔ FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootDepth a = t

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.mem_lowerWeightFiber
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (a b : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d →₀ ℕ),
  b ∈ FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.lowerWeightFiber a ↔
    FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootWeightShift b = FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootWeightShift a

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.mem_replacement_iff
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (i j : Fin d) (hji : j ≤ i) (k : Fin d),
  k ∈ ↑(FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.replacementSubset i j hji) ↔ ↑k < ↑j ∨ k = i

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.minimumRowGap
declarations.statement: {d : ℕ} → (Fin d → ℕ) → (rank : ℕ) → 2 ≤ d → 0 < rank → ℕ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.minimumRowGap_cast_le
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ),
  Antitone mu →
    ∀ (rank : ℕ) (hd : 2 ≤ d) (hr : 0 < rank) (j : Fin (d - 1)),
      ↑j < rank →
        ↑(FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.minimumRowGap mu rank hd hr) ≤
          ↑(mu (FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.left j)) - ↑(mu (FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.right j))

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.minimumRowGap_le
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ) (rank : ℕ) (hd : 2 ≤ d) (hr : 0 < rank) (j : Fin (d - 1)),
  ↑j < rank →
    FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.minimumRowGap mu rank hd hr ≤
      mu (FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.left j) - mu (FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.right j)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.monomialBasis
declarations.statement:
{d : ℕ} →
  (mu : Fin d → ℕ) →
    (a : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d →₀ ℕ) →
      (∀ (k : ℕ),
          Fintype.card
              { x : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.RootCopies a //
                FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootCopyHeight a x = k } ≤
            FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.heightFiber mu k) →
        FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.AmbientIndex mu

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.monomialBasis_at
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ) (a : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d →₀ ℕ)
  (hcapacity :
    ∀ (k : ℕ),
      Fintype.card
          { x : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.RootCopies a //
            FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootCopyHeight a x = k } ≤
        FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.heightFiber mu k)
  (x : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.RootCopies a),
  FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.monomialBasis mu a hcapacity
      ((FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootColumnEmbedding mu a hcapacity) x) =
    (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.indexCast ⋯)
      (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.replacementSubset (↑x.fst).2 (↑x.fst).1 ⋯)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.monomialBasis_coefficient
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ) (a : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d →₀ ℕ)
  (hcapacity :
    ∀ (k : ℕ),
      Fintype.card
          { x : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.RootCopies a //
            FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootCopyHeight a x = k } ≤
        FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.heightFiber mu k)
  (L : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ),
  (∀ (i j : Fin d), i < j → L i j = 0) →
    (∀ (i : Fin d), L i i = 1) →
      FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.tensorMatrix (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.columnHeight mu) L
          (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.monomialBasis mu a hcapacity)
          (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.highestBasisIndex mu) =
        ∏ r : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d, L (↑r).2 (↑r).1 ^ a r

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.monomialBasis_off
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ) (a : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d →₀ ℕ)
  (hcapacity :
    ∀ (k : ℕ),
      Fintype.card
          { x : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.RootCopies a //
            FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootCopyHeight a x = k } ≤
        FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.heightFiber mu k),
  ∀ c ∉ Set.range ⇑(FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootColumnEmbedding mu a hcapacity),
    FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.monomialBasis mu a hcapacity c = FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.first ⋯

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.monomialBasis_weight_difference
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ) (a : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d →₀ ℕ),
  Antitone mu →
    ∀
      (hcapacity :
        ∀ (k : ℕ),
          Fintype.card
              { x : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.RootCopies a //
                FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootCopyHeight a x = k } ≤
            FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.heightFiber mu k)
      (k : Fin d),
      ↑(FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.tensorWeight (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.columnHeight mu)
              (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.monomialBasis mu a hcapacity) k) -
          ↑(mu k) =
        FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootWeightShift a k

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.monomial_family_card_le_weight_finrank
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {I : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype I] (mu a : Fin d → ℕ)
  (exponent : I → FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d →₀ ℕ),
  Function.Injective exponent →
    ∀
      (hcapacity :
        ∀ (i : I) (k : ℕ),
          Fintype.card
              { x : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.RootCopies (exponent i) //
                FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootCopyHeight (exponent i) x = k } ≤
            FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.heightFiber mu k),
      (∀ (i : I),
          FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.tensorWeight (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.columnHeight mu)
              (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.monomialBasis mu (exponent i) ⋯) =
            a) →
        Fintype.card I ≤ Module.finrank ℂ ↥(FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.actualWeightSpace mu a)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.pairWeight_unique
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu nu : Fin d → ℕ),
  Antitone mu →
    Antitone nu →
      ∀ (x : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.AmbientIndex mu × FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.AmbientIndex nu),
        FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.pairWeight mu nu x =

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.pair_weight_unique

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.prefix_eq_enumerate
declarations.statement:
∀ {d k : ℕ} (s : ↑(FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.Index d k)) (t : ℕ),

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.prefix_eq_weight_sum

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.prefix_le

{ι : Type u_1} →

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.productMatrix_adjoint
declarations.statement:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {B : ι → Type u_2} [(a : ι) → Fintype (B a)]
  [(a : ι) → DecidableEq (B a)] (A : (a : ι) → Matrix (B a) (B a) ℂ),
  (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.productMatrix fun (a : ι) => (A a).conjTranspose) =
    (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.productMatrix A).conjTranspose

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.productMatrix_diagonal
declarations.statement:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {B : ι → Type u_2} [(a : ι) → Fintype (B a)]
  [inst_3 : (a : ι) → DecidableEq (B a)] (z : (a : ι) → B a → ℂ),
  (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.productMatrix fun (a : ι) => Matrix.diagonal (z a)) =
    Matrix.diagonal fun (x : (a : ι) → B a) => ∏ a : ι, z a (x a)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.productMatrix_mul
declarations.statement:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {B : ι → Type u_2} [inst_2 : (a : ι) → Fintype (B a)]
  [(a : ι) → DecidableEq (B a)] (A C : (a : ι) → Matrix (B a) (B a) ℂ),
  (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.productMatrix fun (a : ι) => A a * C a) =
    FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.productMatrix A * FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.productMatrix C

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.productMatrix_one
declarations.statement:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {B : ι → Type u_2} [(a : ι) → Fintype (B a)]
  [inst_3 : (a : ι) → DecidableEq (B a)], (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.productMatrix fun (a : ι) => 1) = 1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.projectedRootOrbit_coordinate
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu a : Fin d → ℕ) (b : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.AmbientIndex mu),
  FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.tensorWeight (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.columnHeight mu) b = a →
    ∀ (x : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d → ℂ),
      (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.weightCoordinate mu a b)
          (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.projectedRootOrbit mu a x) =
        FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.tensorMatrix (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.columnHeight mu)
          (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.lowerRootMatrix x) b
          (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.highestBasisIndex mu)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.projection_fixes_cyclic_image
declarations.statement:
∀ {G : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : Fintype A] [inst_2 : DecidableEq A]
  [inst_3 : Fintype B] [inst_4 : DecidableEq B] (U : G →* Matrix A A ℂ) (V : G →* Matrix B B ℂ) (T : Matrix B A ℂ),
  (∀ (g : G), V g * T = T * U g) →
    ∀ (P : Matrix B B ℂ),
      (∀ (g : G), P * V g = V g * P) →
        ∀ (v : EuclideanSpace ℂ A),
          P.mulVec (T.mulVec v.ofLp) = T.mulVec v.ofLp →
            ∀
              x ∈
                FreeEntropy.UnitaryDecomposition.cyclicSubspace
                  (FreeEntropy.UnitaryDecomposition.euclideanRepresentation U) v,
              P.mulVec (T.mulVec x.ofLp) = T.mulVec x.ofLp

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.prvForward_eq
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu nu : Fin d → ℕ) (hmu : Antitone mu) (hnu : Antitone nu)
  (hinc : Antitone fun (i : Fin d) => ↑(nu i) - ↑(mu i)),
  0 < d →
    ∀
      (X :
        Matrix (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex mu) (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex mu) ℂ),
      FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.prvForward mu nu hmu hnu hinc X =
        (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalForward mu nu hmu hnu hinc).toFun X

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.prvReverse

            Matrix (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex mu) (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex mu)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.prvReverse_eq
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu nu : Fin d → ℕ) (hmu : Antitone mu) (hnu : Antitone nu)
  (hinc : Antitone fun (i : Fin d) => ↑(nu i) - ↑(mu i)),

      (Y :
        Matrix (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex nu) (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex nu) ℂ),
      FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.prvReverse mu nu hmu hnu hinc Y =

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.prv_maps_are_channels
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu nu : Fin d → ℕ) (hmu : Antitone mu) (hnu : Antitone nu)
  (hinc : Antitone fun (i : Fin d) => ↑(nu i) - ↑(mu i)),
  0 < d →
    ∃ (F :
      FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex mu)
        (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex nu))
      (R :
      FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex nu)
        (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex mu)),
      F.toFun = FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.prvForward mu nu hmu hnu hinc ∧
        R.toFun = FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.prvReverse mu nu hmu hnu hinc

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rankLowerRootEquiv
declarations.statement:
{d : ℕ} →
  (rank : ℕ) →
    rank ≤ d →
      ↥(FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rankLowerRoots rank) ≃ FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot rank

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rankLowerRoots
declarations.statement: {d : ℕ} → ℕ → Finset (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rank_root_fibers_depth_le
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ},
  ∀ rank ≤ d,
    2 ≤ rank →
      ∀ (s : Finset (Fin (d - 1) → ℕ)),
        (∀ delta ∈ s, FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.SupportedSimpleOffset rank delta) →
          ∀ (t : ℕ),
            ∑ delta ∈ s with FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.depth delta = t,
                (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.lowerWeightFiber
                    (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.simpleRootAssignment delta)).card ≤
              (t + rank.choose 2 - 1).choose (rank.choose 2 - 1)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rank_supported_actualWeight_finrank_add_dominant
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu omega wt : Fin d → ℕ),
  Antitone mu →
    Antitone omega →
      ∀ (g rank : ℕ),
        (∀ (j : Fin d) (hj : ↑j + 1 < d), ↑j + 1 < rank → g + mu ⟨↑j + 1, hj⟩ ≤ mu j) →
          ∀ (a : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d →₀ ℕ),
            FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootDepth a ≤ g →
              (∀ (k : Fin d), ↑(wt k) - ↑(mu k) = FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootWeightShift a k) →
                (∀ (k : Fin d), rank ≤ ↑k → wt k = mu k) →
                  Module.finrank ℂ ↥(FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.actualWeightSpace (mu + omega) (wt + omega)) =
                    Module.finrank ℂ ↥(FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.actualWeightSpace mu wt)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rank_supported_actualWeight_finrank_eq_rootFiber
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu wt : Fin d → ℕ),
  Antitone mu →
    ∀ (g rank : ℕ),
      (∀ (j : Fin d) (hj : ↑j + 1 < d), ↑j + 1 < rank → g + mu ⟨↑j + 1, hj⟩ ≤ mu j) →
        ∀ (a : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d →₀ ℕ),
          FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootDepth a ≤ g →
            (∀ (k : Fin d), ↑(wt k) - ↑(mu k) = FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootWeightShift a k) →
              (∀ (k : Fin d), rank ≤ ↑k → wt k = mu k) →
                Module.finrank ℂ ↥(FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.actualWeightSpace mu wt) =
                  (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.lowerWeightFiber a).card

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rank_supported_lowerWeightFiber_card_le_weight_finrank
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ),
  Antitone mu →
    ∀ (g rank : ℕ),
      (∀ (j : Fin d) (hj : ↑j + 1 < d), ↑j + 1 < rank → g + mu ⟨↑j + 1, hj⟩ ≤ mu j) →
        ∀ (a₀ : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d →₀ ℕ),
          FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootDepth a₀ ≤ g →
            (∀ (k : Fin d), rank ≤ ↑k → FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootWeightShift a₀ k = 0) →
              ∃ (a : Fin d → ℕ),
                (∀ (k : Fin d), ↑(a k) - ↑(mu k) = FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootWeightShift a₀ k) ∧
                  (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.lowerWeightFiber a₀).card ≤
                    Module.finrank ℂ ↥(FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.actualWeightSpace mu a)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.real_matrix_highest_mem
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ) (A : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ),
  (Matrix.toEuclideanLin
        (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.tensorMatrix (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.columnHeight mu)
          (A.map Complex.ofReal)))
      (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.highestVector mu) ∈
    FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.highestSubspace mu

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.real_transvection_factor
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (i j : Fin d) (t : ℝ),
  Matrix.transvection i j ↑t = (Matrix.swap ℂ i j + Matrix.single i i ↑t) * Matrix.swap ℂ i j

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rectProduct
declarations.statement:
{I : Type u_1} →
  [Fintype I] →
    {A : I → Type u_2} →
      {B : I → Type u_3} → ((i : I) → Matrix (A i) (B i) ℂ) → Matrix ((i : I) → A i) ((i : I) → B i) ℂ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rectProduct_adjoint
declarations.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] {A : I → Type u_2} {B : I → Type u_3} [(i : I) → Fintype (A i)]
  [(i : I) → Fintype (B i)] [(i : I) → DecidableEq (A i)] [(i : I) → DecidableEq (B i)]
  (M : (i : I) → Matrix (A i) (B i) ℂ),
  (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rectProduct M).conjTranspose =
    FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rectProduct fun (i : I) => (M i).conjTranspose

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rectProduct_isometry
declarations.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype I] [inst_1 : DecidableEq I] {A : I → Type u_2} {B : I → Type u_3}
  [inst_2 : (i : I) → Fintype (A i)] [(i : I) → Fintype (B i)] [(i : I) → DecidableEq (A i)]
  [inst_5 : (i : I) → DecidableEq (B i)] (M : (i : I) → Matrix (A i) (B i) ℂ),
  (∀ (i : I), (M i).conjTranspose * M i = 1) →
    (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rectProduct M).conjTranspose *
        FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rectProduct M =
      1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rectProduct_mul
declarations.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype I] [inst_1 : DecidableEq I] {A : I → Type u_2} {B : I → Type u_3} {C : I → Type u_4}
  [(i : I) → Fintype (A i)] [inst_3 : (i : I) → Fintype (B i)] [(i : I) → Fintype (C i)] [(i : I) → DecidableEq (A i)]
  [(i : I) → DecidableEq (B i)] [(i : I) → DecidableEq (C i)] (M : (i : I) → Matrix (A i) (B i) ℂ)
  (N : (i : I) → Matrix (B i) (C i) ℂ),
  (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rectProduct fun (i : I) => M i * N i) =
    FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rectProduct M * FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rectProduct N

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rectProduct_one
declarations.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] {A : I → Type u_2} [(i : I) → Fintype (A i)]
  [inst_3 : (i : I) → DecidableEq (A i)], (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rectProduct fun (i : I) => 1) = 1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.replacementEmbedding
declarations.statement: {d : ℕ} → (i j : Fin d) → j ≤ i → Fin (↑j + 1) ↪o Fin d

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.replacementEmbedding_castSucc
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (i j : Fin d) (hji : j ≤ i) (t : Fin ↑j),
  (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.replacementEmbedding i j hji) t.castSucc = ⟨↑t, ⋯⟩

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.replacementEmbedding_last
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (i j : Fin d) (hji : j ≤ i),

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.replacementSubset

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.replacement_weight_difference
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (i j : Fin d) (hji : j < i) (k : Fin d),

      ↑(FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.weight (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.first ⋯) k) =
    (if k = i then 1 else 0) - if k = j then 1 else 0

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.reverseCartanChannel

{d : ℕ} →

          (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex mu)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.reverseCartanChannel_apply
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu nu : Fin d → ℕ) (hmu : Antitone mu) (hnu : Antitone nu)
  (Y :
    Matrix (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex (mu + nu))
      (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex (mu + nu)) ℂ),
  (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.reverseCartanChannel mu nu hmu hnu).toFun Y =
    FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.partialTrace
      (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.cartanEmbedding mu nu hmu hnu * Y *
        (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.cartanEmbedding mu nu hmu hnu).conjTranspose)

∀ {d : ℕ} (mu nu : Fin d → ℕ),

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootColumnEmbedding
declarations.statement:
{d : ℕ} →

              { x : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.RootCopies a //
                FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootCopyHeight a x = k } ≤

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootColumnEmbedding_height
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ) (a : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d →₀ ℕ)
  (hcapacity :
    ∀ (k : ℕ),
      Fintype.card
          { x : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.RootCopies a //
            FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootCopyHeight a x = k } ≤
        FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.heightFiber mu k)
  (x : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.RootCopies a),
  FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.columnHeight mu
      ((FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootColumnEmbedding mu a hcapacity) x) =
    ↑(↑x.fst).1 + 1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootCopies_card

∀ {d : ℕ} (a : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d →₀ ℕ),

    ∑ r : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d, a r

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootCopies_card_le_depth

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootDepth_eq_of_weightShift_eq
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (a b : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d →₀ ℕ),

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootDepth_eq_weightShift
declarations.statement:

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootWeightShift
declarations.statement: {d : ℕ} → (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d →₀ ℕ) → Fin d → ℤ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.root_target_lt_of_zero_tail
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (a : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d →₀ ℕ) (rank : ℕ),

    ∀ (r : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d), a r ≠ 0 → ↑(↑r).2 < rank

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rowL1_extendRow

∀ {d : ℕ} (w : Fin d → ℝ),

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.shallowMonomialBasis
declarations.statement:
{d : ℕ} →
  (mu : Fin d → ℕ) →
    (a : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d →₀ ℕ) →
      Antitone mu →
        (g : ℕ) →
          (∀ (j : Fin d) (hj : ↑j + 1 < d), g + mu ⟨↑j + 1, hj⟩ ≤ mu j) →
            FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootDepth a ≤ g → FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.AmbientIndex mu

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.shallowMonomialBasis_coefficient
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ) (a : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d →₀ ℕ) (hmu : Antitone mu) (g : ℕ)
  (hgap : ∀ (j : Fin d) (hj : ↑j + 1 < d), g + mu ⟨↑j + 1, hj⟩ ≤ mu j)
  (hdepth : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootDepth a ≤ g)
  (x : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d → ℂ),
  FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.tensorMatrix (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.columnHeight mu)
      (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.lowerRootMatrix x)
      (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.shallowMonomialBasis mu a hmu g hgap hdepth)
      (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.highestBasisIndex mu) =
    ∏ r : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d, x r ^ a r

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.shallowMonomialBasis_weight_difference
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ) (a : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d →₀ ℕ) (hmu : Antitone mu) (g : ℕ)
  (hgap : ∀ (j : Fin d) (hj : ↑j + 1 < d), g + mu ⟨↑j + 1, hj⟩ ≤ mu j)
  (hdepth : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootDepth a ≤ g) (k : Fin d),
  ↑(FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.tensorWeight (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.columnHeight mu)
          (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.shallowMonomialBasis mu a hmu g hgap hdepth) k) -
      ↑(mu k) =
    FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootWeightShift a k

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.shallowMonomialBasis_weight_eq
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ) (a b : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d →₀ ℕ) (hmu : Antitone mu) (g : ℕ)
  (hgap : ∀ (j : Fin d) (hj : ↑j + 1 < d), g + mu ⟨↑j + 1, hj⟩ ≤ mu j)
  (ha : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootDepth a ≤ g) (hb : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootDepth b ≤ g),
  FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootWeightShift a = FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootWeightShift b →
    FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.tensorWeight (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.columnHeight mu)
        (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.shallowMonomialBasis mu a hmu g hgap ha) =
      FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.tensorWeight (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.columnHeight mu)
        (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.shallowMonomialBasis mu b hmu g hgap hb)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.shallow_actualWeight_finrank_add_dominant
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu omega wt : Fin d → ℕ),
  Antitone mu →
    Antitone omega →
      ∀ (g : ℕ),
        (∀ (j : Fin d) (hj : ↑j + 1 < d), g + mu ⟨↑j + 1, hj⟩ ≤ mu j) →
          ∀ (a : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d →₀ ℕ),
            FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootDepth a ≤ g →
              (∀ (k : Fin d), ↑(wt k) - ↑(mu k) = FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootWeightShift a k) →
                Module.finrank ℂ ↥(FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.actualWeightSpace (mu + omega) (wt + omega)) =
                  Module.finrank ℂ ↥(FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.actualWeightSpace mu wt)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.shallow_actualWeight_finrank_eq_rootFiber
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu wt : Fin d → ℕ),
  Antitone mu →
    ∀ (g : ℕ),
      (∀ (j : Fin d) (hj : ↑j + 1 < d), g + mu ⟨↑j + 1, hj⟩ ≤ mu j) →
        ∀ (a : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d →₀ ℕ),
          FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootDepth a ≤ g →
            (∀ (k : Fin d), ↑(wt k) - ↑(mu k) = FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootWeightShift a k) →
              Module.finrank ℂ ↥(FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.actualWeightSpace mu wt) =
                (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.lowerWeightFiber a).card

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.shallow_monomials_card_le_weight_finrank
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ) (hmu : Antitone mu) (g : ℕ)
  (hgap : ∀ (j : Fin d) (hj : ↑j + 1 < d), g + mu ⟨↑j + 1, hj⟩ ≤ mu j)
  (s : Finset (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d →₀ ℕ))
  (a₀ : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d →₀ ℕ)
  (ha₀ : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootDepth a₀ ≤ g),
  (∀ a ∈ s, FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootDepth a ≤ g) →
    (∀ a ∈ s,
        FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootWeightShift a = FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootWeightShift a₀) →
      s.card ≤
        Module.finrank ℂ
          ↥(FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.actualWeightSpace mu
              (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.tensorWeight (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.columnHeight mu)
                (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.shallowMonomialBasis mu a₀ hmu g hgap ha₀)))

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.shallow_root_capacity
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ) (a : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d →₀ ℕ),
  Antitone mu →
    ∀ (g : ℕ),
      (∀ (j : Fin d) (hj : ↑j + 1 < d), g + mu ⟨↑j + 1, hj⟩ ≤ mu j) →
        FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootDepth a ≤ g →
          ∀ (k : ℕ),
            Fintype.card
                { x : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.RootCopies a //
                  FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootCopyHeight a x = k } ≤
              FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.heightFiber mu k

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.shiftedWeight_eq_of_difference
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu wt : Fin d → ℕ) (a : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d →₀ ℕ),
  (∀ (k : Fin d), ↑(wt k) - ↑(mu k) = FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootWeightShift a k) →
    FreeEntropy.LiePBW.shiftedWeight (fun (k : Fin d) => ↑(mu k)) a = fun (k : Fin d) => ↑(wt k)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.simpleRootAssignment
declarations.statement: {d : ℕ} → (Fin (d - 1) → ℕ) → FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d →₀ ℕ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.simpleRootAssignment_depth
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (delta : Fin (d - 1) → ℕ),
  FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootDepth (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.simpleRootAssignment delta) =
    FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.depth delta

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.simpleRootAssignment_shift
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (delta : Fin (d - 1) → ℕ) (k : Fin d),
  ↑(FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootWeightShift (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.simpleRootAssignment delta)
        k) =
    -FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.offset delta k

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.simpleRootAssignment_zero_tail
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (rank : ℕ) (delta : Fin (d - 1) → ℕ),
  FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.SupportedSimpleOffset rank delta →
    ∀ (k : Fin d),
      rank ≤ ↑k →
        FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootWeightShift
            (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.simpleRootAssignment delta) k =
          0

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.specifiedCanonicalCartan_phase
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu nu : Fin d → ℕ) (hmu : Antitone mu) (hnu : Antitone nu)
  (hinc : Antitone fun (i : Fin d) => ↑(nu i) - ↑(mu i)),
  0 < d →
    ∀ (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)),
      have V :=
        FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.specifiedCartanEmbedding
          (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeightModel mu)
          (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalAuxiliaryModel mu nu)
          (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeightModel nu) ⋯;
      ∃ (a : ℂ),
        a * star a = 1 ∧
          Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun (x1 x2 : ℂ) => x1 * x2)
                ((FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeightRepresentation mu) U)
                ((FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeightRepresentation
                    (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.auxiliaryRow mu nu))
                  U) *
              V =
            V * a • (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeightRepresentation nu) U

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.star_permutationSign
declarations.statement:
∀ {k : ℕ} (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin k)),
  star (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.permutationSign σ) = FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.permutationSign σ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.sumColumnHeight
declarations.statement:
{d : ℕ} →
  (mu nu : Fin d → ℕ) → FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.Column mu ⊕ FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.Column nu → ℕ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.sumHeightFiberEquiv
declarations.statement:
{d : ℕ} →
  (mu nu : Fin d → ℕ) →
    (k : ℕ) →
      { c : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.Column mu ⊕ FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.Column nu //
          FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.sumColumnHeight mu nu c = k } ≃
        { c : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.Column mu //
            FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.columnHeight mu c = k } ⊕
          { c : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.Column nu //
            FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.columnHeight nu c = k }

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.sum_enumerate
declarations.statement:
∀ {d k : ℕ} {R : Type u_1} [inst : AddCommMonoid R] (s : ↑(FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.Index d k))
  (f : Fin d → R), ∑ i : Fin k, f ((FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.enumerate s) i) = ∑ j ∈ ↑s, f j

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.sum_lowerWeightFiber_at_depth_le
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ},
  2 ≤ d →
    ∀ {B : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (a : B → FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d →₀ ℕ),
      (Function.Injective fun (b : B) => FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootWeightShift (a b)) →
        ∀ (t : ℕ),
          ∑ b : B with FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootDepth (a b) = t,
              (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.lowerWeightFiber (a b)).card ≤
            (t + d.choose 2 - 1).choose (d.choose 2 - 1)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.sum_weight
declarations.statement:
∀ {d k : ℕ} (s : ↑(FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.Index d k)),
  ∑ i : Fin d, FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.weight s i = k

declarations.statement: (d : ℕ) → ℕ → Finset (Fin (d - 1))

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.supportedGapIndices_nonempty
declarations.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (rank : ℕ), 2 ≤ d → 0 < rank → (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.supportedGapIndices d rank).Nonempty

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.supportedMonomialBasis
declarations.statement:
{d : ℕ} →
  (mu : Fin d → ℕ) →
    (a : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d →₀ ℕ) →
      Antitone mu →
        (g : ℕ) →
          (∀ (r : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d),
              a r ≠ 0 → g + mu (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootNext r) ≤ mu (↑r).1) →
            FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootDepth a ≤ g → FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.AmbientIndex mu

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.supportedMonomialBasis_coefficient
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ) (a : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d →₀ ℕ) (hmu : Antitone mu) (g : ℕ)
  (hgap :
    ∀ (r : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d),
      a r ≠ 0 → g + mu (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootNext r) ≤ mu (↑r).1)
  (hdepth : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootDepth a ≤ g)
  (x : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d → ℂ),
  FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.tensorMatrix (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.columnHeight mu)
      (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.lowerRootMatrix x)
      (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.supportedMonomialBasis mu a hmu g hgap hdepth)
      (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.highestBasisIndex mu) =
    ∏ r : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d, x r ^ a r

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.supportedMonomialBasis_weight_difference
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ) (a : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d →₀ ℕ) (hmu : Antitone mu) (g : ℕ)
  (hgap :
    ∀ (r : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d),
      a r ≠ 0 → g + mu (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootNext r) ≤ mu (↑r).1)
  (hdepth : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootDepth a ≤ g) (k : Fin d),
  ↑(FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.tensorWeight (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.columnHeight mu)
          (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.supportedMonomialBasis mu a hmu g hgap hdepth) k) -
      ↑(mu k) =
    FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootWeightShift a k

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.supportedSimpleOffset_zero_tail
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (rank : ℕ) (delta : Fin (d - 1) → ℕ),
  FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.SupportedSimpleOffset rank delta →
    ∀ (k : Fin d), rank ≤ ↑k → FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.offset delta k = 0

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.supported_actualWeight_finrank_eq_rootFiber
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu wt : Fin d → ℕ),
  Antitone mu →
    ∀ (g : ℕ) (a : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d →₀ ℕ),
      FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootDepth a ≤ g →
        (∀ b ∈ FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.lowerWeightFiber a,
            ∀ (r : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d),
              b r ≠ 0 → g + mu (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootNext r) ≤ mu (↑r).1) →
          (∀ (k : Fin d), ↑(wt k) - ↑(mu k) = FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootWeightShift a k) →
            Module.finrank ℂ ↥(FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.actualWeightSpace mu wt) =
              (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.lowerWeightFiber a).card

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.supported_lowerWeightFiber_card_le_weight_finrank
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ) (hmu : Antitone mu) (g : ℕ) (a₀ : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d →₀ ℕ)
  (ha₀ : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootDepth a₀ ≤ g)
  (hgap :
    ∀ a ∈ FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.lowerWeightFiber a₀,
      ∀ (r : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d),
        a r ≠ 0 → g + mu (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootNext r) ≤ mu (↑r).1),
  (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.lowerWeightFiber a₀).card ≤
    Module.finrank ℂ
      ↥(FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.actualWeightSpace mu
          (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.tensorWeight (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.columnHeight mu)
            (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.supportedMonomialBasis mu a₀ hmu g ⋯ ha₀)))

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.supported_root_capacity
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ) (a : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d →₀ ℕ),
  Antitone mu →
    ∀ (g : ℕ),
      (∀ (r : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d),
          a r ≠ 0 → g + mu (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootNext r) ≤ mu (↑r).1) →
        FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootDepth a ≤ g →
          ∀ (k : ℕ),
            Fintype.card
                { x : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.RootCopies a //
                  FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootCopyHeight a x = k } ≤
              FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.heightFiber mu k

      FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.tensorSumPermutation height height' =

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.theorem1_canonical_orbit_converse
declarations.statement:
∀ {d r : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r),
  2 ≤ d →
    ∀ (memory : ℕ → ℕ)
      (E :
        (n : ℕ) →
          FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel
            (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.targetCanonicalRow s n))
            (Fin (memory n)))
      (D :
        (n : ℕ) →
          FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel (Fin (memory n))
            (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex
              (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.targetCanonicalRow s n))),
      Filter.Tendsto
          (fun (n : ℕ) =>
            FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalAverageError s
              (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.targetCanonicalRow s n) (E n) (D n))
          Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
        0 ≤
          Filter.liminf (fun (n : ℕ) => ↑(Real.logb 2 ↑(memory n) - FreeEntropy.Weyl.qmdl d r s.eigenvalue n))
            Filter.atTop

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.theorem2_cartan_cloning_accuracy
declarations.statement:
∀ {d r : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r) (hd : 2 ≤ d) (mu nu : Fin d → ℕ) (hmu : Antitone mu)
  (hnu : Antitone nu),
  (∀ (i : Fin d), r ≤ ↑i → mu i = 0) →
    (∀ (i : Fin d), r ≤ ↑i → nu i = 0) →
      ∀ (hinc : Antitone fun (i : Fin d) => ↑(nu i) - ↑(mu i)) (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)),
        FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance
              ((FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalCartanForward mu nu hmu hnu hinc).toFun
                (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalOrbitState s mu U))
              (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalOrbitState s nu U) ≤
            FreeEntropy.Theorem2.cloningConstant d r s.qx * ↑(FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.differenceNorm mu nu) /
              (↑(FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.minimumRowGap mu r hd ⋯) + 1) ∧
          FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance
              ((FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalCartanReverse mu nu hmu hnu hinc).toFun
                (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalOrbitState s nu U))
              (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalOrbitState s mu U) ≤
            FreeEntropy.Theorem2.cloningConstant d r s.qx * ↑(FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.differenceNorm mu nu) /
              (↑(FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.minimumRowGap mu r hd ⋯) + 1)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.theorem2_cloning_accuracy
declarations.statement:
∀ {d r : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r) (hd : 2 ≤ d) (mu nu : Fin d → ℕ) (hmu : Antitone mu)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.theorem2_cloning_accuracy_petz
declarations.statement:
∀ {d r : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r) (hd : 2 ≤ d) (mu nu : Fin d → ℕ) (hmu : Antitone mu)
  (hnu : Antitone nu),
  (∀ (i : Fin d), r ≤ ↑i → mu i = 0) →

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.transvection_diagonal_conjugate
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (i j : Fin d),
  i ≠ j →
    ∀ (c : ℂ),
      c ≠ 0 →
        Matrix.transvection i j c =
          (Matrix.diagonal fun (k : Fin d) => if k = i then c else 1) * Matrix.transvection i j 1 *
            Matrix.diagonal fun (k : Fin d) => if k = i then c⁻¹ else 1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.unitary_intertwiner_adjoint
declarations.statement:
∀ {G : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : Fintype A] [inst_2 : DecidableEq A]
  [inst_3 : Fintype B] [inst_4 : DecidableEq B] (U : G →* Matrix A A ℂ) (V : G →* Matrix B B ℂ),
  (∀ (g : G), (U g).conjTranspose * U g = 1) →
    (∀ (g : G), (V g).conjTranspose * V g = 1) →
      ∀ (W : Matrix A B ℂ), (∀ (g : G), U g * W = W * V g) → ∀ (g : G), W.conjTranspose * U g = V g * W.conjTranspose

  ∑ j : ι, p j = ∑ j : ι, q j → ∀ (i : ι), |p i - q i| ≤ FreeEntropy.FiniteConcentration.l1 p q / 2

declarations.statement: {ι : Type u_1} → [Fintype ι] → (ι → ℝ) → (ι → ℝ) → ℝ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.FiniteConcentration.hellingerSq_le_kl
declarations.statement:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (p q : ι → ℝ),
  (∀ (i : ι), 0 ≤ p i) →
    (∀ (i : ι), 0 < q i) →
      ∑ i : ι, p i = 1 →
        ∑ i : ι, q i = 1 → FreeEntropy.FiniteConcentration.hellingerSq p q ≤ FreeEntropy.FiniteConcentration.kl p q

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.FiniteConcentration.kl

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.FiniteConcentration.klFun_ge_sqrt

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.FiniteConcentration.kl_eq_weighted_klFun
declarations.statement:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (p q : ι → ℝ),
  (∀ (i : ι), 0 < q i) →
    ∑ i : ι, p i = 1 →
      ∑ i : ι, q i = 1 → FreeEntropy.FiniteConcentration.kl p q = ∑ i : ι, q i * InformationTheory.klFun (p i / q i)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.FiniteConcentration.l1
declarations.statement: {ι : Type u_1} → [Fintype ι] → (ι → ℝ) → (ι → ℝ) → ℝ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.FiniteConcentration.l1_sq_div_four_le_kl
declarations.statement:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (p q : ι → ℝ),
  (∀ (i : ι), 0 ≤ p i) →
    (∀ (i : ι), 0 < q i) →
      ∑ i : ι, p i = 1 →
        ∑ i : ι, q i = 1 → FreeEntropy.FiniteConcentration.l1 p q ^ 2 / 4 ≤ FreeEntropy.FiniteConcentration.kl p q

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.FiniteConcentration.l1_sq_div_four_le_kl_of_support
declarations.statement:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (p q : ι → ℝ),
  (∀ (i : ι), 0 ≤ p i) →
    (∀ (i : ι), 0 ≤ q i) →
      (∀ (i : ι), q i = 0 → p i = 0) →
        ∑ i : ι, p i = 1 →
          ∑ i : ι, q i = 1 → FreeEntropy.FiniteConcentration.l1 p q ^ 2 / 4 ≤ FreeEntropy.FiniteConcentration.kl p q

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.FiniteConcentration.l1_sq_le_four_hellingerSq
declarations.statement:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (p q : ι → ℝ),
  (∀ (i : ι), 0 ≤ p i) →
    (∀ (i : ι), 0 ≤ q i) →
      ∑ i : ι, p i = 1 →
        ∑ i : ι, q i = 1 →
          FreeEntropy.FiniteConcentration.l1 p q ^ 2 ≤ 4 * FreeEntropy.FiniteConcentration.hellingerSq p q

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.FiniteConcentration.notTypical_l1_lower
declarations.statement:
∀ {d r : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r) (n : ℕ),
  2 ≤ n →
    ∀ (row : ℕ → ℤ),
      (∀ (i : ℕ), r ≤ i → i < d → row i = 0) →
        ∑ i : Fin r, row ↑i = ↑n →
          ¬FreeEntropy.TypicalRows.Typical s n row →
            Real.logb 2 ↑n / √↑n ≤
              FreeEntropy.FiniteConcentration.l1 (FreeEntropy.FiniteConcentration.rowFrequency r n row)
                fun (i : Fin r) => s.eigenvalue ↑i

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.FiniteConcentration.rowFrequency
declarations.statement: (r : ℕ) → ℕ → (ℕ → ℤ) → Fin r → ℝ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.FiniteConcentration.rowFrequency_normalized
declarations.statement:
∀ (r n : ℕ),
  0 < n →
    ∀ (row : ℕ → ℤ), ∑ i : Fin r, row ↑i = ↑n → ∑ i : Fin r, FreeEntropy.FiniteConcentration.rowFrequency r n row i = 1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.FiniteConcentration.schur_atypical_tail_le
declarations.statement:
∀ {d r : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r) {Λ : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype Λ] [DecidableEq Λ] (n : ℕ),
  2 ≤ n →
    ∀ (row : Λ → ℕ → ℤ) (mass : Λ → ℝ),
      (Function.Injective fun (a : Λ) (i : Fin r) => row a ↑i) →
        (∀ (a : Λ), ∀ i < r, 0 ≤ row a i) →
          (∀ (a : Λ), ∀ i < r, row a i ≤ ↑n) →
            (∀ (a : Λ) (i : ℕ), r ≤ i → i < d → row a i = 0) →
              (∀ (a : Λ), ∑ i : Fin r, row a ↑i = ↑n) →
                (∀ (a : Λ),
                    mass a ≤
                      (↑n + 1) ^ r.choose 2 *
                        Real.exp
                          (-↑n *
                            FreeEntropy.FiniteConcentration.kl
                              (FreeEntropy.FiniteConcentration.rowFrequency r n (row a)) fun (i : Fin r) =>
                              s.eigenvalue ↑i)) →
                  ∑ a : Λ with ¬FreeEntropy.TypicalRows.Typical s n (row a), mass a ≤
                    FreeEntropy.Concentration.tailBound (r.choose 2 + r) n

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.FiniteConcentration.schur_tail_le
declarations.statement:
∀ {Λ : Type u_2} [Fintype Λ] [DecidableEq Λ] (r n : ℕ) (rows : Λ → Fin r → Fin (n + 1)),
  Function.Injective rows →
    ∀ (reference : Fin r → ℝ) (frequency : Λ → Fin r → ℝ) (mass : Λ → ℝ),
      (∀ (i : Fin r), 0 < reference i) →
        ∑ i : Fin r, reference i = 1 →
          (∀ (a : Λ) (i : Fin r), 0 ≤ frequency a i) →
            (∀ (a : Λ), ∑ i : Fin r, frequency a i = 1) →
              (∀ (a : Λ),
                  mass a ≤
                    (↑n + 1) ^ r.choose 2 *
                      Real.exp (-↑n * FreeEntropy.FiniteConcentration.kl (frequency a) reference)) →
                ∀ (bad : Finset Λ) (ε : ℝ),
                  0 ≤ ε →
                    (∀ a ∈ bad, ε ≤ FreeEntropy.FiniteConcentration.l1 (frequency a) reference) →
                      ∑ a ∈ bad, mass a ≤ (↑n + 1) ^ (r.choose 2 + r) * Real.exp (-↑n * ε ^ 2 / 4)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.FiniteConcentration.schur_tail_le_tailBound
declarations.statement:
∀ {Λ : Type u_2} [Fintype Λ] [DecidableEq Λ] (r n : ℕ),
  2 ≤ n →
    ∀ (rows : Λ → Fin r → Fin (n + 1)),
      Function.Injective rows →
        ∀ (reference : Fin r → ℝ) (frequency : Λ → Fin r → ℝ) (mass : Λ → ℝ),
          (∀ (i : Fin r), 0 < reference i) →
            ∑ i : Fin r, reference i = 1 →
              (∀ (a : Λ) (i : Fin r), 0 ≤ frequency a i) →
                (∀ (a : Λ), ∑ i : Fin r, frequency a i = 1) →
                  (∀ (a : Λ),
                      mass a ≤
                        (↑n + 1) ^ r.choose 2 *
                          Real.exp (-↑n * FreeEntropy.FiniteConcentration.kl (frequency a) reference)) →
                    ∀ (bad : Finset Λ),
                      (∀ a ∈ bad, Real.logb 2 ↑n / √↑n ≤ FreeEntropy.FiniteConcentration.l1 (frequency a) reference) →
                        ∑ a ∈ bad, mass a ≤ FreeEntropy.Concentration.tailBound (r.choose 2 + r) n

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.FiniteConcentration.tv
declarations.statement: {ι : Type u_1} → [Fintype ι] → (ι → ℝ) → (ι → ℝ) → ℝ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.FiniteConcentration.weak_pinsker
declarations.statement:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (p q : ι → ℝ),
  (∀ (i : ι), 0 ≤ p i) →
    (∀ (i : ι), 0 < q i) →
      ∑ i : ι, p i = 1 →
        ∑ i : ι, q i = 1 → FreeEntropy.FiniteConcentration.tv p q ^ 2 ≤ FreeEntropy.FiniteConcentration.kl p q

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.FiniteConcentration.weighted_klFun_ge_sqrt
declarations.statement: ∀ {p q : ℝ}, 0 ≤ p → 0 < q → (√p - √q) ^ 2 ≤ q * InformationTheory.klFun (p / q)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum.eigenvalue_gap_pos

declarations.statement: {d r : ℕ} → FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r → ℝ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum.gammaX_le_eigenvalue_gap
declarations.statement:
∀ {d r : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r) {p₀ p₁ : ℝ},
  s.spectralProduct ≤ p₀ → p₁ ≤ s.qx * p₀ → s.gammaX ≤ p₀ - p₁

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum.gammaX_pos
declarations.statement: ∀ {d r : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r), 0 < s.gammaX

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum.memory_bound_with_gammaX
declarations.statement:
∀ {d r : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r) {dim memory error gap : ℝ},
  0 ≤ dim → 0 ≤ error → s.gammaX ≤ gap → dim * (1 - error / gap) ≤ memory → dim * (1 - error / s.gammaX) ≤ memory

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.GTDimension.binomialDet_branching
declarations.statement:
∀ {n : ℕ} (μ : Fin (n + 1) → ℤ),
  FreeEntropy.GelfandTsetlin.Dominant μ →
    FreeEntropy.GTDimension.binomialDet μ =
      ∑ ν : FreeEntropy.GTDimension.InterlacingRow μ,
        FreeEntropy.GTDimension.binomialDet (FreeEntropy.GTDimension.interlacingWeight ν)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.GTDimension.binomialDet_eq_activeProduct
declarations.statement:
∀ (n : ℕ) (μ : ℕ → ℤ),
  (FreeEntropy.GTDimension.binomialDet fun (i : Fin n) => μ ↑i) =
    FreeEntropy.Weyl.activeProduct n n fun (i : ℕ) => ↑(μ i)

declarations.statement:
{n : ℕ} →
  (μ : Fin (n + 1) → ℤ) →
    FreeEntropy.GelfandTsetlin.Pattern μ ≃
      (ν : FreeEntropy.GTDimension.InterlacingRow μ) ×
        FreeEntropy.GelfandTsetlin.Pattern (FreeEntropy.GTDimension.interlacingWeight ν)

      Fintype.card (FreeEntropy.GelfandTsetlin.Pattern (FreeEntropy.GTDimension.interlacingWeight ν))

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.GTDimension.card_eq_activeWeyl
declarations.statement:
∀ (d r : ℕ),
  r ≤ d →
    ∀ (μ : ℕ → ℤ),
      (FreeEntropy.GelfandTsetlin.Dominant fun (i : Fin d) => μ ↑i) →
        (∀ (i : ℕ), r ≤ i → i < d → μ i = 0) →
          ↑(Fintype.card (FreeEntropy.GelfandTsetlin.Pattern fun (i : Fin d) => μ ↑i)) =
            FreeEntropy.Weyl.activeProduct d r fun (i : ℕ) => ↑(μ i)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.GTDimension.card_eq_binomialDet
declarations.statement:
∀ {n : ℕ} (μ : Fin n → ℤ),
  FreeEntropy.GelfandTsetlin.Dominant μ →
    ↑(Fintype.card (FreeEntropy.GelfandTsetlin.Pattern μ)) = FreeEntropy.GTDimension.binomialDet μ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.GTDimension.card_eq_fullWeyl

∀ (n : ℕ) (μ : ℕ → ℤ),
  (FreeEntropy.GelfandTsetlin.Dominant fun (i : Fin n) => μ ↑i) →
    ↑(Fintype.card (FreeEntropy.GelfandTsetlin.Pattern fun (i : Fin n) => μ ↑i)) =
      FreeEntropy.Weyl.activeProduct n n fun (i : ℕ) => ↑(μ i)

declarations.statement: {n : ℕ} → (Fin n → ℤ) → ℝ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.GTDimension.chooseDet_difference
declarations.statement:
∀ {n : ℕ} (x : Fin (n + 1) → ℤ),
  FreeEntropy.GTDimension.chooseDet x =
    Matrix.det fun (i j : Fin n) => Ring.choose (↑(x i.succ)) (↑j + 1) - Ring.choose (↑(x i.castSucc)) (↑j + 1)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.GTDimension.chooseDet_interval_sum
declarations.statement:
∀ {n : ℕ} (x : Fin (n + 1) → ℤ),
  (∀ (i : Fin n), x i.castSucc ≤ x i.succ) →
    FreeEntropy.GTDimension.chooseDet x =
      ∑ z : FreeEntropy.GTDimension.IntervalRows x, FreeEntropy.GTDimension.chooseDet fun (i : Fin n) => ↑(z i)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.GTDimension.chooseDet_product
declarations.statement:
∀ {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℤ),
  FreeEntropy.GTDimension.chooseDet x =
    (∏ i : Fin n, ∏ j ∈ Finset.Ioi i, (↑(x j) - ↑(x i))) / ∏ j : Fin n, ↑(↑j).factorial

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.GTDimension.extendArray_top

∀ {n : ℕ} (μ : Fin (n + 1) → ℤ) (ν : FreeEntropy.GTDimension.InterlacingRow μ)

  FreeEntropy.GTDimension.extendArray μ ν P (Fin.last (n + 1)) j = μ j

∀ (d r : ℕ),

      (∀ (i : ℕ), r ≤ i → i < d → μ i = 0) → FreeEntropy.Weyl.activeProduct d d μ = FreeEntropy.Weyl.activeProduct d r μ

declarations.statement:
∀ {n : ℕ} {μ : Fin (n + 1) → ℤ},

declarations.statement:
∀ {n : ℕ} {μ : Fin (n + 1) → ℤ} (ν : FreeEntropy.GTDimension.InterlacingRow μ) (i : Fin n),

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.GTDimension.prod_activeRoots
declarations.statement:
∀ {M : Type u_1} [inst : CommMonoid M] (d r : ℕ) (f : ℕ × ℕ → M),
  ∏ p ∈ FreeEntropy.Weyl.activeRoots d r, f p = ∏ i ∈ Finset.range r, ∏ j ∈ Finset.Ico (i + 1) d, f (i, j)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.GTDimension.prod_finRoots

∀ {n : ℕ} {M : Type u_1} [inst : CommMonoid M] (f : Fin n → Fin n → M),
  ∏ p ∈ FreeEntropy.GTDimension.finRoots n, f p.1 p.2 = ∏ i : Fin n, ∏ j ∈ Finset.Ioi i, f i j

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.GTDimension.prod_finRoots_reverse
declarations.statement:
∀ {n : ℕ} {M : Type u_1} [inst : CommMonoid M] (f : ℕ × ℕ → M),
  ∏ p ∈ FreeEntropy.GTDimension.finRoots n, f (↑p.2.rev, ↑p.1.rev) = ∏ p ∈ FreeEntropy.Weyl.activeRoots n n, f p

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.GTDimension.reversed_shifted_numerator
declarations.statement:
∀ (n : ℕ) (μ : ℕ → ℤ),
  ∏ i : Fin n, ∏ j ∈ Finset.Ioi i, (↑(μ ↑j.rev) + ↑↑j - (↑(μ ↑i.rev) + ↑↑i)) =
    ∏ p ∈ FreeEntropy.Weyl.activeRoots n n, (↑(μ p.1) - ↑(μ p.2) + ↑(p.2 - p.1))

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.GTDimension.sum_choose_Ico

∀ (a b : ℤ),
  a ≤ b → ∀ (k : ℕ), ∑ z ∈ Finset.Ico a b, Ring.choose (↑z) k = Ring.choose (↑b) (k + 1) - Ring.choose (↑a) (k + 1)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.GTDimension.targetDimension_log_asymptotic

∀ {d r : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r),
  Filter.Tendsto
    (fun (n : ℕ) =>
      Real.logb 2 ↑(FreeEntropy.GTDimension.targetDimension s n) - FreeEntropy.Weyl.qmdl d r s.eigenvalue n)
    Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.GTDimension.targetDimension_pos
declarations.statement: ∀ {d r : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r) (n : ℕ), 0 < FreeEntropy.GTDimension.targetDimension s n

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.GTDimension.targetIntegerRow_dominant
declarations.statement:
∀ {d r : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r) (n : ℕ),
  FreeEntropy.GelfandTsetlin.Dominant fun (i : Fin d) => FreeEntropy.GTDimension.targetIntegerRow s n ↑i

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.GTDimension.targetIntegerRow_nonneg
declarations.statement: ∀ {d r : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r) (n i : ℕ), 0 ≤ FreeEntropy.GTDimension.targetIntegerRow s n i

{n : ℕ} →

        (FreeEntropy.GTDimension.interlacingWeight (FreeEntropy.GTDimension.penultimate P))

declarations.statement: {d r : ℕ} → FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r → ℕ → Type

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.GTOrbit.adjacentRatio_le_qx
declarations.statement: ∀ {d r : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r) (i : ℕ), s.adjacentRatio i ≤ s.qx

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.GTOrbit.exact_gap
declarations.statement:
∀ {d r : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r) (hd : 2 ≤ d) (μ : Fin d → ℤ)
  (hμ : FreeEntropy.GelfandTsetlin.Dominant μ),
  s.gammaX ≤
    1 / (FreeEntropy.GTOrbit.weights s hd μ hμ).normalizer -
      s.qx * (1 / (FreeEntropy.GTOrbit.weights s hd μ hμ).normalizer)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.GTOrbit.finiteWeights
declarations.statement:
{d r : ℕ} →
  (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r) →
    2 ≤ d →
      (μ : Fin d → ℤ) →
        FreeEntropy.GelfandTsetlin.Dominant μ →
          FreeEntropy.GeometricOrbit.WeightData (Fin (Fintype.card (FreeEntropy.GelfandTsetlin.Pattern μ))) (d.choose 2)
            s.qx

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.GTOrbit.memory_bound
declarations.statement:
∀ {d r : ℕ} {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] [CompactSpace G]
  [inst_4 : MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G] (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r) (hd : 2 ≤ d) (μ : Fin d → ℤ)
  (hμ : FreeEntropy.GelfandTsetlin.Dominant μ) (haar : MeasureTheory.Measure G) [haar.IsMulLeftInvariant]
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure haar]
  (U : G →* Matrix (FreeEntropy.GelfandTsetlin.Pattern μ) (FreeEntropy.GelfandTsetlin.Pattern μ) ℂ),
  Continuous ⇑U →
    (∀ (g : G), (U g).conjTranspose * U g = 1) →
      ∀ [(FreeEntropy.Twirling.matrixRepresentation U).IsIrreducible] {M : Type u_2} [inst_9 : Fintype M]
        [DecidableEq M] (E : FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel (FreeEntropy.GelfandTsetlin.Pattern μ) M)
        (D : FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel M (FreeEntropy.GelfandTsetlin.Pattern μ)),
        ↑(Fintype.card (FreeEntropy.GelfandTsetlin.Pattern μ)) *
            (1 -
              (∫ (g : G),
                  FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance
                    (D.toFun (E.toFun (U g * (FreeEntropy.GTOrbit.weights s hd μ hμ).state * (U g).conjTranspose)))
                    (U g * (FreeEntropy.GTOrbit.weights s hd μ hμ).state * (U g).conjTranspose) ∂haar) /
                (1 - s.qx) ^ (d.choose 2 + 1)) ≤
          ↑(Fintype.card M)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.GTOrbit.memory_bound_gammaX
declarations.statement:
∀ {d r : ℕ} {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] [CompactSpace G]
  [inst_4 : MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G] (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r) (hd : 2 ≤ d) (μ : Fin d → ℤ)
  (hμ : FreeEntropy.GelfandTsetlin.Dominant μ) (haar : MeasureTheory.Measure G) [haar.IsMulLeftInvariant]
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure haar]
  (U : G →* Matrix (FreeEntropy.GelfandTsetlin.Pattern μ) (FreeEntropy.GelfandTsetlin.Pattern μ) ℂ),
  Continuous ⇑U →
    (∀ (g : G), (U g).conjTranspose * U g = 1) →
      ∀ [(FreeEntropy.Twirling.matrixRepresentation U).IsIrreducible] {M : Type u_2} [inst_9 : Fintype M]
        [DecidableEq M] (E : FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel (FreeEntropy.GelfandTsetlin.Pattern μ) M)
        (D : FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel M (FreeEntropy.GelfandTsetlin.Pattern μ)),
        ↑(Fintype.card (FreeEntropy.GelfandTsetlin.Pattern μ)) *
            (1 -
              (∫ (g : G),
                  FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance
                    (D.toFun (E.toFun (U g * (FreeEntropy.GTOrbit.weights s hd μ hμ).state * (U g).conjTranspose)))
                    (U g * (FreeEntropy.GTOrbit.weights s hd μ hμ).state * (U g).conjTranspose) ∂haar) /
                s.gammaX) ≤
          ↑(Fintype.card M)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.GTOrbit.theorem1_padded_orbit_converse
declarations.statement:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] [CompactSpace G]
  [inst_4 : MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G] {d r : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r) (hd : 2 ≤ d)
  (memory : ℕ → ℕ) (haar : MeasureTheory.Measure G) [haar.IsMulLeftInvariant] [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure haar]
  (U : (n : ℕ) → G →* Matrix (FreeEntropy.GTOrbit.PaddedBasis s n) (FreeEntropy.GTOrbit.PaddedBasis s n) ℂ),
  (∀ (n : ℕ), Continuous ⇑(U n)) →
    (∀ (n : ℕ) (g : G), ((U n) g).conjTranspose * (U n) g = 1) →
      (∀ (n : ℕ), (FreeEntropy.Twirling.matrixRepresentation (U n)).IsIrreducible) →
        ∀ (E : (n : ℕ) → FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel (FreeEntropy.GTOrbit.PaddedBasis s n) (Fin (memory n)))
          (D : (n : ℕ) → FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel (Fin (memory n)) (FreeEntropy.GTOrbit.PaddedBasis s n)),
          Filter.Tendsto (fun (n : ℕ) => FreeEntropy.GTOrbit.paddedOrbitError s hd n haar (U n) (E n) (D n))
              Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
            0 ≤
              Filter.liminf (fun (n : ℕ) => ↑(Real.logb 2 ↑(memory n) - FreeEntropy.Weyl.qmdl d r s.eigenvalue n))
                Filter.atTop

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.GeometricOrbit.Code.memory_bound

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.GeometricOrbit.memory_bound
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] [inst_2 : Fintype M] [DecidableEq M] {N : ℕ}
  {q : ℝ} {G : Type u_3} [inst_4 : Group G] [inst_5 : TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] [CompactSpace G]
  [inst_8 : MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure G) [μ.IsMulLeftInvariant]
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (W : FreeEntropy.GeometricOrbit.WeightData H N q),
  0 < N →
    0 ≤ q →
      q < 1 →
        ∀ (U : G →* Matrix H H ℂ),
          Continuous ⇑U →
            (∀ (g : G), (U g).conjTranspose * U g = 1) →
              ∀ [(FreeEntropy.Twirling.matrixRepresentation U).IsIrreducible]
                (E : FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel H M) (D : FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel M H),
                ↑(Fintype.card H) *
                    (1 -
                      (∫ (g : G),
                          FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance
                            (D.toFun (E.toFun (U g * W.state * (U g).conjTranspose)))
                            (U g * W.state * (U g).conjTranspose) ∂μ) /
                        (1 - q) ^ (N + 1)) ≤
                  ↑(Fintype.card M)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.GeometricOrbit.theorem1_converse_of_weight_codes
declarations.statement:
∀ {G : Type u_3} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] [CompactSpace G]
  [inst_4 : MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G] {d r : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r) (N : ℕ) (q : ℝ),
  0 < N →
    0 ≤ q →
      q < 1 →
        ∀ (memory target : ℕ → ℕ) (δ e : ℕ → ℝ) (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure G) [μ.IsMulLeftInvariant]
          [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
          (C : (n : ℕ) → FreeEntropy.GeometricOrbit.Code N q G (target n) (memory n)),
          (∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, ↑(target n) = FreeEntropy.Weyl.activeProduct d r (s.targetRow n)) →
            (∀ (n : ℕ), 0 < target n) →
              Filter.Tendsto δ Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
                e =O[Filter.atTop] FreeEntropy.Weyl.errorScale →
                  (∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, (C n).averageError μ ≤ δ n + e n) →
                    0 ≤
                      Filter.liminf
                        (fun (n : ℕ) => ↑(Real.logb 2 ↑(memory n) - FreeEntropy.Weyl.qmdl d r s.eigenvalue n))
                        Filter.atTop

declarations.statement: {H : Type u_1} → {M : Type u_2} → [Fintype M] → [DecidableEq H] → Matrix H M ℂ → Matrix H H ℂ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.IsometricCompression.complement_adjoint
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [Fintype H] [inst : Fintype M] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] [DecidableEq M]
  (V : Matrix H M ℂ),
  (FreeEntropy.IsometricCompression.complement V).conjTranspose = FreeEntropy.IsometricCompression.complement V

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.IsometricCompression.complement_idempotent
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : Fintype M] [inst_2 : DecidableEq H]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq M] (V : Matrix H M ℂ),
  V.conjTranspose * V = 1 →
    FreeEntropy.IsometricCompression.complement V * FreeEntropy.IsometricCompression.complement V =
      FreeEntropy.IsometricCompression.complement V

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.IsometricCompression.complement_mul
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : Fintype M] [inst_2 : DecidableEq H]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq M] (V : Matrix H M ℂ),
  V.conjTranspose * V = 1 → FreeEntropy.IsometricCompression.complement V * V = 0

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.IsometricCompression.decoder
declarations.statement:
{H : Type u_1} →
  {M : Type u_2} →
    [inst : Fintype H] →
      [inst_1 : Fintype M] →
        [inst_2 : DecidableEq M] → (V : Matrix H M ℂ) → V.conjTranspose * V = 1 → FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel M H

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.IsometricCompression.decoder_apply
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : Fintype M] [DecidableEq H] [inst_3 : DecidableEq M]
  (V : Matrix H M ℂ) (hV : V.conjTranspose * V = 1) (Y : Matrix M M ℂ),
  (FreeEntropy.IsometricCompression.decoder V hV).toFun Y = V * Y * V.conjTranspose

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.IsometricCompression.encoder
declarations.statement:
{H : Type u_1} →
