    [inst : Fintype H] →
      [inst_1 : Fintype M] →
        [DecidableEq H] →
          [inst_3 : DecidableEq M] →
            (V : Matrix H M ℂ) → V.conjTranspose * V = 1 → M → FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel H M

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.IsometricCompression.encoderKraus
declarations.statement:
{H : Type u_1} →
  {M : Type u_2} →
    [Fintype H] → [Fintype M] → [DecidableEq H] → [DecidableEq M] → Matrix H M ℂ → M → Unit ⊕ H → Matrix M H ℂ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.IsometricCompression.encoderKraus_normalization
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : Fintype M] [inst_2 : DecidableEq H]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq M] (V : Matrix H M ℂ),
  V.conjTranspose * V = 1 →
    ∀ (target : M),
      ∑ a : Unit ⊕ H,
          (FreeEntropy.IsometricCompression.encoderKraus V target a).conjTranspose *
            FreeEntropy.IsometricCompression.encoderKraus V target a =
        1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.IsometricCompression.encoder_apply
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : Fintype M] [inst_2 : DecidableEq H]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq M] (V : Matrix H M ℂ) (hV : V.conjTranspose * V = 1) (target : M) (X : Matrix H H ℂ),
  (FreeEntropy.IsometricCompression.encoder V hV target).toFun X =
    V.conjTranspose * X * V +
      (FreeEntropy.AtypicalChannels.replacementChannel target).toFun
        (FreeEntropy.IsometricCompression.complement V * X * FreeEntropy.IsometricCompression.complement V)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.IsometricCompression.encoder_embedding
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : Fintype M] [inst_2 : DecidableEq H]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq M] (V : Matrix H M ℂ) (hV : V.conjTranspose * V = 1) (target : M) (Y : Matrix M M ℂ),
  (FreeEntropy.IsometricCompression.encoder V hV target).toFun (V * Y * V.conjTranspose) = Y

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.IsometricCompression.roundtrip_embedding
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : Fintype M] [inst_2 : DecidableEq H]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq M] (V : Matrix H M ℂ) (hV : V.conjTranspose * V = 1) (target : M) (Y : Matrix M M ℂ),
  (FreeEntropy.IsometricCompression.decoder V hV).toFun
      ((FreeEntropy.IsometricCompression.encoder V hV target).toFun (V * Y * V.conjTranspose)) =
    V * Y * V.conjTranspose

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.KostantCounting.card_depth_fiber_le_of_encoding
declarations.statement:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [DecidableEq ι] {β : Type u_3} [DecidableEq β] (s : Finset β) (depth : β → ℕ) (encode : β → ι →₀ ℕ)
  (roots : Finset ι) (height : ι → ℕ),
  (∀ i ∈ roots, 0 < height i) →
    ∀ k ∈ roots,
      Set.InjOn encode ↑s →
        (∀ b ∈ s, (encode b).support ⊆ roots) →
          (∀ b ∈ s, FreeEntropy.KostantCounting.weightedDepth roots height (encode b) = depth b) →
            ∀ (t : ℕ), {b ∈ s | depth b = t}.card ≤ (t + roots.card - 1).choose (roots.card - 1)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.KostantCounting.card_positiveRootAssignments_le
declarations.statement:
∀ (r t : ℕ),
  2 ≤ r → (FreeEntropy.KostantCounting.positiveRootAssignments r t).card ≤ (t + r.choose 2 - 1).choose (r.choose 2 - 1)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.KostantCounting.card_typeA_depth_fiber_le_of_encoding
declarations.statement:
∀ {β : Type u_3} [DecidableEq β] (s : Finset β) (depth : β → ℕ) (encode : β → ℕ × ℕ →₀ ℕ) (r : ℕ),
  2 ≤ r →
    Set.InjOn encode ↑s →
      (∀ b ∈ s, (encode b).support ⊆ FreeEntropy.Weyl.activeRoots r r) →
        (∀ b ∈ s,
            FreeEntropy.KostantCounting.weightedDepth (FreeEntropy.Weyl.activeRoots r r) (fun (p : ℕ × ℕ) => p.2 - p.1)
                (encode b) =
              depth b) →
          ∀ (t : ℕ), {b ∈ s | depth b = t}.card ≤ (t + r.choose 2 - 1).choose (r.choose 2 - 1)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.KostantCounting.card_weightedAssignments_le
declarations.statement:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] (roots : Finset ι) (height : ι → ℕ),
  (∀ i ∈ roots, 0 < height i) →
    ∀ k ∈ roots,
      ∀ (t : ℕ),
        (FreeEntropy.KostantCounting.weightedAssignments roots height t).card ≤
          (t + roots.card - 1).choose (roots.card - 1)

declarations.statement: ℕ → (ℕ → ℕ) → ℕ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.KostantCounting.kostantFiber

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.KostantCounting.mem_kostantFiber
declarations.statement:
∀ (r : ℕ) (δ : ℕ → ℕ) (c : ℕ × ℕ →₀ ℕ),
  c ∈ FreeEntropy.KostantCounting.kostantFiber r δ ↔
    c.support ⊆ FreeEntropy.Weyl.activeRoots r r ∧ FreeEntropy.KostantCounting.typeAOffset r c = δ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.KostantCounting.mem_weightedAssignments
declarations.statement:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] (roots : Finset ι) (height : ι → ℕ),
  (∀ i ∈ roots, 0 < height i) →
    ∀ (t : ℕ) (c : ι →₀ ℕ),
      c ∈ FreeEntropy.KostantCounting.weightedAssignments roots height t ↔
        c.support ⊆ roots ∧ FreeEntropy.KostantCounting.weightedDepth roots height c = t

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.KostantCounting.offsetDepth
declarations.statement: ℕ → (ℕ → ℕ) → ℕ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.KostantCounting.offsetDepth_typeAOffset
declarations.statement:
∀ (r : ℕ) (c : ℕ × ℕ →₀ ℕ),
  FreeEntropy.KostantCounting.offsetDepth r (FreeEntropy.KostantCounting.typeAOffset r c) =
    FreeEntropy.KostantCounting.weightedDepth (FreeEntropy.Weyl.activeRoots r r) (fun (p : ℕ × ℕ) => p.2 - p.1) c

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.KostantCounting.ordinaryDegree_le_weightedDepth
declarations.statement:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} (roots : Finset ι) (height : ι → ℕ),
  (∀ i ∈ roots, 0 < height i) →
    ∀ (c : ι →₀ ℕ), ∑ i ∈ roots, c i ≤ FreeEntropy.KostantCounting.weightedDepth roots height c

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.KostantCounting.padAssignment
declarations.statement: {ι : Type u_1} → Finset ι → ι → ℕ → (ι →₀ ℕ) → ι →₀ ℕ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.KostantCounting.padAssignment_apply_ne
declarations.statement:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} (roots : Finset ι) (k : ι) (t : ℕ) (c : ι →₀ ℕ) (i : ι),
  i ≠ k → (FreeEntropy.KostantCounting.padAssignment roots k t c) i = c i

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.KostantCounting.padAssignment_injective_on
declarations.statement:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] (roots : Finset ι) (height : ι → ℕ),
  (∀ i ∈ roots, 0 < height i) →
    ∀ k ∈ roots,
      ∀ (t : ℕ),
        Set.InjOn (FreeEntropy.KostantCounting.padAssignment roots k t)
          ↑(FreeEntropy.KostantCounting.weightedAssignments roots height t)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.KostantCounting.padAssignment_mem_antidiag
declarations.statement:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] (roots : Finset ι) (height : ι → ℕ),
  (∀ i ∈ roots, 0 < height i) →
    ∀ k ∈ roots,
      ∀ (t : ℕ),
        ∀ c ∈ FreeEntropy.KostantCounting.weightedAssignments roots height t,
          FreeEntropy.KostantCounting.padAssignment roots k t c ∈ roots.finsuppAntidiag t

declarations.statement: ℕ → ℕ → Finset (ℕ × ℕ →₀ ℕ)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.KostantCounting.sum_fiber_multiplicities_le
declarations.statement:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {κ : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq κ] (roots : Finset ι) (height : ι → ℕ),
  (∀ i ∈ roots, 0 < height i) →
    ∀ k ∈ roots,
      ∀ (t : ℕ) (offsets : Finset κ) (offset : (ι →₀ ℕ) → κ) (multiplicity : κ → ℕ),
        (∀ δ ∈ offsets,
            multiplicity δ ≤ {c ∈ FreeEntropy.KostantCounting.weightedAssignments roots height t | offset c = δ}.card) →
          ∑ δ ∈ offsets, multiplicity δ ≤ (t + roots.card - 1).choose (roots.card - 1)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.KostantCounting.sum_kostantCount_at_depth_le
declarations.statement:
∀ (r : ℕ),
  2 ≤ r →
    ∀ (offsets : Finset (ℕ → ℕ)) (t : ℕ),
      ∑ δ ∈ offsets with FreeEntropy.KostantCounting.offsetDepth r δ = t, FreeEntropy.KostantCounting.kostantCount r δ ≤
        (t + r.choose 2 - 1).choose (r.choose 2 - 1)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.KostantCounting.sum_multiplicities_at_depth_le
declarations.statement:
∀ (r : ℕ),
  2 ≤ r →
    ∀ (offsets : Finset (ℕ → ℕ)) (multiplicity : (ℕ → ℕ) → ℕ),
      (∀ δ ∈ offsets, multiplicity δ ≤ FreeEntropy.KostantCounting.kostantCount r δ) →
        ∀ (t : ℕ),
          ∑ δ ∈ offsets with FreeEntropy.KostantCounting.offsetDepth r δ = t, multiplicity δ ≤
            (t + r.choose 2 - 1).choose (r.choose 2 - 1)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.KostantCounting.sum_simple_cuts
declarations.statement:
∀ (r : ℕ),
  0 < r →
    ∀ (c : ℕ × ℕ →₀ ℕ),
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (r - 1), FreeEntropy.KostantCounting.typeAOffset r c (j + 1) =
        FreeEntropy.KostantCounting.weightedDepth (FreeEntropy.Weyl.activeRoots r r) (fun (p : ℕ × ℕ) => p.2 - p.1) c

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.KostantCounting.typeAOffset
declarations.statement: ℕ → (ℕ × ℕ →₀ ℕ) → ℕ → ℕ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.KostantCounting.typeAOffset_eq_zero_of_le
declarations.statement: ∀ (r : ℕ) (c : ℕ × ℕ →₀ ℕ) (k : ℕ), r ≤ k → FreeEntropy.KostantCounting.typeAOffset r c k = 0

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.KostantCounting.typeAOffset_zero
declarations.statement: ∀ (r : ℕ) (c : ℕ × ℕ →₀ ℕ), FreeEntropy.KostantCounting.typeAOffset r c 0 = 0

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.KostantCounting.weight_mean_le_of_kostant
declarations.statement:
∀ (r : ℕ),
  2 ≤ r →
    ∀ (offsets : Finset (ℕ → ℕ)) (multiplicity : (ℕ → ℕ) → ℕ) (p : (ℕ → ℕ) → ℝ) (q : ℝ),
      0 ≤ q →
        q < 1 →
          (∀ δ ∈ offsets, multiplicity δ ≤ FreeEntropy.KostantCounting.kostantCount r δ) →
            (∀ δ ∈ offsets, p δ ≤ q ^ FreeEntropy.KostantCounting.offsetDepth r δ) →
              ∑ δ ∈ offsets, ↑(FreeEntropy.KostantCounting.offsetDepth r δ) * p δ * ↑(multiplicity δ) ≤
                FreeEntropy.MeanDepth.meanDepthConstant (r.choose 2) q

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.KostantCounting.weightedAssignments
declarations.statement: {ι : Type u_1} → [DecidableEq ι] → Finset ι → (ι → ℕ) → ℕ → Finset (ι →₀ ℕ)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.KostantCounting.weightedDepth
declarations.statement: {ι : Type u_1} → Finset ι → (ι → ℕ) → (ι →₀ ℕ) → ℕ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.KostantCounting.weightedDepth_eq_zero_iff
declarations.statement:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [DecidableEq ι] (roots : Finset ι) (height : ι → ℕ),
  (∀ i ∈ roots, 0 < height i) →
    ∀ (c : ι →₀ ℕ), c.support ⊆ roots → (FreeEntropy.KostantCounting.weightedDepth roots height c = 0 ↔ c = 0)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.KostantWeightData.ofRootEncoding
declarations.statement:
{β : Type u_1} →
  [inst : Fintype β] →
    [DecidableEq β] →
      (r : ℕ) →
        2 ≤ r →
          (q : ℝ) →
            (encode : β → ℕ × ℕ →₀ ℕ) →
              Function.Injective encode →
                (∀ (b : β), (encode b).support ⊆ FreeEntropy.Weyl.activeRoots r r) →
                  (highest : β) →
                    encode highest = 0 →
                      (ratio : ℕ → ℝ) →
                        (∀ j < r - 1, 0 ≤ ratio j) →
                          (∀ j < r - 1, ratio j ≤ q) → FreeEntropy.GeometricOrbit.WeightData β (r.choose 2) q

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.KostantWeightData.rootWeight
declarations.statement: ℕ → (ℕ → ℝ) → (ℕ × ℕ →₀ ℕ) → ℝ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.KostantWeightData.rootWeight_le_depth
declarations.statement:
∀ (r : ℕ),
  0 < r →
    ∀ (ratio : ℕ → ℝ) (q : ℝ),
      (∀ j < r - 1, 0 ≤ ratio j) →
        (∀ j < r - 1, ratio j ≤ q) →
          ∀ (c : ℕ × ℕ →₀ ℕ),
            FreeEntropy.KostantWeightData.rootWeight r ratio c ≤
              q ^
                FreeEntropy.KostantCounting.weightedDepth (FreeEntropy.Weyl.activeRoots r r)
                  (fun (p : ℕ × ℕ) => p.2 - p.1) c

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.KostantWeightData.rootWeight_nonneg
declarations.statement:
∀ (r : ℕ) (ratio : ℕ → ℝ),
  (∀ j < r - 1, 0 ≤ ratio j) → ∀ (c : ℕ × ℕ →₀ ℕ), 0 ≤ FreeEntropy.KostantWeightData.rootWeight r ratio c

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.KostantWeightData.rootWeight_zero
declarations.statement: ∀ (r : ℕ) (ratio : ℕ → ℝ), FreeEntropy.KostantWeightData.rootWeight r ratio 0 = 1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.Poly
declarations.statement: ℕ → Type

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.alphabetPermutation
declarations.statement: {d : ℕ} → Equiv.Perm (Fin d) → ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.alphabetPermutation_diagonal
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin d)) (z : Fin d → ℂ),
  ↑(FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.alphabetPermutation e) * Matrix.diagonal z *
      (↑(FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.alphabetPermutation e)).conjTranspose =
    Matrix.diagonal (z ∘ ⇑e)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.casimir_trace_identity
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H)
  (weight : H → Fin d → ℕ),
  (∀ (k : Fin d), R.E k k = Matrix.diagonal fun (h : H) => ↑(weight h k)) →
    ∀ (c : ℂ),
      R.casimir = c • 1 →
        MvPolynomial.C c * FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.character weight =
          FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.laplacian (FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.character weight) +
            ∑ i : Fin d,
              ∑ j : Fin d,
                if i < j then
                  FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.pairTrace R weight i j + FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.pairTrace R weight j i
                else 0

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.character
declarations.statement: {d : ℕ} → {H : Type u_1} → [Fintype H] → (H → Fin d → ℕ) → FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.Poly d

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.character_coeff
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [DecidableEq H] (weight : H → Fin d → ℕ) (m : Fin d →₀ ℕ),
  MvPolynomial.coeff m (FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.character weight) =
    ↑{h : H | FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.exponent (weight h) = m}.card

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.character_coeff_weight_ne_zero
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [DecidableEq H] (weight : H → Fin d → ℕ) (a : H),
  MvPolynomial.coeff (FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.exponent (weight a)) (FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.character weight) ≠ 0

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.character_eval_one
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [DecidableEq H] (weight : H → Fin d → ℕ),
  (MvPolynomial.eval fun (x : Fin d) => 1) (FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.character weight) = ↑(Fintype.card H)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.character_rename_of_physical
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (J : Matrix (Fin n → Fin d) H ℂ),
  J.conjTranspose * J = 1 →
    ∀ (weight : H → Fin d → ℕ),
      (∀ (j : Fin d),
          (FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.generators d n).E j j * J = J * Matrix.diagonal fun (a : H) => ↑(weight a j)) →
        FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.TensorCommutant (J * J.conjTranspose) →
          ∀ (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin d)),
            (MvPolynomial.rename ⇑e) (FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.character weight) =
              FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.character weight

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.character_total_euler
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [DecidableEq H] (weight : H → Fin d → ℕ) (n : ℕ),
  (∀ (h : H), ∑ i : Fin d, weight h i = n) →
    ∑ i : Fin d, (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.euler i) (FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.character weight) =
      ↑n • FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.character weight

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.compressed_trace_conjugate
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [DecidableEq H] (J : Matrix (Fin n → Fin d) H ℂ),
  FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.TensorCommutant (J * J.conjTranspose) →
    ∀ (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)) (A : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ),
      (J.conjTranspose * FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.matrix n (↑U * A * (↑U).conjTranspose) * J).trace =
        (J.conjTranspose * FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.matrix n A * J).trace

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.cyclic_character_highest_coeff
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] [Nonempty H]
  (M : FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.CyclicWeightModel d H) (weight : H → Fin d → ℕ),
  (∀ (h : H) (i : Fin d), M.weight h i = ↑(weight h i)) →
    ∀ (mu : Fin d → ℕ),
      (∀ (i : Fin d), M.row i = ↑(mu i)) →
        MvPolynomial.coeff (FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.exponent mu) (FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.character weight) = 1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.cyclic_character_root_cone
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H]
  (M : FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.CyclicWeightModel d H) (weight : H → Fin d → ℕ),
  (∀ (h : H) (i : Fin d), M.weight h i = ↑(weight h i)) →
    ∀ (m : Fin d →₀ ℕ),
      MvPolynomial.coeff m (FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.character weight) ≠ 0 →
        ∃ (c : Fin (d - 1) → ℕ), (M.row - fun (i : Fin d) => ↑(m i)) = FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.offset c

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.cyclic_radial_identity
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H]
  (M : FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.CyclicWeightModel d H) (weight : H → Fin d → ℕ),
  (∀ (h : H) (i : Fin d), M.weight h i = ↑(weight h i)) →
    FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.rootProduct d *
        (MvPolynomial.C ↑(FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.casimir M.row) * FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.character weight -
          FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.laplacian (FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.character weight)) =
      ∑ p ∈ FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.positiveRoots d,
        FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.rootProductExcept p * (MvPolynomial.X p.1 + MvPolynomial.X p.2) *
          ((FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.euler p.2) (FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.character weight) -
            (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.euler p.1) (FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.character weight))

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.cyclic_weight_total
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H]
  (M : FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.CyclicWeightModel d H) (h : H), ∑ i : Fin d, M.weight h i = ∑ i : Fin d, M.row i

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.diagonal_trace
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H)
  (weight : H → Fin d → ℕ),
  (∀ (k : Fin d), R.E k k = Matrix.diagonal fun (h : H) => ↑(weight h k)) →
    ∀ (i : Fin d),
      (FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.weightMatrix weight * FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.lift (R.E i i)).trace =
        FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.moment weight i

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.euler_character
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [DecidableEq H] (weight : H → Fin d → ℕ) (i : Fin d),
  (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.euler i) (FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.character weight) =
    FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.moment weight i

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.euler_sq_character
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [DecidableEq H] (weight : H → Fin d → ℕ) (i : Fin d),
  (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.euler i)
      ((FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.euler i) (FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.character weight)) =
    FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.secondMoment weight i

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.eval_character
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [DecidableEq H] (weight : H → Fin d → ℕ) (z : Fin d → ℂ),
  (MvPolynomial.eval z) (FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.character weight) = ∑ a : H, ∏ j : Fin d, z j ^ weight a j

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.eval_character_eq_trace
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (J : Matrix (Fin n → Fin d) H ℂ),
  J.conjTranspose * J = 1 →
    ∀ (weight : H → Fin d → ℕ),
      (∀ (j : Fin d),
          (FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.generators d n).E j j * J = J * Matrix.diagonal fun (a : H) => ↑(weight a j)) →
        ∀ (z : Fin d → ℂ),
          (MvPolynomial.eval z) (FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.character weight) =
            (J.conjTranspose * FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.matrix n (Matrix.diagonal z) * J).trace

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.eval_weightMonomial
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (w : Fin d → ℕ) (z : Fin d → ℂ),
  (MvPolynomial.eval z) (FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.weightMonomial w) = ∏ j : Fin d, z j ^ w j

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.exists_permuted_weight
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [DecidableEq H] (weight : H → Fin d → ℕ),
  (∀ (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin d)),
      (MvPolynomial.rename ⇑e) (FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.character weight) =
        FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.character weight) →
    ∀ (a : H) (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin d)), ∃ (b : H), weight b = weight a ∘ ⇑e

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.exists_weight_of_coeff_ne_zero
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [DecidableEq H] (weight : H → Fin d → ℕ) (m : Fin d →₀ ℕ),
  MvPolynomial.coeff m (FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.character weight) ≠ 0 →
    ∃ (h : H), FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.exponent (weight h) = m

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.exponent
declarations.statement: {d : ℕ} → (Fin d → ℕ) → Fin d →₀ ℕ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.generator_exponent_shift
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H)
  (weight : H → Fin d → ℕ),
  (∀ (k : Fin d), R.E k k = Matrix.diagonal fun (h : H) => ↑(weight h k)) →
    ∀ (i j : Fin d),
      i ≠ j →
        ∀ (a b : H),
          R.E i j a b ≠ 0 →
            Finsupp.single j 1 + FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.exponent (weight a) =
              Finsupp.single i 1 + FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.exponent (weight b)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.lift
declarations.statement: {d : ℕ} → {H : Type u_1} → [Fintype H] → [DecidableEq H] → Matrix H H ℂ → Matrix H H (FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.Poly d)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.lift_mul
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (M N : Matrix H H ℂ),
  FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.lift (M * N) = FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.lift M * FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.lift N

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.lift_one
declarations.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H], FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.lift 1 = 1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.lift_sub
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (M N : Matrix H H ℂ),
  FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.lift (M - N) = FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.lift M - FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.lift N

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.moment
declarations.statement: {d : ℕ} → {H : Type u_1} → [Fintype H] → (H → Fin d → ℕ) → Fin d → FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.Poly d

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.pairTrace
declarations.statement:
{d : ℕ} →
  {H : Type u_1} →
    [inst : Fintype H] →
      [DecidableEq H] →
        FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H → (H → Fin d → ℕ) → Fin d → Fin d → FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.Poly d

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.pairTrace_diagonal
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H)
  (weight : H → Fin d → ℕ),
  (∀ (k : Fin d), R.E k k = Matrix.diagonal fun (h : H) => ↑(weight h k)) →
    ∀ (i : Fin d), FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.pairTrace R weight i i = FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.secondMoment weight i

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.pairTrace_sub
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H)
  (weight : H → Fin d → ℕ),
  (∀ (k : Fin d), R.E k k = Matrix.diagonal fun (h : H) => ↑(weight h k)) →
    ∀ (i j : Fin d),
      FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.pairTrace R weight i j - FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.pairTrace R weight j i =
        FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.moment weight i - FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.moment weight j

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.physical_weight_source
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (J : Matrix (Fin n → Fin d) H ℂ)
  (weight : H → Fin d → ℕ),
  (∀ (j : Fin d),
      (FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.generators d n).E j j * J = J * Matrix.diagonal fun (a : H) => ↑(weight a j)) →
    ∀ (z : Fin d → ℂ),
      FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.matrix n (Matrix.diagonal z) * J =
        J * Matrix.diagonal fun (a : H) => ∏ j : Fin d, z j ^ weight a j

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.positiveRoots
declarations.statement: (d : ℕ) → Finset (Fin d × Fin d)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.radial_casimir_identity
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H)
  (weight : H → Fin d → ℕ),
  (∀ (k : Fin d), R.E k k = Matrix.diagonal fun (h : H) => ↑(weight h k)) →
    ∀ (c : ℂ),
      R.casimir = c • 1 →
        FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.rootProduct d *
            (MvPolynomial.C c * FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.character weight -
              FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.laplacian (FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.character weight)) =
          ∑ p ∈ FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.positiveRoots d,
            FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.rootProductExcept p * (MvPolynomial.X p.1 + MvPolynomial.X p.2) *
              ((FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.euler p.2) (FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.character weight) -
                (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.euler p.1) (FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.character weight))

declarations.statement: {d : ℕ} → Fin d × Fin d → FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.Poly d

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.rootProduct
declarations.statement: (d : ℕ) → FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.Poly d

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.rootProductExcept
declarations.statement: {d : ℕ} → Fin d × Fin d → FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.Poly d

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.rootProduct_eq_denominator
declarations.statement: ∀ (d : ℕ), FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.rootProduct d = FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.denominator d

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.rootProduct_factor
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ},
  ∀ p ∈ FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.positiveRoots d,
    FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.rootProduct d =
      FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.rootFactor p * FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.rootProductExcept p

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.root_radial_identity
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H)
  (weight : H → Fin d → ℕ),
  (∀ (k : Fin d), R.E k k = Matrix.diagonal fun (h : H) => ↑(weight h k)) →
    ∀ (i j : Fin d),
      i ≠ j →
        (MvPolynomial.X i - MvPolynomial.X j) *
            (FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.pairTrace R weight i j + FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.pairTrace R weight j i) =
          (MvPolynomial.X i + MvPolynomial.X j) *
            (FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.moment weight i - FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.moment weight j)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.secondMoment
declarations.statement: {d : ℕ} → {H : Type u_1} → [Fintype H] → (H → Fin d → ℕ) → Fin d → FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.Poly d

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.sum_diagonal_upper
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (f : Fin d → Fin d → FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.Poly d),
  ∑ i : Fin d, ∑ j : Fin d, f i j = ∑ i : Fin d, f i i + ∑ i : Fin d, ∑ j : Fin d, if i < j then f i j + f j i else 0

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.sum_positiveRoots
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (f : Fin d × Fin d → FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.Poly d),
  ∑ p ∈ FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.positiveRoots d, f p = ∑ i : Fin d, ∑ j : Fin d, if i < j then f (i, j) else 0

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.trace_weightMatrix
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (weight : H → Fin d → ℕ),
  (FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.weightMatrix weight).trace = FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.character weight

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.variable_pairTrace
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H)
  (weight : H → Fin d → ℕ),
  (∀ (k : Fin d), R.E k k = Matrix.diagonal fun (h : H) => ↑(weight h k)) →
    ∀ (i j : Fin d),
      i ≠ j →
        MvPolynomial.X j * FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.pairTrace R weight i j =
          MvPolynomial.X i * FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.pairTrace R weight j i

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.variable_weight_intertwines
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H)
  (weight : H → Fin d → ℕ),
  (∀ (k : Fin d), R.E k k = Matrix.diagonal fun (h : H) => ↑(weight h k)) →
    ∀ (i j : Fin d),
      i ≠ j →
        MvPolynomial.X j • (FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.weightMatrix weight * FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.lift (R.E i j)) =
          MvPolynomial.X i • (FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.lift (R.E i j) * FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.weightMatrix weight)

declarations.statement: {d : ℕ} → {H : Type u_1} → [DecidableEq H] → (H → Fin d → ℕ) → Matrix H H (FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.Poly d)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieDecomposition.constituentEmbedding_intertwines
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H)
  (i : FreeEntropy.LieDecomposition.Index R) (a b : Fin d),
  R.E a b * FreeEntropy.LieDecomposition.constituentEmbedding R i =
    FreeEntropy.LieDecomposition.constituentEmbedding R i *
      (FreeEntropy.LieDecomposition.constituentModel R i).generators.E a b

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieDecomposition.constituentEmbedding_isometry
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H)
  (i : FreeEntropy.LieDecomposition.Index R),
  (FreeEntropy.LieDecomposition.constituentEmbedding R i).conjTranspose *
      FreeEntropy.LieDecomposition.constituentEmbedding R i =
    1

declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H)
  (i j : FreeEntropy.LieDecomposition.Index R),
  i ≠ j →
    (FreeEntropy.LieDecomposition.constituentEmbedding R i).conjTranspose *
        FreeEntropy.LieDecomposition.constituentEmbedding R j =

∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H),
  ∑ i : FreeEntropy.LieDecomposition.Index R,

declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H)
  (K : FreeEntropy.LieDecomposition.Space H),
  FreeEntropy.LieDecomposition.Invariant R K →
    ∀ (a b : Fin d),
      R.E a b * FreeEntropy.UnitaryDecomposition.embedding K =
        FreeEntropy.UnitaryDecomposition.embedding K *
          ((FreeEntropy.UnitaryDecomposition.embedding K).conjTranspose * R.E a b *
            FreeEntropy.UnitaryDecomposition.embedding K)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieDecomposition.exists_complete_orthogonal_family
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H),
  ∃ (s : Finset (FreeEntropy.LieDecomposition.Space H)),
    (∀ L ∈ s, FreeEntropy.LieDecomposition.IrreducibleSubspace R L) ∧
      (∀ L ∈ s, ∀ J ∈ s, L ≠ J → FreeEntropy.UnitaryDecomposition.Orthogonal L J) ∧ s.sup id = ⊤

declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H)
  (K : FreeEntropy.LieDecomposition.Space H),
  FreeEntropy.LieDecomposition.Invariant R K → K ≠ ⊥ → ∃ L ≤ K, FreeEntropy.LieDecomposition.IrreducibleSubspace R L

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieDecomposition.exists_orthogonal_irreducible_family
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H)
  (K : FreeEntropy.LieDecomposition.Space H),
  FreeEntropy.LieDecomposition.Invariant R K →
    ∃ (s : Finset (FreeEntropy.LieDecomposition.Space H)),
      (∀ L ∈ s, FreeEntropy.LieDecomposition.IrreducibleSubspace R L) ∧
        (∀ L ∈ s, ∀ J ∈ s, L ≠ J → FreeEntropy.UnitaryDecomposition.Orthogonal L J) ∧ s.sup id = K

declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] {R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H}
  {K L : FreeEntropy.LieDecomposition.Space H},

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieDecomposition.irreducibleFamily_spec
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H),
  (∀ K ∈ FreeEntropy.LieDecomposition.irreducibleFamily R, FreeEntropy.LieDecomposition.IrreducibleSubspace R K) ∧
    (∀ K ∈ FreeEntropy.LieDecomposition.irreducibleFamily R,
        ∀ L ∈ FreeEntropy.LieDecomposition.irreducibleFamily R,
          K ≠ L → FreeEntropy.UnitaryDecomposition.Orthogonal K L) ∧

declarations.statement:

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators.casimir
declarations.statement: {d : ℕ} → {H : Type u_1} → [inst : Fintype H] → FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H → Matrix H H ℂ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators.casimir_commutes
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [DecidableEq H] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H)
  (k l : Fin d), R.casimir * R.E k l = R.E k l * R.casimir

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators.casimir_commutes_word
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H)
  (w : List (Fin d × Fin d)), R.casimir * R.wordMatrix w = R.wordMatrix w * R.casimir

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators.casimir_eq_scalar_of_cyclic
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H) [Nonempty K] (P : Matrix H K ℂ) (lam : Fin d → ℝ),
  (∀ (i : Fin d), R.E i i * P = lam i • P) →
    (∀ (i j : Fin d), i < j → R.E i j * P = 0) →
      R.cyclicSpan P = ⊤ → R.casimir = FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.casimir lam • 1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators.casimir_hermitian
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [DecidableEq H] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H),
  R.casimir.IsHermitian

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators.casimir_intertwines
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : Fintype K] [DecidableEq H] [DecidableEq K]
  (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H) (S : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d K)
  (V : Matrix H K ℂ), (∀ (i j : Fin d), R.E i j * V = V * S.E i j) → R.casimir * V = V * S.casimir

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators.casimir_on_cyclicSpan
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H) (P : Matrix H K ℂ) (lam : Fin d → ℝ),
  (∀ (i : Fin d), R.E i i * P = lam i • P) →
    (∀ (i j : Fin d), i < j → R.E i j * P = 0) →
      ∀ {X : Matrix H K ℂ}, X ∈ R.cyclicSpan P → R.casimir * X = FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.casimir lam • X

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators.casimir_on_highest
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} {C : Type u_3} [inst : Fintype H] [Fintype C] [DecidableEq H] [DecidableEq C]
  (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H) (P : Matrix H C ℂ) (lam : Fin d → ℝ),
  (∀ (i : Fin d), R.E i i * P = lam i • P) →
    (∀ (i j : Fin d), i < j → R.E i j * P = 0) → R.casimir * P = FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.casimir lam • P

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators.casimir_on_highest_word
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H) (P : Matrix H K ℂ) (lam : Fin d → ℝ),
  (∀ (i : Fin d), R.E i i * P = lam i • P) →
    (∀ (i j : Fin d), i < j → R.E i j * P = 0) →
      ∀ (w : List (Fin d × Fin d)),
        R.casimir * (R.wordMatrix w * P) = FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.casimir lam • (R.wordMatrix w * P)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators.casimir_positive
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [DecidableEq H] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H),
  R.casimir.PosSemidef

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators.casimir_scalar_of_vector_cyclic
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H)
  (lam : Fin d → ℝ) (v : H → ℂ),
  (∀ (i : Fin d), (R.E i i).mulVec v = lam i • v) →
    (∀ (i j : Fin d), i < j → (R.E i j).mulVec v = 0) →
      FreeEntropy.LiePBW.cyclicSpan R v = ⊤ → R.casimir = FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.casimir lam • 1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators.casimir_tensor
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : Fintype K] [inst_2 : DecidableEq H]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq K] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H)
  (S : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d K),
  (R.tensor S).casimir =
    Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun (x1 x2 : ℂ) => x1 * x2) R.casimir 1 +
        Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun (x1 x2 : ℂ) => x1 * x2) 1 S.casimir +
      2 • ∑ i : Fin d, ∑ j : Fin d, Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun (x1 x2 : ℂ) => x1 * x2) (R.E i j) (S.E j i)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators.column_cyclic_of_vector
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {A : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : DecidableEq A] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d A)
  (v : A → ℂ), FreeEntropy.LiePBW.cyclicSpan R v = ⊤ → (R.cyclicSpan fun (a : A) (x : Unit) => v a) = ⊤

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators.conjugate_eq_neg_dual
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [DecidableEq H] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H)
  (i j : Fin d), (R.E j i).map ⇑(starRingEnd ℂ) = -R.dual.E i j

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators.cyclicSpan
declarations.statement:
{d : ℕ} →
  {H : Type u_1} →
    {K : Type u_2} →
      [inst : Fintype H] →
        [DecidableEq H] → FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H → Matrix H K ℂ → Submodule ℂ (Matrix H K ℂ)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators.diagonal_commute
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {A : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d A)
  (i j : Fin d), R.E i i * R.E j j = R.E j j * R.E i i

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators.dual
declarations.statement:
{d : ℕ} →
  {H : Type u_1} →
    [inst : Fintype H] → FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H → FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators.dual_dual_E
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [DecidableEq H] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H)
  (i j : Fin d), R.dual.dual.E i j = R.E i j

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators.dual_tensor_E
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] [inst_2 : Fintype K]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq K] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H)
  (S : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d K) (i j : Fin d),
  (R.tensor S).dual.E i j = (R.dual.tensor S.dual).E i j

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators.exists_highest
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {A : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Nonempty A]
  (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d A),
  ∃ (lam : Fin d → ℝ) (v : A → ℂ),
    v ≠ 0 ∧
      Antitone lam ∧ (∀ (j : Fin d), (R.E j j).mulVec v = lam j • v) ∧ ∀ (i j : Fin d), i < j → (R.E i j).mulVec v = 0

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators.exists_jointBasis
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {A : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d A),
  ∃ (b : OrthonormalBasis A ℂ (EuclideanSpace ℂ A)) (χ : A → Fin d → ℂ),
    ∀ (a : A) (j : Fin d), (R.E j j).mulVec (b a).ofLp = χ a j • (b a).ofLp

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators.exists_real_jointBasis
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {A : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d A),
  ∃ (b : OrthonormalBasis A ℂ (EuclideanSpace ℂ A)) (χ : A → Fin d → ℝ),
    ∀ (a : A) (j : Fin d), (R.E j j).mulVec (b a).ofLp = χ a j • (b a).ofLp

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators.exists_weightCoordinates
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {A : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : DecidableEq A] [Nonempty A]
  (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d A),
  (∀ (v : A → ℂ), v ≠ 0 → FreeEntropy.LiePBW.cyclicSpan R v = ⊤) →
    Nonempty (FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.WeightCoordinates R)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators.highest_compression
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [DecidableEq H] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H)
  (P : Matrix H H ℂ),
  IsStarProjection P →
    ∀ (lam : Fin d → ℝ),
      (∀ (i : Fin d), R.E i i * P = lam i • P) →
        (∀ (i j : Fin d), i < j → R.E i j * P = 0) → ∀ (i j : Fin d), P * R.E i j * P = if i = j then lam i • P else 0

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators.highest_product
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} {C : Type u_3} [inst : Fintype H] [Fintype C] [DecidableEq H] [DecidableEq C]
  (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H) (P : Matrix H C ℂ) (lam : Fin d → ℝ),
  (∀ (i : Fin d), R.E i i * P = lam i • P) →
    (∀ (i j : Fin d), i < j → R.E i j * P = 0) →
      ∀ (i j : Fin d),
        R.E i j * R.E j i * P = ((if i = j then lam i ^ 2 else 0) + if i < j then lam i - lam j else 0) • P

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators.highest_weight_dominant
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [DecidableEq H] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H)
  (lam : Fin d → ℝ) (v : H → ℂ),
  v ≠ 0 →
    (∀ (i : Fin d), (R.E i i).mulVec v = lam i • v) → (∀ (i j : Fin d), i < j → (R.E i j).mulVec v = 0) → Antitone lam

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators.intertwines_shift_move
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {A : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} {C : Type u_3} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : DecidableEq A] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq B] [inst_4 : Fintype C] [inst_5 : DecidableEq C]
  (E : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d A) (F : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d B)
  (S : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d C) (c : ℝ) (V : Matrix (A × B) C ℂ),
  (∀ (i j : Fin d), (E.tensor (F.shift (-c))).E i j * V = V * S.E i j) →
    ∀ (i j : Fin d), (E.tensor F).E i j * V = V * (S.shift c).E i j

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators.raising_weight
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [DecidableEq H] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H)
  (lam : Fin d → ℂ) (v : H → ℂ),
  (∀ (k : Fin d), (R.E k k).mulVec v = lam k • v) →
    ∀ (i j k : Fin d),
      (R.E k k).mulVec ((R.E i j).mulVec v) =
        ((lam k + if k = i then 1 else 0) - if k = j then 1 else 0) • (R.E i j).mulVec v

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators.shift
declarations.statement:
{d : ℕ} →
  {H : Type u_1} →
    [inst : Fintype H] →
      [DecidableEq H] → FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H → ℝ → FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators.shift_cyclicSpan
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H)
  (c : ℝ) (lam : Fin d → ℂ) (v : H → ℂ),
  (∀ (i : Fin d), (R.E i i).mulVec v = lam i • v) →
    (∀ (i j : Fin d), i < j → (R.E i j).mulVec v = 0) →
      FreeEntropy.LiePBW.cyclicSpan (R.shift c) v = FreeEntropy.LiePBW.cyclicSpan R v

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators.shift_diagonal
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H)
  (c : ℝ) (i : Fin d), (R.shift c).E i i = R.E i i + c • 1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators.shift_highest_weight
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H)
  (c : ℝ) (lam : Fin d → ℂ) (v : H → ℂ),
  (∀ (i : Fin d), (R.E i i).mulVec v = lam i • v) → ∀ (i : Fin d), ((R.shift c).E i i).mulVec v = (lam i + ↑c) • v

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators.shift_loweringSpan
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H)
  (c : ℝ) (v : H → ℂ), FreeEntropy.LiePBW.loweringSpan (R.shift c) v = FreeEntropy.LiePBW.loweringSpan R v

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators.shift_lowering_word
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H)
  (c : ℝ) (w : List (FreeEntropy.LiePBW.Root d)),
  (∀ a ∈ w, a.2 < a.1) → FreeEntropy.LiePBW.word (R.shift c) w = FreeEntropy.LiePBW.word R w

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators.shift_offdiagonal
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H)
  (c : ℝ) (i j : Fin d), i ≠ j → (R.shift c).E i j = R.E i j

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators.tensor
declarations.statement:
{d : ℕ} →
  {H : Type u_1} →
    {K : Type u_2} →
      [inst : Fintype H] →
        [inst_1 : Fintype K] →
          [DecidableEq H] →
            [DecidableEq K] →
              FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H →
                FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d K → FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d (H × K)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators.tensor_casimir_compression
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : Fintype K] [inst_2 : DecidableEq H]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq K] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H)
  (S : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d K) (P : Matrix H H ℂ) (Q : Matrix K K ℂ),
  IsStarProjection P →
    IsStarProjection Q →
      ∀ (mu lam omega : Fin d → ℝ),
        R.casimir * P = FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.casimir mu • P →
          (∀ (i : Fin d), R.E i i * P = lam i • P) →
            (∀ (i : Fin d), S.E i i * Q = omega i • Q) →
              (∀ (i j : Fin d), i < j → S.E i j * Q = 0) →
                Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun (x1 x2 : ℂ) => x1 * x2) P Q * (R.tensor S).casimir *
                    Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun (x1 x2 : ℂ) => x1 * x2) P Q =
                  (FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.casimir mu + FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.casimir omega +
                      2 * FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.dot lam omega) •
                    Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun (x1 x2 : ℂ) => x1 * x2) P Q

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators.tensor_casimir_deficit
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : Fintype K] [inst_2 : DecidableEq H]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq K] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H)
  (S : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d K) (P : Matrix H H ℂ) (Q : Matrix K K ℂ),
  IsStarProjection P →
    IsStarProjection Q →
      ∀ (mu omega delta : Fin d → ℝ),
        R.casimir * P = FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.casimir mu • P →
          (∀ (i : Fin d), R.E i i * P = (mu i - delta i) • P) →
            (∀ (i : Fin d), S.E i i * Q = omega i • Q) →
              (∀ (i j : Fin d), i < j → S.E i j * Q = 0) →
                Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun (x1 x2 : ℂ) => x1 * x2) P Q *
                      (FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.casimir (mu + omega) • 1 - (R.tensor S).casimir) *
                    Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun (x1 x2 : ℂ) => x1 * x2) P Q =
                  (2 * FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.dot delta omega) •
                    Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun (x1 x2 : ℂ) => x1 * x2) P Q

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators.tensor_cross_compression
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : Fintype K] [DecidableEq H] [DecidableEq K]
  (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H) (S : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d K) (P : Matrix H H ℂ)
  (Q : Matrix K K ℂ),
  IsStarProjection P →
    IsStarProjection Q →
      ∀ (lam omega : Fin d → ℝ),
        (∀ (i : Fin d), R.E i i * P = lam i • P) →
          (∀ (i : Fin d), S.E i i * Q = omega i • Q) →
            (∀ (i j : Fin d), i < j → S.E i j * Q = 0) →
              (Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun (x1 x2 : ℂ) => x1 * x2) P Q *
                    ∑ i : Fin d, ∑ j : Fin d, Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun (x1 x2 : ℂ) => x1 * x2) (R.E i j) (S.E j i)) *
                  Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun (x1 x2 : ℂ) => x1 * x2) P Q =
                FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.dot lam omega • Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun (x1 x2 : ℂ) => x1 * x2) P Q

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators.tensor_shift
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {A : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : DecidableEq A] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq B] (E : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d A)
  (F : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d B) (c : ℝ) (i j : Fin d),
  (E.tensor (F.shift c)).E i j = ((E.tensor F).shift c).E i j

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators.unitaryConjugate
declarations.statement:
{d : ℕ} →
  {A : Type u_1} →
    [inst : Fintype A] →
      [inst_1 : DecidableEq A] →
        FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d A →
          (W : Matrix A A ℂ) → W.conjTranspose * W = 1 → FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d A

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators.unitaryConjugate_action
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {A : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : DecidableEq A] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d A)
  (W : Matrix A A ℂ) (hW : W.conjTranspose * W = 1) (i j : Fin d) (v : A → ℂ),
  ((R.unitaryConjugate W hW).E i j).mulVec (W.conjTranspose.mulVec v) = W.conjTranspose.mulVec ((R.E i j).mulVec v)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators.unitaryConjugate_cyclic
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {A : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : DecidableEq A] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d A)
  (W : Matrix A A ℂ) (hW : W.conjTranspose * W = 1) (v : A → ℂ),
  FreeEntropy.LiePBW.cyclicSpan R v = ⊤ →
    FreeEntropy.LiePBW.cyclicSpan (R.unitaryConjugate W hW) (W.conjTranspose.mulVec v) = ⊤

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators.unitaryConjugate_word
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {A : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : DecidableEq A] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d A)
  (W : Matrix A A ℂ) (hW : W.conjTranspose * W = 1) (w : List (Fin d × Fin d)),
  FreeEntropy.LiePBW.word (R.unitaryConjugate W hW) w = W.conjTranspose * FreeEntropy.LiePBW.word R w * W

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators.vector_cyclic_of_column
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {A : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : DecidableEq A] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d A)
  (P : Matrix A Unit ℂ), R.cyclicSpan P = ⊤ → (FreeEntropy.LiePBW.cyclicSpan R fun (a : A) => P a ()) = ⊤

  (W : Matrix K H ℂ),
  (∀ (i j : Fin d), S.E i j * W = W * R.E i j) →

declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (lam : Fin d → ℝ),

    FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.casimir lam

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.kronecker_sub_left
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [Fintype H] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq H] [DecidableEq K] (X Y : Matrix H H ℂ)
  (Z : Matrix K K ℂ),
  Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun (x1 x2 : ℂ) => x1 * x2) (X - Y) Z =
    Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun (x1 x2 : ℂ) => x1 * x2) X Z - Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun (x1 x2 : ℂ) => x1 * x2) Y Z

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.kronecker_sub_right
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [Fintype H] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq H] [DecidableEq K] (X : Matrix H H ℂ)
  (Y Z : Matrix K K ℂ),
  Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun (x1 x2 : ℂ) => x1 * x2) X (Y - Z) =
    Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun (x1 x2 : ℂ) => x1 * x2) X Y - Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun (x1 x2 : ℂ) => x1 * x2) X Z

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.kronecker_sum_left
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [Fintype H] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq H] [DecidableEq K] {ι : Type u_4}
  [inst : Fintype ι] (X : ι → Matrix H H ℂ) (Y : Matrix K K ℂ),
  Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun (x1 x2 : ℂ) => x1 * x2) (∑ i : ι, X i) Y =
    ∑ i : ι, Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun (x1 x2 : ℂ) => x1 * x2) (X i) Y

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.kronecker_sum_right
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [Fintype H] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq H] [DecidableEq K] {ι : Type u_4}
  [inst : Fintype ι] (X : Matrix H H ℂ) (Y : ι → Matrix K K ℂ),
  Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun (x1 x2 : ℂ) => x1 * x2) X (∑ i : ι, Y i) =
    ∑ i : ι, Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun (x1 x2 : ℂ) => x1 * x2) X (Y i)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.sum_positive_root_differences
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (lam : Fin d → ℝ),

    ∑ i : Fin d, lam i * FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.twiceRho i

declarations.statement: {H : Type u_1} → {K : Type u_2} → {B : Type u_3} → Matrix (H × K) B ℂ → Matrix (K × H) B ℂ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.swap_tensor_intertwines
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] [inst_2 : Fintype K]

  (W : Matrix (H × K) B ℂ),
  (∀ (i j : Fin d), (R.tensor S).E i j * W = W * N.E i j) →

      (S.tensor R).E i j * FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.swapRows W = FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.swapRows W * N.E i j

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.card_le_polynomial_of_cyclic
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H)
  (wt : H → Fin d → ℕ) (n : ℕ),
  (∀ (k : Fin d), R.E k k = Matrix.diagonal fun (h : H) => ↑(wt h k)) →
    (∀ (h : H), ∑ k : Fin d, wt h k = n) →
      ∀ (lam : Fin d → ℕ) (v : H → ℂ),
        (∀ (k : Fin d), (R.E k k).mulVec v = ↑(lam k) • v) →
          (∀ (i j : Fin d), i < j → (R.E i j).mulVec v = 0) →
            FreeEntropy.LiePBW.cyclicSpan R v = ⊤ → Fintype.card H ≤ (n * (d - 1) + 1) ^ d.choose 2

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.commutant_scalar_of_highest
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H)
  (lam : Fin d → ℂ) (v : H → ℂ),
  v ≠ 0 →
    (∀ (i : Fin d), (R.E i i).mulVec v = lam i • v) →
      (∀ (i j : Fin d), i < j → (R.E i j).mulVec v = 0) →
        FreeEntropy.LiePBW.cyclicSpan R v = ⊤ →
          ∀ (T : Matrix H H ℂ), (∀ (i j : Fin d), T * R.E i j = R.E i j * T) → ∃ (c : ℂ), T = c • 1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.commuting_operator_scalar_on_cyclicSpan
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H)
  (v : H → ℂ) (T : Matrix H H ℂ),
  (∀ (i j : Fin d), T * R.E i j = R.E i j * T) →
    ∀ (c : ℂ), T.mulVec v = c • v → ∀ {x : H → ℂ}, x ∈ FreeEntropy.LiePBW.cyclicSpan R v → T.mulVec x = c • x

declarations.statement: {d : ℕ} → {H : Type u_1} → (H → Fin d → ℂ) → (Fin d → ℂ) → Submodule ℂ (H → ℂ)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.coordinateWeightSpace_finrank
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [DecidableEq H] (wt : H → Fin d → ℂ) (target : Fin d → ℂ),
  Module.finrank ℂ ↥(FreeEntropy.LiePBW.coordinateWeightSpace wt target) = Fintype.card { h : H // wt h = target }

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.coordinate_weight_has_assignment
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H)
  (wt : H → Fin d → ℂ),
  (∀ (k : Fin d), R.E k k = Matrix.diagonal fun (h : H) => wt h k) →
    ∀ (lam : Fin d → ℂ) (v : H → ℂ),
      (∀ (k : Fin d), (R.E k k).mulVec v = lam k • v) →
        (∀ (i j : Fin d), i < j → (R.E i j).mulVec v = 0) →
          ∀ x ∈ FreeEntropy.LiePBW.cyclicSpan R v,
            ∀ (i : H),
              x i ≠ 0 →
                ∃ (a : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d →₀ ℕ),
                  wt i = FreeEntropy.LiePBW.shiftedWeight lam a

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.cyclicIntertwinerEquiv
declarations.statement:
{d : ℕ} →
  {H : Type u_1} →
    {K : Type u_2} →
      [inst : Fintype H] →
        [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] →
          [inst_2 : Fintype K] →
            [inst_3 : DecidableEq K] →
              (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H) →
                (S : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d K) →
                  (lam : Fin d → ℂ) →
                    (v : H → ℂ) →
                      (∀ (i : Fin d), (R.E i i).mulVec v = lam i • v) →
                        (∀ (i j : Fin d), i < j → (R.E i j).mulVec v = 0) →
                          (f : (H → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] K → ℂ) →
                            (∀ (i j : Fin d) (x : H → ℂ), f ((R.E i j).mulVec x) = (S.E i j).mulVec (f x)) →
                              f v ≠ 0 →
                                FreeEntropy.LiePBW.cyclicSpan S (f v) = ⊤ →
                                  ↥(FreeEntropy.LiePBW.cyclicSpan R v) ≃ₗ[ℂ] K → ℂ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.cyclicSpan_eq_loweringSpan
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H)
  (lam : Fin d → ℂ) (v : H → ℂ),
  (∀ (i : Fin d), (R.E i i).mulVec v = lam i • v) →
    (∀ (i j : Fin d), i < j → (R.E i j).mulVec v = 0) →
      FreeEntropy.LiePBW.cyclicSpan R v = FreeEntropy.LiePBW.loweringSpan R v

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.cyclicSpan_eq_orderedLoweringSpan
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H)
  (lam : Fin d → ℂ) (v : H → ℂ),
  (∀ (i : Fin d), (R.E i i).mulVec v = lam i • v) →
    (∀ (i j : Fin d), i < j → (R.E i j).mulVec v = 0) →
      FreeEntropy.LiePBW.cyclicSpan R v = FreeEntropy.LiePBW.orderedLoweringSpan R v

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.cyclicSpan_finrank_le_polynomial
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H)
  (wt : H → Fin d → ℕ) (n : ℕ),
  (∀ (k : Fin d), R.E k k = Matrix.diagonal fun (h : H) => ↑(wt h k)) →
    (∀ (h : H), ∑ k : Fin d, wt h k = n) →
      ∀ (lam : Fin d → ℕ) (v : H → ℂ),
        (∀ (k : Fin d), (R.E k k).mulVec v = ↑(lam k) • v) →
          (∀ (i j : Fin d), i < j → (R.E i j).mulVec v = 0) →
            Module.finrank ℂ ↥(FreeEntropy.LiePBW.cyclicSpan R v) ≤ (n * (d - 1) + 1) ^ d.choose 2

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.cyclicSpan_le_boundedLoweringSpan
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H)
  (wt : H → Fin d → ℕ) (n : ℕ),
  (∀ (k : Fin d), R.E k k = Matrix.diagonal fun (h : H) => ↑(wt h k)) →
    (∀ (h : H), ∑ k : Fin d, wt h k = n) →
      ∀ (lam : Fin d → ℕ) (v : H → ℂ),
        (∀ (k : Fin d), (R.E k k).mulVec v = ↑(lam k) • v) →
          (∀ (i j : Fin d), i < j → (R.E i j).mulVec v = 0) →
            FreeEntropy.LiePBW.cyclicSpan R v ≤ FreeEntropy.LiePBW.boundedLoweringSpan R v (n * (d - 1))

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.cyclicSpan_le_of_invariant
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H)
  (v : H → ℂ) {S : Submodule ℂ (H → ℂ)},
  FreeEntropy.LiePBW.GeneratorInvariant R S → v ∈ S → FreeEntropy.LiePBW.cyclicSpan R v ≤ S

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.cyclic_highest_irreducible
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H)
  (lam : Fin d → ℂ) (v : H → ℂ),
  v ≠ 0 →
    (∀ (i : Fin d), (R.E i i).mulVec v = lam i • v) →
      (∀ (i j : Fin d), i < j → (R.E i j).mulVec v = 0) →
        ∀ (S : Submodule ℂ (H → ℂ)),
          FreeEntropy.LiePBW.GeneratorInvariant R S →
            S ≤ FreeEntropy.LiePBW.cyclicSpan R v → S = ⊥ ∨ S = FreeEntropy.LiePBW.cyclicSpan R v

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.cyclic_intertwiner_injective
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] [inst_2 : Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H) (S : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d K) (lam : Fin d → ℂ)
  (v : H → ℂ),
  (∀ (i : Fin d), (R.E i i).mulVec v = lam i • v) →
    (∀ (i j : Fin d), i < j → (R.E i j).mulVec v = 0) →
      ∀ (f : (H → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] K → ℂ),
        (∀ (i j : Fin d) (x : H → ℂ), f ((R.E i j).mulVec x) = (S.E i j).mulVec (f x)) →
          f v ≠ 0 → Function.Injective ⇑(f ∘ₗ (FreeEntropy.LiePBW.cyclicSpan R v).subtype)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.cyclic_intertwiner_surjective
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] [inst_2 : Fintype K]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq K] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H)
  (S : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d K) (v : H → ℂ) (f : (H → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] K → ℂ),
  (∀ (i j : Fin d) (x : H → ℂ), f ((R.E i j).mulVec x) = (S.E i j).mulVec (f x)) →
    FreeEntropy.LiePBW.cyclicSpan S (f v) = ⊤ → Function.Surjective ⇑(f ∘ₗ (FreeEntropy.LiePBW.cyclicSpan R v).subtype)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.cyclic_weightSpace_finrank_le_rootFiber
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H)
  (wt : H → Fin d → ℂ),
  (∀ (k : Fin d), R.E k k = Matrix.diagonal fun (h : H) => wt h k) →
    ∀ (lam : Fin d → ℂ) (v : H → ℂ),
      (∀ (k : Fin d), (R.E k k).mulVec v = lam k • v) →
        (∀ (i j : Fin d), i < j → (R.E i j).mulVec v = 0) →
          ∀ (a : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d →₀ ℕ),
            Module.finrank ℂ
                ↥(FreeEntropy.LiePBW.cyclicSpan R v ⊓
                    FreeEntropy.LiePBW.coordinateWeightSpace wt (FreeEntropy.LiePBW.shiftedWeight lam a)) ≤
              (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.lowerWeightFiber a).card

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.directSum
declarations.statement:
{d : ℕ} →
  {H : Type u_1} →
    {K : Type u_2} →
      [inst : Fintype H] →
        [inst_1 : Fintype K] →
          FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H →
            FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d K → FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d (H ⊕ K)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.directSum_mulVec
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype H] [DecidableEq H] [inst_2 : Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H) (S : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d K) (i j : Fin d)
  (x : H ⊕ K → ℂ),
  ((FreeEntropy.LiePBW.directSum R S).E i j).mulVec x =
    Sum.elim ((R.E i j).mulVec (x ∘ Sum.inl)) ((S.E i j).mulVec (x ∘ Sum.inr))

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.directSum_raise
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype H] [DecidableEq H] [inst_2 : Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H) (S : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d K) (v : H → ℂ)
  (w : K → ℂ),
  (∀ (i j : Fin d), i < j → (R.E i j).mulVec v = 0) →
    (∀ (i j : Fin d), i < j → (S.E i j).mulVec w = 0) →
      ∀ (i j : Fin d), i < j → ((FreeEntropy.LiePBW.directSum R S).E i j).mulVec (Sum.elim v w) = 0

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.directSum_weight
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype H] [DecidableEq H] [inst_2 : Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H) (S : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d K) (lam : Fin d → ℂ)
  (v : H → ℂ) (w : K → ℂ),
  (∀ (i : Fin d), (R.E i i).mulVec v = lam i • v) →
    (∀ (i : Fin d), (S.E i i).mulVec w = lam i • w) →
      ∀ (i : Fin d), ((FreeEntropy.LiePBW.directSum R S).E i i).mulVec (Sum.elim v w) = lam i • Sum.elim v w

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.eigenvector_mem_weightSpace
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H)
  (wt : H → Fin d → ℂ),
  (∀ (k : Fin d), R.E k k = Matrix.diagonal fun (h : H) => wt h k) →
    ∀ (target : Fin d → ℂ) (x : H → ℂ),
      (∀ (k : Fin d), (R.E k k).mulVec x = target k • x) → x ∈ FreeEntropy.LiePBW.coordinateWeightSpace wt target

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.exists_highest_linearEquiv
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] [inst_2 : Fintype K]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq K] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H)
  (S : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d K) (lam : Fin d → ℂ) (v : H → ℂ) (w : K → ℂ),
  v ≠ 0 →
    w ≠ 0 →
      (∀ (i : Fin d), (R.E i i).mulVec v = lam i • v) →
        (∀ (i : Fin d), (S.E i i).mulVec w = lam i • w) →
          (∀ (i j : Fin d), i < j → (R.E i j).mulVec v = 0) →
            (∀ (i j : Fin d), i < j → (S.E i j).mulVec w = 0) →
              FreeEntropy.LiePBW.cyclicSpan R v = ⊤ →
                FreeEntropy.LiePBW.cyclicSpan S w = ⊤ →
                  ∃ (e : (H → ℂ) ≃ₗ[ℂ] K → ℂ),
                    e v = w ∧ ∀ (i j : Fin d) (x : H → ℂ), e ((R.E i j).mulVec x) = (S.E i j).mulVec (e x)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.exists_highest_matrixEquiv
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] [inst_2 : Fintype K]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq K] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H)
  (S : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d K) (lam : Fin d → ℂ) (v : H → ℂ) (w : K → ℂ),
  v ≠ 0 →
    w ≠ 0 →
      (∀ (i : Fin d), (R.E i i).mulVec v = lam i • v) →
        (∀ (i : Fin d), (S.E i i).mulVec w = lam i • w) →
          (∀ (i j : Fin d), i < j → (R.E i j).mulVec v = 0) →
            (∀ (i j : Fin d), i < j → (S.E i j).mulVec w = 0) →
              FreeEntropy.LiePBW.cyclicSpan R v = ⊤ →
                FreeEntropy.LiePBW.cyclicSpan S w = ⊤ →
                  ∃ (F : Matrix K H ℂ),
                    (Function.Bijective fun (x : H → ℂ) => F.mulVec x) ∧
                      F.mulVec v = w ∧ ∀ (i j : Fin d), F * R.E i j = S.E i j * F

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.exists_highest_unitary
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] [inst_2 : Fintype K]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq K] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H)
  (S : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d K) (lam : Fin d → ℂ) (v : H → ℂ) (w : K → ℂ),
  v ≠ 0 →
    w ≠ 0 →
      (∀ (i : Fin d), (R.E i i).mulVec v = lam i • v) →
        (∀ (i : Fin d), (S.E i i).mulVec w = lam i • w) →
          (∀ (i j : Fin d), i < j → (R.E i j).mulVec v = 0) →
            (∀ (i j : Fin d), i < j → (S.E i j).mulVec w = 0) →
              FreeEntropy.LiePBW.cyclicSpan R v = ⊤ →
                FreeEntropy.LiePBW.cyclicSpan S w = ⊤ →
                  ∃ (W : Matrix K H ℂ),
                    W.conjTranspose * W = 1 ∧ W * W.conjTranspose = 1 ∧ ∀ (i j : Fin d), W * R.E i j = S.E i j * W

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.exists_nonorthogonal_lowering_word
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H)
  (v u : H → ℂ),
  u ∈ FreeEntropy.LiePBW.loweringSpan R v →
    u ≠ 0 →
      ∃ (w : List (FreeEntropy.LiePBW.Root d)),
        (∀ a ∈ w, a.2 < a.1) ∧ star u ⬝ᵥ (FreeEntropy.LiePBW.word R w).mulVec v ≠ 0

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.exists_positive_root_coeff
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (i j : Fin d),
  j < i →
    ∃ (c : Fin (d - 1) → ℕ),
      FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.offset c = fun (k : Fin d) => (if k = j then 1 else 0) - if k = i then 1 else 0

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.finiteWeightSpan
declarations.statement:
{d : ℕ} →

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.firstCoordinate
declarations.statement: {H : Type u_1} → {K : Type u_2} → (H ⊕ K → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] H → ℂ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.firstCoordinate_apply
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [Fintype H] [DecidableEq H] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K] (x : H ⊕ K → ℂ),
  FreeEntropy.LiePBW.firstCoordinate x = x ∘ Sum.inl

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.firstCoordinate_intertwines
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype H] [DecidableEq H] [inst_2 : Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H) (S : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d K) (i j : Fin d)
  (x : H ⊕ K → ℂ),
  FreeEntropy.LiePBW.firstCoordinate (((FreeEntropy.LiePBW.directSum R S).E i j).mulVec x) =
    (R.E i j).mulVec (FreeEntropy.LiePBW.firstCoordinate x)

declarations.statement: {d : ℕ} → FreeEntropy.LiePBW.Root d → ℕ

declarations.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ}, Function.Injective FreeEntropy.LiePBW.fullKey

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.fully_ordered_word_scalar_lowering
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H)
  (lam : Fin d → ℂ) (v : H → ℂ),
  (∀ (i : Fin d), (R.E i i).mulVec v = lam i • v) →
    (∀ (i j : Fin d), i < j → (R.E i j).mulVec v = 0) →
      ∀ (w : List (FreeEntropy.LiePBW.Root d)),
        List.Pairwise
            (fun (a b : FreeEntropy.LiePBW.Root d) => FreeEntropy.LiePBW.fullKey a ≤ FreeEntropy.LiePBW.fullKey b) w →
          ∃ (l : List (FreeEntropy.LiePBW.Root d)),
            (∀ a ∈ l, a.2 < a.1) ∧
              l.Sublist w ∧
                ∃ (c : ℂ), (FreeEntropy.LiePBW.word R w).mulVec v = c • (FreeEntropy.LiePBW.word R l).mulVec v

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.generator_preserves_cyclicSpan
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H)
  (v : H → ℂ) (i j : Fin d) {x : H → ℂ},
  x ∈ FreeEntropy.LiePBW.cyclicSpan R v → (R.E i j).mulVec x ∈ FreeEntropy.LiePBW.cyclicSpan R v

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.gram_commutes
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype H] [DecidableEq H] [inst_2 : Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H) (S : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d K)
  (F : Matrix K H ℂ),
  (∀ (i j : Fin d), F * R.E i j = S.E i j * F) →
    ∀ (i j : Fin d), F.conjTranspose * F * R.E i j = R.E i j * (F.conjTranspose * F)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.highest_dot_lowering_word_zero
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H)
  (u v : H → ℂ),
  (∀ (i j : Fin d), i < j → (R.E i j).mulVec u = 0) →
    ∀ (w : List (FreeEntropy.LiePBW.Root d)),
      w ≠ [] → (∀ a ∈ w, a.2 < a.1) → star u ⬝ᵥ (FreeEntropy.LiePBW.word R w).mulVec v = 0

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.highest_line_unique
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H)
  (lam : Fin d → ℂ) (v u : H → ℂ),
  v ≠ 0 →
    (∀ (i : Fin d), (R.E i i).mulVec v = lam i • v) →
      (∀ (i j : Fin d), i < j → (R.E i j).mulVec v = 0) →
        u ∈ FreeEntropy.LiePBW.cyclicSpan R v → (∀ (i j : Fin d), i < j → (R.E i j).mulVec u = 0) → ∃ (c : ℂ), u = c • v

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.highest_orthogonal_zero
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H)
  (lam : Fin d → ℂ) (v u : H → ℂ),
  (∀ (i : Fin d), (R.E i i).mulVec v = lam i • v) →
    (∀ (i j : Fin d), i < j → (R.E i j).mulVec v = 0) →
      u ∈ FreeEntropy.LiePBW.cyclicSpan R v →
        (∀ (i j : Fin d), i < j → (R.E i j).mulVec u = 0) → star u ⬝ᵥ v = 0 → u = 0

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.hilbertSubspace
declarations.statement: {H : Type u_1} → [inst : Fintype H] → Submodule ℂ (H → ℂ) → Submodule ℂ (EuclideanSpace ℂ H)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.intertwiner_ext_of_cyclic
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] [inst_2 : Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H) (S : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d K) (v : H → ℂ),
  FreeEntropy.LiePBW.cyclicSpan R v = ⊤ →
    ∀ (T V : Matrix K H ℂ),
      (∀ (i j : Fin d), T * R.E i j = S.E i j * T) →
        (∀ (i j : Fin d), V * R.E i j = S.E i j * V) → T.mulVec v = V.mulVec v → T = V

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.intertwiner_word
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] [inst_2 : Fintype K]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq K] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H)
  (S : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d K) (f : (H → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] K → ℂ),
  (∀ (i j : Fin d) (x : H → ℂ), f ((R.E i j).mulVec x) = (S.E i j).mulVec (f x)) →
    ∀ (w : List (FreeEntropy.LiePBW.Root d)) (v : H → ℂ),
      f ((FreeEntropy.LiePBW.word R w).mulVec v) = (FreeEntropy.LiePBW.word S w).mulVec (f v)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.lowerExponent_cons
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (r : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d)
  (l : List (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d)),
  FreeEntropy.LiePBW.lowerExponent (r :: l) = Finsupp.single r 1 + FreeEntropy.LiePBW.lowerExponent l

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.lowerExponent_injective_on_ordered
declarations.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ}, Function.Injective fun (l : FreeEntropy.LiePBW.OrderedLoweringWord d) => FreeEntropy.LiePBW.lowerExponent ↑l

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.lowerExponent_nil
declarations.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ}, FreeEntropy.LiePBW.lowerExponent [] = 0

{d : ℕ} →

        FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H →
          List (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d) → Matrix H H ℂ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.lowerWord_depth_le_of_ne_zero
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H)
  (wt : H → Fin d → ℕ) (n : ℕ),
  (∀ (k : Fin d), R.E k k = Matrix.diagonal fun (h : H) => ↑(wt h k)) →
    (∀ (h : H), ∑ k : Fin d, wt h k = n) →
      ∀ (lam : Fin d → ℕ) (v : H → ℂ),
        (∀ (k : Fin d), (R.E k k).mulVec v = ↑(lam k) • v) →
          ∀ (l : List (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d)),
            (FreeEntropy.LiePBW.lowerWord R l).mulVec v ≠ 0 →
              FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootDepth (FreeEntropy.LiePBW.lowerExponent l) ≤ n * (d - 1)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.lowerWord_weight
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H)
  (lam : Fin d → ℂ) (v : H → ℂ),
  (∀ (k : Fin d), (R.E k k).mulVec v = lam k • v) →
    ∀ (l : List (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d)) (k : Fin d),
      (R.E k k).mulVec ((FreeEntropy.LiePBW.lowerWord R l).mulVec v) =
        FreeEntropy.LiePBW.shiftedWeight lam (FreeEntropy.LiePBW.lowerExponent l) k •
          (FreeEntropy.LiePBW.lowerWord R l).mulVec v

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.lower_of_fullKey_le
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {a b : FreeEntropy.LiePBW.Root d},
  FreeEntropy.LiePBW.fullKey a ≤ FreeEntropy.LiePBW.fullKey b → b.2 < b.1 → a.2 < a.1

declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (w : List (FreeEntropy.LiePBW.Root d)) (hw : ∀ a ∈ w, a.2 < a.1),
  List.map FreeEntropy.LiePBW.loweringRoot (FreeEntropy.LiePBW.loweringList w hw) = w

declarations.statement: {d : ℕ} → FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d → FreeEntropy.LiePBW.Root d

declarations.statement:
{d : ℕ} →

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.lowering_word_weight
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H)
  (lam : Fin d → ℝ) (v : H → ℂ),
  (∀ (k : Fin d), (R.E k k).mulVec v = lam k • v) →
    ∀ (w : List (FreeEntropy.LiePBW.Root d)),
      (∀ a ∈ w, a.2 < a.1) →
        ∃ (c : Fin (d - 1) → ℕ),
          ∀ (k : Fin d),
            (R.E k k).mulVec ((FreeEntropy.LiePBW.word R w).mulVec v) =
              (lam k - FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.offset c k) • (FreeEntropy.LiePBW.word R w).mulVec v

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.map_cyclicSpan
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] [inst_2 : Fintype K]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq K] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H)
  (S : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d K) (f : (H → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] K → ℂ),
  (∀ (i j : Fin d) (x : H → ℂ), f ((R.E i j).mulVec x) = (S.E i j).mulVec (f x)) →
    ∀ (v : H → ℂ), Submodule.map f (FreeEntropy.LiePBW.cyclicSpan R v) = FreeEntropy.LiePBW.cyclicSpan S (f v)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.nonlower_word_scalar
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H)
  (lam : Fin d → ℂ) (v : H → ℂ),
  (∀ (i : Fin d), (R.E i i).mulVec v = lam i • v) →
    (∀ (i j : Fin d), i < j → (R.E i j).mulVec v = 0) →
      ∀ (w : List (FreeEntropy.LiePBW.Root d)),
        (∀ a ∈ w, ¬a.2 < a.1) → ∃ (c : ℂ), (FreeEntropy.LiePBW.word R w).mulVec v = c • v

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.offset_add
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (a b : Fin (d - 1) → ℕ),
  FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.offset (a + b) = FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.offset a + FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.offset b

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.offset_single
declarations.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (k : Fin (d - 1)), FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.offset (Pi.single k 1) = FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.simpleRoot k

declarations.statement:
