        FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H → (FreeEntropy.LiePBW.Root d → ℕ) → Submodule ℂ (Matrix H H ℂ)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.orderedWordsAtWeightEmbedding
declarations.statement:
{d : ℕ} →
  (a : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d →₀ ℕ) →
    FreeEntropy.LiePBW.OrderedWordsAtWeight a ↪ ↥(FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.lowerWeightFiber a)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.ordered_word_scalar_lowering
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H)
  (lam : Fin d → ℂ) (v : H → ℂ),
  (∀ (i : Fin d), (R.E i i).mulVec v = lam i • v) →
    (∀ (i j : Fin d), i < j → (R.E i j).mulVec v = 0) →
      ∀ (w : List (FreeEntropy.LiePBW.Root d)),
        List.Pairwise (fun (a b : FreeEntropy.LiePBW.Root d) => FreeEntropy.LiePBW.kind a ≤ FreeEntropy.LiePBW.kind b)
            w →
          ∃ (l : List (FreeEntropy.LiePBW.Root d)),
            (∀ a ∈ l, a.2 < a.1) ∧
              ∃ (c : ℂ), (FreeEntropy.LiePBW.word R w).mulVec v = c • (FreeEntropy.LiePBW.word R l).mulVec v

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.perm_difference_mem
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H)
  (S : Submodule ℂ (Matrix H H ℂ)) (n : ℕ),
  (∀ (w : List (FreeEntropy.LiePBW.Root d)), w.length < n → FreeEntropy.LiePBW.word R w ∈ S) →
    ∀ {u v : List (FreeEntropy.LiePBW.Root d)},
      u.Perm v →
        ∀ (p : List (FreeEntropy.LiePBW.Root d)),
          p.length + u.length ≤ n → FreeEntropy.LiePBW.word R (p ++ u) - FreeEntropy.LiePBW.word R (p ++ v) ∈ S

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.projected_cyclic_mem_finiteWeightSpan
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H)
  (wt : H → Fin d → ℂ),
  (∀ (k : Fin d), R.E k k = Matrix.diagonal fun (h : H) => wt h k) →
    ∀ (lam : Fin d → ℂ) (v : H → ℂ),
      (∀ (k : Fin d), (R.E k k).mulVec v = lam k • v) →
        (∀ (i j : Fin d), i < j → (R.E i j).mulVec v = 0) →
          ∀ (a : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d →₀ ℕ),
            ∀ x ∈ FreeEntropy.LiePBW.cyclicSpan R v,
              (FreeEntropy.LiePBW.weightProjection wt (FreeEntropy.LiePBW.shiftedWeight lam a)) x ∈
                FreeEntropy.LiePBW.finiteWeightSpan R v a

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.projectionMatrix
declarations.statement: {H : Type u_1} → [Fintype H] → [DecidableEq H] → Submodule ℂ (H → ℂ) → Matrix H H ℂ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.projectionMatrix_apply
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (S : Submodule ℂ (H → ℂ)) (x : H → ℂ),
  (FreeEntropy.LiePBW.projectionMatrix S).mulVec x =
    ((FreeEntropy.LiePBW.hilbertSubspace S).starProjection (WithLp.toLp 2 x)).ofLp

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.projectionMatrix_commutes
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H)
  {S : Submodule ℂ (H → ℂ)},
  FreeEntropy.LiePBW.GeneratorInvariant R S →
    ∀ (i j : Fin d), FreeEntropy.LiePBW.projectionMatrix S * R.E i j = R.E i j * FreeEntropy.LiePBW.projectionMatrix S

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.projectionMatrix_fix
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] {S : Submodule ℂ (H → ℂ)} {x : H → ℂ},
  x ∈ S → (FreeEntropy.LiePBW.projectionMatrix S).mulVec x = x

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.projectionMatrix_mem
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (S : Submodule ℂ (H → ℂ)) (x : H → ℂ),
  (FreeEntropy.LiePBW.projectionMatrix S).mulVec x ∈ S

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.raising_weight_real
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [DecidableEq H] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H)
  (lam : Fin d → ℝ) (v : H → ℂ),
  (∀ (k : Fin d), (R.E k k).mulVec v = lam k • v) →
    ∀ (i j k : Fin d),
      (R.E k k).mulVec ((R.E i j).mulVec v) =
        ((lam k + if k = i then 1 else 0) - if k = j then 1 else 0) • (R.E i j).mulVec v

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.rootCoefficient_le_depth
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (a : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d →₀ ℕ)
  (r : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d), a r ≤ FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootDepth a

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.rootWeightShift_add
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (a b : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d →₀ ℕ),
  FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootWeightShift (a + b) =
    FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootWeightShift a + FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootWeightShift b

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.rootWeightShift_single
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (r : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d),
  FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootWeightShift (Finsupp.single r 1) = fun (k : Fin d) =>
    (if k = (↑r).2 then 1 else 0) - if k = (↑r).1 then 1 else 0

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.secondCoordinate
declarations.statement: {H : Type u_1} → {K : Type u_2} → (H ⊕ K → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] K → ℂ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.secondCoordinate_apply
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [Fintype H] [DecidableEq H] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K] (x : H ⊕ K → ℂ),
  FreeEntropy.LiePBW.secondCoordinate x = x ∘ Sum.inr

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.secondCoordinate_intertwines
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype H] [DecidableEq H] [inst_2 : Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H) (S : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d K) (i j : Fin d)
  (x : H ⊕ K → ℂ),
  FreeEntropy.LiePBW.secondCoordinate (((FreeEntropy.LiePBW.directSum R S).E i j).mulVec x) =
    (S.E i j).mulVec (FreeEntropy.LiePBW.secondCoordinate x)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.self_mem_cyclicSpan
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H)
  (v : H → ℂ), v ∈ FreeEntropy.LiePBW.cyclicSpan R v

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.shiftedWeight
declarations.statement: {d : ℕ} → (Fin d → ℂ) → (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d →₀ ℕ) → Fin d → ℂ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.shiftedWeight_eq_iff
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (lam : Fin d → ℂ) (a b : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d →₀ ℕ),
  FreeEntropy.LiePBW.shiftedWeight lam a = FreeEntropy.LiePBW.shiftedWeight lam b ↔
    FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootWeightShift a = FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.rootWeightShift b

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.span_words_eq_orderedSpan
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H)
  (key : FreeEntropy.LiePBW.Root d → ℕ),
  Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range (FreeEntropy.LiePBW.word R)) = FreeEntropy.LiePBW.orderedSpan R key

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.weightProjection
declarations.statement: {d : ℕ} → {H : Type u_1} → (H → Fin d → ℂ) → (Fin d → ℂ) → (H → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] H → ℂ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.weightProjection_fix
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [Fintype H] [DecidableEq H] (wt : H → Fin d → ℂ) (target : Fin d → ℂ),
  ∀ x ∈ FreeEntropy.LiePBW.coordinateWeightSpace wt target, (FreeEntropy.LiePBW.weightProjection wt target) x = x

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.weightProjection_other
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [Fintype H] [DecidableEq H] (wt : H → Fin d → ℂ) (target other : Fin d → ℂ),
  other ≠ target →
    ∀ x ∈ FreeEntropy.LiePBW.coordinateWeightSpace wt other, (FreeEntropy.LiePBW.weightProjection wt target) x = 0

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.weightSpace_finrank_le_rootFiber
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H)
  (wt : H → Fin d → ℂ),
  (∀ (k : Fin d), R.E k k = Matrix.diagonal fun (h : H) => wt h k) →
    ∀ (lam : Fin d → ℂ) (v : H → ℂ),
      (∀ (k : Fin d), (R.E k k).mulVec v = lam k • v) →
        (∀ (i j : Fin d), i < j → (R.E i j).mulVec v = 0) →
          FreeEntropy.LiePBW.cyclicSpan R v = ⊤ →
            ∀ (a : FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.LowerRoot d →₀ ℕ),
              Module.finrank ℂ ↥(FreeEntropy.LiePBW.coordinateWeightSpace wt (FreeEntropy.LiePBW.shiftedWeight lam a)) ≤
                (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.lowerWeightFiber a).card

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.weight_in_root_cone
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H)
  (lam mu : Fin d → ℝ) (v u : H → ℂ),
  (∀ (k : Fin d), (R.E k k).mulVec v = lam k • v) →
    (∀ (i j : Fin d), i < j → (R.E i j).mulVec v = 0) →
      u ∈ FreeEntropy.LiePBW.cyclicSpan R v →
        u ≠ 0 →
          (∀ (k : Fin d), (R.E k k).mulVec u = mu k • u) →
            ∃ (c : Fin (d - 1) → ℕ), lam - mu = FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.offset c

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.weights_equal_of_nonorthogonal
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [DecidableEq H] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H)
  (mu nu : Fin d → ℝ) (u v : H → ℂ),
  (∀ (k : Fin d), (R.E k k).mulVec u = mu k • u) →
    (∀ (k : Fin d), (R.E k k).mulVec v = nu k • v) → star u ⬝ᵥ v ≠ 0 → mu = nu

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.word
declarations.statement:
{d : ℕ} →
  {H : Type u_1} →
    [inst : Fintype H] →
      [DecidableEq H] → FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H → List (FreeEntropy.LiePBW.Root d) → Matrix H H ℂ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.word_action_mem_loweringSpan
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H)
  (lam : Fin d → ℂ) (v : H → ℂ),
  (∀ (i : Fin d), (R.E i i).mulVec v = lam i • v) →
    (∀ (i j : Fin d), i < j → (R.E i j).mulVec v = 0) →
      ∀ (w : List (FreeEntropy.LiePBW.Root d)),
        (FreeEntropy.LiePBW.word R w).mulVec v ∈ FreeEntropy.LiePBW.loweringSpan R v

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.word_action_mem_orderedLoweringSpan
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H)
  (lam : Fin d → ℂ) (v : H → ℂ),
  (∀ (i : Fin d), (R.E i i).mulVec v = lam i • v) →
    (∀ (i j : Fin d), i < j → (R.E i j).mulVec v = 0) →
      ∀ (w : List (FreeEntropy.LiePBW.Root d)),
        (FreeEntropy.LiePBW.word R w).mulVec v ∈ FreeEntropy.LiePBW.orderedLoweringSpan R v

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.word_append
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H)
  (w v : List (FreeEntropy.LiePBW.Root d)),
  FreeEntropy.LiePBW.word R (w ++ v) = FreeEntropy.LiePBW.word R w * FreeEntropy.LiePBW.word R v

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.word_cons
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H)
  (a : FreeEntropy.LiePBW.Root d) (w : List (FreeEntropy.LiePBW.Root d)),
  FreeEntropy.LiePBW.word R (a :: w) = R.E a.1 a.2 * FreeEntropy.LiePBW.word R w

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.word_mem_orderedSpan
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H)
  (key : FreeEntropy.LiePBW.Root d → ℕ) (w : List (FreeEntropy.LiePBW.Root d)),
  FreeEntropy.LiePBW.word R w ∈ FreeEntropy.LiePBW.orderedSpan R key

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.LiePBW.word_nil
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H),
  FreeEntropy.LiePBW.word R [] = 1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.MeanDepth.finite_mean_le
declarations.statement:
∀ (T : Finset ℕ) (mass : ℕ → ℝ) (N : ℕ),
  0 < N →
    ∀ (q : ℝ),
      0 ≤ q →
        q < 1 →
          (∀ t ∈ T, mass t ≤ ↑((t + N - 1).choose (N - 1)) * q ^ t) →
            ∑ t ∈ T, ↑t * mass t ≤ FreeEntropy.MeanDepth.meanDepthConstant N q

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.MeanDepth.first_moment_coefficient
declarations.statement: ∀ (t N : ℕ), 0 < N → t * (t + N - 1).choose (N - 1) = N * (t + N - 1).choose N

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.MeanDepth.hasSum_first_moment
declarations.statement:
∀ (N : ℕ),
  0 < N →
    ∀ (q : ℝ),
      0 ≤ q →
        q < 1 →
          HasSum (fun (t : ℕ) => ↑t * ↑((t + N - 1).choose (N - 1)) * q ^ t)
            (FreeEntropy.MeanDepth.meanDepthConstant N q)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.MeanDepth.meanDepthConstant
declarations.statement: ℕ → ℝ → ℝ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.MeanDepth.meanDepthConstant_nonneg
declarations.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (q : ℝ), 0 ≤ q → q < 1 → 0 ≤ FreeEntropy.MeanDepth.meanDepthConstant N q

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.MeanDepth.meanDepthConstant_zero
declarations.statement: ∀ (q : ℝ), FreeEntropy.MeanDepth.meanDepthConstant 0 q = 0

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.MeanDepth.normalized_root_monomial_le
declarations.statement:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} (s : Finset ι) (c : ι → ℕ) (ratio : ι → ℝ) (q normalizer : ℝ),
  (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ ratio i) →
    (∀ i ∈ s, ratio i ≤ q) → 1 ≤ normalizer → (∏ i ∈ s, ratio i ^ c i) / normalizer ≤ q ^ ∑ i ∈ s, c i

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.MeanDepth.root_monomial_le
declarations.statement:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} (s : Finset ι) (c : ι → ℕ) (ratio : ι → ℝ) (q : ℝ),
  (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ ratio i) → (∀ i ∈ s, ratio i ≤ q) → ∏ i ∈ s, ratio i ^ c i ≤ q ^ ∑ i ∈ s, c i

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.MeanDepth.weight_mean_le
declarations.statement:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} (s : Finset ι) (depth mult : ι → ℕ) (p : ι → ℝ) (N : ℕ),
  0 < N →
    ∀ (q : ℝ),
      0 ≤ q →
        q < 1 →
          (∀ i ∈ s, p i ≤ q ^ depth i) →
            (∀ (t : ℕ), ∑ i ∈ s with depth i = t, mult i ≤ (t + N - 1).choose (N - 1)) →
              ∑ i ∈ s, ↑(depth i) * p i * ↑(mult i) ≤ FreeEntropy.MeanDepth.meanDepthConstant N q

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.MultiplicityChannels.appendChannel
declarations.statement:
{B : Type u_1} →
  {A : Type u_2} →
    [inst : Fintype B] →
      [inst_1 : Fintype A] →
        [DecidableEq B] → [DecidableEq A] → [Nonempty A] → FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel B (B × A)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.MultiplicityChannels.appendChannel_apply
declarations.statement:
∀ {B : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype B] [inst_1 : Fintype A] [inst_2 : DecidableEq B]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq A] [inst_4 : Nonempty A] (X : Matrix B B ℂ),
  FreeEntropy.MultiplicityChannels.appendChannel.toFun X = FreeEntropy.MultiplicityChannels.appendMap X

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.MultiplicityChannels.appendMap
declarations.statement: {B : Type u_1} → {A : Type u_2} → [Fintype A] → [DecidableEq A] → Matrix B B ℂ → Matrix (B × A) (B × A) ℂ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.MultiplicityChannels.appendMap_positive
declarations.statement:
∀ {B : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} [Fintype B] [inst : Fintype A] [DecidableEq B] [inst_2 : DecidableEq A] [Nonempty A]
  {X : Matrix B B ℂ}, X.PosSemidef → (FreeEntropy.MultiplicityChannels.appendMap X).PosSemidef

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.MultiplicityChannels.appendMap_trace
declarations.statement:
∀ {B : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype B] [inst_1 : Fintype A] [DecidableEq B] [inst_3 : DecidableEq A]
  [Nonempty A] (X : Matrix B B ℂ), (FreeEntropy.MultiplicityChannels.appendMap X).trace = X.trace

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.MultiplicityChannels.append_discard_product
declarations.statement:
∀ {B : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype B] [inst_1 : Fintype A] [inst_2 : DecidableEq B]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq A] [inst_4 : Nonempty A] (X : Matrix B B ℂ),
  FreeEntropy.MultiplicityChannels.appendChannel.toFun
      (FreeEntropy.MultiplicityChannels.discardChannel.toFun
        (Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun (x1 x2 : ℂ) => x1 * x2) X (FreeEntropy.MultiplicityChannels.maximallyMixed A))) =
    Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun (x1 x2 : ℂ) => x1 * x2) X (FreeEntropy.MultiplicityChannels.maximallyMixed A)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.MultiplicityChannels.discardChannel
declarations.statement:
{B : Type u_1} →
  {A : Type u_2} →
    [inst : Fintype B] →
      [inst_1 : Fintype A] → [DecidableEq B] → [DecidableEq A] → FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel (B × A) B

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.MultiplicityChannels.discardChannel_apply
declarations.statement:
∀ {B : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype B] [inst_1 : Fintype A] [inst_2 : DecidableEq B]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq A] (X : Matrix (B × A) (B × A) ℂ),
  FreeEntropy.MultiplicityChannels.discardChannel.toFun X = FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.partialTrace X

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.MultiplicityChannels.discard_append
declarations.statement:
∀ {B : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype B] [inst_1 : Fintype A] [inst_2 : DecidableEq B]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq A] [inst_4 : Nonempty A] (X : Matrix B B ℂ),
  FreeEntropy.MultiplicityChannels.discardChannel.toFun (FreeEntropy.MultiplicityChannels.appendChannel.toFun X) = X

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.MultiplicityChannels.discard_product
declarations.statement:
∀ {B : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype B] [inst_1 : Fintype A] [inst_2 : DecidableEq B]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq A] (X : Matrix B B ℂ) (Y : Matrix A A ℂ),
  Y.trace = 1 →
    FreeEntropy.MultiplicityChannels.discardChannel.toFun (Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun (x1 x2 : ℂ) => x1 * x2) X Y) = X

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.MultiplicityChannels.identity_balance
declarations.statement:
∀ {B : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} [Fintype B] [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : DecidableEq B] [inst_2 : DecidableEq A],
  FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.partialTrace 1 = ↑(Fintype.card A) • 1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.MultiplicityChannels.maximallyMixed
declarations.statement: (A : Type u_3) → [Fintype A] → [DecidableEq A] → Matrix A A ℂ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.MultiplicityChannels.maximallyMixed_positive
declarations.statement:
∀ {A : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : DecidableEq A],
  (FreeEntropy.MultiplicityChannels.maximallyMixed A).PosSemidef

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.MultiplicityChannels.maximallyMixed_trace
declarations.statement:
∀ {A : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : DecidableEq A] [Nonempty A],
  (FreeEntropy.MultiplicityChannels.maximallyMixed A).trace = 1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.MultiplicityChannels.partialTrace_kronecker
declarations.statement:
∀ {B : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} [Fintype B] [inst : Fintype A] [DecidableEq B] [DecidableEq A] (X : Matrix B B ℂ)
  (Y : Matrix A A ℂ),
  FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.partialTrace (Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun (x1 x2 : ℂ) => x1 * x2) X Y) = Y.trace • X

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.MultiplicityChannels.traceDistance_append
declarations.statement:
∀ {B : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype B] [inst_1 : Fintype A] [inst_2 : DecidableEq B]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq A] [Nonempty A] {X Y : Matrix B B ℂ},
  X.PosSemidef →
    Y.PosSemidef →
      FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance (FreeEntropy.MultiplicityChannels.appendMap X)
          (FreeEntropy.MultiplicityChannels.appendMap Y) =
        FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance X Y

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation
declarations.statement: ℕ → ℕ → Type

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Occupation.basis
declarations.statement: {d n : ℕ} → Matrix (Fin n → Fin d) (FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n) ℂ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Occupation.basis_column_contentInvariant
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} (a : FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n),
  FreeEntropy.WordTypes.ContentInvariant fun (w : Fin n → Fin d) => FreeEntropy.Occupation.basis w a

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Occupation.basis_isometry
declarations.statement: ∀ {d n : ℕ}, FreeEntropy.Occupation.basis.conjTranspose * FreeEntropy.Occupation.basis = 1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Occupation.basis_mulVec_coefficients
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} (z : Fin d → ℂ),
  FreeEntropy.Occupation.basis.mulVec (FreeEntropy.Occupation.coefficients z) = FreeEntropy.Occupation.tensorVector z

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Occupation.basis_mulVec_contentCoordinates
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} {v : (Fin n → Fin d) → ℂ},
  FreeEntropy.WordTypes.ContentInvariant v →
    FreeEntropy.Occupation.basis.mulVec (FreeEntropy.Occupation.contentCoordinates v) = v

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Occupation.card_occupation
declarations.statement: ∀ (d n : ℕ), Fintype.card (FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n) = (d + n - 1).choose n

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Occupation.card_occupation_symm
declarations.statement: ∀ (d n : ℕ), 0 < d → Fintype.card (FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n) = (n + (d - 1)).choose (d - 1)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Occupation.character
declarations.statement: {d n : ℕ} → (Fin d → ℂ) → FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n → ℂ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Occupation.character_separates
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} (a b : FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n),
  a ≠ b →
    ∃ (z : Fin d → ℂ),
      (∀ (i : Fin d), ‖z i‖ = 1) ∧ FreeEntropy.Occupation.character z a ≠ FreeEntropy.Occupation.character z b

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Occupation.coefficients
declarations.statement: {d n : ℕ} → (Fin d → ℂ) → FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n → ℂ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Occupation.coefficients_action
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} (U : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) (v : Fin d → ℂ),
  (FreeEntropy.Occupation.symmetricMatrix U).mulVec (FreeEntropy.Occupation.coefficients v) =
    FreeEntropy.Occupation.coefficients (U.mulVec v)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Occupation.coefficients_nonzero
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} (z : Fin d → ℂ),
  (∀ (i : Fin d), z i ≠ 0) → ∀ (a : FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n), FreeEntropy.Occupation.coefficients z a ≠ 0

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Occupation.coefficients_single_support
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} (i₀ : Fin d) (a : FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n),
  a ≠ FreeEntropy.Occupation.highestOccupation i₀ → FreeEntropy.Occupation.coefficients (Pi.single i₀ 1) a = 0

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Occupation.commutant_diagonal
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} (T : Matrix (FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n) (FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n) ℂ),
  (∀ (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)),
      T * FreeEntropy.Occupation.symmetricMatrix ↑U = FreeEntropy.Occupation.symmetricMatrix ↑U * T) →
    T = Matrix.diagonal fun (a : FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n) => T a a

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Occupation.commutant_scalar_of_nonzero_column
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} (i₀ : Fin d) (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)),
  (∀ (i : Fin d), ↑U i i₀ ≠ 0) →
    ∀ (T : Matrix (FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n) (FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n) ℂ),
      (∀ (W : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)),
          T * FreeEntropy.Occupation.symmetricMatrix ↑W = FreeEntropy.Occupation.symmetricMatrix ↑W * T) →
        ∃ (c : ℂ), T = c • 1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Occupation.contentCoordinates
declarations.statement: {d n : ℕ} → ((Fin n → Fin d) → ℂ) → FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n → ℂ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Occupation.content_sum
declarations.statement: ∀ {d n : ℕ} (w : Fin n → Fin d), ∑ i : Fin d, FreeEntropy.WordTypes.content w i = n

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Occupation.diagonalUnitary
declarations.statement: {d : ℕ} → (z : Fin d → ℂ) → (∀ (i : Fin d), ‖z i‖ = 1) → ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Occupation.diagonal_intertwines
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} (z : Fin d → ℂ),
  FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.matrix n (Matrix.diagonal z) * FreeEntropy.Occupation.basis =
    FreeEntropy.Occupation.basis * Matrix.diagonal (FreeEntropy.Occupation.character z)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Occupation.highestOccupation
declarations.statement: {d n : ℕ} → Fin d → FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Occupation.highestOccupation_val
declarations.statement: ∀ {d n : ℕ} (i₀ i : Fin d), ↑(FreeEntropy.Occupation.highestOccupation i₀) i = if i = i₀ then n else 0

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Occupation.occupationDimension_pos
declarations.statement: ∀ (d n : ℕ), 0 < d → 0 < Fintype.card (FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Occupation.occupation_log_asymptotic
declarations.statement:
∀ (d : ℕ),
  0 < d →
    Filter.Tendsto
      (fun (n : ℕ) =>
        Real.logb 2 ↑(Fintype.card (FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n)) -
          (↑(d - 1) * Real.logb 2 ↑n - Real.logb 2 ↑(d - 1).factorial))
      Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Occupation.occupation_qmdl_asymptotic
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d 1),
  Filter.Tendsto
    (fun (n : ℕ) =>
      Real.logb 2 ↑(Fintype.card (FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n)) - FreeEntropy.Weyl.qmdl d 1 s.eigenvalue n)
    Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Occupation.ofWord
declarations.statement: {d n : ℕ} → (Fin n → Fin d) → FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Occupation.projection_fixes_contentInvariant
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} {v : (Fin n → Fin d) → ℂ},
  FreeEntropy.WordTypes.ContentInvariant v →
    (FreeEntropy.Occupation.basis * FreeEntropy.Occupation.basis.conjTranspose).mulVec v = v

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Occupation.sampleWord

{d n : ℕ} →

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Occupation.symmetricMatrix_adjoint
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ),
  FreeEntropy.Occupation.symmetricMatrix A.conjTranspose = (FreeEntropy.Occupation.symmetricMatrix A).conjTranspose

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Occupation.symmetricMatrix_continuous
declarations.statement: ∀ {d n : ℕ}, Continuous FreeEntropy.Occupation.symmetricMatrix

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Occupation.symmetricMatrix_diagonal
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} (z : Fin d → ℂ),
  FreeEntropy.Occupation.symmetricMatrix (Matrix.diagonal z) = Matrix.diagonal (FreeEntropy.Occupation.character z)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Occupation.symmetricMatrix_intertwines
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ),
  FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.matrix n A * FreeEntropy.Occupation.basis =
    FreeEntropy.Occupation.basis * FreeEntropy.Occupation.symmetricMatrix A

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Occupation.symmetricMatrix_mul
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} (A B : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ),
  FreeEntropy.Occupation.symmetricMatrix (A * B) =
    FreeEntropy.Occupation.symmetricMatrix A * FreeEntropy.Occupation.symmetricMatrix B

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Occupation.symmetricMatrix_one
declarations.statement: ∀ {d n : ℕ}, FreeEntropy.Occupation.symmetricMatrix 1 = 1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Occupation.symmetricMatrix_unitary
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} {U : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ},
  U.conjTranspose * U = 1 →
    (FreeEntropy.Occupation.symmetricMatrix U).conjTranspose * FreeEntropy.Occupation.symmetricMatrix U = 1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Occupation.symmetricRepresentation
declarations.statement:
{d n : ℕ} →
  {G : Type u_1} →
    [inst : Monoid G] →
      (G →* Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) →
        G →* Matrix (FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n) (FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n) ℂ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Occupation.tensorVector
declarations.statement: {d n : ℕ} → (Fin d → ℂ) → (Fin n → Fin d) → ℂ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Occupation.tensor_diagonal
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} (z : Fin d → ℂ),
  FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.matrix n (Matrix.diagonal z) = Matrix.diagonal (FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.vector n z)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Occupation.tensor_matrix_continuous
declarations.statement: ∀ {d n : ℕ}, Continuous (FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.matrix n)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Occupation.tensor_preserves_range
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ),
  FreeEntropy.Occupation.basis * FreeEntropy.Occupation.basis.conjTranspose *
      (FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.matrix n A * FreeEntropy.Occupation.basis) =
    FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.matrix n A * FreeEntropy.Occupation.basis

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Occupation.tensor_pure_embedding
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} (z : Fin d → ℂ),
  FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.matrix n (FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.pure z) =
    FreeEntropy.Occupation.basis * FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.pure (FreeEntropy.Occupation.coefficients z) *
      FreeEntropy.Occupation.basis.conjTranspose

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Occupation.typeSize
declarations.statement: {d n : ℕ} → FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n → ℕ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Occupation.typeSize_pos
declarations.statement: ∀ {d n : ℕ} (a : FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n), 0 < FreeEntropy.Occupation.typeSize a

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Occupation.unitaryRepresentation
declarations.statement:
(d n : ℕ) →
  ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ) →*
    Matrix (FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n) (FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n) ℂ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Occupation.unitaryRepresentation_continuous
declarations.statement: ∀ (d n : ℕ), Continuous ⇑(FreeEntropy.Occupation.unitaryRepresentation d n)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Occupation.unitaryRepresentation_irreducible
declarations.statement:
∀ (d n : ℕ),
  0 < d → (FreeEntropy.Twirling.matrixRepresentation (FreeEntropy.Occupation.unitaryRepresentation d n)).IsIrreducible

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Occupation.unitaryRepresentation_unitary
declarations.statement:
∀ (d n : ℕ) (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)),
  ((FreeEntropy.Occupation.unitaryRepresentation d n) U).conjTranspose *
      (FreeEntropy.Occupation.unitaryRepresentation d n) U =
    1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Occupation.words_nonempty
declarations.statement: ∀ {d n : ℕ} (a : FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n), Nonempty (FreeEntropy.WordTypes.Words ↑a)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.OccupationCloning.dimensionRatio
declarations.statement: ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℝ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.OccupationCloning.dimensionRatio_le_one
declarations.statement: ∀ (d n m : ℕ), 0 < d → FreeEntropy.OccupationCloning.dimensionRatio d n m ≤ 1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.OccupationCloning.dimensionRatio_loss_le
declarations.statement: ∀ (d n m : ℕ), 0 < d → 1 - FreeEntropy.OccupationCloning.dimensionRatio d n m ≤ ↑(d - 1) * ↑m / (↑n + 1)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.OccupationCloning.dimensionRatio_nonneg
declarations.statement: ∀ (d n m : ℕ), 0 ≤ FreeEntropy.OccupationCloning.dimensionRatio d n m

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.OccupationCloning.dimensionRatio_product
declarations.statement:
∀ (d n m : ℕ),
  0 < d →
    FreeEntropy.OccupationCloning.dimensionRatio d n m = ∏ i ∈ Finset.range (d - 1), (↑n + ↑i + 1) / (↑n + ↑i + 1 + ↑m)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.OccupationCloning.forward
declarations.statement:
(d n m : ℕ) →
  0 < d →
    FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel (FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n)
      (FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d (n + m))

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.OccupationCloning.forward_apply
declarations.statement:
∀ (d n m : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d)
  (X : Matrix (FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n) (FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n) ℂ),
  (FreeEntropy.OccupationCloning.forward d n m hd).toFun X =
    FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.sectorMap (↑(Fintype.card (FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n)))
      (↑(Fintype.card (FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d (n + m)))) FreeEntropy.OccupationSplit.split X

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.OccupationCloning.forward_error_exact
declarations.statement:
∀ (d n m : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (z : Fin d → ℂ),
  ∑ i : Fin d, Complex.normSq (z i) = 1 →
    FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance
        ((FreeEntropy.OccupationCloning.forward d n m hd).toFun (FreeEntropy.OccupationCloning.state n z))
        (FreeEntropy.OccupationCloning.state (n + m) z) =
      1 - FreeEntropy.OccupationCloning.dimensionRatio d n m

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.OccupationCloning.forward_error_of_formula
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n m : ℕ},
  0 < d →
    ∀
      (F :
        FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel (FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n)
          (FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d (n + m))),
      (∀ (X : Matrix (FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n) (FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n) ℂ),
          F.toFun X =
            FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.sectorMap (↑(Fintype.card (FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n)))
              (↑(Fintype.card (FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d (n + m)))) FreeEntropy.OccupationSplit.split X) →
        ∀ (z : Fin d → ℂ),
          ∑ i : Fin d, Complex.normSq (z i) = 1 →
            FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance (F.toFun (FreeEntropy.OccupationCloning.state n z))
                (FreeEntropy.OccupationCloning.state (n + m) z) ≤
              1 - FreeEntropy.OccupationCloning.dimensionRatio d n m

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.OccupationCloning.forward_formula_dominates
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (n m : ℕ) (z : Fin d → ℂ),
  ∑ i : Fin d, Complex.normSq (z i) = 1 →
    FreeEntropy.OccupationCloning.dimensionRatio d n m • FreeEntropy.OccupationCloning.state (n + m) z ≤
      FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.sectorMap (↑(Fintype.card (FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n)))
        (↑(Fintype.card (FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d (n + m)))) FreeEntropy.OccupationSplit.split
        (FreeEntropy.OccupationCloning.state n z)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.OccupationCloning.forward_target_test
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (n m : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (z : Fin d → ℂ),
  ∑ i : Fin d, Complex.normSq (z i) = 1 →
    FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr
        (FreeEntropy.OccupationCloning.state (n + m) z *
          (FreeEntropy.OccupationCloning.forward d n m hd).toFun (FreeEntropy.OccupationCloning.state n z)) =
      FreeEntropy.OccupationCloning.dimensionRatio d n m

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.OccupationCloning.physicalForward
declarations.statement: (d n m : ℕ) → 0 < d → FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel (Fin n → Fin d) (Fin (n + m) → Fin d)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.OccupationCloning.physicalForward_apply
declarations.statement:
∀ (d n m : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (z : Fin d → ℂ),
  (FreeEntropy.OccupationCloning.physicalForward d n m hd).toFun
      (FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.matrix n (FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.pure z)) =
    FreeEntropy.Occupation.basis *
        (FreeEntropy.OccupationCloning.forward d n m hd).toFun (FreeEntropy.OccupationCloning.state n z) *
      FreeEntropy.Occupation.basis.conjTranspose

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.OccupationCloning.physicalForward_error_exact
declarations.statement:
∀ (d n m : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (z : Fin d → ℂ),
  ∑ i : Fin d, Complex.normSq (z i) = 1 →
    FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance
        ((FreeEntropy.OccupationCloning.physicalForward d n m hd).toFun
          (FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.matrix n (FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.pure z)))
        (FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.matrix (n + m) (FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.pure z)) =
      1 - FreeEntropy.OccupationCloning.dimensionRatio d n m

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.OccupationCloning.physicalReverse
declarations.statement: (d n m : ℕ) → 0 < d → FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel (Fin (n + m) → Fin d) (Fin n → Fin d)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.OccupationCloning.physicalReverse_exact
declarations.statement:
∀ (d n m : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (z : Fin d → ℂ),
  ∑ i : Fin d, Complex.normSq (z i) = 1 →
    (FreeEntropy.OccupationCloning.physicalReverse d n m hd).toFun
        (FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.matrix (n + m) (FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.pure z)) =
      FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.matrix n (FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.pure z)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.OccupationCloning.pure_cloning
declarations.statement:
∀ (d n m : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (z : Fin d → ℂ),
  ∑ i : Fin d, Complex.normSq (z i) = 1 →
    FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance
          ((FreeEntropy.OccupationCloning.forward d n m hd).toFun (FreeEntropy.OccupationCloning.state n z))
          (FreeEntropy.OccupationCloning.state (n + m) z) ≤
        1 - FreeEntropy.OccupationCloning.dimensionRatio d n m ∧
      FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance
          ((FreeEntropy.OccupationCloning.reverse d n m).toFun (FreeEntropy.OccupationCloning.state (n + m) z))
          (FreeEntropy.OccupationCloning.state n z) =
        0

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.OccupationCloning.reverse
declarations.statement:
(d n m : ℕ) →
  FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel (FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d (n + m))
    (FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.OccupationCloning.reverse_error_zero
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (n m : ℕ) (z : Fin d → ℂ),
  ∑ i : Fin d, Complex.normSq (z i) = 1 →
    FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance
        ((FreeEntropy.OccupationCloning.reverse d n m).toFun (FreeEntropy.OccupationCloning.state (n + m) z))
        (FreeEntropy.OccupationCloning.state n z) =
      0

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.OccupationCloning.reverse_state
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (n m : ℕ) (z : Fin d → ℂ),
  ∑ i : Fin d, Complex.normSq (z i) = 1 →
    (FreeEntropy.OccupationCloning.reverse d n m).toFun (FreeEntropy.OccupationCloning.state (n + m) z) =
      FreeEntropy.OccupationCloning.state n z

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.OccupationCloning.state
declarations.statement:
{d : ℕ} →
  (n : ℕ) → (Fin d → ℂ) → Matrix (FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n) (FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n) ℂ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.OccupationCloning.state_idempotent
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (n : ℕ) (z : Fin d → ℂ),
  ∑ i : Fin d, Complex.normSq (z i) = 1 →
    FreeEntropy.OccupationCloning.state n z * FreeEntropy.OccupationCloning.state n z =
      FreeEntropy.OccupationCloning.state n z

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.OccupationCloning.state_positive
declarations.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (n : ℕ) (z : Fin d → ℂ), (FreeEntropy.OccupationCloning.state n z).PosSemidef

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.OccupationCloning.state_trace
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (n : ℕ) (z : Fin d → ℂ),
  ∑ i : Fin d, Complex.normSq (z i) = 1 → (FreeEntropy.OccupationCloning.state n z).trace = 1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.OccupationCloning.theorem2_physical_pure_cloning
declarations.statement:
∀ (d n m : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (z : Fin d → ℂ),
  ∑ i : Fin d, Complex.normSq (z i) = 1 →
    FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance
          ((FreeEntropy.OccupationCloning.physicalForward d n m hd).toFun
            (FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.matrix n (FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.pure z)))
          (FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.matrix (n + m) (FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.pure z)) ≤
        ↑(d - 1) * ↑m / (↑n + 1) ∧
      (FreeEntropy.OccupationCloning.physicalReverse d n m hd).toFun
          (FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.matrix (n + m) (FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.pure z)) =
        FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.matrix n (FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.pure z)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.OccupationCloning.theorem2_pure_cloning
declarations.statement:
∀ (d n m : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (z : Fin d → ℂ),
  ∑ i : Fin d, Complex.normSq (z i) = 1 →
    FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance
          ((FreeEntropy.OccupationCloning.forward d n m hd).toFun (FreeEntropy.OccupationCloning.state n z))
          (FreeEntropy.OccupationCloning.state (n + m) z) ≤
        ↑(d - 1) * ↑m / (↑n + 1) ∧
      FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance
          ((FreeEntropy.OccupationCloning.reverse d n m).toFun (FreeEntropy.OccupationCloning.state (n + m) z))
          (FreeEntropy.OccupationCloning.state n z) ≤
        ↑(d - 1) * ↑m / (↑n + 1)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.OccupationCounting.card_compositions
declarations.statement: ∀ (d n : ℕ), Nat.card { lam : Fin d → ℕ // ∑ i : Fin d, lam i = n } = (d + n - 1).choose n

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.OccupationCounting.card_compositions_symm
declarations.statement: ∀ (d n : ℕ), 0 < d → Nat.card { lam : Fin d → ℕ // ∑ i : Fin d, lam i = n } = (n + (d - 1)).choose (d - 1)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.OccupationCounting.choose_add_eq_product
declarations.statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ), ↑((n + k).choose k) = ∏ i ∈ Finset.range k, (↑n + ↑i + 1) / (↑i + 1)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.OccupationCounting.choose_log_asymptotic
declarations.statement:
∀ (k : ℕ),
  Filter.Tendsto (fun (n : ℕ) => Real.logb 2 ↑((n + k).choose k) - (↑k * Real.logb 2 ↑n - Real.logb 2 ↑k.factorial))
    Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.OccupationCounting.compositionEquivAntidiag
declarations.statement: (d n : ℕ) → { lam : Fin d → ℕ // ∑ i : Fin d, lam i = n } ≃ ↥(Finset.univ.finsuppAntidiag n)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.OccupationCounting.qmdl_rank_one
declarations.statement:
∀ (d n : ℕ),
  0 < d →
    ∀ (x : ℕ → ℝ), x 0 = 1 → FreeEntropy.Weyl.qmdl d 1 x n = ↑(d - 1) * Real.logb 2 ↑n - Real.logb 2 ↑(d - 1).factorial

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.OccupationSplit.content_joinWords
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n m : ℕ} (w : Fin n → Fin d) (v : Fin m → Fin d),
  FreeEntropy.WordTypes.content (FreeEntropy.OccupationSplit.joinWords (w, v)) = fun (i : Fin d) =>
    FreeEntropy.WordTypes.content w i + FreeEntropy.WordTypes.content v i

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.OccupationSplit.joinWords
declarations.statement: {d n m : ℕ} → (Fin n → Fin d) × (Fin m → Fin d) ≃ (Fin (n + m) → Fin d)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.OccupationSplit.joinWords_left
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n m : ℕ} (w : Fin n → Fin d) (v : Fin m → Fin d) (i : Fin n),
  FreeEntropy.OccupationSplit.joinWords (w, v) (Fin.castAdd m i) = w i

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.OccupationSplit.joinWords_right
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n m : ℕ} (w : Fin n → Fin d) (v : Fin m → Fin d) (i : Fin m),
  FreeEntropy.OccupationSplit.joinWords (w, v) (Fin.natAdd n i) = v i

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.OccupationSplit.joinedBasis
declarations.statement: {d n m : ℕ} → Matrix ((Fin n → Fin d) × (Fin m → Fin d)) (FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d (n + m)) ℂ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.OccupationSplit.joinedBasis_intertwines
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n m : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ),
  Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun (x1 x2 : ℂ) => x1 * x2) (FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.matrix n A)
        (FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.matrix m A) *
      FreeEntropy.OccupationSplit.joinedBasis =
    FreeEntropy.OccupationSplit.joinedBasis * FreeEntropy.Occupation.symmetricMatrix A

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.OccupationSplit.joinedBasis_isometry
declarations.statement: ∀ {d n m : ℕ}, FreeEntropy.OccupationSplit.joinedBasis.conjTranspose * FreeEntropy.OccupationSplit.joinedBasis = 1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.OccupationSplit.productBasis
declarations.statement:
{d n m : ℕ} →
  Matrix ((Fin n → Fin d) × (Fin m → Fin d))
    (FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n × FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d m) ℂ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.OccupationSplit.productBasis_intertwines
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n m : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ),
  Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun (x1 x2 : ℂ) => x1 * x2) (FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.matrix n A)
        (FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.matrix m A) *
      FreeEntropy.OccupationSplit.productBasis =
    FreeEntropy.OccupationSplit.productBasis *
      Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun (x1 x2 : ℂ) => x1 * x2) (FreeEntropy.Occupation.symmetricMatrix A)
        (FreeEntropy.Occupation.symmetricMatrix A)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.OccupationSplit.productBasis_isometry
declarations.statement: ∀ {d n m : ℕ}, FreeEntropy.OccupationSplit.productBasis.conjTranspose * FreeEntropy.OccupationSplit.productBasis = 1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.OccupationSplit.productBasis_mul_split
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n m : ℕ},
  FreeEntropy.OccupationSplit.productBasis * FreeEntropy.OccupationSplit.split = FreeEntropy.OccupationSplit.joinedBasis

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.OccupationSplit.split
declarations.statement:

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.OccupationSplit.tensor_matrix_joinWords
declarations.statement:

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.OrbitEigenvalues.irreducible_orbit_memory_bound_gammaX_of_eigenvalues
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} {G : Type u_3} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] [inst_2 : Fintype M]
  [DecidableEq M] [inst_4 : Group G] [inst_5 : TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] [CompactSpace G]
  [inst_8 : MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G] [Nonempty H] {d r : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r)
  (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure G) [μ.IsMulLeftInvariant] [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (U : G →* Matrix H H ℂ),
  Continuous ⇑U →
    (∀ (g : G), (U g).conjTranspose * U g = 1) →
      ∀ [(FreeEntropy.Twirling.matrixRepresentation U).IsIrreducible] (E : Matrix H H ℂ →ₗ[ℝ] Matrix M M ℂ)
        (D : Matrix M M ℂ →ₗ[ℝ] Matrix H H ℂ),
        (∀ (A : Matrix H H ℂ), A.PosSemidef → (E A).PosSemidef) →
          (∀ (A : Matrix M M ℂ), A.PosSemidef → (D A).PosSemidef) →
            (∀ (A : Matrix H H ℂ), (E A).trace = A.trace) →
              (∀ (A : Matrix M M ℂ), (D A).trace = A.trace) →
                ∀ (τ : Matrix H H ℂ) (hτ : τ.PosSemidef) (k : H) (p₁ : ℝ),
                  (∀ (i : H), i ≠ k → ⋯.eigenvalues i ≤ p₁) →
                    s.spectralProduct ≤ ⋯.eigenvalues k →
                      p₁ ≤ s.qx * ⋯.eigenvalues k →
                        ↑(Fintype.card H) *
                            (1 -
                              (∫ (g : G),
                                  FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance (D (E (U g * τ * (U g).conjTranspose)))
                                    (U g * τ * (U g).conjTranspose) ∂μ) /
                                s.gammaX) ≤
                          ↑(Fintype.card M)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.OrbitEigenvalues.irreducible_orbit_memory_bound_of_eigenvalues
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} {G : Type u_3} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] [inst_2 : Fintype M]
  [DecidableEq M] [inst_4 : Group G] [inst_5 : TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] [CompactSpace G]
  [inst_8 : MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G] [Nonempty H] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure G) [μ.IsMulLeftInvariant]
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (U : G →* Matrix H H ℂ),
  Continuous ⇑U →
    (∀ (g : G), (U g).conjTranspose * U g = 1) →
      ∀ [(FreeEntropy.Twirling.matrixRepresentation U).IsIrreducible] (E : Matrix H H ℂ →ₗ[ℝ] Matrix M M ℂ)
        (D : Matrix M M ℂ →ₗ[ℝ] Matrix H H ℂ),
        (∀ (A : Matrix H H ℂ), A.PosSemidef → (E A).PosSemidef) →
          (∀ (A : Matrix M M ℂ), A.PosSemidef → (D A).PosSemidef) →
            (∀ (A : Matrix H H ℂ), (E A).trace = A.trace) →
              (∀ (A : Matrix M M ℂ), (D A).trace = A.trace) →
                ∀ (τ : Matrix H H ℂ) (hτ : τ.PosSemidef) (k : H) (p₁ : ℝ),
                  (∀ (i : H), i ≠ k → ⋯.eigenvalues i ≤ p₁) →
                    0 < ⋯.eigenvalues k - p₁ →
                      ↑(Fintype.card H) *
                          (1 -
                            (∫ (g : G),
                                FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance (D (E (U g * τ * (U g).conjTranspose)))
                                  (U g * τ * (U g).conjTranspose) ∂μ) /
                              (⋯.eigenvalues k - p₁)) ≤
                        ↑(Fintype.card M)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.OrbitEigenvalues.orbitCodeOfEigenvalues
declarations.statement:
{G : Type u_3} →
  [inst : Group G] →
    [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace G] →
      {d r target memory : ℕ} →
        (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r) →
          (U : G →* Matrix (Fin target) (Fin target) ℂ) →
            Continuous ⇑U →
              (∀ (g : G), (U g).conjTranspose * U g = 1) →
                [(FreeEntropy.Twirling.matrixRepresentation U).IsIrreducible] →
                  FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel (Fin target) (Fin memory) →
                    FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel (Fin memory) (Fin target) →
                      (τ : Matrix (Fin target) (Fin target) ℂ) →
                        (hτ : τ.PosSemidef) →
                          τ.trace = 1 →
                            (k : Fin target) →
                              (p₁ : ℝ) →
                                (∀ (i : Fin target), i ≠ k → ⋯.eigenvalues i ≤ p₁) →
                                  s.spectralProduct ≤ ⋯.eigenvalues k →
                                    p₁ ≤ s.qx * ⋯.eigenvalues k →
                                      FreeEntropy.OrbitTraceDistance.OrbitCode s G target memory

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.average_overlap_upper
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} {G : Type u_3} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] [inst_2 : Fintype M]
  [DecidableEq M] [inst_4 : Fintype G] [Nonempty H] (E : Matrix H H ℂ →ₗ[ℝ] Matrix M M ℂ)
  (D : Matrix M M ℂ →ₗ[ℝ] Matrix H H ℂ),
  (∀ (A : Matrix H H ℂ), A.PosSemidef → (E A).PosSemidef) →
    (∀ (A : Matrix M M ℂ), A.PosSemidef → (D A).PosSemidef) →
      (∀ (A : Matrix H H ℂ), (E A).trace = A.trace) →
        (∀ (A : Matrix M M ℂ), (D A).trace = A.trace) →
          ∀ (w : G → ℝ),
            (∀ (g : G), 0 ≤ w g) →
              ∀ (P τ : G → Matrix H H ℂ),
                (∀ (g : G), (P g).PosSemidef) →
                  (∀ (g : G), (P g).trace = 1) →
                    ∑ g : G, w g • P g = (↑(Fintype.card H))⁻¹ • 1 →
                      ∀ {p₁ γ : ℝ},
                        0 ≤ γ →
                          (∀ (g : G), τ g ≤ p₁ • 1 + γ • P g) →
                            ∑ g : G, w g * FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr (P g * D (E (τ g))) ≤
                              p₁ + γ * ↑(Fintype.card M) / ↑(Fintype.card H)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.average_trace_pairing
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} {G : Type u_3} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] [inst_2 : Fintype G] (w : G → ℝ)
  (P : G → Matrix H H ℂ),
  ∑ g : G, w g • P g = (↑(Fintype.card H))⁻¹ • 1 →
    ∀ (A : Matrix H H ℂ),
      ∑ g : G, w g * FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr (P g * A) = (↑(Fintype.card H))⁻¹ * FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr A

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.channel_spectral_upper
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] [inst_2 : Fintype M]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq M] (E : Matrix H H ℂ →ₗ[ℝ] Matrix M M ℂ) (D : Matrix M M ℂ →ₗ[ℝ] Matrix H H ℂ),
  (∀ (A : Matrix H H ℂ), A.PosSemidef → (E A).PosSemidef) →
    (∀ (A : Matrix M M ℂ), A.PosSemidef → (D A).PosSemidef) →
      (∀ (A : Matrix H H ℂ), (E A).trace = A.trace) →
        ∀ {P τ : Matrix H H ℂ},
          P.PosSemidef → P.trace = 1 → ∀ {p₁ γ : ℝ}, 0 ≤ γ → τ ≤ p₁ • 1 + γ • P → D (E τ) ≤ p₁ • D (E 1) + γ • D 1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.finite_orbit_memory_bound
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} {G : Type u_3} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] [inst_2 : Fintype M]
  [DecidableEq M] [inst_4 : Fintype G] [Nonempty H] (E : Matrix H H ℂ →ₗ[ℝ] Matrix M M ℂ)
  (D : Matrix M M ℂ →ₗ[ℝ] Matrix H H ℂ),
  (∀ (A : Matrix H H ℂ), A.PosSemidef → (E A).PosSemidef) →
    (∀ (A : Matrix M M ℂ), A.PosSemidef → (D A).PosSemidef) →
      (∀ (A : Matrix H H ℂ), (E A).trace = A.trace) →
        (∀ (A : Matrix M M ℂ), (D A).trace = A.trace) →
          ∀ (w : G → ℝ),
            (∀ (g : G), 0 ≤ w g) →
              ∀ (P τ : G → Matrix H H ℂ),
                (∀ (g : G), (P g).PosSemidef) →
                  (∀ (g : G), (P g).trace = 1) →
                    ∑ g : G, w g • P g = (↑(Fintype.card H))⁻¹ • 1 →
                      ∀ {p₀ p₁ γ δ : ℝ},
                        0 < γ →
                          γ = p₀ - p₁ →
                            (∀ (g : G), τ g ≤ p₁ • 1 + γ • P g) →
                              p₀ - δ ≤ ∑ g : G, w g * FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr (P g * D (E (τ g))) →
                                ↑(Fintype.card H) * (1 - δ / γ) ≤ ↑(Fintype.card M)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.integral_orbit_memory_bound
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] [inst_2 : Fintype M] [DecidableEq M]
  {X : Type u_4} [inst_4 : MeasurableSpace X] [Nonempty H] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure X)
  (E : Matrix H H ℂ →ₗ[ℝ] Matrix M M ℂ) (D : Matrix M M ℂ →ₗ[ℝ] Matrix H H ℂ),
  (∀ (A : Matrix H H ℂ), A.PosSemidef → (E A).PosSemidef) →
    (∀ (A : Matrix M M ℂ), A.PosSemidef → (D A).PosSemidef) →
      (∀ (A : Matrix H H ℂ), (E A).trace = A.trace) →
        (∀ (A : Matrix M M ℂ), (D A).trace = A.trace) →
          ∀ (P τ : X → Matrix H H ℂ),
            (∀ (x : X), (P x).PosSemidef) →
              (∀ (x : X), (P x).trace = 1) →
                MeasureTheory.Integrable P μ →
                  ∫ (x : X), P x ∂μ = (↑(Fintype.card H))⁻¹ • 1 →
                    ∀ {p₀ p₁ γ δ : ℝ},
                      0 < γ →
                        γ = p₀ - p₁ →
                          (∀ (x : X), τ x ≤ p₁ • 1 + γ • P x) →
                            MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun (x : X) => FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr (P x * D (E (τ x)))) μ →
                              p₀ - δ ≤ ∫ (x : X), FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr (P x * D (E (τ x))) ∂μ →
                                ↑(Fintype.card H) * (1 - δ / γ) ≤ ↑(Fintype.card M)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.integral_trace_pairing
declarations.statement:

declarations.statement:

                      ∫ (x : X), P x ∂μ = (↑(Fintype.card H))⁻¹ • 1 →

                                      (fun (x : X) => FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance (D (E (τ x))) (τ x)) μ →
                                    ↑(Fintype.card H) *
                                        (1 -
                                          (∫ (x : X), FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance (D (E (τ x))) (τ x) ∂μ) /
                                            γ) ≤

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.OrbitTraceDistance.integral_orbit_memory_bound_of_error_le
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} {X : Type u_3} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] [inst_2 : Fintype M]
  [DecidableEq M] [inst_4 : MeasurableSpace X] [Nonempty H] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure X)
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (E : Matrix H H ℂ →ₗ[ℝ] Matrix M M ℂ) (D : Matrix M M ℂ →ₗ[ℝ] Matrix H H ℂ),
  (∀ (A : Matrix H H ℂ), A.PosSemidef → (E A).PosSemidef) →
    (∀ (A : Matrix M M ℂ), A.PosSemidef → (D A).PosSemidef) →
      (∀ (A : Matrix H H ℂ), (E A).trace = A.trace) →
        (∀ (A : Matrix M M ℂ), (D A).trace = A.trace) →
          ∀ (P τ : X → Matrix H H ℂ),
            (∀ (x : X), (P x).PosSemidef) →
              (∀ (x : X), (P x).trace = 1) →
                (∀ (x : X), (τ x).PosSemidef) →
                  MeasureTheory.Integrable P μ →
                    ∫ (x : X), P x ∂μ = (↑(Fintype.card H))⁻¹ • 1 →
                      ∀ {p₀ p₁ γ δ : ℝ},
                        0 < γ →
                          γ = p₀ - p₁ →
                            (∀ (x : X), FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr (P x * τ x) = p₀) →
                              (∀ (x : X), τ x ≤ p₁ • 1 + γ • P x) →
                                MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun (x : X) => FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr (P x * D (E (τ x))))
                                    μ →
                                  MeasureTheory.Integrable
                                      (fun (x : X) => FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance (D (E (τ x))) (τ x)) μ →
                                    ∫ (x : X), FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance (D (E (τ x))) (τ x) ∂μ ≤ δ →
                                      ↑(Fintype.card H) * (1 - δ / γ) ≤ ↑(Fintype.card M)

declarations.statement:

  (E : Matrix H H ℂ →ₗ[ℝ] Matrix M M ℂ) (D : Matrix M M ℂ →ₗ[ℝ] Matrix H H ℂ),
  (∀ (A : Matrix H H ℂ), A.PosSemidef → (E A).PosSemidef) →
    (∀ (A : Matrix M M ℂ), A.PosSemidef → (D A).PosSemidef) →
      (∀ (A : Matrix H H ℂ), (E A).trace = A.trace) →
        (∀ (A : Matrix M M ℂ), (D A).trace = A.trace) →
          ∀ (P τ : X → Matrix H H ℂ),
            (∀ (x : X), (P x).PosSemidef) →
              (∀ (x : X), (P x).trace = 1) →
                (∀ (x : X), (τ x).PosSemidef) →
                  ∀ {p₀ : ℝ},
                    (∀ (x : X), FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr (P x * τ x) = p₀) →
                      MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun (x : X) => FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr (P x * D (E (τ x)))) μ →
                        MeasureTheory.Integrable
                            (fun (x : X) => FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance (D (E (τ x))) (τ x)) μ →
                          p₀ - ∫ (x : X), FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance (D (E (τ x))) (τ x) ∂μ ≤
                            ∫ (x : X), FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr (P x * D (E (τ x))) ∂μ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.OrbitTraceDistance.irreducible_orbit_memory_bound
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] [inst_2 : Fintype M] [DecidableEq M]
  {G : Type u_4} [inst_4 : Group G] [inst_5 : TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] [CompactSpace G]
  [inst_8 : MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G] [Nonempty H] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure G) [μ.IsMulLeftInvariant]
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (U : G →* Matrix H H ℂ),
  Continuous ⇑U →
    (∀ (g : G), (U g).conjTranspose * U g = 1) →
      ∀ [(FreeEntropy.Twirling.matrixRepresentation U).IsIrreducible] (E : Matrix H H ℂ →ₗ[ℝ] Matrix M M ℂ)
        (D : Matrix M M ℂ →ₗ[ℝ] Matrix H H ℂ),
        (∀ (A : Matrix H H ℂ), A.PosSemidef → (E A).PosSemidef) →
          (∀ (A : Matrix M M ℂ), A.PosSemidef → (D A).PosSemidef) →
            (∀ (A : Matrix H H ℂ), (E A).trace = A.trace) →
              (∀ (A : Matrix M M ℂ), (D A).trace = A.trace) →
                ∀ (P τ : Matrix H H ℂ),
                  P.PosSemidef →
                    P.trace = 1 →
                      τ.PosSemidef →
                        ∀ {p₀ p₁ : ℝ},
                          0 < p₀ - p₁ →
                            FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr (P * τ) = p₀ →
                              τ ≤ p₁ • 1 + (p₀ - p₁) • P →
                                ↑(Fintype.card H) *
                                    (1 -
                                      (∫ (g : G),
                                          FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance
                                            (D (E (U g * τ * (U g).conjTranspose)))
                                            (U g * τ * (U g).conjTranspose) ∂μ) /
                                        (p₀ - p₁)) ≤
                                  ↑(Fintype.card M)

declarations.statement:

  {G : Type u_4} [inst_4 : Group G] [inst_5 : TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] [CompactSpace G]
  [inst_8 : MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G] [Nonempty H] {d r : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r)
  (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure G) [μ.IsMulLeftInvariant] [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (U : G →* Matrix H H ℂ),
  Continuous ⇑U →
    (∀ (g : G), (U g).conjTranspose * U g = 1) →
      ∀ [(FreeEntropy.Twirling.matrixRepresentation U).IsIrreducible] (E : Matrix H H ℂ →ₗ[ℝ] Matrix M M ℂ)
        (D : Matrix M M ℂ →ₗ[ℝ] Matrix H H ℂ),
        (∀ (A : Matrix H H ℂ), A.PosSemidef → (E A).PosSemidef) →
          (∀ (A : Matrix M M ℂ), A.PosSemidef → (D A).PosSemidef) →
            (∀ (A : Matrix H H ℂ), (E A).trace = A.trace) →
              (∀ (A : Matrix M M ℂ), (D A).trace = A.trace) →
                ∀ (P τ : Matrix H H ℂ),
                  P.PosSemidef →
                    P.trace = 1 →
                      τ.PosSemidef →
                        ∀ {p₀ p₁ : ℝ},
                          s.spectralProduct ≤ p₀ →
                            p₁ ≤ s.qx * p₀ →
                              FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr (P * τ) = p₀ →
                                τ ≤ p₁ • 1 + (p₀ - p₁) • P →
                                  ↑(Fintype.card H) *
                                      (1 -
                                        (∫ (g : G),
                                            FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance
                                              (D (E (U g * τ * (U g).conjTranspose)))
                                              (U g * τ * (U g).conjTranspose) ∂μ) /

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.OrbitTraceDistance.theorem1_converse_of_compact_orbit_codes
declarations.statement:
∀ {G : Type u_4} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] [CompactSpace G]
  [inst_4 : MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G] {d r : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r) (memory target : ℕ → ℕ)
  (δ e : ℕ → ℝ) (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure G) [μ.IsMulLeftInvariant] [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
  (C : (n : ℕ) → FreeEntropy.OrbitTraceDistance.OrbitCode s G (target n) (memory n)),
  (∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, ↑(target n) = FreeEntropy.Weyl.activeProduct d r (s.targetRow n)) →
    (∀ (n : ℕ), 0 < target n) →
      Filter.Tendsto δ Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
        e =O[Filter.atTop] FreeEntropy.Weyl.errorScale →
          (∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, (C n).averageError μ ≤ δ n + e n) →
            0 ≤
              Filter.liminf (fun (n : ℕ) => ↑(Real.logb 2 ↑(memory n) - FreeEntropy.Weyl.qmdl d r s.eigenvalue n))
                Filter.atTop

declarations.statement:

  (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ q i) →
    ∑ i ∈ s, q i = 1 →
      0 ≤ ε →
        (∀ i ∈ s, i ∈ t → forward i ≤ ε) →
          (∀ i ∈ s, i ∈ t → reverse i ≤ ε) →
            (∀ i ∈ s, forward i ≤ 1) →
              (∀ i ∈ s, reverse i ≤ 1) →
                δ ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, q i * forward i + ∑ i ∈ s, q i * reverse i →

      0 ≤ ε →
        (∀ i ∈ s, i ∈ t → err i ≤ ε) →
          (∀ i ∈ s, err i ≤ 1) → ∑ i ∈ s, q i * err i ≤ ε + FreeEntropy.Protocol.outsideMass s t q

    FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.matrix n (FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.pure z)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.PureTensorCompression.theorem1_pure_achievability
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d 1) {G : Type u_1} (z : G → Fin d → ℂ),
  (∀ (g : G), ∑ i : Fin d, Complex.normSq (z g i) = 1) →
    Filter.Tendsto
        (fun (n : ℕ) =>
          Real.logb 2 ↑(Fintype.card (FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n)) -
            FreeEntropy.Weyl.qmdl d 1 s.eigenvalue n)
        Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
      ∀ (n : ℕ) (g : G),
        (FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.matrix n (FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.pure (z g))).PosSemidef ∧
          (FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.matrix n (FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.pure (z g))).trace = 1 ∧
            FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance
                ((FreeEntropy.PureTensorCompression.decoder d n).toFun
                  ((FreeEntropy.PureTensorCompression.encoder d n ⋯).toFun
                    (FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.matrix n (FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.pure (z g)))))
                (FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.matrix n (FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.pure (z g))) =
              0

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.PureTensorCompression.theorem1_pure_converse
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d 1) (z : Fin d → ℂ),
  ∑ i : Fin d, Complex.normSq (z i) = 1 →
    ∀ (memory : ℕ → ℕ) (E : (n : ℕ) → FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel (Fin n → Fin d) (Fin (memory n)))
      (D : (n : ℕ) → FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel (Fin (memory n)) (Fin n → Fin d)),
      Filter.Tendsto (fun (n : ℕ) => FreeEntropy.PureTensorCompression.physicalAverageError n z (E n) (D n))
          Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
        0 ≤
          Filter.liminf (fun (n : ℕ) => ↑(Real.logb 2 ↑(memory n) - FreeEntropy.Weyl.qmdl d 1 s.eigenvalue n))

declarations.statement:

        (((FreeEntropy.PureTensorCompression.encoder d n hd).comp D).toFun

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.QuantumProtocol.mixture_roundtrip_error
declarations.statement:
∀ {S : Type u_1} {M : Type u_3} {ι : Type u_4} [inst : Fintype S] [inst_1 : DecidableEq S] [inst_2 : Fintype M]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq M] (s : Finset ι) (q : ι → ℝ) (E : FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel S M)
  (D : FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel M S) (source rebuilt : ι → Matrix S S ℂ) (encoded : ι → Matrix M M ℂ)
  (τ : Matrix M M ℂ),
  (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ q i) →
    ∑ i ∈ s, q i = 1 →
      (∀ i ∈ s, (source i).PosSemidef) →
        (∀ i ∈ s, (encoded i).PosSemidef) →
          (∀ i ∈ s, (rebuilt i).PosSemidef) →
            τ.PosSemidef →
              E.toFun (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s q source) =
                  FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s q encoded →
                D.toFun τ = FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s q rebuilt →
                  FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance
                      (D.toFun (E.toFun (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s q source)))
                      (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s q source) ≤
                    ∑ i ∈ s, q i * FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance (encoded i) τ +
                      ∑ i ∈ s, q i * FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance (rebuilt i) (source i)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.QuantumProtocol.roundtrip_error
declarations.statement:
∀ {S : Type u_1} {T : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype S] [inst_1 : DecidableEq S] [inst_2 : Fintype T]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq T] (A : FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel S T) (B : FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel T S)
  {ρ : Matrix S S ℂ} {τ : Matrix T T ℂ},
  ρ.PosSemidef →
    τ.PosSemidef →
      FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance (B.toFun (A.toFun ρ)) ρ ≤
        FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance (A.toFun ρ) τ + FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance (B.toFun τ) ρ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.QuantumProtocol.transferred_code_error
declarations.statement:
∀ {S : Type u_1} {T : Type u_2} {M : Type u_3} [inst : Fintype S] [inst_1 : DecidableEq S] [inst_2 : Fintype T]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq T] [inst_4 : Fintype M] [DecidableEq M] (A : FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel S T)
  (B : FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel T S) (E : FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel S M)
  (D : FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel M S) {ρ : Matrix S S ℂ} {τ : Matrix T T ℂ},
  ρ.PosSemidef →
    τ.PosSemidef →
      FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance (A.toFun (D.toFun (E.toFun (B.toFun τ)))) τ ≤
        FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance (B.toFun τ) ρ +
            FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance (D.toFun (E.toFun ρ)) ρ +
          FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance (A.toFun ρ) τ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.QuantumProtocol.typical_roundtrip_error
declarations.statement:
∀ {S : Type u_1} {M : Type u_3} {ι : Type u_4} [inst : Fintype S] [inst_1 : DecidableEq S] [inst_2 : Fintype M]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq M] [inst_4 : DecidableEq ι] (s typical : Finset ι) (q : ι → ℝ)
  (E : FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel S M) (D : FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel M S)
  (source rebuilt : ι → Matrix S S ℂ) (encoded : ι → Matrix M M ℂ) (τ : Matrix M M ℂ) (ε : ℝ),
  (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ q i) →
    ∑ i ∈ s, q i = 1 →
      0 ≤ ε →
        (∀ i ∈ s, (source i).PosSemidef) →
          (∀ i ∈ s, (encoded i).PosSemidef) →
            (∀ i ∈ s, (rebuilt i).PosSemidef) →
              τ.PosSemidef →
                (∀ i ∈ s, (source i).trace = 1) →
                  (∀ i ∈ s, (encoded i).trace = 1) →
                    (∀ i ∈ s, (rebuilt i).trace = 1) →
                      τ.trace = 1 →
                        E.toFun (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s q source) =
                            FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s q encoded →
                          D.toFun τ = FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s q rebuilt →
                            (∀ i ∈ s, i ∈ typical → FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance (encoded i) τ ≤ ε) →
                              (∀ i ∈ s,
                                  i ∈ typical → FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance (rebuilt i) (source i) ≤ ε) →
                                FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance
                                    (D.toFun (E.toFun (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s q source)))
                                    (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s q source) ≤
                                  2 * ε + 2 * FreeEntropy.Protocol.outsideMass s typical q

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.QuantumTransfer.TransferCode.averageError_le

  (C : FreeEntropy.QuantumTransfer.TransferCode N q G source target memory) (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure G)
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (δ fwd rev : ℝ),
  C.sourceAverageError μ ≤ δ →
    (∀ (g : G), C.forwardError g ≤ fwd) →
      (∀ (g : G), C.reverseError g ≤ rev) → C.transferred.averageError μ ≤ δ + fwd + rev

  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (δ fwd rev : ℝ),
  C.sourceAverageError μ ≤ δ →

declarations.statement:

  [inst_2 : Fintype T] [inst_3 : DecidableEq T] [inst_4 : Fintype M] [DecidableEq M] [inst_6 : TopologicalSpace X]
  [CompactSpace X] [inst_8 : MeasurableSpace X] [OpensMeasurableSpace X] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure X)
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (A : FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel S T)
  (B : FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel T S) (E : FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel S M)
  (D : FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel M S) (ρ : X → Matrix S S ℂ) (τ : X → Matrix T T ℂ),
  Continuous ρ →
    Continuous τ →
      (∀ (x : X), (ρ x).PosSemidef) →
        (∀ (x : X), (τ x).PosSemidef) →
          ∫ (x : X), FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance ((A.comp D).toFun ((E.comp B).toFun (τ x))) (τ x) ∂μ ≤
            ∫ (x : X), FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance (B.toFun (τ x)) (ρ x) ∂μ +
                ∫ (x : X), FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance (D.toFun (E.toFun (ρ x))) (ρ x) ∂μ +
              ∫ (x : X), FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance (A.toFun (ρ x)) (τ x) ∂μ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.QuantumTransfer.compact_transferred_average_error_le
declarations.statement:
∀ {S : Type u_1} {T : Type u_2} {M : Type u_3} {X : Type u_4} [inst : Fintype S] [inst_1 : DecidableEq S]
  [inst_2 : Fintype T] [inst_3 : DecidableEq T] [inst_4 : Fintype M] [DecidableEq M] [inst_6 : TopologicalSpace X]
  [CompactSpace X] [inst_8 : MeasurableSpace X] [OpensMeasurableSpace X] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure X)
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (A : FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel S T)
  (B : FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel T S) (E : FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel S M)
  (D : FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel M S) (ρ : X → Matrix S S ℂ) (τ : X → Matrix T T ℂ),
  Continuous ρ →
    Continuous τ →
      (∀ (x : X), (ρ x).PosSemidef) →
        (∀ (x : X), (τ x).PosSemidef) →
          ∀ (δ forwardError reverseError : ℝ),
            ∫ (x : X), FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance (D.toFun (E.toFun (ρ x))) (ρ x) ∂μ ≤ δ →
              (∀ (x : X), FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance (A.toFun (ρ x)) (τ x) ≤ forwardError) →
                (∀ (x : X), FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance (B.toFun (τ x)) (ρ x) ≤ reverseError) →
                  ∫ (x : X),
                      FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance ((A.comp D).toFun ((E.comp B).toFun (τ x))) (τ x) ∂μ ≤
                    δ + forwardError + reverseError

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.QuantumTransfer.theorem1_converse_of_transferred_weight_codes
declarations.statement:
∀ {G : Type u_5} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] [CompactSpace G]
  [inst_4 : MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G] {d r : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r) (N : ℕ) (q : ℝ),
  0 < N →
    0 ≤ q →
      q < 1 →
        ∀ (source memory target : ℕ → ℕ) (δ fwd rev : ℕ → ℝ) (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure G) [μ.IsMulLeftInvariant]
          [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
          (C : (n : ℕ) → FreeEntropy.QuantumTransfer.TransferCode N q G (source n) (target n) (memory n)),
          (∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, ↑(target n) = FreeEntropy.Weyl.activeProduct d r (s.targetRow n)) →
            Filter.Tendsto δ Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
              fwd =O[Filter.atTop] FreeEntropy.Weyl.errorScale →
                rev =O[Filter.atTop] FreeEntropy.Weyl.errorScale →
                  (∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, (C n).sourceAverageError μ ≤ δ n) →
                    (∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, ∀ (g : G), (C n).forwardError g ≤ fwd n) →
                      (∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, ∀ (g : G), (C n).reverseError g ≤ rev n) →
                        0 ≤
                          Filter.liminf
                            (fun (n : ℕ) => ↑(Real.logb 2 ↑(memory n) - FreeEntropy.Weyl.qmdl d r s.eigenvalue n))
                            Filter.atTop

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.RankOneCompression.theorem1_rank_one_achievability
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d 1) (ρ : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ),
  ρ.PosSemidef →
    ρ.trace = 1 →
      ρ.rank = 1 →
        Filter.Tendsto
            (fun (n : ℕ) =>
              Real.logb 2 ↑(Fintype.card (FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n)) -
                FreeEntropy.Weyl.qmdl d 1 s.eigenvalue n)
            Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
          ∀ (n : ℕ) (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)),
            FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance
                ((FreeEntropy.PureTensorCompression.decoder d n).toFun
                  ((FreeEntropy.PureTensorCompression.encoder d n ⋯).toFun
                    (FreeEntropy.RankOneCompression.orbitState n ρ U)))
                (FreeEntropy.RankOneCompression.orbitState n ρ U) =
              0

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.RankOneCompression.theorem1_rank_one_converse
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d 1) (ρ : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ),
  ρ.PosSemidef →
    ρ.trace = 1 →
      ρ.rank = 1 →
        ∀ (memory : ℕ → ℕ) (E : (n : ℕ) → FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel (Fin n → Fin d) (Fin (memory n)))
          (D : (n : ℕ) → FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel (Fin (memory n)) (Fin n → Fin d)),
          Filter.Tendsto (fun (n : ℕ) => FreeEntropy.RankOneCompression.averageError n ρ (E n) (D n)) Filter.atTop
              (nhds 0) →
            0 ≤
              Filter.liminf (fun (n : ℕ) => ↑(Real.logb 2 ↑(memory n) - FreeEntropy.Weyl.qmdl d 1 s.eigenvalue n))
                Filter.atTop

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.RankOneCompression.theorem1_rank_one_converse_of_uniform
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d 1) (ρ : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ),
  ρ.PosSemidef →
    ρ.trace = 1 →
      ρ.rank = 1 →
        ∀ (memory : ℕ → ℕ) (E : (n : ℕ) → FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel (Fin n → Fin d) (Fin (memory n)))
          (D : (n : ℕ) → FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel (Fin (memory n)) (Fin n → Fin d)) (δ : ℕ → ℝ),
          Filter.Tendsto δ Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
            (∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
                ∀ (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)),
                  FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance
                      ((D n).toFun ((E n).toFun (FreeEntropy.RankOneCompression.orbitState n ρ U)))
                      (FreeEntropy.RankOneCompression.orbitState n ρ U) ≤
                    δ n) →
              0 ≤
                Filter.liminf (fun (n : ℕ) => ↑(Real.logb 2 ↑(memory n) - FreeEntropy.Weyl.qmdl d 1 s.eigenvalue n))
                  Filter.atTop

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.RankOneCompression.theorem2_rank_one_cloning
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (n m : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (ρ : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ),
  ρ.PosSemidef →
    ρ.trace = 1 →
      ρ.rank = 1 →
        FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance
              ((FreeEntropy.OccupationCloning.physicalForward d n m hd).toFun (FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.matrix n ρ))
              (FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.matrix (n + m) ρ) ≤
            ↑(d - 1) * ↑m / (↑n + 1) ∧
          (FreeEntropy.OccupationCloning.physicalReverse d n m hd).toFun (FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.matrix (n + m) ρ) =
            FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.matrix n ρ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.RankOneStates.exists_normalized_vector
declarations.statement:

  ρ.PosSemidef →
    ρ.trace = 1 → ρ.rank = 1 → ∃ (z : H → ℂ), ∑ i : H, Complex.normSq (z i) = 1 ∧ ρ = FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.pure z

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.RootPartitionFunction.adjacentRatio_product
declarations.statement:
∀ {d r : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r) (i j : ℕ),

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.RootPartitionFunction.fixedSpectrum_partition_upper
declarations.statement:
∀ {d r : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r) {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [DecidableEq H]
  (encode : H → ℕ × ℕ →₀ ℕ),
  Function.Injective encode →
    (∀ (h : H), (encode h).support ⊆ FreeEntropy.Weyl.activeRoots d d) →
      ∑ h : H, FreeEntropy.KostantWeightData.rootWeight d s.adjacentRatio (encode h) ≤ s.spectralProduct⁻¹

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.RootPartitionFunction.fixedSpectrum_top_lower
declarations.statement:
∀ {d r : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r) {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [DecidableEq H]
  (encode : H → ℕ × ℕ →₀ ℕ),
  Function.Injective encode →
    (∀ (h : H), (encode h).support ⊆ FreeEntropy.Weyl.activeRoots d d) →
      ∀ (highest : H),
        encode highest = 0 →
          s.spectralProduct ≤ 1 / ∑ h : H, FreeEntropy.KostantWeightData.rootWeight d s.adjacentRatio (encode h)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.RootPartitionFunction.monomial_sum_le_product
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : Fintype R] [DecidableEq H] [DecidableEq R] (c : H → R → ℕ),
  Function.Injective c →
    ∀ (ratio : R → ℝ),
      (∀ (i : R), 0 ≤ ratio i) → (∀ (i : R), ratio i < 1) → ∑ h : H, ∏ i : R, ratio i ^ c h i ≤ ∏ i : R, (1 - ratio i)⁻¹

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.RootPartitionFunction.rootWeight_eq_root_product
declarations.statement:
∀ (d : ℕ) (ratio : ℕ → ℝ) (c : ℕ × ℕ →₀ ℕ),
  FreeEntropy.KostantWeightData.rootWeight d ratio c =
    ∏ p ∈ FreeEntropy.Weyl.activeRoots d d, FreeEntropy.RootPartitionFunction.rootRatio ratio p ^ c p

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.RootPartitionFunction.rootWeight_sum_le_product
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [DecidableEq H] (d : ℕ) (encode : H → ℕ × ℕ →₀ ℕ),
  Function.Injective encode →
    (∀ (h : H), (encode h).support ⊆ FreeEntropy.Weyl.activeRoots d d) →
      ∀ (ratio : ℕ → ℝ),
        (∀ (j : ℕ), 0 ≤ ratio j) →
