declarations.name: FreeEntropy.RootPartitionFunction.weightData_gammaX_gap
declarations.statement:
∀ {d r N : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r) {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [DecidableEq H]
  (W : FreeEntropy.GeometricOrbit.WeightData H N s.qx) (encode : H → ℕ × ℕ →₀ ℕ),
  Function.Injective encode →
    (∀ (h : H), (encode h).support ⊆ FreeEntropy.Weyl.activeRoots d d) →
      (∀ (h : H), W.weight h = FreeEntropy.KostantWeightData.rootWeight d s.adjacentRatio (encode h)) →
        encode W.highest = 0 → s.gammaX ≤ 1 / W.normalizer - s.qx * (1 / W.normalizer)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.RootPartitionFunction.weightData_memory_bound_gammaX
declarations.statement:
∀ {d r N : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r) {H : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype H]
  [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] [inst_2 : Fintype M] [DecidableEq M] {G : Type u_3} [inst_4 : Group G]
  [inst_5 : TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] [CompactSpace G] [inst_8 : MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
  (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure G) [μ.IsMulLeftInvariant] [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
  (W : FreeEntropy.GeometricOrbit.WeightData H N s.qx) (encode : H → ℕ × ℕ →₀ ℕ),
  Function.Injective encode →
    (∀ (h : H), (encode h).support ⊆ FreeEntropy.Weyl.activeRoots d d) →
      (∀ (h : H), W.weight h = FreeEntropy.KostantWeightData.rootWeight d s.adjacentRatio (encode h)) →
        encode W.highest = 0 →
          ∀ (U : G →* Matrix H H ℂ),
            Continuous ⇑U →
              (∀ (g : G), (U g).conjTranspose * U g = 1) →
                ∀ [(FreeEntropy.Twirling.matrixRepresentation U).IsIrreducible]
                  (E : FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel H M) (D : FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel M H),
                  ↑(Fintype.card H) *
                      (1 -
                        (∫ (g : G),
                            FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance
                              (D.toFun (E.toFun (U g * W.state * (U g).conjTranspose)))
                              (U g * W.state * (U g).conjTranspose) ∂μ) /
                          s.gammaX) ≤
                    ↑(Fintype.card M)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.RootPartitionFunction.weightData_top_lower
declarations.statement:
∀ {d r N : ℕ} {q : ℝ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r) {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [DecidableEq H]

        encode W.highest = 0 → s.spectralProduct ≤ 1 / W.normalizer

∀ {d r m : ℕ} (C : FreeEntropy.SchurAchievability.Code m) (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r) (hd : 2 ≤ d) (K : ℝ),

                  FreeEntropy.SchurAchievability.cloningEnvelope s hd K n (C.row i)) →

declarations.statement:

      (∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, ∀ i ∈ (code n).typical, FreeEntropy.TypicalRows.Typical s n ((code n).row i)) →
        (∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
            ∀ i ∈ (code n).typical,
              FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance (((code n).forward i).toFun ((code n).state i)) (code n).target ≤
                FreeEntropy.SchurAchievability.cloningEnvelope s hd K n ((code n).row i)) →
          (∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
              ∀ i ∈ (code n).typical,

                    ((code n).state i) ≤
                  FreeEntropy.SchurAchievability.cloningEnvelope s hd K n ((code n).row i)) →
            (∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, (code n).tail ≤ 1 / ↑n) →

                    ((code n).state i) ≤

            Filter.Tendsto (fun (n : ℕ) => Real.logb 2 ↑(memory n) - FreeEntropy.Weyl.qmdl d r s.eigenvalue n)
                Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
              (fun (n : ℕ) => (code n).error) =O[Filter.atTop] FreeEntropy.Weyl.errorScale ∧
                Filter.Tendsto (fun (n : ℕ) => (code n).error) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurProbability.adjacent
declarations.statement: {r : ℕ} → (Fin r → ℝ) → ℕ → ℝ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurProbability.adjacent_le_one
declarations.statement:
∀ {r : ℕ} (x : Fin r → ℝ),
  (∀ (i : Fin r), 0 < x i) → Antitone x → ∀ (j : ℕ), FreeEntropy.SchurProbability.adjacent x j ≤ 1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurProbability.adjacent_nonneg
declarations.statement: ∀ {r : ℕ} (x : Fin r → ℝ), (∀ (i : Fin r), 0 < x i) → ∀ (j : ℕ), 0 ≤ FreeEntropy.SchurProbability.adjacent x j

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurProbability.adjacent_pos
declarations.statement:
∀ {r : ℕ} (x : Fin r → ℝ),
  (∀ (i : Fin r), 0 < x i) → ∀ (j : ℕ), j + 1 < r → 0 < FreeEntropy.SchurProbability.adjacent x j

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurProbability.cut_pairing
declarations.statement:
∀ (r : ℕ) (c L : ℕ → ℝ),
  c 0 = 0 →
    c r = 0 → ∑ i ∈ Finset.range r, (c (i + 1) - c i) * L i = -∑ j ∈ Finset.range (r - 1), c (j + 1) * (L (j + 1) - L j)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurProbability.gtCharacter
declarations.statement: {r : ℕ} → (Fin r → ℕ) → (Fin r → ℝ) → ℝ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurProbability.gtCharacter_eq_nat_weight_sum
declarations.statement:
∀ {r : ℕ} (lam : Fin r → ℕ) (x : Fin r → ℝ),
  (∀ (i : Fin r), 0 < x i) →
    FreeEntropy.SchurProbability.gtCharacter lam x =
      ∑ P : FreeEntropy.GelfandTsetlin.Pattern (FreeEntropy.SchurProbability.integralRow lam),
        ∏ i : Fin r, x i ^ (FreeEntropy.GelfandTsetlin.weight P i).toNat

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurProbability.gtCharacter_eq_weight_sum
declarations.statement:
∀ {r : ℕ} (lam : Fin r → ℕ) (x : Fin r → ℝ),
  (∀ (i : Fin r), 0 < x i) →
    FreeEntropy.SchurProbability.gtCharacter lam x =
      ∑ P : FreeEntropy.GelfandTsetlin.Pattern (FreeEntropy.SchurProbability.integralRow lam),
        ∏ i : Fin r, x i ^ FreeEntropy.GelfandTsetlin.weight P i

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurProbability.gtCharacter_le
declarations.statement:
∀ {r : ℕ} (lam : Fin r → ℕ) (x : Fin r → ℝ),
  (∀ (i : Fin r), 0 < x i) →
    Antitone x →
      FreeEntropy.SchurProbability.gtCharacter lam x ≤
        ↑(Fintype.card (FreeEntropy.GelfandTsetlin.Pattern (FreeEntropy.SchurProbability.integralRow lam))) *
          FreeEntropy.WordTypes.monomial lam x

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurProbability.gt_monomial_eq
declarations.statement:
∀ {r : ℕ} (lam : Fin r → ℕ) (x : Fin r → ℝ),
  (∀ (i : Fin r), 0 < x i) →
    ∀ (P : FreeEntropy.GelfandTsetlin.Pattern (FreeEntropy.SchurProbability.integralRow lam)),
      ∏ i : Fin r, x i ^ FreeEntropy.GelfandTsetlin.weight P i =
        FreeEntropy.WordTypes.monomial lam x *
          FreeEntropy.KostantWeightData.rootWeight r (FreeEntropy.SchurProbability.adjacent x)
            (FreeEntropy.GelfandTsetlin.drops P)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurProbability.gt_weight_nonneg
declarations.statement:
∀ {r : ℕ} (lam : Fin r → ℕ) (P : FreeEntropy.GelfandTsetlin.Pattern (FreeEntropy.SchurProbability.integralRow lam))
  (i : Fin r), 0 ≤ FreeEntropy.GelfandTsetlin.weight P i

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurProbability.pattern_card_le
declarations.statement:
∀ {r n : ℕ} (lam : Fin r → ℕ),
  ∑ i : Fin r, lam i = n →
    Fintype.card (FreeEntropy.GelfandTsetlin.Pattern (FreeEntropy.SchurProbability.integralRow lam)) ≤

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurProbability.rootWeight_le_one
declarations.statement:
∀ {r : ℕ} (x : Fin r → ℝ),

    Antitone x →
      ∀ (c : ℕ × ℕ →₀ ℕ), FreeEntropy.KostantWeightData.rootWeight r (FreeEntropy.SchurProbability.adjacent x) c ≤ 1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurProbability.schurMass
declarations.statement: {r : ℕ} → (Fin r → ℕ) → ℕ → (Fin r → ℝ) → ℝ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurProbability.schurMass_le
declarations.statement:
∀ {r n : ℕ} (lam : Fin r → ℕ),
  0 < n →
    ∑ i : Fin r, lam i = n →
      ∀ (x : Fin r → ℝ),
        (∀ (i : Fin r), 0 < x i) →
          Antitone x →
            FreeEntropy.SchurProbability.schurMass lam n x ≤
              (↑n + 1) ^ r.choose 2 *
                Real.exp (-↑n * FreeEntropy.FiniteConcentration.kl (FreeEntropy.WordTypes.empirical lam n) x)

                ∑ P : FreeEntropy.GelfandTsetlin.Pattern (FreeEntropy.SchurProbability.integralRow lam),
                  ∏ i : Fin r, x i ^ FreeEntropy.GelfandTsetlin.weight P i ≤

  [inst_3 : DecidableEq M] {B : ι → Type u_3} {A : ι → Type u_4} [inst_4 : (i : ι) → Fintype (B i)]
  [inst_5 : (i : ι) → DecidableEq (B i)] [inst_6 : (i : ι) → Fintype (A i)] [inst_7 : (i : ι) → DecidableEq (A i)]
  [inst_8 : ∀ (i : ι), Nonempty (A i)] (F : (i : ι) → FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel (B i) M)
  (G : (i : ι) → FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel M (B i)) (q : ι → ℝ) (hq0 : ∀ (i : ι), 0 ≤ q i)
  (hq1 : ∑ i : ι, q i = 1) (σ : (i : ι) → Matrix (B i) (B i) ℂ),
  (∀ (i : ι), (σ i).PosSemidef) →
    (∀ (i : ι), (σ i).trace = 1) →
      ∀ (τ : Matrix M M ℂ),
        τ.PosSemidef →
          τ.trace = 1 →
            ∀ (typical : Finset ι) (ε : ℝ),
              0 ≤ ε →
                (∀ i ∈ typical, FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance ((F i).toFun (σ i)) τ ≤ ε) →
                  (∀ i ∈ typical, FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance ((G i).toFun τ) (σ i) ≤ ε) →
                    FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance
                        ((FreeEntropy.SchurProtocol.decoder G q hq0 hq1).toFun
                          ((FreeEntropy.SchurProtocol.encoder F).toFun (FreeEntropy.SchurProtocol.sourceState q σ)))
                        (FreeEntropy.SchurProtocol.sourceState q σ) ≤
                      2 * ε + 2 * FreeEntropy.Protocol.outsideMass Finset.univ typical q

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurProtocol.typical_roundtrip_error_in_basis
declarations.statement:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : Fintype M] [inst_2 : DecidableEq ι]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq M] {B : ι → Type u_3} {A : ι → Type u_4} [inst_4 : (i : ι) → Fintype (B i)]
  [inst_5 : (i : ι) → DecidableEq (B i)] [inst_6 : (i : ι) → Fintype (A i)] [inst_7 : (i : ι) → DecidableEq (A i)]
  [inst_8 : ∀ (i : ι), Nonempty (A i)] {S : Type u_5} [inst_9 : Fintype S] [inst_10 : DecidableEq S]
  (U : Matrix S ((i : ι) × B i × A i) ℂ) (hU : U.conjTranspose * U = 1) (hU' : U * U.conjTranspose = 1)
  (F : (i : ι) → FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel (B i) M) (G : (i : ι) → FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel M (B i))
  (q : ι → ℝ) (hq0 : ∀ (i : ι), 0 ≤ q i) (hq1 : ∑ i : ι, q i = 1) (σ : (i : ι) → Matrix (B i) (B i) ℂ),
  (∀ (i : ι), (σ i).PosSemidef) →
    (∀ (i : ι), (σ i).trace = 1) →
      ∀ (τ : Matrix M M ℂ),
        τ.PosSemidef →
          τ.trace = 1 →
            ∀ (typical : Finset ι) (ε : ℝ),
              0 ≤ ε →
                (∀ i ∈ typical, FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance ((F i).toFun (σ i)) τ ≤ ε) →
                  (∀ i ∈ typical, FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance ((G i).toFun τ) (σ i) ≤ ε) →
                    FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance
                        ((FreeEntropy.SchurProtocol.transportDecoder U hU
                              (FreeEntropy.SchurProtocol.decoder G q hq0 hq1)).toFun
                          ((FreeEntropy.SchurProtocol.transportEncoder U hU'
                                (FreeEntropy.SchurProtocol.encoder F)).toFun
                            (U * FreeEntropy.SchurProtocol.sourceState q σ * U.conjTranspose)))
                        (U * FreeEntropy.SchurProtocol.sourceState q σ * U.conjTranspose) ≤
                      2 * ε + 2 * FreeEntropy.Protocol.outsideMass Finset.univ typical q

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.actual_transferred_average_error_le
declarations.statement:
∀ {d r : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r),
  2 ≤ d →
    ∀ (n : ℕ) {B : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype B] [inst_1 : DecidableEq B]
      (A :
        FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel (Fin n → Fin d)
          (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.targetCanonicalRow s n)))
      (R :
        FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel
          (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.targetCanonicalRow s n))
          (Fin n → Fin d))
      (E : FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel (Fin n → Fin d) B)
      (D : FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel B (Fin n → Fin d)) (f g : ℝ),
      (∀ (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)),
          FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance (A.toFun (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalSource s n U))
              (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalOrbitState s
                (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.targetCanonicalRow s n) U) ≤
            f) →
        (∀ (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)),
            FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance
                (R.toFun
                  (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalOrbitState s
                    (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.targetCanonicalRow s n) U))
                (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalSource s n U) ≤
              g) →
          FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalAverageError s
              (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.targetCanonicalRow s n) (E.comp R) (A.comp D) ≤
            FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.mixedAverageError s n E D + f + g

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.copyVectors
declarations.statement:
{d n : ℕ} →
  {A : Type u_1} →
    {M : Type u_2} → [Fintype A] → (M → Matrix (Fin n → Fin d) A ℂ) → (A → ℂ) → Matrix (Fin n → Fin d) M ℂ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.copyVectors_isometry
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} {A : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : DecidableEq A] [Fintype M]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq M] (J : M → Matrix (Fin n → Fin d) A ℂ),
  (∀ (i : M), (J i).conjTranspose * J i = 1) →
    (∀ (i j : M), i ≠ j → (J i).conjTranspose * J j = 0) →
      ∀ (v : A → ℂ),
        star v ⬝ᵥ v = 1 →
          (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.copyVectors J v).conjTranspose * FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.copyVectors J v = 1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.copy_matrixUnit_commutant
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} {A : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : DecidableEq A]
  (R : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ) →* Matrix A A ℂ) (J K : Matrix (Fin n → Fin d) A ℂ),
  K.conjTranspose * K = 1 →
    (∀ (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)), (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalRepresentation d n) U * J = J * R U) →
      (∀ (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)), (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalRepresentation d n) U * K = K * R U) →
        FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.TensorCommutant (J * K.conjTranspose)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.copy_multiplicity_entropy_bound
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} {A : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : DecidableEq A] [inst_2 : Fintype M]
  [DecidableEq M] (R : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ) →* Matrix A A ℂ) (J : M → Matrix (Fin n → Fin d) A ℂ),
  (∀ (i : M), (J i).conjTranspose * J i = 1) →
    (∀ (i j : M), i ≠ j → (J i).conjTranspose * J j = 0) →
      (∀ (i : M) (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)),
          (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalRepresentation d n) U * J i = J i * R U) →
        ∀ (a : FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n) (v : A → ℂ),
          star v ⬝ᵥ v = 1 →
            (∀ (z : Fin d → ℂ) (hz : ∀ (j : Fin d), ‖z j‖ = 1),
                (R (FreeEntropy.Occupation.diagonalUnitary z hz)).mulVec v = FreeEntropy.Occupation.character z a • v) →
              0 < n →
                ∀ (x : Fin d → ℝ),
                  (∀ (i : Fin d), 0 < x i) →
                    ↑(Fintype.card M) * FreeEntropy.WordTypes.monomial (↑a) x ≤
                      Real.exp (-↑n * FreeEntropy.FiniteConcentration.kl (FreeEntropy.WordTypes.empirical (↑a) n) x)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.copy_multiplicity_le_words
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} {A : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : DecidableEq A] [inst_2 : Fintype M]
  [DecidableEq M] (R : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ) →* Matrix A A ℂ) (J : M → Matrix (Fin n → Fin d) A ℂ),
  (∀ (i : M), (J i).conjTranspose * J i = 1) →
    (∀ (i j : M), i ≠ j → (J i).conjTranspose * J j = 0) →
      (∀ (i : M) (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)),
          (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalRepresentation d n) U * J i = J i * R U) →
        ∀ (a : FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n) (v : A → ℂ),
          star v ⬝ᵥ v = 1 →
            (∀ (z : Fin d → ℂ) (hz : ∀ (j : Fin d), ‖z j‖ = 1),
                (R (FreeEntropy.Occupation.diagonalUnitary z hz)).mulVec v = FreeEntropy.Occupation.character z a • v) →
              Fintype.card M ≤ Fintype.card (FreeEntropy.WordTypes.Words ↑a)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.diagonal_intertwines_of_torus
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} {B : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype B] [inst_1 : DecidableEq B] (J : Matrix (Fin n → Fin d) B ℂ)
  (weight : B → Fin d → ℕ),
  (∀ (z : Fin d → ℂ),
      (∀ (i : Fin d), ‖z i‖ = 1) →
        FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.matrix n (Matrix.diagonal z) * J =
          J * Matrix.diagonal fun (b : B) => FreeEntropy.TorusWeights.character z (weight b)) →
    ∀ (k : Fin d),
      (FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.generators d n).E k k * J = J * Matrix.diagonal fun (b : B) => ↑(weight b k)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.differential_intertwines
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} {A : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : DecidableEq A]
  (R : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ) →* Matrix A A ℂ) (J : Matrix (Fin n → Fin d) A ℂ),
  J.conjTranspose * J = 1 →
    (∀ (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)), (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalRepresentation d n) U * J = J * R U) →
      ∀ (X : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ),
        FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.differential n X * J =
          J * (J.conjTranspose * FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.differential n X * J)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.differential_mem
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} (K : FreeEntropy.UnitaryDecomposition.Subspace (Fin n → Fin d)),
  FreeEntropy.UnitaryDecomposition.Invariant
      (FreeEntropy.UnitaryDecomposition.euclideanRepresentation (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalRepresentation d n)) K →
    ∀ (X : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ), ∀ v ∈ K, (Matrix.toEuclideanLin (FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.differential n X)) v ∈ K

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.exists_highest_of_weight
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} (K : Submodule ℂ ((Fin n → Fin d) → ℂ)),
  (∀ (i j : Fin d), ∀ v ∈ K, ((FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.generators d n).E i j).mulVec v ∈ K) →
    (∃ (a : FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n), ∃ v ∈ K, v ≠ 0 ∧ FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.HasTensorWeight a v) →
      ∃ (a : FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n),
        ∃ v ∈ K,
          v ≠ 0 ∧
            FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.HasTensorWeight a v ∧
              Antitone ↑a ∧ ∀ (i j : Fin d), i < j → ((FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.generators d n).E i j).mulVec v = 0

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.exists_physical_highest_vector
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} (K : FreeEntropy.UnitaryDecomposition.Subspace (Fin n → Fin d)),
  FreeEntropy.UnitaryDecomposition.Invariant
      (FreeEntropy.UnitaryDecomposition.euclideanRepresentation (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalRepresentation d n)) K →
    K ≠ ⊥ →
      ∃ (a : FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n),
        ∃ v ∈ K,
          v ≠ 0 ∧
            FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.HasTensorWeight a v.ofLp ∧
              Antitone ↑a ∧ ∀ (i j : Fin d), i < j → ((FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.generators d n).E i j).mulVec v.ofLp = 0

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.exists_sectorHighest_canonical_unitary
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} (i : ↥(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.Sector d n)),
  ∃ (W :
    Matrix (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex ↑(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorHighestOccupation i))
      (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.SectorSpace d n i) ℂ),
    W.conjTranspose * W = 1 ∧
      W * W.conjTranspose = 1 ∧
        ∀ (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)),
          W * ((FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalDecomposition d n).representation i) U =
            (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.irrepMatrix ↑(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorHighestOccupation i)) U * W

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.exists_sector_highest
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} (i : ↥(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.Sector d n)),
  ∃ (a : FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n) (v : FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.SectorSpace d n i → ℂ),
    v ≠ 0 ∧
      Antitone ↑a ∧
        (∀ (j : Fin d), ((FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorGenerators i).E j j).mulVec v = ↑(↑a j) • v) ∧
          (∀ (j k : Fin d), j < k → ((FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorGenerators i).E j k).mulVec v = 0) ∧
            FreeEntropy.LiePBW.cyclicSpan (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorGenerators i) v = ⊤

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.exists_sector_lowering_generator
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} (i : ↥(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.Sector d n)),
  ∃ (a : FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n) (v : FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.SectorSpace d n i → ℂ),
    v ≠ 0 ∧
      Antitone ↑a ∧
        (∀ (j : Fin d), ((FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorGenerators i).E j j).mulVec v = ↑(↑a j) • v) ∧
          (∀ (j k : Fin d), j < k → ((FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorGenerators i).E j k).mulVec v = 0) ∧
            FreeEntropy.LiePBW.loweringSpan (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorGenerators i) v = ⊤

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.exists_sector_unique_highest
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} (i : ↥(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.Sector d n)),
  ∃ (a : FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n) (v : FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.SectorSpace d n i → ℂ),
    v ≠ 0 ∧
      Antitone ↑a ∧
        (∀ (j : Fin d), ((FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorGenerators i).E j j).mulVec v = ↑(↑a j) • v) ∧
          (∀ (j k : Fin d), j < k → ((FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorGenerators i).E j k).mulVec v = 0) ∧
            ∀ (u : FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.SectorSpace d n i → ℂ),
              (∀ (j k : Fin d), j < k → ((FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorGenerators i).E j k).mulVec u = 0) →
                ∃ (c : ℂ), u = c • v

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.exists_sector_weight_highest
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} (i : ↥(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.Sector d n)),
  ∃ (a : FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n) (v : FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.SectorSpace d n i → ℂ),
    v ≠ 0 ∧
      Antitone ↑a ∧
        (∀ (j : Fin d), ((FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorWeightGenerators i).E j j).mulVec v = ↑(↑a j) • v) ∧
          (∀ (j k : Fin d), j < k → ((FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorWeightGenerators i).E j k).mulVec v = 0) ∧
            FreeEntropy.LiePBW.cyclicSpan (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorWeightGenerators i) v = ⊤

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.exists_weight_vector
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} (K : FreeEntropy.UnitaryDecomposition.Subspace (Fin n → Fin d)),
  FreeEntropy.UnitaryDecomposition.Invariant
      (FreeEntropy.UnitaryDecomposition.euclideanRepresentation (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalRepresentation d n)) K →
    K ≠ ⊥ →
      ∃ (a : FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n),
        ∃ v ∈ K,
          v ≠ 0 ∧
            ∀ (z : Fin d → ℂ) (hz : ∀ (i : Fin d), ‖z i‖ = 1),
              (FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.matrix n ↑(FreeEntropy.Occupation.diagonalUnitary z hz)).mulVec v.ofLp =
                FreeEntropy.Occupation.character z a • v.ofLp

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.group_intertwiner_of_physical_generators
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n m : ℕ} {A : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : DecidableEq A] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq B] (R : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ) →* Matrix A A ℂ)
  (S : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ) →* Matrix B B ℂ) (J : Matrix (Fin n → Fin d) A ℂ)
  (K : Matrix (Fin m → Fin d) B ℂ),
  n = m →
    J.conjTranspose * J = 1 →
      K.conjTranspose * K = 1 →
        (∀ (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)), (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalRepresentation d n) U * J = J * R U) →
          (∀ (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)),
              (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalRepresentation d m) U * K = K * S U) →
            ∀ (E : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d A) (F : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d B),
              (∀ (i j : Fin d), (FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.generators d n).E i j * J = J * E.E i j) →
                (∀ (i j : Fin d), (FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.generators d m).E i j * K = K * F.E i j) →
                  ∀ (V : Matrix B A ℂ),
                    (∀ (i j : Fin d), V * E.E i j = F.E i j * V) →
                      ∀ (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)), V * R U = S U * V

{d n : ℕ} →

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.groupedHighestColumns_isometry
declarations.statement:

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.hasTensorWeight_of_support
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} (a : FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n) (v : (Fin n → Fin d) → ℂ),
  (∀ (w : Fin n → Fin d), FreeEntropy.WordTypes.content w ≠ ↑a → v w = 0) → FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.HasTensorWeight a v

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.highestSectorMass
declarations.statement: {d n : ℕ} → FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n → (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.highestSectorMass_le_exp_neg_kl
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} (lam : FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n),
  0 < n →
    ∀ (x : Fin d → ℝ),
      (∀ (j : Fin d), 0 ≤ x j) →
        Antitone x →
          (∀ (j : Fin d), ↑lam j ≠ 0 → 0 < x j) →
            FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.highestSectorMass lam x ≤
              (↑n + 1) ^ FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.concentrationExponent d *
                Real.exp (-↑n * FreeEntropy.FiniteConcentration.kl (FreeEntropy.WordTypes.empirical (↑lam) n) x)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.highestSectorMass_le_type
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} (lam : FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n) (x : Fin d → ℝ),
  (∀ (j : Fin d), 0 ≤ x j) →
    Antitone x →
      FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.highestSectorMass lam x ≤
        (↑n + 1) ^ FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.concentrationExponent d *
          (↑(Fintype.card (FreeEntropy.WordTypes.Words ↑lam)) * FreeEntropy.WordTypes.monomial (↑lam) x)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.highestSectorMass_le_zero_of_unsupported
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} (lam : FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n) (x : Fin d → ℝ),
  (∀ (j : Fin d), 0 ≤ x j) →
    Antitone x → ∀ (j : Fin d), x j = 0 → ↑lam j ≠ 0 → FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.highestSectorMass lam x ≤ 0

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.intertwiner_adjoint
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} {A : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : DecidableEq A]
  (R : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ) →* Matrix A A ℂ) (J : Matrix (Fin n → Fin d) A ℂ),
  J.conjTranspose * J = 1 →
    (∀ (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)), (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalRepresentation d n) U * J = J * R U) →
      ∀ (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)),
        J.conjTranspose * (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalRepresentation d n) U = R U * J.conjTranspose

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.invariant_projection_commutant
declarations.statement:

    FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.TensorCommutant
      (FreeEntropy.UnitaryDecomposition.embedding K * (FreeEntropy.UnitaryDecomposition.embedding K).conjTranspose)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.mixedAverageError_nonneg
declarations.statement:
∀ {d r : ℕ} {B : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype B] [inst_1 : DecidableEq B] (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r) (n : ℕ)
  (E : FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel (Fin n → Fin d) B) (D : FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel B (Fin n → Fin d)),

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.mixedAverageError_tendsto_of_uniform
declarations.statement:
∀ {d r : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r) (memory : ℕ → ℕ)
  (E : (n : ℕ) → FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel (Fin n → Fin d) (Fin (memory n)))
  (D : (n : ℕ) → FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel (Fin (memory n)) (Fin n → Fin d)),
  Filter.Tendsto (fun (n : ℕ) => FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.mixedWorstError s n (E n) (D n)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
    Filter.Tendsto (fun (n : ℕ) => FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.mixedAverageError s n (E n) (D n)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

declarations.statement:
∀ {d r : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r) (hd : 2 ≤ d),
  ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
    ∀ (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)),
      FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance
          ((FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.mixedEncoder s n).toFun (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalSource s n U))

{d r : ℕ} →
  {B : Type u_1} →
    [inst : Fintype B] →
      FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r →
        (n : ℕ) →
          FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel (Fin n → Fin d) B →
            FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel B (Fin n → Fin d) → ℝ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.mixedWorstError_le
declarations.statement:
∀ {d r : ℕ} {B : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r) (n : ℕ)
  (E : FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel (Fin n → Fin d) B) (D : FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel B (Fin n → Fin d))
  (bound : ℝ),
  (∀ (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)),
      FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance (D.toFun (E.toFun (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalSource s n U)))
          (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalSource s n U) ≤
        bound) →
    FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.mixedWorstError s n E D ≤ bound

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.mixedWorstError_nonneg
declarations.statement:
∀ {d r : ℕ} {B : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r) (n : ℕ)
  (E : FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel (Fin n → Fin d) B) (D : FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel B (Fin n → Fin d)),
  0 ≤ FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.mixedWorstError s n E D

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.mixed_comparison_error_eventually
declarations.statement:
∀ {d r : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r) (hd : 2 ≤ d),
  ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
    ∀ (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)),
      FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance
            ((FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.mixedEncoder s n).toFun (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalSource s n U))
            (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalOrbitState s
              (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.targetCanonicalRow s n) U) ≤
          FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.mixedComparisonError s hd n ∧
        FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance
            ((FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.mixedDecoder s n).toFun
              (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalOrbitState s
                (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.targetCanonicalRow s n) U))
            (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalSource s n U) ≤
          FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.mixedComparisonError s hd n

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.monomial_le_of_root_cone
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (lam mu : Fin d → ℕ) (c : Fin (d - 1) → ℕ),
  ((fun (j : Fin d) => ↑(lam j)) - fun (j : Fin d) => ↑(mu j)) = FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.offset c →
    ∀ (x : Fin d → ℝ),
      (∀ (j : Fin d), 0 ≤ x j) → Antitone x → FreeEntropy.WordTypes.monomial mu x ≤ FreeEntropy.WordTypes.monomial lam x

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.monomial_le_of_root_cone_pos
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (lam mu : Fin d → ℕ) (c : Fin (d - 1) → ℕ),
  ((fun (j : Fin d) => ↑(lam j)) - fun (j : Fin d) => ↑(mu j)) = FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.offset c →
    ∀ (x : Fin d → ℝ),
      (∀ (j : Fin d), 0 < x j) → Antitone x → FreeEntropy.WordTypes.monomial mu x ≤ FreeEntropy.WordTypes.monomial lam x

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.multiplicityEmbedding
declarations.statement: {d n : ℕ} → {A : Type u_1} → {M : Type u_2} → (M → Matrix (Fin n → Fin d) A ℂ) → Matrix (Fin n → Fin d) (A × M) ℂ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.multiplicityEmbedding_compression_entry
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} {A : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype M] [DecidableEq M]
  (J : M → Matrix (Fin n → Fin d) A ℂ) (X : Matrix (Fin n → Fin d) (Fin n → Fin d) ℂ) (a b : A) (i j : M),
  ((FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.multiplicityEmbedding J).conjTranspose * X * FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.multiplicityEmbedding J)
      (a, i) (b, j) =
    ((J i).conjTranspose * X * J j) a b

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.multiplicityEmbedding_isometry
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} {A : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [Fintype A] [inst : DecidableEq A] [Fintype M] [inst_2 : DecidableEq M]
  (J : M → Matrix (Fin n → Fin d) A ℂ),
  (∀ (a : M), (J a).conjTranspose * J a = 1) →
    (∀ (a b : M), a ≠ b → (J a).conjTranspose * J b = 0) →
      (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.multiplicityEmbedding J).conjTranspose * FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.multiplicityEmbedding J = 1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.multiplicity_block_normalized
declarations.statement:
∀ {A : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : DecidableEq A] [Nonempty A] [inst_3 : Fintype M]
  [inst_4 : DecidableEq M] [Nonempty M] {B : Matrix A A ℂ},
  B.PosSemidef →
    Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun (x1 x2 : ℂ) => x1 * x2) B 1 =
      (↑(Fintype.card M) * FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr B) •
        Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun (x1 x2 : ℂ) => x1 * x2) (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.normalizedBlock B)
          (FreeEntropy.MultiplicityChannels.maximallyMixed M)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.multiplicity_mass_nonneg
declarations.statement:
∀ {A : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Nonempty A] [inst_3 : Fintype M] [DecidableEq M]
  [Nonempty M] {B : Matrix A A ℂ}, B.PosSemidef → 0 ≤ ↑(Fintype.card M) * FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr B

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.normalizedBlock
declarations.statement: {A : Type u_1} → [Fintype A] → [DecidableEq A] → Matrix A A ℂ → Matrix A A ℂ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.normalizedBlock_positive
declarations.statement:
∀ {A : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : DecidableEq A] [Nonempty A] {B : Matrix A A ℂ},
  B.PosSemidef → (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.normalizedBlock B).PosSemidef

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.normalizedBlock_trace
declarations.statement:
∀ {A : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : DecidableEq A] [Nonempty A] {B : Matrix A A ℂ},
  B.PosSemidef → (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.normalizedBlock B).trace = 1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.normalizedBlock_unitary
declarations.statement:
∀ {A : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : DecidableEq A] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq B] [Nonempty A] [Nonempty B] (W : Matrix B A ℂ),
  W.conjTranspose * W = 1 →
    W * W.conjTranspose = 1 →
      ∀ (X : Matrix A A ℂ),
        FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.normalizedBlock (W * X * W.conjTranspose) =
          W * FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.normalizedBlock X * W.conjTranspose

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.occupationRow
declarations.statement: {d n : ℕ} → FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n → ℕ → ℤ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.occupationRow_cast_fin
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} (lam : FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n) (j : Fin d),
  ↑(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.occupationRow lam ↑j) = ↑(↑lam j)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.occupation_card_le
declarations.statement: ∀ (d n : ℕ), Fintype.card (FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n) ≤ (n + 1) ^ d

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.occupation_notTypical_l1
declarations.statement:
∀ {d r : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r) (n : ℕ),
  2 ≤ n →
    ∀ (lam : FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n),
      (∀ (j : Fin d), ↑lam j ≠ 0 → 0 < FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalSpectrum s j) →
        ¬FreeEntropy.TypicalRows.Typical s n (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.occupationRow lam) →
          Real.logb 2 ↑n / √↑n ≤
            FreeEntropy.FiniteConcentration.l1 (FreeEntropy.WordTypes.empirical (↑lam) n)
              (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalSpectrum s)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.orthonormal_supported_card_le
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} {M : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype M] [inst_1 : DecidableEq M] (a : FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n)
  (V : Matrix (Fin n → Fin d) M ℂ),
  V.conjTranspose * V = 1 →
    (∀ (w : Fin n → Fin d), FreeEntropy.WordTypes.content w ≠ ↑a → ∀ (i : M), V w i = 0) →
      Fintype.card M ≤ Fintype.card (FreeEntropy.WordTypes.Words ↑a)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.orthonormal_weight_card_le
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} {M : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype M] [inst_1 : DecidableEq M] (a : FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n)
  (V : Matrix (Fin n → Fin d) M ℂ),
  V.conjTranspose * V = 1 →
    (∀ (i : M) (z : Fin d → ℂ) (hz : ∀ (j : Fin d), ‖z j‖ = 1),
        ((FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.matrix n ↑(FreeEntropy.Occupation.diagonalUnitary z hz)).mulVec
            fun (w : Fin n → Fin d) => V w i) =
          FreeEntropy.Occupation.character z a • fun (w : Fin n → Fin d) => V w i) →
      Fintype.card M ≤ Fintype.card (FreeEntropy.WordTypes.Words ↑a)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalAtypicalMass
declarations.statement: {d r : ℕ} → FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r → ℕ → ℝ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalAtypicalMass_eventually_le_inv
declarations.statement:
∀ {d r : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r),
  ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalAtypicalMass s n ≤ 1 / ↑n

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalAtypicalMass_le_tailBound
declarations.statement:
∀ {d r : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r) (n : ℕ),
  2 ≤ n →
    FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalAtypicalMass s n ≤
      FreeEntropy.Concentration.tailBound (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.concentrationExponent d + d) n

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalBasis
declarations.statement:

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalOrbit_forward_error_le
declarations.statement:
∀ {d r : ℕ} {M : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype M] [inst_1 : DecidableEq M] (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r) (n : ℕ),
  2 ≤ n →
    ∀
      (F :
        (i : ↥(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.Sector d n)) →
          FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel
            (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex ↑(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorHighestOccupation i)) M)
      (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)) (τ : Matrix M M ℂ),
      τ.PosSemidef →
        τ.trace = 1 →
          ∀ (ε : ℝ),
            0 ≤ ε →
              (∀ i ∈ FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalTypical s n,
                  FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance
                      ((F i).toFun
                        (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalOrbitState s
                          (↑(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorHighestOccupation i)) U))
                      τ ≤
                    ε) →
                FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance
                    ((FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalOrbitEncoder F).toFun
                      (FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.matrix n (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalDensity s U)))
                    τ ≤
                  ε + FreeEntropy.Concentration.tailBound (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.concentrationExponent d + d) n

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physical_atypical_grouped_tail_le
declarations.statement:
∀ {d r : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r) (n : ℕ),
  2 ≤ n →
    ∑ lam : FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n with
        ¬FreeEntropy.TypicalRows.Typical s n (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.occupationRow lam),
        FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.highestSectorMass lam (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalSpectrum s) ≤
      FreeEntropy.Concentration.tailBound (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.concentrationExponent d + d) n

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physical_error_le_one
declarations.statement:
∀ {d r : ℕ} {B : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r) (n : ℕ)
  (E : FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel (Fin n → Fin d) B) (D : FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel B (Fin n → Fin d))
  (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)),
  FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance (D.toFun (E.toFun (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalSource s n U)))
      (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalSource s n U) ≤
    1

declarations.statement:
∀ {d r : ℕ} {B : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r) (n : ℕ)
  (E : FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel (Fin n → Fin d) B) (D : FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel B (Fin n → Fin d))
  (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)),
  FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance (D.toFun (E.toFun (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalSource s n U)))
      (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalSource s n U) ≤
    FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.mixedWorstError s n E D

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physical_forward_error_le
declarations.statement:
∀ {d r : ℕ} {M : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype M] [inst_1 : DecidableEq M] (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r) (n : ℕ),
  2 ≤ n →
    ∀
      (F :
        (i : ↥(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.Sector d n)) →
          FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.SectorSpace d n i) M)
      (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)) (τ : Matrix M M ℂ),
      τ.PosSemidef →
        τ.trace = 1 →
          ∀ (ε : ℝ),
            0 ≤ ε →
              (∀ i ∈ FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalTypical s n,
                  FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance
                      ((F i).toFun (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalSectorState s n U i)) τ ≤
                    ε) →
                FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance
                    ((FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalEncoder F).toFun
                      (FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.matrix n (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalDensity s U)))
                    τ ≤
                  ε + FreeEntropy.Concentration.tailBound (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.concentrationExponent d + d) n

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physical_grouped_tail_le
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (n : ℕ),
  0 < n →
    ∀ (x : Fin d → ℝ),
      (∀ (j : Fin d), 0 ≤ x j) →
        Antitone x →
          ∑ j : Fin d, x j = 1 →
            ∀ (bad : Finset (FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n)) (ε : ℝ),
              0 ≤ ε →
                (∀ lam ∈ bad,
                    (∀ (j : Fin d), ↑lam j ≠ 0 → 0 < x j) →
                      ε ≤ FreeEntropy.FiniteConcentration.l1 (FreeEntropy.WordTypes.empirical (↑lam) n) x) →
                  ∑ lam ∈ bad, FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.highestSectorMass lam x ≤
                    (↑n + 1) ^ (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.concentrationExponent d + d) * Real.exp (-↑n * ε ^ 2 / 4)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physical_invariant_of_generators
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} (S : Submodule ℂ ((Fin n → Fin d) → ℂ)),
  (∀ (i j : Fin d), ∀ x ∈ S, ((FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.generators d n).E i j).mulVec x ∈ S) →
    ∀ (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)),
      ∀ x ∈ S, ((FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalRepresentation d n) U).mulVec x ∈ S

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physical_memory_bound_of_comparison
declarations.statement:
∀ {d r : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r),
  2 ≤ d →
    ∀ (n : ℕ) {B : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype B] [inst_1 : DecidableEq B]
      (A :
        FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel (Fin n → Fin d)
          (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.targetCanonicalRow s n)))
      (R :
        FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel
          (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.targetCanonicalRow s n))
          (Fin n → Fin d))
      (E : FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel (Fin n → Fin d) B)
      (D : FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel B (Fin n → Fin d)) (f g : ℝ),
      (∀ (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)),
          FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance (A.toFun (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalSource s n U))
              (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalOrbitState s
                (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.targetCanonicalRow s n) U) ≤
            f) →
        (∀ (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)),
            FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance
                (R.toFun
                  (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalOrbitState s
                    (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.targetCanonicalRow s n) U))
                (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalSource s n U) ≤
              g) →
          ↑(FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.targetCanonicalDimension s n) *
              (1 - (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.mixedAverageError s n E D + f + g) / (1 - s.qx) ^ (d.choose 2 + 1)) ≤
            ↑(Fintype.card B)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physical_orbit_atypical_tail_le
declarations.statement:
∀ {d r : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r) (n : ℕ),
  2 ≤ n →
    ∀ (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)),
      ∑ i : ↥(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.Sector d n) with
          ¬FreeEntropy.TypicalRows.Typical s n
              (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.occupationRow (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorHighestOccupation i)),
          FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorProbability n
            ((↑U * Matrix.diagonal fun (j : Fin d) => ↑(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalSpectrum s j)) *
              (↑U).conjTranspose)
            i ≤
        FreeEntropy.Concentration.tailBound (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.concentrationExponent d + d) n

      (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalProbability s n) =
    FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalAtypicalMass s n

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physical_reverse_error_le
declarations.statement:
∀ {d r : ℕ} {M : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype M] [inst_1 : DecidableEq M] (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r) (n : ℕ),
  2 ≤ n →
    ∀
      (G :
        (i : ↥(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.Sector d n)) →
          FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel M (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.SectorSpace d n i))
      (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)) (τ : Matrix M M ℂ),
      τ.PosSemidef →
        τ.trace = 1 →
          ∀ (ε : ℝ),
            0 ≤ ε →
              (∀ i ∈ FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalTypical s n,
                  FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance ((G i).toFun τ)
                      (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalSectorState s n U i) ≤
                    ε) →
                FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance ((FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalDecoder s n G).toFun τ)
                    (FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.matrix n (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalDensity s U)) ≤
                  ε + FreeEntropy.Concentration.tailBound (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.concentrationExponent d + d) n

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physical_roundtrip_error_le
declarations.statement:
∀ {d r : ℕ} {M : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype M] [inst_1 : DecidableEq M] (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r) (n : ℕ),
  2 ≤ n →
    ∀
      (F :
        (i : ↥(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.Sector d n)) →
          FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.SectorSpace d n i) M)
      (G :
        (i : ↥(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.Sector d n)) →
          FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel M (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.SectorSpace d n i))
      (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)) (τ : Matrix M M ℂ),
      τ.PosSemidef →
        τ.trace = 1 →
          ∀ (ε : ℝ),
            0 ≤ ε →
              (∀ i ∈ FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalTypical s n,
                  FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance
                      ((F i).toFun (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalSectorState s n U i)) τ ≤
                    ε) →
                (∀ i ∈ FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalTypical s n,
                    FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance ((G i).toFun τ)
                        (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalSectorState s n U i) ≤
                      ε) →
                  FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance
                      ((FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalDecoder s n G).toFun
                        ((FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalEncoder F).toFun
                          (FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.matrix n (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalDensity s U))))
                      (FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.matrix n (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalDensity s U)) ≤
                    2 * ε +
                      2 * FreeEntropy.Concentration.tailBound (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.concentrationExponent d + d) n

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physical_roundtrip_from_canonical
declarations.statement:
∀ {d r : ℕ} {M : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype M] [inst_1 : DecidableEq M] (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r) (n : ℕ),
  2 ≤ n →
    ∀
      (F :
        (i : ↥(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.Sector d n)) →
          FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel
            (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex ↑(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorHighestOccupation i)) M)
      (G :
        (i : ↥(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.Sector d n)) →
          FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel M
            (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex ↑(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorHighestOccupation i)))
      (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)) (τ : Matrix M M ℂ),
      τ.PosSemidef →
        τ.trace = 1 →
          ∀ (ε : ℝ),
            0 ≤ ε →
              (∀ i ∈ FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalTypical s n,
                  FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance
                      ((F i).toFun
                        (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.canonicalTensorState (↑(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorHighestOccupation i))
                          (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalDensity s U)))
                      τ ≤
                    ε) →
                (∀ i ∈ FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalTypical s n,
                    FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance ((G i).toFun τ)
                        (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.canonicalTensorState (↑(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorHighestOccupation i))
                          (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalDensity s U)) ≤
                      ε) →
                  FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance
                      ((FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalDecoder s n fun (i : ↥(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.Sector d n)) =>
                            FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorCanonicalReverse i (G i)).toFun
                        ((FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalEncoder fun (i : ↥(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.Sector d n)) =>
                              FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorCanonicalForward i (F i)).toFun
                          (FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.matrix n (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalDensity s U))))
                      (FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.matrix n (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalDensity s U)) ≤
                    2 * ε +
                      2 * FreeEntropy.Concentration.tailBound (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.concentrationExponent d + d) n

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physical_roundtrip_of_comparison
declarations.statement:
∀ {d r : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r),
  2 ≤ d →
    ∀ (n : ℕ)
      (A :
        FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel (Fin n → Fin d)
          (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.targetCanonicalRow s n)))
      (R :
        FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel
          (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.targetCanonicalRow s n))
          (Fin n → Fin d))
      (f g : ℝ),
      (∀ (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)),
          FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance (A.toFun (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalSource s n U))
              (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalOrbitState s
                (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.targetCanonicalRow s n) U) ≤
            f) →
        (∀ (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)),
            FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance
                (R.toFun
                  (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalOrbitState s
                    (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.targetCanonicalRow s n) U))
                (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalSource s n U) ≤
              g) →
          FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.mixedWorstError s n A R ≤ f + g

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physical_sector_casimir
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} (i : ↥(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.Sector d n)),
  ∃ (a : FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n),
    Antitone ↑a ∧
      (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorGenerators i).casimir =
        (FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.casimir fun (k : Fin d) => ↑(↑a k)) • 1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physical_sector_highest
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} (i : ↥(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.Sector d n)),
  ∃ (a : FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n),
    ∃ v ∈ ↑i,
      v ≠ 0 ∧
        FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.HasTensorWeight a v.ofLp ∧
          Antitone ↑a ∧
            (∀ (j k : Fin d), j < k → ((FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.generators d n).E j k).mulVec v.ofLp = 0) ∧
              FreeEntropy.UnitaryDecomposition.cyclicSubspace
                  (FreeEntropy.UnitaryDecomposition.euclideanRepresentation
                    (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalRepresentation d n))
                  v =
                ↑i

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physical_source_block_sum
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (n : ℕ) {ρ : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ},
  ρ.IsHermitian →
    FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.matrix n ρ =
      ∑ i : ↥(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.Sector d n),
        (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalDecomposition d n).embedding i * FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalBlock n ρ i *
          ((FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalDecomposition d n).embedding i).conjTranspose

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physical_source_in_basis
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (n : ℕ) {ρ : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ},
  ρ.IsHermitian →
    (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalBasis d n).conjTranspose * FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.matrix n ρ *
        FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalBasis d n =
      Matrix.blockDiagonal' (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalBlock n ρ)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physical_source_mixture
declarations.statement:
∀ {d r : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r) (n : ℕ) (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)),
  FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.matrix n (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalDensity s U) =
    ∑ i : ↥(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.Sector d n),
      FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalProbability s n i •
        FreeEntropy.SectorChannels.embed ((FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalDecomposition d n).embedding i)
          (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalSectorState s n U i)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physical_source_normalized_sum
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (n : ℕ) {ρ : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ},
  ρ.PosSemidef →
    FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.matrix n ρ =
      ∑ i : ↥(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.Sector d n),
        FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorProbability n ρ i •
          ((FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalDecomposition d n).embedding i * FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorState n ρ i *
            ((FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalDecomposition d n).embedding i).conjTranspose)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physical_source_weight_diagonal
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} (i : ↥(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.Sector d n)) (z : Fin d → ℂ),
  (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorWeightEmbedding i).conjTranspose *
        FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.matrix n (Matrix.diagonal z) *
      FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorWeightEmbedding i =
    Matrix.diagonal fun (a : FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.SectorSpace d n i) =>
      FreeEntropy.Occupation.character z (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorWeight i a)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.positive_trace_real
declarations.statement:
∀ {A : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Nonempty A] {B : Matrix A A ℂ},
  B.PosSemidef → ↑(FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr B) = B.trace

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.raising_hasTensorWeight
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} (a : FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n) (v : (Fin n → Fin d) → ℂ),
  FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.HasTensorWeight a v →
    ∀ (i j : Fin d),
      ((FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.generators d n).E i j).mulVec v ≠ 0 →
        ∃ (b : FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n),
          FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.HasTensorWeight b (((FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.generators d n).E i j).mulVec v) ∧
            FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.weightEnergy b = FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.weightEnergy a + ↑↑i - ↑↑j

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.restrictedGenerators
declarations.statement:
{d n : ℕ} →
  {A : Type u_1} →
    [inst : Fintype A] →
      [inst_1 : DecidableEq A] →
        (R : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ) →* Matrix A A ℂ) →
          (J : Matrix (Fin n → Fin d) A ℂ) →
            J.conjTranspose * J = 1 →
              (∀ (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)),
                  (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalRepresentation d n) U * J = J * R U) →
                FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d A

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.restrictedGenerators_eq_of_intertwines
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} {A : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : DecidableEq A]
  (R : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ) →* Matrix A A ℂ) (J : Matrix (Fin n → Fin d) A ℂ) (hJ : J.conjTranspose * J = 1)
  (hJR : ∀ (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)), (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalRepresentation d n) U * J = J * R U)
  (E : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d A),
  (∀ (i j : Fin d), (FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.generators d n).E i j * J = J * E.E i j) →
    ∀ (i j : Fin d), (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.restrictedGenerators R J hJ hJR).E i j = E.E i j

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.restrictedGenerators_intertwines
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} {A : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : DecidableEq A]
  (R : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ) →* Matrix A A ℂ) (J : Matrix (Fin n → Fin d) A ℂ) (hJ : J.conjTranspose * J = 1)
  (hJR : ∀ (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)), (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalRepresentation d n) U * J = J * R U)
  (i j : Fin d),
  (FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.generators d n).E i j * J =
    J * (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.restrictedGenerators R J hJ hJR).E i j

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.restricted_commutant_of_generators
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} {A : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : DecidableEq A]
  (R : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ) →* Matrix A A ℂ) (J : Matrix (Fin n → Fin d) A ℂ) (hJ : J.conjTranspose * J = 1)
  (hJR : ∀ (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)), (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalRepresentation d n) U * J = J * R U)
  (T : Matrix A A ℂ),
  (∀ (i j : Fin d),
      T * (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.restrictedGenerators R J hJ hJR).E i j =
        (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.restrictedGenerators R J hJ hJR).E i j * T) →
    ∀ (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)), T * R U = R U * T

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.restricted_cyclicSpan_eq_top
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} {A : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : DecidableEq A]
  (R : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ) →* Matrix A A ℂ) (J : Matrix (Fin n → Fin d) A ℂ) (hJ : J.conjTranspose * J = 1)
  (hJR : ∀ (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)), (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalRepresentation d n) U * J = J * R U),
  (FreeEntropy.Twirling.matrixRepresentation R).IsIrreducible →
    ∀ (v : A → ℂ), v ≠ 0 → FreeEntropy.LiePBW.cyclicSpan (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.restrictedGenerators R J hJ hJR) v = ⊤

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.restricted_group_intertwiner_of_generators
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} {A : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : DecidableEq A] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq B] (R : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ) →* Matrix A A ℂ)
  (S : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ) →* Matrix B B ℂ) (J : Matrix (Fin n → Fin d) A ℂ)
  (K : Matrix (Fin n → Fin d) B ℂ) (hJ : J.conjTranspose * J = 1) (hK : K.conjTranspose * K = 1)
  (hJR : ∀ (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)), (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalRepresentation d n) U * J = J * R U)
  (hKS : ∀ (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)), (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalRepresentation d n) U * K = K * S U)
  (F : Matrix B A ℂ),
  (∀ (i j : Fin d),
      F * (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.restrictedGenerators R J hJ hJR).E i j =
        (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.restrictedGenerators S K hK hKS).E i j * F) →
    ∀ (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)), F * R U = S U * F

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.restricted_invariant_of_generators
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} {A : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : DecidableEq A]
  (R : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ) →* Matrix A A ℂ) (J : Matrix (Fin n → Fin d) A ℂ) (hJ : J.conjTranspose * J = 1)
  (hJR : ∀ (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)), (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalRepresentation d n) U * J = J * R U)
  (S : Submodule ℂ (A → ℂ)),
  (∀ (i j : Fin d), ∀ x ∈ S, ((FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.restrictedGenerators R J hJ hJR).E i j).mulVec x ∈ S) →
    ∀ (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)), ∀ x ∈ S, (R U).mulVec x ∈ S

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.restriction_unitary
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} {A : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : DecidableEq A]
  (R : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ) →* Matrix A A ℂ) (J : Matrix (Fin n → Fin d) A ℂ),
  J.conjTranspose * J = 1 →
    (∀ (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)), (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalRepresentation d n) U * J = J * R U) →
      ∀ (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)), (R U).conjTranspose * R U = 1

  (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorCanonicalUnitary i).conjTranspose * FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorCanonicalUnitary i = 1 ∧
