    FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorJointEigenvalue i a j • ((FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorJointBasis i) a).ofLp

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorJointEigenvalue
declarations.statement: {d n : ℕ} → (i : ↥(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.Sector d n)) → FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.SectorSpace d n i → Fin d → ℂ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorJointEigenvalue_eq_weight
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} (i : ↥(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.Sector d n)) (a : FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.SectorSpace d n i) (j : Fin d),
  FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorJointEigenvalue i a j = ↑(↑(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorWeight i a) j)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorJointEigenvalue_is_occupation
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} (i : ↥(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.Sector d n)) (a : FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.SectorSpace d n i),
  ∃ (w : FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n),
    ∀ (j : Fin d), FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorJointEigenvalue i a j = ↑(↑w j)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorOrbitForward
declarations.statement:
{d n : ℕ} →
  {M : Type u_1} →
    [inst : Fintype M] →
      (i : ↥(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.Sector d n)) →
        FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel
            (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex ↑(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorHighestOccupation i)) M →
          FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.SectorSpace d n i) M

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorOrbitForward_state
declarations.statement:
∀ {d r : ℕ} {M : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype M] [DecidableEq M] (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r) (n : ℕ)
  (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)),
  ∀ i ∈ FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalTypical s n,
    ∀
      (F :
        FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel
          (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex ↑(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorHighestOccupation i)) M),
      (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorOrbitForward i F).toFun (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalSectorState s n U i) =
        F.toFun
          (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalOrbitState s (↑(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorHighestOccupation i))
            U)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorOrbitReverse
declarations.statement:
{d n : ℕ} →
  {M : Type u_1} →
    [inst : Fintype M] →
      (i : ↥(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.Sector d n)) →
        FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel M
            (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex ↑(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorHighestOccupation i)) →
          FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel M (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.SectorSpace d n i)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorOrbitReverse_error
declarations.statement:
∀ {d r : ℕ} {M : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype M] [DecidableEq M] (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r) (n : ℕ)
  (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)),
  ∀ i ∈ FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalTypical s n,
    ∀
      (G :
        FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel M
          (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex ↑(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorHighestOccupation i)))
      {τ : Matrix M M ℂ},
      τ.PosSemidef →
        FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance ((FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorOrbitReverse i G).toFun τ)
            (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalSectorState s n U i) =
          FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance (G.toFun τ)
            (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalOrbitState s
              (↑(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorHighestOccupation i)) U)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorProbability
declarations.statement: {d : ℕ} → (n : ℕ) → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ → ↥(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.Sector d n) → ℝ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorProbability_diagonal
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} (i : ↥(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.Sector d n)) (x : Fin d → ℝ),
  FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorProbability n (Matrix.diagonal fun (j : Fin d) => ↑(x j)) i =
    ∑ a : FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.SectorSpace d n i,
      FreeEntropy.WordTypes.monomial (↑(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorWeight i a)) x

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorProbability_le_highest
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} (i : ↥(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.Sector d n)) (x : Fin d → ℝ),
  (∀ (j : Fin d), 0 ≤ x j) →
    Antitone x →
      FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorProbability n (Matrix.diagonal fun (j : Fin d) => ↑(x j)) i ≤
        ↑(Fintype.card (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.SectorSpace d n i)) *
          FreeEntropy.WordTypes.monomial (↑(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorHighestOccupation i)) x

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorProbability_nonneg
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (n : ℕ) {ρ : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ},
  ρ.PosSemidef → ∀ (i : ↥(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.Sector d n)), 0 ≤ FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorProbability n ρ i

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorProbability_sum
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (n : ℕ) {ρ : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ},
  ρ.PosSemidef →
    ρ.trace = 1 → ∑ i : ↥(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.Sector d n), FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorProbability n ρ i = 1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorProbability_sum_grouped
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} (x : Fin d → ℝ) (p : FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n → Prop),
  ∑ i : ↥(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.Sector d n) with p (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorHighestOccupation i),
      FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorProbability n (Matrix.diagonal fun (j : Fin d) => ↑(x j)) i =
    ∑ lam : FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n with p lam, FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.highestSectorMass lam x

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorProbability_unitary_conjugate
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} (i : ↥(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.Sector d n)) (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ))
  (ρ : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ),
  FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorProbability n (↑U * ρ * (↑U).conjTranspose) i =
    FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorProbability n ρ i

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorState
declarations.statement:
{d : ℕ} →
  (n : ℕ) →
    Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ →
      (i : ↥(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.Sector d n)) →
        Matrix (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.SectorSpace d n i) (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.SectorSpace d n i) ℂ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorState_canonical
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} (i : ↥(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.Sector d n)) {ρ : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ},
  ρ.IsHermitian →
    FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorCanonicalUnitary i * FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorState n ρ i *
        (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorCanonicalUnitary i).conjTranspose =
      FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.canonicalTensorState (↑(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorHighestOccupation i)) ρ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorState_canonicalWeight
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} (i : ↥(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.Sector d n)) {ρ : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ},
  ρ.IsHermitian →
    FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorWeightCanonicalUnitary i * FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorState n ρ i *
        (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorWeightCanonicalUnitary i).conjTranspose =
      FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.canonicalWeightTensorState (↑(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorHighestOccupation i)) ρ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorState_canonical_pullback
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} (i : ↥(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.Sector d n)) {ρ : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ},
  ρ.IsHermitian →
    FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorState n ρ i =
      (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorCanonicalUnitary i).conjTranspose *
          FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.canonicalTensorState (↑(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorHighestOccupation i)) ρ *
        FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorCanonicalUnitary i

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorState_positive
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (n : ℕ) {ρ : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ},
  ρ.PosSemidef → ∀ (i : ↥(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.Sector d n)), (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorState n ρ i).PosSemidef

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorState_trace
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (n : ℕ) {ρ : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ},
  ρ.PosSemidef → ∀ (i : ↥(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.Sector d n)), (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorState n ρ i).trace = 1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorWeight
declarations.statement:
{d n : ℕ} →
  (i : ↥(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.Sector d n)) →
    FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.SectorSpace d n i → FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorWeightCanonicalUnitary
declarations.statement:
{d n : ℕ} →
  (i : ↥(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.Sector d n)) →
    Matrix (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex ↑(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorHighestOccupation i))
      (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.SectorSpace d n i) ℂ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorWeightCanonicalUnitary_coisometry
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} (i : ↥(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.Sector d n)),
  FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorWeightCanonicalUnitary i *
      (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorWeightCanonicalUnitary i).conjTranspose =
    1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorWeightCanonicalUnitary_isometry
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} (i : ↥(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.Sector d n)),
  (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorWeightCanonicalUnitary i).conjTranspose *
      FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorWeightCanonicalUnitary i =
    1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorWeightCoefficients
declarations.statement: {d n : ℕ} → (i : ↥(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.Sector d n)) → FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.SectorSpace d n i → Fin (d - 1) → ℕ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorWeightCoefficients_spec
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} (i : ↥(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.Sector d n)) (b : FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.SectorSpace d n i),
  ((fun (j : Fin d) => ↑(↑(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorHighestOccupation i) j)) - fun (j : Fin d) =>
      ↑(↑(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorWeight i b) j)) =
    FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.offset (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorWeightCoefficients i b)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorWeightEmbedding
declarations.statement:
{d n : ℕ} →
  (i : ↥(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.Sector d n)) → Matrix (Fin n → Fin d) (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.SectorSpace d n i) ℂ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorWeightEmbedding_generators
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} (i : ↥(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.Sector d n)) (j k : Fin d),
  (FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.generators d n).E j k * FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorWeightEmbedding i =
    FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorWeightEmbedding i * (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorWeightGenerators i).E j k

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorWeightEmbedding_isometry
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} (i : ↥(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.Sector d n)),
  (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorWeightEmbedding i).conjTranspose * FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorWeightEmbedding i = 1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorWeightEmbedding_orthogonal
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} (i j : ↥(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.Sector d n)),
  i ≠ j →
    (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorWeightEmbedding i).conjTranspose * FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorWeightEmbedding j = 0

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorWeightEmbedding_source
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} (i : ↥(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.Sector d n)) (z : Fin d → ℂ),
  FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.matrix n (Matrix.diagonal z) * FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorWeightEmbedding i =
    FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorWeightEmbedding i *
      Matrix.diagonal fun (a : FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.SectorSpace d n i) =>
        FreeEntropy.Occupation.character z (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorWeight i a)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorWeightEmbedding_supported
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} (i : ↥(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.Sector d n)) (a : FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.SectorSpace d n i) (w : Fin n → Fin d),
  FreeEntropy.WordTypes.content w ≠ ↑(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorWeight i a) →
    FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorWeightEmbedding i w a = 0

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorWeightGenerators
declarations.statement:
{d n : ℕ} →
  (i : ↥(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.Sector d n)) →
    FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.SectorSpace d n i)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorWeightGenerators_diagonal
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} (i : ↥(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.Sector d n)) (j : Fin d),
  (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorWeightGenerators i).E j j =
    Matrix.diagonal fun (a : FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.SectorSpace d n i) => ↑(↑(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorWeight i a) j)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorWeightHighestVector
declarations.statement: {d n : ℕ} → (i : ↥(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.Sector d n)) → FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.SectorSpace d n i → ℂ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorWeightHighestVector_spec
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} (i : ↥(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.Sector d n)),
  FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorWeightHighestVector i ≠ 0 ∧
    Antitone ↑(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorHighestOccupation i) ∧
      (∀ (j : Fin d),
          ((FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorWeightGenerators i).E j j).mulVec
              (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorWeightHighestVector i) =
            ↑(↑(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorHighestOccupation i) j) •
              FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorWeightHighestVector i) ∧
        (∀ (j k : Fin d),
            j < k →
              ((FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorWeightGenerators i).E j k).mulVec
                  (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorWeightHighestVector i) =
                0) ∧
          FreeEntropy.LiePBW.cyclicSpan (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorWeightGenerators i)
              (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorWeightHighestVector i) =
            ⊤

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorWeightModel
declarations.statement:
{d n : ℕ} →
  (i : ↥(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.Sector d n)) →
    FreeEntropy.CartanLieCloning.CyclicWeightModel d (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.SectorSpace d n i)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorWeightModel_generators
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} (i : ↥(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.Sector d n)),
  (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorWeightModel i).generators = FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorWeightGenerators i

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorWeightModel_row
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} (i : ↥(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.Sector d n)) (j : Fin d),
  (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorWeightModel i).row j = ↑(↑(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorHighestOccupation i) j)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorWeightModel_weight
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} (i : ↥(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.Sector d n)) (b : FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.SectorSpace d n i) (j : Fin d),
  (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorWeightModel i).weight b j = ↑(↑(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorWeight i b) j)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorWeightUnitary
declarations.statement:
{d n : ℕ} →
  (i : ↥(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.Sector d n)) →
    Matrix (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.SectorSpace d n i) (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.SectorSpace d n i) ℂ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorWeightUnitary_coisometry
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} (i : ↥(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.Sector d n)),
  FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorWeightUnitary i * (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorWeightUnitary i).conjTranspose = 1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorWeightUnitary_diagonal
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} (i : ↥(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.Sector d n)) (j : Fin d),
  (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorWeightUnitary i).conjTranspose * (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorGenerators i).E j j *
      FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorWeightUnitary i =
    Matrix.diagonal fun (a : FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.SectorSpace d n i) => ↑(↑(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorWeight i a) j)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorWeightUnitary_isometry
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} (i : ↥(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.Sector d n)),
  (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorWeightUnitary i).conjTranspose * FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorWeightUnitary i = 1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorWeight_in_root_cone
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} (i : ↥(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.Sector d n)) (b : FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.SectorSpace d n i),
  ∃ (c : Fin (d - 1) → ℕ),
    ((fun (j : Fin d) => ↑(↑(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorHighestOccupation i) j)) - fun (j : Fin d) =>
        ↑(↑(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorWeight i b) j)) =
      FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.offset c

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sector_card_le_pbw_polynomial
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} (i : ↥(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.Sector d n)),
  Fintype.card (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.SectorSpace d n i) ≤ (n * (d - 1) + 1) ^ d.choose 2

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sector_card_le_polynomial
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} (i : ↥(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.Sector d n)),
  Fintype.card (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.SectorSpace d n i) ≤ (n + 1) ^ ((d - 1) * d.choose 2)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sector_cyclicSpan_eq_top
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} (i : ↥(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.Sector d n)) (v : FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.SectorSpace d n i → ℂ),
  v ≠ 0 → FreeEntropy.LiePBW.cyclicSpan (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorGenerators i) v = ⊤

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sector_highestBasis_occupation
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} (i : ↥(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.Sector d n)),
  FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorWeight i (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorWeightModel i).highestBasis =
    FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorHighestOccupation i

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sector_monomial_le_highest
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} (i : ↥(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.Sector d n)) (a : FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.SectorSpace d n i) (x : Fin d → ℝ),
  (∀ (j : Fin d), 0 ≤ x j) →
    Antitone x →
      FreeEntropy.WordTypes.monomial (↑(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorWeight i a)) x ≤
        FreeEntropy.WordTypes.monomial (↑(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorHighestOccupation i)) x

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorsAt_card_le_words
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} (lam : FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n),
  Fintype.card (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.SectorsAt lam) ≤ Fintype.card (FreeEntropy.WordTypes.Words ↑lam)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.source_block_canonical
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} {A : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : DecidableEq A]
  (R : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ) →* Matrix A A ℂ) (J : Matrix (Fin n → Fin d) A ℂ),
  J.conjTranspose * J = 1 →
    (∀ (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)), (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalRepresentation d n) U * J = J * R U) →
      ∀ (mu : Fin d → ℕ),
        FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.tensorDegree mu = n →
          ∀ (W : Matrix (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex mu) A ℂ),
            W.conjTranspose * W = 1 →
              W * W.conjTranspose = 1 →
                (∀ (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)),
                    W * R U = (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.irrepMatrix mu) U * W) →
                  ∀ {ρ : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ},
                    ρ.IsHermitian →
                      W * (J.conjTranspose * FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.matrix n ρ * J) * W.conjTranspose =
                        FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.canonicalTensorSource mu ρ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.source_block_sum
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} {ι : Type u_3} [inst : Fintype ι] {D : ι → Type u_4} [inst_1 : (i : ι) → Fintype (D i)]
  [inst_2 : (i : ι) → DecidableEq (D i)] (R : (i : ι) → ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ) →* Matrix (D i) (D i) ℂ)
  (J : (i : ι) → Matrix (Fin n → Fin d) (D i) ℂ),
  (∀ (i : ι), (J i).conjTranspose * J i = 1) →
    (∀ (i : ι) (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)),
        (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalRepresentation d n) U * J i = J i * (R i) U) →
      ∑ i : ι, J i * (J i).conjTranspose = 1 →
        ∀ {ρ : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ},
          ρ.IsHermitian →
            FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.matrix n ρ =
              ∑ i : ι, J i * ((J i).conjTranspose * FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.matrix n ρ * J i) * (J i).conjTranspose

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.source_block_unitary
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} {A : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : DecidableEq A] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq B] (R : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ) →* Matrix A A ℂ)
  (S : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ) →* Matrix B B ℂ) (J : Matrix (Fin n → Fin d) A ℂ)
  (K : Matrix (Fin n → Fin d) B ℂ),
  J.conjTranspose * J = 1 →
    K.conjTranspose * K = 1 →
      (∀ (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)), (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalRepresentation d n) U * J = J * R U) →
        (∀ (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)), (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalRepresentation d n) U * K = K * S U) →
          ∀ (W : Matrix B A ℂ),
            W.conjTranspose * W = 1 →
              W * W.conjTranspose = 1 →
                (∀ (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)), W * R U = S U * W) →
                  ∀ {ρ : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ},
                    ρ.IsHermitian →
                      W * (J.conjTranspose * FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.matrix n ρ * J) * W.conjTranspose =
                        K.conjTranspose * FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.matrix n ρ * K

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.source_blocks_equal
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} {A : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : DecidableEq A]
  (R : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ) →* Matrix A A ℂ) (J K : Matrix (Fin n → Fin d) A ℂ),
  J.conjTranspose * J = 1 →
    K.conjTranspose * K = 1 →
      (∀ (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)), (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalRepresentation d n) U * J = J * R U) →
        (∀ (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)), (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalRepresentation d n) U * K = K * R U) →
          ∀ {ρ : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ},
            ρ.IsHermitian →
              J.conjTranspose * FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.matrix n ρ * J =
                K.conjTranspose * FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.matrix n ρ * K

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.source_compressed_positive
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} {A : Type u_1} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (J : Matrix (Fin n → Fin d) A ℂ) {ρ : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ},
  ρ.PosSemidef → (J.conjTranspose * FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.matrix n ρ * J).PosSemidef

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.source_crossBlock_zero
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} {A : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [inst : Fintype B] [inst_1 : DecidableEq B]
  (R : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ) →* Matrix B B ℂ) (J : Matrix (Fin n → Fin d) A ℂ)
  (K : Matrix (Fin n → Fin d) B ℂ),
  K.conjTranspose * K = 1 →
    J.conjTranspose * K = 0 →
      (∀ (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)), (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalRepresentation d n) U * K = K * R U) →
        ∀ {ρ : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ}, ρ.IsHermitian → J.conjTranspose * FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.matrix n ρ * K = 0

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.source_intertwines
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} {A : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : DecidableEq A]
  (R : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ) →* Matrix A A ℂ) (J : Matrix (Fin n → Fin d) A ℂ),
  J.conjTranspose * J = 1 →
    (∀ (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)), (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalRepresentation d n) U * J = J * R U) →
      ∀ {ρ : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ},
        ρ.IsHermitian →
          FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.matrix n ρ * J = J * (J.conjTranspose * FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.matrix n ρ * J)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.source_multiplicity_identity
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} {A : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : DecidableEq A] [Fintype M]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq M] (R : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ) →* Matrix A A ℂ) (J : M → Matrix (Fin n → Fin d) A ℂ)
  (i₀ : M),
  (∀ (a : M), (J a).conjTranspose * J a = 1) →
    (∀ (a b : M), a ≠ b → (J a).conjTranspose * J b = 0) →
      (∀ (a : M) (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)),
          (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalRepresentation d n) U * J a = J a * R U) →
        ∀ {ρ : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ},
          ρ.IsHermitian →
            (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.multiplicityEmbedding J).conjTranspose * FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.matrix n ρ *
                FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.multiplicityEmbedding J =
              Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun (x1 x2 : ℂ) => x1 * x2)
                ((J i₀).conjTranspose * FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.matrix n ρ * J i₀) 1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.source_multiplicity_normalized
declarations.statement:
∀ {A : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : DecidableEq A] [Nonempty A] [inst_3 : Fintype M]
  [inst_4 : DecidableEq M] [Nonempty M] {d n : ℕ} (R : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ) →* Matrix A A ℂ)
  (J : M → Matrix (Fin n → Fin d) A ℂ) (i₀ : M),
  (∀ (a : M), (J a).conjTranspose * J a = 1) →
    (∀ (a b : M), a ≠ b → (J a).conjTranspose * J b = 0) →
      (∀ (a : M) (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)),
          (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalRepresentation d n) U * J a = J a * R U) →
        ∀ {ρ : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ},
          ρ.PosSemidef →
            (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.multiplicityEmbedding J).conjTranspose * FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.matrix n ρ *
                FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.multiplicityEmbedding J =
              (↑(Fintype.card M) *
                  FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr ((J i₀).conjTranspose * FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.matrix n ρ * J i₀)) •
                Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun (x1 x2 : ℂ) => x1 * x2)
                  (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.normalizedBlock
                    ((J i₀).conjTranspose * FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.matrix n ρ * J i₀))
                  (FreeEntropy.MultiplicityChannels.maximallyMixed M)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.supported_torus_eigenvector
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} (a : FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n) (v : (Fin n → Fin d) → ℂ),
  (∀ (w : Fin n → Fin d), FreeEntropy.WordTypes.content w ≠ ↑a → v w = 0) →
    ∀ (z : Fin d → ℂ) (hz : ∀ (i : Fin d), ‖z i‖ = 1),
      (FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.matrix n ↑(FreeEntropy.Occupation.diagonalUnitary z hz)).mulVec v =
        FreeEntropy.Occupation.character z a • v

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.targetCanonicalRow_supported
declarations.statement:
∀ {d r : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r) (n : ℕ) (j : Fin d),
  r ≤ ↑j → FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.targetCanonicalRow s n j = 0

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.tensorCommutant_iff_generators
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} (T : Matrix (Fin n → Fin d) (Fin n → Fin d) ℂ),
  FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.TensorCommutant T ↔
    ∀ (i j : Fin d),
      T * (FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.generators d n).E i j = (FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.generators d n).E i j * T

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.tensorVector_eq_character
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} (z : Fin d → ℂ) (w : Fin n → Fin d),
  FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.vector n z w = FreeEntropy.Occupation.character z (FreeEntropy.Occupation.ofWord w)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.theorem1_physical_achievability_of_comparison
declarations.statement:
∀ {d r : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r),
  2 ≤ d →
    ∀
      (A :
        (n : ℕ) →
          FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel (Fin n → Fin d)
            (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.targetCanonicalRow s n)))
      (R :
        (n : ℕ) →
          FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel
            (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.targetCanonicalRow s n))
            (Fin n → Fin d))
      (f g : ℕ → ℝ),
      (∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
          ∀ (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)),
            FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance ((A n).toFun (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalSource s n U))
                (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalOrbitState s
                  (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.targetCanonicalRow s n) U) ≤
              f n) →
        (∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
            ∀ (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)),
              FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance
                  ((R n).toFun
                    (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalOrbitState s
                      (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.targetCanonicalRow s n) U))
                  (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalSource s n U) ≤
                g n) →
          (fun (n : ℕ) => f n + g n) =O[Filter.atTop] FreeEntropy.Weyl.errorScale →
            Filter.Tendsto
                (fun (n : ℕ) =>
                  Real.logb 2 ↑(FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.targetCanonicalDimension s n) -
                    FreeEntropy.Weyl.qmdl d r s.eigenvalue n)
                Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
              (fun (n : ℕ) => FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.mixedWorstError s n (A n) (R n)) =O[Filter.atTop]
                  FreeEntropy.Weyl.errorScale ∧
                Filter.Tendsto (fun (n : ℕ) => FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.mixedWorstError s n (A n) (R n)) Filter.atTop
                  (nhds 0)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.theorem1_physical_converse_of_comparison
declarations.statement:
∀ {d r : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r),
  2 ≤ d →
    ∀ (memory : ℕ → ℕ) (E : (n : ℕ) → FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel (Fin n → Fin d) (Fin (memory n)))
      (D : (n : ℕ) → FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel (Fin (memory n)) (Fin n → Fin d))
      (A :
        (n : ℕ) →
          FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel (Fin n → Fin d)
            (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.targetCanonicalRow s n)))
      (R :
        (n : ℕ) →
          FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel
            (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.targetCanonicalRow s n))
            (Fin n → Fin d))
      (f g : ℕ → ℝ),
      (∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
          ∀ (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)),
            FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance ((A n).toFun (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalSource s n U))
                (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalOrbitState s
                  (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.targetCanonicalRow s n) U) ≤
              f n) →
        (∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
            ∀ (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)),
              FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance
                  ((R n).toFun
                    (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalOrbitState s
                      (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.targetCanonicalRow s n) U))
                  (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalSource s n U) ≤
                g n) →
          (fun (n : ℕ) => f n + g n) =O[Filter.atTop] FreeEntropy.Weyl.errorScale →
            Filter.Tendsto (fun (n : ℕ) => FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.mixedAverageError s n (E n) (D n)) Filter.atTop
                (nhds 0) →
              0 ≤
                Filter.liminf (fun (n : ℕ) => ↑(Real.logb 2 ↑(memory n) - FreeEntropy.Weyl.qmdl d r s.eigenvalue n))
                  Filter.atTop

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.theorem1_scalar_achievability
declarations.statement:
∀ {r : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum 1 r),
  Filter.Tendsto (fun (n : ℕ) => Real.logb 2 1 - FreeEntropy.Weyl.qmdl 1 r s.eigenvalue n) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
    (fun (n : ℕ) =>
          FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.mixedWorstError s n (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.scalarSourceEncoder n)
            (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.scalarSourceDecoder n)) =O[Filter.atTop]
        FreeEntropy.Weyl.errorScale ∧
      Filter.Tendsto
        (fun (n : ℕ) =>
          FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.mixedWorstError s n (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.scalarSourceEncoder n)
            (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.scalarSourceDecoder n))
        Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.theorem1_scalar_converse
declarations.statement:
∀ {r : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum 1 r) (memory : ℕ → ℕ)
  (E : (n : ℕ) → FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel (Fin n → Fin 1) (Fin (memory n))),
  0 ≤ Filter.liminf (fun (n : ℕ) => ↑(Real.logb 2 ↑(memory n) - FreeEntropy.Weyl.qmdl 1 r s.eigenvalue n)) Filter.atTop

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.torus_eigenvector_supported
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} (a : FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n) (v : (Fin n → Fin d) → ℂ),
  (∀ (z : Fin d → ℂ) (hz : ∀ (i : Fin d), ‖z i‖ = 1),
      (FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.matrix n ↑(FreeEntropy.Occupation.diagonalUnitary z hz)).mulVec v =
        FreeEntropy.Occupation.character z a • v) →
    ∀ (w : Fin n → Fin d), FreeEntropy.WordTypes.content w ≠ ↑a → v w = 0

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.torus_intertwiner_support
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} {B : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype B] [inst_1 : DecidableEq B] (J : Matrix (Fin n → Fin d) B ℂ)
  (weight : B → Fin d → ℕ),
  (∀ (z : Fin d → ℂ),
      (∀ (i : Fin d), ‖z i‖ = 1) →
        FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.matrix n (Matrix.diagonal z) * J =
          J * Matrix.diagonal fun (b : B) => FreeEntropy.TorusWeights.character z (weight b)) →
    ∀ (w : Fin n → Fin d) (b : B), FreeEntropy.WordTypes.content w ≠ weight b → J w b = 0

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.trace_one_subsingleton_state
declarations.statement:
∀ {A : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : DecidableEq A] [Subsingleton A] (a : A) (X : Matrix A A ℂ),
  X.trace = 1 → X = FreeEntropy.SpectralProjector.coordinateProjection a

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.typicalCanonical_differenceNorm_pos
declarations.statement:
∀ {d r : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r) (n : ℕ),
  1 ≤ n →
    ∀ (lam : FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n),
      FreeEntropy.TypicalRows.Typical s n (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.occupationRow lam) →
        1 ≤
          FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.differenceNorm (↑lam)
            (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.targetCanonicalRow s n)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.typicalCanonical_distance_ge_one
declarations.statement:
∀ {d r : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r) (n : ℕ),
  1 ≤ n →
    ∀ (lam : FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n),
      FreeEntropy.TypicalRows.Typical s n (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.occupationRow lam) →
        1 ≤ FreeEntropy.Weyl.rowL1 d fun (j : ℕ) => s.targetRow n j - ↑(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.occupationRow lam j)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.typicalCanonical_envelope_le
declarations.statement:
∀ {d r : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r) (hd : 2 ≤ d) (K : ℝ),
  0 ≤ K →
    ∀ (n : ℕ),
      2 ≤ n →
        ∀ (lam : FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n),
          FreeEntropy.TypicalRows.Typical s n (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.occupationRow lam) →
            (K *
                  FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.l1 fun (j : Fin d) =>
                    ↑(FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.targetCanonicalRow s n j) - ↑(↑lam j)) /
                (↑n * FreeEntropy.TypicalRows.minimumGap s hd / 2 + 1) ≤
              2 * K * (↑r * (3 * ↑r + 2)) / FreeEntropy.TypicalRows.minimumGap s hd * FreeEntropy.Weyl.errorScale n

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.typicalCanonical_eventually_gaps
declarations.statement:
∀ {d r : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r) (hd : 2 ≤ d),
  ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
    ∀ (lam : FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n),
      FreeEntropy.TypicalRows.Typical s n (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.occupationRow lam) →
        ∀ (j : Fin (d - 1)),
          ↑j < r →
            ↑n * FreeEntropy.TypicalRows.minimumGap s hd / 2 ≤
                ↑(↑lam (FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.left j)) - ↑(↑lam (FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.right j)) ∧
              ↑n * FreeEntropy.TypicalRows.minimumGap s hd / 2 ≤
                ↑(FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.targetCanonicalRow s n (FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.left j)) -
                  ↑(FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.targetCanonicalRow s n (FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.right j))

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.typicalCanonical_eventually_minimumGap
declarations.statement:
∀ {d r : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r) (hd : 2 ≤ d),
  ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
    ∀ (lam : FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n),
      Antitone ↑lam →
        FreeEntropy.TypicalRows.Typical s n (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.occupationRow lam) →
          ↑n * FreeEntropy.TypicalRows.minimumGap s hd / 2 ≤
            ↑(FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.minimumRowGap (↑lam) r hd ⋯)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.typicalCanonical_increment_antitone
declarations.statement:
∀ {d r : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r) (n : ℕ),
  1 ≤ n →
    ∀ (lam : FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n),
      FreeEntropy.TypicalRows.Typical s n (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.occupationRow lam) →
        Antitone fun (j : Fin d) => ↑(FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.targetCanonicalRow s n j) - ↑(↑lam j)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.typicalCanonical_increment_zero_tail
declarations.statement:
∀ {d r : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r) (n : ℕ) (lam : FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n),
  FreeEntropy.TypicalRows.Typical s n (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.occupationRow lam) →
    ∀ (j : Fin d), r ≤ ↑j → ↑(FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.targetCanonicalRow s n j) - ↑(↑lam j) = 0

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.typicalCanonical_l1_eq
declarations.statement:
∀ {d r : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r) (n : ℕ) (lam : FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n),
  (FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.l1 fun (j : Fin d) =>
      ↑(FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.targetCanonicalRow s n j) - ↑(↑lam j)) =
    FreeEntropy.Weyl.rowL1 d fun (j : ℕ) => s.targetRow n j - ↑(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.occupationRow lam j)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.typicalCanonical_le_target
declarations.statement:
∀ {d r : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r) (n : ℕ),
  1 ≤ n →
    ∀ (lam : FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n),
      FreeEntropy.TypicalRows.Typical s n (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.occupationRow lam) →
        ∀ (j : Fin d), ↑lam j ≤ FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.targetCanonicalRow s n j

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.typicalCanonical_natural_increment_antitone
declarations.statement:
∀ {d r : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r) (n : ℕ),
  1 ≤ n →
    ∀ (lam : FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n),
      FreeEntropy.TypicalRows.Typical s n (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.occupationRow lam) →
        Antitone fun (j : Fin d) => FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.targetCanonicalRow s n j - ↑lam j

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.typicalCanonical_supported
declarations.statement:
∀ {d r : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r) (n : ℕ) (lam : FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n),
  FreeEntropy.TypicalRows.Typical s n (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.occupationRow lam) → ∀ (j : Fin d), r ≤ ↑j → ↑lam j = 0

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.typicalCartanForward
declarations.statement:
{d r : ℕ} →
  (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r) →
    (n : ℕ) →
      (i : ↥(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.Sector d n)) →
        FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel
          (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex ↑(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorHighestOccupation i))
          (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.targetCanonicalRow s n))

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.typicalCartanForward_of_mem
declarations.statement:
∀ {d r : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r) (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (i : ↥(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.Sector d n))
  (hi : i ∈ FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalTypical s n),
  FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.typicalCartanForward s n i =
    FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalForward (↑(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorHighestOccupation i))
      (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.targetCanonicalRow s n) ⋯ ⋯ ⋯

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.typicalCartanReverse
declarations.statement:
{d r : ℕ} →
  (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r) →
    (n : ℕ) →
      (i : ↥(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.Sector d n)) →
        FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel
          (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.targetCanonicalRow s n))
          (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex ↑(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorHighestOccupation i))

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.typicalCartanReverse_of_mem
declarations.statement:
∀ {d r : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r) (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (i : ↥(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.Sector d n))
  (hi : i ∈ FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalTypical s n),

    FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalReverse (↑(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorHighestOccupation i))
      (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.targetCanonicalRow s n) ⋯ ⋯ ⋯

declarations.statement:
∀ {d r : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r) (hd : 2 ≤ d),
  ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
    ∀ i ∈ FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalTypical s n,
      FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance
            ((FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.typicalCartanForward s n i).toFun
              ((FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeightModel
                    ↑(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorHighestOccupation i)).relativeState
                fun (j : Fin (d - 1)) => s.adjacentRatio ↑j))
            ((FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeightModel
                  (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.targetCanonicalRow s n)).relativeState
              fun (j : Fin (d - 1)) => s.adjacentRatio ↑j) ≤
          FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.mixedComparisonConstant s hd * FreeEntropy.Weyl.errorScale n ∧
        FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance
            ((FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.typicalCartanReverse s n i).toFun
              ((FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeightModel
                    (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.targetCanonicalRow s n)).relativeState
                fun (j : Fin (d - 1)) => s.adjacentRatio ↑j))
            ((FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeightModel
                  ↑(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorHighestOccupation i)).relativeState
              fun (j : Fin (d - 1)) => s.adjacentRatio ↑j) ≤
          FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.mixedComparisonConstant s hd * FreeEntropy.Weyl.errorScale n

                (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalOrbitState s
                  (↑(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.sectorHighestOccupation i)) U))
              (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalOrbitState s
                (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.targetCanonicalRow s n) U) ≤
            FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.mixedComparisonConstant s hd * FreeEntropy.Weyl.errorScale n ∧

                (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalOrbitState s
                  (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.targetCanonicalRow s n) U))
              (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalOrbitState s

        [(i : ι) → Fintype (B i)] →
          [(i : ι) → DecidableEq (B i)] →
            (ι → ℝ) → ((i : ι) → Matrix (B i) (B i) ℂ) → Matrix ((i : ι) × B i) ((i : ι) × B i) ℂ

  [inst_3 : (i : ι) → DecidableEq (B i)] (q : ι → ℝ),
  (∀ (i : ι), 0 ≤ q i) →
    ∀ (σ : (i : ι) → Matrix (B i) (B i) ℂ),
      (∀ (i : ι), (σ i).PosSemidef) → (FreeEntropy.SectorProtocol.directSumState q σ).PosSemidef

    ∀ (σ : (i : ι) → Matrix (B i) (B i) ℂ),

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SectorProtocol.directSum_typical_roundtrip_error
declarations.statement:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {M : Type u_3} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : Fintype M] [inst_2 : DecidableEq ι]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq M] {B : ι → Type u_4} [inst_4 : (i : ι) → Fintype (B i)] [inst_5 : (i : ι) → DecidableEq (B i)]
  (F : (i : ι) → FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel (B i) M) (G : (i : ι) → FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel M (B i))
  (q : ι → ℝ) (hq0 : ∀ (i : ι), 0 ≤ q i) (hq1 : ∑ i : ι, q i = 1) (σ : (i : ι) → Matrix (B i) (B i) ℂ),
  (∀ (i : ι), (σ i).PosSemidef) →
    (∀ (i : ι), (σ i).trace = 1) →
      ∀ (τ : Matrix M M ℂ),
        τ.PosSemidef →
          τ.trace = 1 →
            ∀ (typical : Finset ι) (ε : ℝ),
              0 ≤ ε →
                (∀ i ∈ typical, FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance ((F i).toFun (σ i)) τ ≤ ε) →
                  (∀ i ∈ typical, FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance ((G i).toFun τ) (σ i) ≤ ε) →
                    FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance
                        ((FreeEntropy.SectorChannels.directSumDecoder G q hq0 hq1).toFun
                          ((FreeEntropy.SectorChannels.directSumEncoder F).toFun
                            (FreeEntropy.SectorProtocol.directSumState q σ)))
                        (FreeEntropy.SectorProtocol.directSumState q σ) ≤
                      2 * ε + 2 * FreeEntropy.Protocol.outsideMass Finset.univ typical q

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SectorProtocol.sector_roundtrip_error
declarations.statement:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} {M : Type u_3} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : Fintype S] [inst_2 : Fintype M]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq ι] [inst_4 : DecidableEq S] [inst_5 : DecidableEq M] {B : ι → Type u_4}
  [inst_6 : (i : ι) → Fintype (B i)] [inst_7 : (i : ι) → DecidableEq (B i)] (J : (i : ι) → Matrix S (B i) ℂ)
  (F : (i : ι) → FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel (B i) M) (G : (i : ι) → FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel M (B i))
  (hresolve : ∑ i : ι, J i * (J i).conjTranspose = 1) (hJ : ∀ (i : ι), (J i).conjTranspose * J i = 1),
  (∀ (i j : ι), i ≠ j → (J i).conjTranspose * J j = 0) →
    ∀ (q : ι → ℝ) (hq0 : ∀ (i : ι), 0 ≤ q i) (hq1 : ∑ i : ι, q i = 1) (σ : (i : ι) → Matrix (B i) (B i) ℂ),
      (∀ (i : ι), (σ i).PosSemidef) →
        ∀ (τ : Matrix M M ℂ),
          τ.PosSemidef →
            FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance
                ((FreeEntropy.SectorChannels.decoder J G q hJ hq0 hq1).toFun
                  ((FreeEntropy.SectorChannels.encoder J F hresolve).toFun
                    (∑ i : ι, q i • FreeEntropy.SectorChannels.embed (J i) (σ i))))
                (∑ i : ι, q i • FreeEntropy.SectorChannels.embed (J i) (σ i)) ≤
              ∑ i : ι, q i * FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance ((F i).toFun (σ i)) τ +
                ∑ i : ι, q i * FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance ((G i).toFun τ) (σ i)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.SectorProtocol.typical_sector_roundtrip_error
declarations.statement:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} {M : Type u_3} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : Fintype S] [inst_2 : Fintype M]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq ι] [inst_4 : DecidableEq S] [inst_5 : DecidableEq M] {B : ι → Type u_4}
  [inst_6 : (i : ι) → Fintype (B i)] [inst_7 : (i : ι) → DecidableEq (B i)] (J : (i : ι) → Matrix S (B i) ℂ)
  (F : (i : ι) → FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel (B i) M) (G : (i : ι) → FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel M (B i))
  (hresolve : ∑ i : ι, J i * (J i).conjTranspose = 1) (hJ : ∀ (i : ι), (J i).conjTranspose * J i = 1),
  (∀ (i j : ι), i ≠ j → (J i).conjTranspose * J j = 0) →
    ∀ (q : ι → ℝ) (hq0 : ∀ (i : ι), 0 ≤ q i) (hq1 : ∑ i : ι, q i = 1) (σ : (i : ι) → Matrix (B i) (B i) ℂ),
      (∀ (i : ι), (σ i).PosSemidef) →
        (∀ (i : ι), (σ i).trace = 1) →
          ∀ (τ : Matrix M M ℂ),
            τ.PosSemidef →
              τ.trace = 1 →
                ∀ (typical : Finset ι) (ε : ℝ),
                  0 ≤ ε →
                    (∀ i ∈ typical, FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance ((F i).toFun (σ i)) τ ≤ ε) →
                      (∀ i ∈ typical, FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance ((G i).toFun τ) (σ i) ≤ ε) →
                        FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance
                            ((FreeEntropy.SectorChannels.decoder J G q hJ hq0 hq1).toFun
                              ((FreeEntropy.SectorChannels.encoder J F hresolve).toFun
                                (∑ i : ι, q i • FreeEntropy.SectorChannels.embed (J i) (σ i))))
                            (∑ i : ι, q i • FreeEntropy.SectorChannels.embed (J i) (σ i)) ≤
                          2 * ε + 2 * FreeEntropy.Protocol.outsideMass Finset.univ typical q

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.pairEmbedding
declarations.statement:
{d n m : ℕ} →
  {A : Type u_1} →
    {B : Type u_2} → Matrix (Fin n → Fin d) A ℂ → Matrix (Fin m → Fin d) B ℂ → Matrix (Fin (n + m) → Fin d) (A × B) ℂ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.pairEmbedding_generators
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n m : ℕ} {A : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : DecidableEq A] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq B] (J : Matrix (Fin n → Fin d) A ℂ) (K : Matrix (Fin m → Fin d) B ℂ)
  (E : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d A) (F : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d B),
  (∀ (i j : Fin d), (FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.generators d n).E i j * J = J * E.E i j) →
    (∀ (i j : Fin d), (FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.generators d m).E i j * K = K * F.E i j) →
      ∀ (i j : Fin d),
        (FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.generators d (n + m)).E i j * FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.pairEmbedding J K =
          FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.pairEmbedding J K * (E.tensor F).E i j

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.pairEmbedding_intertwines
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n m : ℕ} {A : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [inst_2 : Fintype B] [DecidableEq B]
  (J : Matrix (Fin n → Fin d) A ℂ) (K : Matrix (Fin m → Fin d) B ℂ) (U : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) (R : Matrix A A ℂ)
  (S : Matrix B B ℂ),
  FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.matrix n U * J = J * R →
    FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.matrix m U * K = K * S →
      FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.matrix (n + m) U * FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.pairEmbedding J K =
        FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.pairEmbedding J K * Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun (x1 x2 : ℂ) => x1 * x2) R S

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.pairEmbedding_isometry
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n m : ℕ} {A : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} [Fintype A] [inst : DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [inst_2 : DecidableEq B]
  (J : Matrix (Fin n → Fin d) A ℂ) (K : Matrix (Fin m → Fin d) B ℂ),
  J.conjTranspose * J = 1 →
    K.conjTranspose * K = 1 →
      (FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.pairEmbedding J K).conjTranspose * FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.pairEmbedding J K = 1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.pairFlatten
declarations.statement: {d n m : ℕ} → Matrix (Fin (n + m) → Fin d) ((Fin n → Fin d) × (Fin m → Fin d)) ℂ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.pairFlatten_differential
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n m : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ),
  FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.differential (n + m) A * FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.pairFlatten =
    FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.pairFlatten *
      (Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun (x1 x2 : ℂ) => x1 * x2) (FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.differential n A) 1 +
        Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun (x1 x2 : ℂ) => x1 * x2) 1 (FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.differential m A))

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.pairFlatten_differential_entry

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Theorem2.cloningConstant
declarations.statement: ℕ → ℕ → ℝ → ℝ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Theorem2.cloningConstant_nonneg
declarations.statement: ∀ (d r : ℕ) (q : ℝ), 0 ≤ q → q < 1 → 0 ≤ FreeEntropy.Theorem2.cloningConstant d r q

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Theorem2.theorem2_finite_reduction
declarations.statement:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} (s : Finset ι) (depth m n : ι → ℕ) (pμ pν : ι → ℝ) (d r D g : ℕ) (b q Ef Er dimRatio Z : ℝ),
  2 ≤ r →
    0 ≤ q →
      q < 1 →
        0 ≤ b →
          b ≤ ↑g →
            (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ pμ i) →
              (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ pν i) →
                (∀ i ∈ s, m i ≤ n i) →
                  (∀ i ∈ s, depth i ≤ g → m i = n i) →
                    ∑ i ∈ s, pμ i * ↑(m i) = 1 →
                      ∑ i ∈ s, pν i * ↑(n i) = 1 →
                        (∀ i ∈ s, pν i = Z * pμ i) →
                          (∀ i ∈ s, pμ i ≤ q ^ depth i) →
                            (∀ i ∈ s, pν i ≤ q ^ depth i) →
                              (∀ (t : ℕ),
                                  ∑ i ∈ s with depth i = t, m i ≤ (t + r.choose 2 - 1).choose (r.choose 2 - 1)) →
                                (∀ (t : ℕ),
                                    ∑ i ∈ s with depth i = t, n i ≤ (t + r.choose 2 - 1).choose (r.choose 2 - 1)) →
                                  1 - dimRatio ≤ ↑(d.choose 2) * ↑D / (b + 1) →
                                    (D = 0 → Ef = 0 ∧ Er = 0) →
                                      Ef ≤ 1 - dimRatio + FreeEntropy.Cloning.blockDeficit s depth n pν D g →
                                        Er ≤ 1 - Z + FreeEntropy.Cloning.blockDeficit s depth m pμ D g →
                                          Ef ≤ FreeEntropy.Theorem2.cloningConstant d r q * ↑D / (b + 1) ∧
                                            Er ≤ FreeEntropy.Theorem2.cloningConstant d r q * ↑D / (b + 1)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Theorem2.theorem2_rank_one
declarations.statement:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} (s : Finset ι) (depth m n : ι → ℕ) (pμ pν : ι → ℝ) (d D g : ℕ) (b Ef Er dimRatio Z : ℝ),
  (∀ i ∈ s, depth i = 0) →
    Z = 1 →
      0 ≤ Er →
        1 - dimRatio ≤ ↑(d.choose 2) * ↑D / (b + 1) →
          Ef ≤ 1 - dimRatio + FreeEntropy.Cloning.blockDeficit s depth n pν D g →
            Er ≤ 1 - Z + FreeEntropy.Cloning.blockDeficit s depth m pμ D g →
              Ef ≤ FreeEntropy.Theorem2.cloningConstant d 1 0 * ↑D / (b + 1) ∧ Er = 0

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Theorem2.theorem2_zero_difference
declarations.statement:
∀ (d r D : ℕ) (q b Ef Er : ℝ),
  D = 0 →
    (D = 0 → Ef = 0 ∧ Er = 0) →
      Ef ≤ FreeEntropy.Theorem2.cloningConstant d r q * ↑D / (b + 1) ∧
        Er ≤ FreeEntropy.Theorem2.cloningConstant d r q * ↑D / (b + 1)

declarations.statement: {r : ℕ} → Finset (ℕ → ℕ) → (Fin r → ℤ) → (ℕ → ℝ) → (ℕ → ℕ) → ℝ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.gtMultiplicity
declarations.statement: {r : ℕ} → (Fin r → ℤ) → (ℕ → ℕ) → ℕ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.gtMultiplicity_zero
declarations.statement: ∀ {r : ℕ} (μ : Fin r → ℤ), FreeEntropy.GelfandTsetlin.Dominant μ → FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.gtMultiplicity μ 0 = 1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.normalizer_ge_one
declarations.statement:
∀ {r : ℕ} (s : Finset (ℕ → ℕ)) (μ : Fin r → ℤ),
  FreeEntropy.GelfandTsetlin.Dominant μ →
    0 ∈ s →
      ∀ (ratio : ℕ → ℝ),
        (∀ j < r - 1, 0 ≤ ratio j) →
          1 ≤
            FreeEntropy.WeightNormalization.partitionFunction s (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.gtMultiplicity μ)
              (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rootMonomial r ratio)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rankRow

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rankRow_dominant
declarations.statement:
∀ {d r : ℕ},
  r ≤ d →

      (∀ (i j : ℕ), i < j → j < d → μ j ≤ μ i) →
        FreeEntropy.GelfandTsetlin.Dominant (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rankRow r μ)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rank_one_coefficient
declarations.statement:

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rank_one_support_eq_singleton
declarations.statement: ∀ (s : Finset (ℕ → ℕ)), (∀ δ ∈ s, FreeEntropy.GelfandTsetlin.ValidCuts 1 δ) → 0 ∈ s → s = {0}

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rootMonomial
declarations.statement: ℕ → (ℕ → ℝ) → (ℕ → ℕ) → ℝ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rootMonomial_le_depth
declarations.statement:
∀ (r : ℕ),
  0 < r →
    ∀ (ratio : ℕ → ℝ) (q : ℝ),
      (∀ j < r - 1, 0 ≤ ratio j) →
        (∀ j < r - 1, ratio j ≤ q) →
          ∀ (δ : ℕ → ℕ),
            FreeEntropy.GelfandTsetlin.ValidCuts r δ →
              FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rootMonomial r ratio δ ≤ q ^ FreeEntropy.KostantCounting.offsetDepth r δ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rootMonomial_nonneg
declarations.statement: ∀ (r : ℕ) (ratio : ℕ → ℝ), (∀ j < r - 1, 0 ≤ ratio j) → ∀ (δ : ℕ → ℕ), 0 ≤ FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rootMonomial r ratio δ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rootMonomial_zero
declarations.statement: ∀ (r : ℕ) (ratio : ℕ → ℝ), FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rootMonomial r ratio 0 = 1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rowDistance
declarations.statement: ℕ → (ℕ → ℤ) → ℕ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rowDistance_cast
declarations.statement: ∀ (d : ℕ) (ω : ℕ → ℤ), ↑(FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rowDistance d ω) = FreeEntropy.Weyl.rowL1 d fun (i : ℕ) => ↑(ω i)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.sum_cuts_eq_depth
declarations.statement:
∀ (r : ℕ),
  0 < r →
    ∀ (δ : ℕ → ℕ),
      FreeEntropy.GelfandTsetlin.ValidCuts r δ →
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (r - 1), δ (j + 1) = FreeEntropy.KostantCounting.offsetDepth r δ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.theorem2_gt_canonical_from_integer_rows
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] [inst_2 : Fintype K]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq K] (d r g : ℕ) (μ ω : ℕ → ℤ) (ratio : ℕ → ℝ) (b q : ℝ)
  (R :
    FreeEntropy.TraceCloning.TraceBlockRealization
      (FreeEntropy.GelfandTsetlin.commonCuts (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rankRow r μ) (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rankRow r ω))
      (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.gtMultiplicity (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rankRow r μ))
      (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.gtMultiplicity (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rankRow r μ + FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rankRow r ω))
      (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.gtCoefficient
        (FreeEntropy.GelfandTsetlin.commonCuts (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rankRow r μ)
          (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rankRow r ω))
        (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rankRow r μ) ratio)
      (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.gtCoefficient
        (FreeEntropy.GelfandTsetlin.commonCuts (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rankRow r μ)
          (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rankRow r ω))
        (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rankRow r μ + FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rankRow r ω) ratio)
      (fun (δ : ℕ → ℕ) =>
        min 1
          (2 * ↑(FreeEntropy.KostantCounting.offsetDepth r δ) * ↑(FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rowDistance d ω) / (↑g + 2)))
      (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.weylRatio d μ ω) H K),
  2 ≤ r →
    r ≤ d →
      (∀ (i j : ℕ), i < j → j < d → μ j ≤ μ i) →
        (∀ (i j : ℕ), i < j → j < d → ω j ≤ ω i) →
          (∀ (i : ℕ), r ≤ i → i < d → ω i = 0) →
            (∀ j < r - 1, 0 ≤ ratio j) →
              (∀ j < r - 1, ratio j ≤ q) →
                0 ≤ q →
                  q < 1 →
                    0 ≤ b →
                      b ≤ ↑g →
                        FreeEntropy.GelfandTsetlin.HasGap (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rankRow r μ) g →
                          (∀ i < r, i + 1 < d → b ≤ ↑(μ i) - ↑(μ (i + 1))) →
                            FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance
                                  (R.forward.toFun
                                    (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture
                                      (FreeEntropy.GelfandTsetlin.commonCuts (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rankRow r μ)
                                        (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rankRow r ω))
                                      (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.gtCoefficient
                                        (FreeEntropy.GelfandTsetlin.commonCuts (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rankRow r μ)
                                          (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rankRow r ω))
                                        (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rankRow r μ) ratio)
                                      R.Pμ))
                                  (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture
                                    (FreeEntropy.GelfandTsetlin.commonCuts (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rankRow r μ)
                                      (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rankRow r ω))
                                    (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.gtCoefficient
                                      (FreeEntropy.GelfandTsetlin.commonCuts (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rankRow r μ)
                                        (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rankRow r ω))
                                      (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rankRow r μ + FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rankRow r ω) ratio)
                                    R.Pν) ≤
                                FreeEntropy.Theorem2.cloningConstant d r q * ↑(FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rowDistance d ω) /
                                  (b + 1) ∧
                              FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance
                                  (R.reverse.toFun
                                    (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture
                                      (FreeEntropy.GelfandTsetlin.commonCuts (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rankRow r μ)
                                        (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rankRow r ω))
                                      (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.gtCoefficient
                                        (FreeEntropy.GelfandTsetlin.commonCuts (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rankRow r μ)
                                          (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rankRow r ω))
                                        (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rankRow r μ + FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rankRow r ω) ratio)
                                      R.Pν))
                                  (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture
                                    (FreeEntropy.GelfandTsetlin.commonCuts (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rankRow r μ)
                                      (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rankRow r ω))
                                    (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.gtCoefficient
                                      (FreeEntropy.GelfandTsetlin.commonCuts (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rankRow r μ)
                                        (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rankRow r ω))
                                      (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rankRow r μ) ratio)
                                    R.Pμ) ≤
                                FreeEntropy.Theorem2.cloningConstant d r q * ↑(FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rowDistance d ω) /
                                  (b + 1)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.theorem2_gt_from_integer_rows
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] [inst_2 : Fintype K]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq K] (d r g : ℕ) (s : Finset (ℕ → ℕ)) (μ ω : ℕ → ℤ) (ratio : ℕ → ℝ) (b q : ℝ)
  (R :
    FreeEntropy.TraceCloning.TraceBlockRealization s
      (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.gtMultiplicity (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rankRow r μ))
      (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.gtMultiplicity (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rankRow r μ + FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rankRow r ω))
      (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.gtCoefficient s (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rankRow r μ) ratio)
      (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.gtCoefficient s (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rankRow r μ + FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rankRow r ω)
        ratio)
      (fun (δ : ℕ → ℕ) =>
        min 1
          (2 * ↑(FreeEntropy.KostantCounting.offsetDepth r δ) * ↑(FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rowDistance d ω) / (↑g + 2)))
      (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.weylRatio d μ ω) H K),
  2 ≤ r →
    r ≤ d →
      (∀ (i j : ℕ), i < j → j < d → μ j ≤ μ i) →
        (∀ (i j : ℕ), i < j → j < d → ω j ≤ ω i) →
          (∀ (i : ℕ), r ≤ i → i < d → ω i = 0) →
            (∀ δ ∈ s, FreeEntropy.GelfandTsetlin.ValidCuts r δ) →
              0 ∈ s →
                (∀ j < r - 1, 0 ≤ ratio j) →
                  (∀ j < r - 1, ratio j ≤ q) →
                    0 ≤ q →
                      q < 1 →
                        0 ≤ b →
                          b ≤ ↑g →
                            FreeEntropy.GelfandTsetlin.HasGap (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rankRow r μ) g →
                              (∀ i < r, i + 1 < d → b ≤ ↑(μ i) - ↑(μ (i + 1))) →
                                FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance
                                      (R.forward.toFun
                                        (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s
                                          (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.gtCoefficient s (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rankRow r μ)
                                            ratio)
                                          R.Pμ))
                                      (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s
                                        (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.gtCoefficient s
                                          (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rankRow r μ + FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rankRow r ω)
                                          ratio)
                                        R.Pν) ≤
                                    FreeEntropy.Theorem2.cloningConstant d r q *
                                        ↑(FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rowDistance d ω) /
                                      (b + 1) ∧
                                  FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance
                                      (R.reverse.toFun
                                        (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s
                                          (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.gtCoefficient s
                                            (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rankRow r μ + FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rankRow r ω)
                                            ratio)
                                          R.Pν))
                                      (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s
                                        (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.gtCoefficient s (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rankRow r μ)
                                          ratio)
                                        R.Pμ) ≤
                                    FreeEntropy.Theorem2.cloningConstant d r q *
                                        ↑(FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rowDistance d ω) /
                                      (b + 1)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.theorem2_gt_of_traced_blocks
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] [inst_2 : Fintype K]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq K] (d r D g : ℕ) (s : Finset (ℕ → ℕ)) (μ ω : Fin r → ℤ) (ratio : ℕ → ℝ) (b q a : ℝ)
  (R :
    FreeEntropy.TraceCloning.TraceBlockRealization s (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.gtMultiplicity μ)
      (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.gtMultiplicity (μ + ω)) (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.gtCoefficient s μ ratio)
      (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.gtCoefficient s (μ + ω) ratio)
      (fun (δ : ℕ → ℕ) => min 1 (2 * ↑(FreeEntropy.KostantCounting.offsetDepth r δ) * ↑D / (↑g + 2))) a H K),
  2 ≤ r →
    FreeEntropy.GelfandTsetlin.Dominant μ →
      FreeEntropy.GelfandTsetlin.Dominant ω →
        (∀ δ ∈ s, FreeEntropy.GelfandTsetlin.ValidCuts r δ) →
          0 ∈ s →
            (∀ j < r - 1, 0 ≤ ratio j) →
              (∀ j < r - 1, ratio j ≤ q) →
                0 ≤ q →
                  q < 1 →
                    0 ≤ b →
                      b ≤ ↑g →
                        FreeEntropy.GelfandTsetlin.HasGap μ g →
                          (D = 0 → ω = 0) →
                            0 ≤ a →
                              a ≤ 1 →
                                1 - a ≤ ↑(d.choose 2) * ↑D / (b + 1) →
                                  FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance
                                        (R.forward.toFun
                                          (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s
                                            (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.gtCoefficient s μ ratio) R.Pμ))
                                        (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s
                                          (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.gtCoefficient s (μ + ω) ratio) R.Pν) ≤
                                      FreeEntropy.Theorem2.cloningConstant d r q * ↑D / (b + 1) ∧
                                    FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance
                                        (R.reverse.toFun
                                          (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s
                                            (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.gtCoefficient s (μ + ω) ratio) R.Pν))
                                        (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s
                                          (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.gtCoefficient s μ ratio) R.Pμ) ≤
                                      FreeEntropy.Theorem2.cloningConstant d r q * ↑D / (b + 1)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.theorem2_rank_one_gt_from_integer_rows
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] [inst_2 : Fintype K]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq K] (d g : ℕ) (s : Finset (ℕ → ℕ)) (μ ω : ℕ → ℤ) (ratio : ℕ → ℝ) (b : ℝ)
  (R :
    FreeEntropy.TraceCloning.TraceBlockRealization s
      (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.gtMultiplicity (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rankRow 1 μ))
      (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.gtMultiplicity (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rankRow 1 μ + FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rankRow 1 ω))
      (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.gtCoefficient s (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rankRow 1 μ) ratio)
      (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.gtCoefficient s (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rankRow 1 μ + FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rankRow 1 ω)
        ratio)
      (fun (δ : ℕ → ℕ) =>
        min 1
          (2 * ↑(FreeEntropy.KostantCounting.offsetDepth 1 δ) * ↑(FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rowDistance d ω) / (↑g + 2)))
      (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.weylRatio d μ ω) H K),
  (∀ (i j : ℕ), i < j → j < d → μ j ≤ μ i) →
    (∀ (i j : ℕ), i < j → j < d → ω j ≤ ω i) →
      (∀ (i : ℕ), 1 ≤ i → i < d → ω i = 0) →
        (∀ δ ∈ s, FreeEntropy.GelfandTsetlin.ValidCuts 1 δ) →
          0 ∈ s →
            0 ≤ b →
              (∀ i < 1, i + 1 < d → b ≤ ↑(μ i) - ↑(μ (i + 1))) →
                FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance
                      (R.forward.toFun
                        (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s
                          (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.gtCoefficient s (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rankRow 1 μ) ratio) R.Pμ))
                      (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s
                        (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.gtCoefficient s
                          (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rankRow 1 μ + FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rankRow 1 ω) ratio)
                        R.Pν) ≤
                    FreeEntropy.Theorem2.cloningConstant d 1 0 * ↑(FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rowDistance d ω) / (b + 1) ∧
                  FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance
                      (R.reverse.toFun
                        (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s
                          (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.gtCoefficient s
                            (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rankRow 1 μ + FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rankRow 1 ω) ratio)
                          R.Pν))
                      (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s
                        (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.gtCoefficient s (FreeEntropy.Theorem2GT.rankRow 1 μ) ratio) R.Pμ) =
                    0

            FreeEntropy.UnitaryDecomposition.IrreducibleSubspace
              (FreeEntropy.UnitaryDecomposition.euclideanRepresentation U)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.TraceCloning.TraceBlockRealization.error_comparisons
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} {ι : Type u_3} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] [inst_2 : Fintype K]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq K] {s : Finset ι} {m n : ι → ℕ} {pμ pν e : ι → ℝ} {a Z : ℝ}
  (R : FreeEntropy.TraceCloning.TraceBlockRealization s m n pμ pν e a H K),
  (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ pμ i) →
    (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ pν i) →
      0 ≤ a →
        a ≤ 1 →
          0 ≤ Z →
            Z ≤ 1 →
              (∀ i ∈ s, pν i = Z * pμ i) →
                FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance
                      (R.forward.toFun (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s pμ R.Pμ))
                      (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s pν R.Pν) ≤
                    1 - a + ∑ i ∈ s, e i * (pν i * ↑(n i)) ∧
                  FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance
                      (R.reverse.toFun (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s pν R.Pν))
                      (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s pμ R.Pμ) ≤
                    1 - Z + ∑ i ∈ s, e i * (pμ i * ↑(m i))

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.TraceCloning.forward_traceDistance_le_traced_loss
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_3} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (s : Finset ι) (p q e : ι → ℝ)
  (P C : ι → Matrix H H ℂ) (σ : Matrix H H ℂ) (a : ℝ),
  (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ p i) →
    (∀ i ∈ s, p i ≤ q i) →
      (∀ i ∈ s, (P i).PosSemidef) →
        (∀ i ∈ s, (C i).PosSemidef) →
          0 ≤ a →
            a ≤ 1 →
              (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s p P).trace = 1 →
                σ.trace = 1 →
                  (∀ i ∈ s, (P i - C i).PosSemidef) →
                    (∀ i ∈ s, FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr (P i - C i) ≤ e i * FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr (P i)) →
                      a • FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s q C ≤ σ →
                        FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance σ (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s p P) ≤
                          1 - a + ∑ i ∈ s, e i * p i * FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr (P i)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.TraceCloning.identityRealization_errors
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (s : Finset ι) (m : ι → ℕ) (p : ι → ℝ)
  (P : ι → Matrix H H ℂ) (hP : ∀ i ∈ s, (P i).PosSemidef) (htr : ∀ i ∈ s, FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr (P i) = ↑(m i))
  (hnorm : (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s p P).trace = 1),
  FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance
        ((FreeEntropy.TraceCloning.identityRealization s m p P hP htr hnorm).forward.toFun
          (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s p P))
        (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s p P) =
      0 ∧
    FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance
        ((FreeEntropy.TraceCloning.identityRealization s m p P hP htr hnorm).reverse.toFun
          (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s p P))
        (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s p P) =
      0

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.TraceCloning.theorem2_of_traced_blocks
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} {ι : Type u_3} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] [inst_2 : Fintype K]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq K] (s : Finset ι) (depth m n : ι → ℕ) (pμ pν : ι → ℝ) (d r D g : ℕ) (b q a Z : ℝ)
  (R :
    FreeEntropy.TraceCloning.TraceBlockRealization s m n pμ pν (fun (i : ι) => min 1 (2 * ↑(depth i) * ↑D / (↑g + 2))) a
      H K),
  2 ≤ r →
    0 ≤ q →
      q < 1 →
        0 ≤ b →
          b ≤ ↑g →
            0 ≤ a →
              a ≤ 1 →
                (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ pμ i) →
                  (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ pν i) →
                    (∀ i ∈ s, m i ≤ n i) →
                      (∀ i ∈ s, depth i ≤ g → m i = n i) →
                        (D = 0 → ∀ i ∈ s, m i = n i) →
                          (∀ i ∈ s, pν i = Z * pμ i) →
                            (∀ i ∈ s, pμ i ≤ q ^ depth i) →
                              (∀ i ∈ s, pν i ≤ q ^ depth i) →
                                (∀ (t : ℕ),
                                    ∑ i ∈ s with depth i = t, m i ≤ (t + r.choose 2 - 1).choose (r.choose 2 - 1)) →
                                  (∀ (t : ℕ),
                                      ∑ i ∈ s with depth i = t, n i ≤ (t + r.choose 2 - 1).choose (r.choose 2 - 1)) →
                                    1 - a ≤ ↑(d.choose 2) * ↑D / (b + 1) →
                                      FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance
                                            (R.forward.toFun (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s pμ R.Pμ))
                                            (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s pν R.Pν) ≤
                                          FreeEntropy.Theorem2.cloningConstant d r q * ↑D / (b + 1) ∧
                                        FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance
                                            (R.reverse.toFun (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s pν R.Pν))
                                            (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s pμ R.Pμ) ≤
                                          FreeEntropy.Theorem2.cloningConstant d r q * ↑D / (b + 1)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.TraceCloning.traceDistance_le_traced_loss
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_3} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (s : Finset ι) (p e : ι → ℝ)
  (P C : ι → Matrix H H ℂ) (σ : Matrix H H ℂ) (a : ℝ),
  (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ p i) →
    (∀ i ∈ s, (P i).PosSemidef) →
      0 ≤ a →
        a ≤ 1 →
          (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s p P).trace = 1 →
            σ.trace = 1 →
              (∀ i ∈ s, (P i - C i).PosSemidef) →
                (∀ i ∈ s, FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr (P i - C i) ≤ e i * FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr (P i)) →
                  a • FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s p C ≤ σ →
                    FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance σ (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s p P) ≤
                      1 - a + ∑ i ∈ s, e i * p i * FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr (P i)
