declarations.name: FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.positive_remainder_bound
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] {A B R : Matrix H H ℂ},
  R.PosSemidef →
    B - R ≤ A →
      (FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceNorm (A - B) + FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr B - FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr A) / 2 ≤
        FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr R

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.retained_branch_error_bound
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] {A B R : Matrix H H ℂ},
  B.trace = 1 →
    R.PosSemidef →
      B - R ≤ A →
        FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance A B + (1 - FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr A) / 2 ≤
          FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr R

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.sandwich
declarations.statement: {H : Type u_1} → {M : Type u_2} → [Fintype H] → Matrix M H ℂ → Matrix H H ℂ →ₗ[ℝ] Matrix M M ℂ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.sandwich_apply
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype H] (V : Matrix M H ℂ) (X : Matrix H H ℂ),
  (FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.sandwich V) X = V * X * V.conjTranspose

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.sandwich_traceNorm_le
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] [inst_2 : Fintype M]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq M] (V : Matrix M H ℂ),
  V.conjTranspose * V ≤ 1 →
    ∀ {D : Matrix H H ℂ},
      D.IsHermitian →
        FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceNorm (V * D * V.conjTranspose) ≤ FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceNorm D

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.sandwich_trace_le
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] [inst_2 : Fintype M] (V : Matrix M H ℂ),
  V.conjTranspose * V ≤ 1 →
    ∀ {A : Matrix H H ℂ},
      A.PosSemidef →
        FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr ((FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.sandwich V) A) ≤ FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr A

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.state_measurement_bound
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] {P A B : Matrix H H ℂ},
  A.PosSemidef →
    B.PosSemidef →
      A.trace = B.trace →
        P.PosSemidef →
          P ≤ 1 →
            |FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr (P * A) - FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr (P * B)| ≤
              FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance A B

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance
declarations.statement: {H : Type u_1} → [Fintype H] → [DecidableEq H] → Matrix H H ℂ → Matrix H H ℂ → ℝ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance_contract
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] [inst_2 : Fintype M]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq M] (E : Matrix H H ℂ →ₗ[ℝ] Matrix M M ℂ),
  (∀ (A : Matrix H H ℂ), A.PosSemidef → (E A).PosSemidef) →
    (∀ (A : Matrix H H ℂ), (E A).trace = A.trace) →
      ∀ {A B : Matrix H H ℂ},
        A.PosSemidef →
          B.PosSemidef →
            FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance (E A) (E B) ≤ FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance A B

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance_contract_of_trace_le
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] [inst_2 : Fintype M]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq M] (E : Matrix H H ℂ →ₗ[ℝ] Matrix M M ℂ),
  (∀ (A : Matrix H H ℂ), A.PosSemidef → (E A).PosSemidef) →
    (∀ (A : Matrix H H ℂ), A.PosSemidef → FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr (E A) ≤ FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr A) →
      ∀ {A B : Matrix H H ℂ},
        A.PosSemidef →
          B.PosSemidef →
            FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance (E A) (E B) ≤ FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance A B

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance_isometry
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] [inst_2 : Fintype M]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq M] (V : Matrix M H ℂ),
  V.conjTranspose * V = 1 →
    ∀ {A B : Matrix H H ℂ},
      A.PosSemidef →
        B.PosSemidef →
          FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance (V * A * V.conjTranspose) (V * B * V.conjTranspose) =
            FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance A B

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance_le_remainder
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] {A B R : Matrix H H ℂ},
  A.trace = B.trace →
    R.PosSemidef → B - R ≤ A → FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance A B ≤ FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr R

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance_mixture_le
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (s : Finset ι) (w : ι → ℝ)
  (A : ι → Matrix H H ℂ) (B : Matrix H H ℂ),
  (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ w i) →
    ∑ i ∈ s, w i = 1 →
      (∀ i ∈ s, (A i).IsHermitian) →
        B.IsHermitian →
          FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s w A) B ≤
            ∑ i ∈ s, w i * FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance (A i) B

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance_mixtures_le
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (s : Finset ι) (w : ι → ℝ)
  (A B : ι → Matrix H H ℂ),
  (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ w i) →
    (∀ i ∈ s, (A i).IsHermitian) →
      (∀ i ∈ s, (B i).IsHermitian) →
        FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s w A)
            (FreeEntropy.CloningMatrices.mixture s w B) ≤
          ∑ i ∈ s, w i * FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance (A i) (B i)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance_nonneg
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (A B : Matrix H H ℂ),
  0 ≤ FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance A B

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance_states_le_one
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] {A B : Matrix H H ℂ},
  A.PosSemidef → B.PosSemidef → A.trace = 1 → B.trace = 1 → FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance A B ≤ 1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance_symm
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (A B : Matrix H H ℂ),
  FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance A B = FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance B A

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance_triangle
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] {A B C : Matrix H H ℂ},
  A.IsHermitian →
    B.IsHermitian →
      C.IsHermitian →
        FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance A C ≤
          FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance A B + FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceDistance B C

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceNorm
declarations.statement: {H : Type u_1} → [Fintype H] → [DecidableEq H] → Matrix H H ℂ → ℝ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceNorm_add_le
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] {X Y : Matrix H H ℂ},
  X.IsHermitian →
    Y.IsHermitian →
      FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceNorm (X + Y) ≤
        FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceNorm X + FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceNorm Y

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceNorm_contract_hermitian
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] [inst_2 : Fintype M]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq M] (E : Matrix H H ℂ →ₗ[ℝ] Matrix M M ℂ),
  (∀ (A : Matrix H H ℂ), A.PosSemidef → (E A).PosSemidef) →
    (∀ (A : Matrix H H ℂ), (E A).trace = A.trace) →
      ∀ {D : Matrix H H ℂ},
        D.IsHermitian → FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceNorm (E D) ≤ FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceNorm D

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceNorm_contract_hermitian_of_trace_le
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] [inst_2 : Fintype M]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq M] (E : Matrix H H ℂ →ₗ[ℝ] Matrix M M ℂ),
  (∀ (A : Matrix H H ℂ), A.PosSemidef → (E A).PosSemidef) →
    (∀ (A : Matrix H H ℂ), A.PosSemidef → FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr (E A) ≤ FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr A) →
      ∀ {D : Matrix H H ℂ},
        D.IsHermitian → FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceNorm (E D) ≤ FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceNorm D

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceNorm_eq_sum_abs_eigenvalues
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] {D : Matrix H H ℂ} (hD : D.IsHermitian),
  FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceNorm D = ∑ i : H, |hD.eigenvalues i|

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceNorm_isometry
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] [inst_2 : Fintype M]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq M] (V : Matrix M H ℂ),
  V.conjTranspose * V = 1 →
    ∀ {D : Matrix H H ℂ},
      D.IsHermitian →
        FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceNorm (V * D * V.conjTranspose) = FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceNorm D

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceNorm_neg
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (X : Matrix H H ℂ),
  FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceNorm (-X) = FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceNorm X

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceNorm_nonneg
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (X : Matrix H H ℂ),
  0 ≤ FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceNorm X

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceNorm_sub_comm
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (A B : Matrix H H ℂ),
  FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceNorm (A - B) = FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceNorm (B - A)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceNorm_sub_le_trace_add
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] {A B : Matrix H H ℂ},
  A.PosSemidef →
    B.PosSemidef →
      FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceNorm (A - B) ≤ FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr A + FreeEntropy.OrbitMemory.tr B

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceNorm_weighted_sum_le
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (s : Finset ι) (w : ι → ℝ)
  (X : ι → Matrix H H ℂ),
  (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ w i) →
    (∀ i ∈ s, (X i).IsHermitian) →
      FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceNorm (∑ i ∈ s, w i • X i) ≤
        ∑ i ∈ s, w i * FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceNorm (X i)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceNorm_zero
declarations.statement: ∀ {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H], FreeEntropy.TraceDistance.traceNorm 0 = 0

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Twirling.commutant_is_scalar
declarations.statement:
∀ {G : Type u_1} {H : Type u_2} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : Fintype H] [inst_2 : DecidableEq H] (U : G →* Matrix H H ℂ)
  [(FreeEntropy.Twirling.matrixRepresentation U).IsIrreducible] (A : Matrix H H ℂ),
  (∀ (g : G), A * U g = U g * A) → ∃ (c : ℂ), A = c • 1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Twirling.compact_irreducible_twirl
declarations.statement:
∀ {G : Type u_1} {H : Type u_2} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : Fintype H] [inst_2 : DecidableEq H]
  [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] [CompactSpace G] [inst_6 : MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
  [Nonempty H] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure G) [μ.IsMulLeftInvariant] [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
  (U : G →* Matrix H H ℂ),
  Continuous ⇑U →
    ∀ [(FreeEntropy.Twirling.matrixRepresentation U).IsIrreducible] (P : Matrix H H ℂ),
      ∫ (g : G), FreeEntropy.Twirling.conjugate U g P ∂μ = (P.trace / ↑(Fintype.card H)) • 1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Twirling.compact_irreducible_unitary_twirl
declarations.statement:
∀ {G : Type u_1} {H : Type u_2} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : Fintype H] [inst_2 : DecidableEq H]
  [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] [CompactSpace G] [inst_6 : MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
  [Nonempty H] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure G) [μ.IsMulLeftInvariant] [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
  (U : G →* Matrix H H ℂ),
  Continuous ⇑U →
    (∀ (g : G), (U g).conjTranspose * U g = 1) →
      ∀ [(FreeEntropy.Twirling.matrixRepresentation U).IsIrreducible] (P : Matrix H H ℂ),
        ∫ (g : G), U g * P * (U g).conjTranspose ∂μ = (P.trace / ↑(Fintype.card H)) • 1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Twirling.compact_trace_one_unitary_twirl
declarations.statement:
∀ {G : Type u_1} {H : Type u_2} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : Fintype H] [inst_2 : DecidableEq H]
  [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] [CompactSpace G] [inst_6 : MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
  [Nonempty H] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure G) [μ.IsMulLeftInvariant] [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
  (U : G →* Matrix H H ℂ),
  Continuous ⇑U →
    (∀ (g : G), (U g).conjTranspose * U g = 1) →
      ∀ [(FreeEntropy.Twirling.matrixRepresentation U).IsIrreducible] (P : Matrix H H ℂ),
        P.trace = 1 → ∫ (g : G), U g * P * (U g).conjTranspose ∂μ = (↑(Fintype.card H))⁻¹ • 1

{G : Type u_1} →

declarations.statement:
∀ {G : Type u_1} {H : Type u_2} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : Fintype H] [inst_2 : DecidableEq H] (U : G →* Matrix H H ℂ)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Twirling.conjugate_eq_unitary_conjugate
declarations.statement:
∀ {G : Type u_1} {H : Type u_2} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : Fintype H] [inst_2 : DecidableEq H] (U : G →* Matrix H H ℂ),

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Twirling.conjugate_integrable
declarations.statement:
∀ {G : Type u_1} {H : Type u_2} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : Fintype H] [inst_2 : DecidableEq H]
  [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] [CompactSpace G] [inst_6 : MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
  (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure G) [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ] (U : G →* Matrix H H ℂ),
  Continuous ⇑U → ∀ (P : Matrix H H ℂ), MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun (g : G) => FreeEntropy.Twirling.conjugate U g P) μ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Twirling.conjugate_mul
declarations.statement:
∀ {G : Type u_1} {H : Type u_2} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : Fintype H] [inst_2 : DecidableEq H] (U : G →* Matrix H H ℂ)
  (g h : G) (A : Matrix H H ℂ),
  FreeEntropy.Twirling.conjugate U g (FreeEntropy.Twirling.conjugate U h A) = FreeEntropy.Twirling.conjugate U (g * h) A

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Twirling.integral_conjugate_commutes
declarations.statement:
∀ {G : Type u_1} {H : Type u_2} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : Fintype H] [inst_2 : DecidableEq H]
  [inst_3 : MeasurableSpace G] [MeasurableMul G] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure G) [μ.IsMulLeftInvariant]
  (U : G →* Matrix H H ℂ) (P : Matrix H H ℂ),
  MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun (g : G) => FreeEntropy.Twirling.conjugate U g P) μ →
    ∀ (h : G),
      (∫ (g : G), FreeEntropy.Twirling.conjugate U g P ∂μ) * U h =
        U h * ∫ (g : G), FreeEntropy.Twirling.conjugate U g P ∂μ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Twirling.integral_conjugate_eq_scalar
declarations.statement:
∀ {G : Type u_1} {H : Type u_2} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : Fintype H] [inst_2 : DecidableEq H]
  [inst_3 : MeasurableSpace G] [MeasurableMul G] [Nonempty H] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure G) [μ.IsMulLeftInvariant]
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (U : G →* Matrix H H ℂ)
  [(FreeEntropy.Twirling.matrixRepresentation U).IsIrreducible] (P : Matrix H H ℂ),
  MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun (g : G) => FreeEntropy.Twirling.conjugate U g P) μ →
    ∫ (g : G), FreeEntropy.Twirling.conjugate U g P ∂μ = (P.trace / ↑(Fintype.card H)) • 1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Twirling.integral_conjugate_invariant
declarations.statement:
∀ {G : Type u_1} {H : Type u_2} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : Fintype H] [inst_2 : DecidableEq H]
  [inst_3 : MeasurableSpace G] [MeasurableMul G] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure G) [μ.IsMulLeftInvariant]
  (U : G →* Matrix H H ℂ) (P : Matrix H H ℂ),
  MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun (g : G) => FreeEntropy.Twirling.conjugate U g P) μ →
    ∀ (h : G),
      FreeEntropy.Twirling.conjugate U h (∫ (g : G), FreeEntropy.Twirling.conjugate U g P ∂μ) =
        ∫ (g : G), FreeEntropy.Twirling.conjugate U g P ∂μ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Twirling.inverse_eq_conjTranspose
declarations.statement:
∀ {G : Type u_1} {H : Type u_2} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : Fintype H] [inst_2 : DecidableEq H] (U : G →* Matrix H H ℂ),
  (∀ (g : G), (U g).conjTranspose * U g = 1) → ∀ (g : G), U g⁻¹ = (U g).conjTranspose

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Twirling.irreducible_of_scalar_commutant
declarations.statement:
∀ {G : Type u_1} {H : Type u_2} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : Fintype H] [inst_2 : DecidableEq H] [Nonempty H]
  (U : G →* Matrix H H ℂ),
  (∀ (g : G), (U g).conjTranspose * U g = 1) →
    (∀ (A : Matrix H H ℂ), (∀ (g : G), U g * A = A * U g) → ∃ (c : ℂ), A = c • 1) →
      (FreeEntropy.Twirling.matrixRepresentation U).IsIrreducible

declarations.statement:

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Twirling.unitary_orbit_integrable
declarations.statement:
∀ {G : Type u_1} {H : Type u_2} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : Fintype H] [inst_2 : DecidableEq H]
  [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] [CompactSpace G] [inst_6 : MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.TypicalRows.Typical
declarations.statement: {d r : ℕ} → FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r → ℕ → (ℕ → ℤ) → Prop

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.TypicalRows.cloning_envelope_le
declarations.statement:
∀ {d r : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r) (hd : 2 ≤ d) (C : ℝ),
  0 ≤ C →
    ∀ (n : ℕ),
      2 ≤ n →
        ∀ (μ : ℕ → ℤ),
          FreeEntropy.TypicalRows.Typical s n μ →
            (C * FreeEntropy.Weyl.rowL1 d fun (i : ℕ) => s.targetRow n i - ↑(μ i)) /
                (↑n * FreeEntropy.TypicalRows.minimumGap s hd / 2 + 1) ≤
              2 * C * (↑r * (3 * ↑r + 2)) / FreeEntropy.TypicalRows.minimumGap s hd * FreeEntropy.Weyl.errorScale n

  [inst_2 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E] [inst_3 : FiniteDimensional ℂ E] (ρ : Representation ℂ G E),

      FreeEntropy.UnitaryDecomposition.Invariant ρ K →
        ∃ (s : Finset (Submodule ℂ E)),
          (∀ L ∈ s, FreeEntropy.UnitaryDecomposition.IrreducibleSubspace ρ L) ∧
            (∀ L ∈ s, ∀ J ∈ s, L ≠ J → FreeEntropy.UnitaryDecomposition.Orthogonal L J) ∧ s.sup id = K

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeightNormalization.coefficient
declarations.statement: {ι : Type u_1} → Finset ι → (ι → ℕ) → (ι → ℝ) → ι → ℝ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeightNormalization.coefficient_le_geometric
declarations.statement:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} (s : Finset ι) (mult depth : ι → ℕ) (w : ι → ℝ) (q : ℝ),
  (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ w i) →
    1 ≤ FreeEntropy.WeightNormalization.partitionFunction s mult w →
      (∀ i ∈ s, w i ≤ q ^ depth i) → ∀ i ∈ s, FreeEntropy.WeightNormalization.coefficient s mult w i ≤ q ^ depth i

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeightNormalization.coefficient_nonneg
declarations.statement:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} (s : Finset ι) (mult : ι → ℕ) (w : ι → ℝ),
  (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ w i) →
    0 < FreeEntropy.WeightNormalization.partitionFunction s mult w →
      ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ FreeEntropy.WeightNormalization.coefficient s mult w i

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeightNormalization.coefficient_normalized
declarations.statement:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} (s : Finset ι) (mult : ι → ℕ) (w : ι → ℝ),
  FreeEntropy.WeightNormalization.partitionFunction s mult w ≠ 0 →
    ∑ i ∈ s, FreeEntropy.WeightNormalization.coefficient s mult w i * ↑(mult i) = 1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeightNormalization.coefficient_ratio
declarations.statement:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} (s : Finset ι) (m n : ι → ℕ) (w : ι → ℝ),
  FreeEntropy.WeightNormalization.partitionFunction s m w ≠ 0 →
    ∀ (i : ι),
      FreeEntropy.WeightNormalization.coefficient s n w i =
        FreeEntropy.WeightNormalization.partitionFunction s m w /
            FreeEntropy.WeightNormalization.partitionFunction s n w *
          FreeEntropy.WeightNormalization.coefficient s m w i

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeightNormalization.coefficient_root_envelope
declarations.statement:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {κ : Type u_2} (s : Finset ι) (roots : Finset κ) (mult : ι → ℕ) (c : ι → κ → ℕ) (ratio : κ → ℝ)
  (q : ℝ),
  (∀ j ∈ roots, 0 ≤ ratio j) →
    (∀ j ∈ roots, ratio j ≤ q) →
      (1 ≤ FreeEntropy.WeightNormalization.partitionFunction s mult fun (i : ι) => ∏ j ∈ roots, ratio j ^ c i j) →
        ∀ (i : ι),
          FreeEntropy.WeightNormalization.coefficient s mult (fun (i : ι) => ∏ j ∈ roots, ratio j ^ c i j) i ≤
            q ^ ∑ j ∈ roots, c i j

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeightNormalization.next_coefficient_upper
declarations.statement:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} (s : Finset ι) (depth mult : ι → ℕ) (w : ι → ℝ) (q : ℝ),
  0 ≤ q →
    q ≤ 1 →
      0 < FreeEntropy.WeightNormalization.partitionFunction s mult w →
        ∀ (i : ι),
          1 ≤ depth i →
            w i ≤ q ^ depth i →
              FreeEntropy.WeightNormalization.coefficient s mult w i ≤
                q * (1 / FreeEntropy.WeightNormalization.partitionFunction s mult w)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeightNormalization.partitionFunction
declarations.statement: {ι : Type u_1} → Finset ι → (ι → ℕ) → (ι → ℝ) → ℝ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeightNormalization.partitionFunction_ge_one
declarations.statement:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} (s : Finset ι) (mult : ι → ℕ) (w : ι → ℝ),
  (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ w i) → ∀ i₀ ∈ s, mult i₀ = 1 → w i₀ = 1 → 1 ≤ FreeEntropy.WeightNormalization.partitionFunction s mult w

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeightNormalization.partitionFunction_le
declarations.statement:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} (s : Finset ι) (depth mult : ι → ℕ) (w : ι → ℝ) (N : ℕ),
  0 < N →
    ∀ (q : ℝ),
      0 ≤ q →
        q < 1 →
          (∀ i ∈ s, w i ≤ q ^ depth i) →
            (∀ (t : ℕ), ∑ i ∈ s with depth i = t, mult i ≤ (t + N - 1).choose (N - 1)) →
              FreeEntropy.WeightNormalization.partitionFunction s mult w ≤ 1 / (1 - q) ^ N

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeightNormalization.top_coefficient_lower
declarations.statement:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} (s : Finset ι) (mult : ι → ℕ) (w : ι → ℝ) (N : ℕ),
  ∀ q < 1,
    0 < FreeEntropy.WeightNormalization.partitionFunction s mult w →
      FreeEntropy.WeightNormalization.partitionFunction s mult w ≤ 1 / (1 - q) ^ N →
        (1 - q) ^ N ≤ 1 / FreeEntropy.WeightNormalization.partitionFunction s mult w

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeightNormalization.uniform_gap
declarations.statement:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} (s : Finset ι) (mult : ι → ℕ) (w : ι → ℝ) (N : ℕ),
  ∀ q < 1,
    0 < FreeEntropy.WeightNormalization.partitionFunction s mult w →
      FreeEntropy.WeightNormalization.partitionFunction s mult w ≤ 1 / (1 - q) ^ N →
        0 < (1 - q) ^ (N + 1) ∧
          (1 - q) ^ (N + 1) ≤
            1 / FreeEntropy.WeightNormalization.partitionFunction s mult w -
              q * (1 / FreeEntropy.WeightNormalization.partitionFunction s mult w)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeightSectors.basisEmbedding_weightProjector
declarations.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} {A : Type u_4} {B : Type u_5} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : Fintype B] [inst_2 : DecidableEq A]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq B] (wA : A → I → ℝ) (wB : B → I → ℝ) (k : B) (lam : I → ℝ),
  FreeEntropy.WeightSectors.weightProjector (FreeEntropy.WeightSectors.totalWeight wA wB) (lam + wB k) *
      FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k =
    FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k * FreeEntropy.WeightSectors.weightProjector wA lam

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeightSectors.branch_identities_of_sector_intertwining
declarations.statement:
∀ {H : Type u_2} {A : Type u_4} {C : Type u_6} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : Fintype A] [inst_2 : Fintype C]
  [DecidableEq H] [inst_4 : DecidableEq A] [DecidableEq C] (S : Matrix H H ℂ) (Pm : Matrix A A ℂ) (Pn : Matrix C C ℂ)
  (V : Matrix H C ℂ) (J : Matrix H A ℂ),
  IsStarProjection S →
    IsStarProjection Pm →
      IsStarProjection Pn →
        J.conjTranspose * J = 1 →
          S * V = V * Pn →
            S * J = J * Pm →
              V * V.conjTranspose * (J * Pm * J.conjTranspose) * (V * V.conjTranspose) =
                  V * Pn * V.conjTranspose * (J * Pm * J.conjTranspose) * (V * Pn * V.conjTranspose) ∧
                J.conjTranspose * (V * Pn * V.conjTranspose) * J =
                    J.conjTranspose *
                        (J * Pm * J.conjTranspose * (V * Pn * V.conjTranspose) * (J * Pm * J.conjTranspose)) *
                      J ∧
                  J * Pm * J.conjTranspose * S * (J * Pm * J.conjTranspose) = J * Pm * J.conjTranspose

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeightSectors.cloning_weight_sector_identities
declarations.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} {A : Type u_4} {B : Type u_5} {C : Type u_6} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : Fintype B]
  [inst_2 : Fintype C] [inst_3 : DecidableEq A] [inst_4 : DecidableEq B] [inst_5 : DecidableEq C] (wA : A → I → ℝ)
  (wB : B → I → ℝ) (wC : C → I → ℝ) (V : Matrix (A × B) C ℂ),
  (∀ (i : I),
      (Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun (x1 x2 : ℂ) => x1 * x2) (FreeEntropy.WeightSectors.weightDiagonal wA i) 1 +
            Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun (x1 x2 : ℂ) => x1 * x2) 1 (FreeEntropy.WeightSectors.weightDiagonal wB i)) *
          V =
        V * FreeEntropy.WeightSectors.weightDiagonal wC i) →
    ∀ (k : B) (lam : I → ℝ),
      have Pm := FreeEntropy.WeightSectors.weightProjector wA lam;
      have Pn := FreeEntropy.WeightSectors.weightProjector wC (lam + wB k);
      have S := FreeEntropy.WeightSectors.weightProjector (FreeEntropy.WeightSectors.totalWeight wA wB) (lam + wB k);
      have J := FreeEntropy.CartanChannel.basisEmbedding k;
      V * V.conjTranspose * (J * Pm * J.conjTranspose) * (V * V.conjTranspose) =
          V * Pn * V.conjTranspose * (J * Pm * J.conjTranspose) * (V * Pn * V.conjTranspose) ∧
        J.conjTranspose * (V * Pn * V.conjTranspose) * J =
            J.conjTranspose * (J * Pm * J.conjTranspose * (V * Pn * V.conjTranspose) * (J * Pm * J.conjTranspose)) * J ∧
          J * Pm * J.conjTranspose * S * (J * Pm * J.conjTranspose) = J * Pm * J.conjTranspose

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeightSectors.intertwiner_weight_eq
declarations.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} {H : Type u_2} {K : Type u_3} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : Fintype K] [inst_2 : DecidableEq H]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq K] (wH : H → I → ℝ) (wK : K → I → ℝ) (V : Matrix H K ℂ),
  (∀ (i : I), FreeEntropy.WeightSectors.weightDiagonal wH i * V = V * FreeEntropy.WeightSectors.weightDiagonal wK i) →
    ∀ (h : H) (k : K), V h k ≠ 0 → wH h = wK k

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeightSectors.totalWeight
declarations.statement: {I : Type u_1} → {A : Type u_4} → {B : Type u_5} → (A → I → ℝ) → (B → I → ℝ) → A × B → I → ℝ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeightSectors.totalWeight_diagonal
declarations.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} {A : Type u_4} {B : Type u_5} [Fintype A] [Fintype B] [inst : DecidableEq A] [inst_1 : DecidableEq B]
  (wA : A → I → ℝ) (wB : B → I → ℝ) (i : I),
  FreeEntropy.WeightSectors.weightDiagonal (FreeEntropy.WeightSectors.totalWeight wA wB) i =
    Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun (x1 x2 : ℂ) => x1 * x2) (FreeEntropy.WeightSectors.weightDiagonal wA i) 1 +
      Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun (x1 x2 : ℂ) => x1 * x2) 1 (FreeEntropy.WeightSectors.weightDiagonal wB i)

declarations.statement: {I : Type u_1} → {H : Type u_2} → [DecidableEq H] → (H → I → ℝ) → I → Matrix H H ℂ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeightSectors.weightProjector
declarations.statement: {I : Type u_1} → {H : Type u_2} → [DecidableEq H] → (H → I → ℝ) → (I → ℝ) → Matrix H H ℂ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeightSectors.weightProjector_intertwines
declarations.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} {H : Type u_2} {K : Type u_3} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : Fintype K] [inst_2 : DecidableEq H]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq K] (wH : H → I → ℝ) (wK : K → I → ℝ) (V : Matrix H K ℂ),

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeightSectors.weightProjector_ne_zero_iff
declarations.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} {H : Type u_2} [Fintype H] [inst : DecidableEq H] (w : H → I → ℝ) (lam : I → ℝ),

declarations.statement:

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Weyl.activeProduct
declarations.statement: ℕ → ℕ → (ℕ → ℝ) → ℝ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Weyl.activeProduct_congr_rows
declarations.statement:
∀ (d r : ℕ) (μ ν : ℕ → ℝ),
  (∀ i < d, μ i = ν i) → FreeEntropy.Weyl.activeProduct d r μ = FreeEntropy.Weyl.activeProduct d r ν

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Weyl.activeProduct_log_asymptotic
declarations.statement:
∀ (d r : ℕ) (row : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (x : ℕ → ℝ),
  (∀ (i j : ℕ), i < r → i < j → j < d → x j < x i) →
    (∀ i < d, Filter.Tendsto (fun (n : ℕ) => row n i / ↑n) Filter.atTop (nhds (x i))) →
      Filter.Tendsto
        (fun (n : ℕ) => Real.logb 2 (FreeEntropy.Weyl.activeProduct d r (row n)) - FreeEntropy.Weyl.rootLeading d r x n)
        Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Weyl.activeProduct_mono_add_dominant
declarations.statement:
∀ (d : ℕ) (μ ω : ℕ → ℝ),
  (∀ (i j : ℕ), i < j → j < d → μ j ≤ μ i) →
    (∀ (i j : ℕ), i < j → j < d → ω j ≤ ω i) →
      FreeEntropy.Weyl.activeProduct d d μ ≤ FreeEntropy.Weyl.activeProduct d d fun (i : ℕ) => μ i + ω i

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Weyl.activeProduct_pos_of_ordered
declarations.statement: ∀ (d : ℕ) (μ : ℕ → ℝ), (∀ (i j : ℕ), i < j → j < d → μ j ≤ μ i) → 0 < FreeEntropy.Weyl.activeProduct d d μ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Weyl.activeRoots
declarations.statement: ℕ → ℕ → Finset (ℕ × ℕ)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Weyl.activeRoots_rows_disjoint
declarations.statement:
∀ (d r : ℕ),
  (↑(Finset.range r)).PairwiseDisjoint fun (i : ℕ) => Finset.image (fun (j : ℕ) => (i, j)) (Finset.Ico (i + 1) d)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Weyl.active_denominator
declarations.statement: ∀ (d r : ℕ), r ≤ d → ∏ i ∈ Finset.range r, ∏ j ∈ Finset.Ico (i + 1) d, (j - i) = ∏ k ∈ Finset.Ico (d - r) d, k.factorial

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Weyl.active_row_count
declarations.statement: ∀ (d r : ℕ), r ≤ d → ∑ i ∈ Finset.range r, (d - i - 1) = r * (2 * d - r - 1) / 2

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Weyl.all_root_count
declarations.statement: ∀ (d : ℕ), ↑(FreeEntropy.Weyl.activeRoots d d).card = ↑(d.choose 2)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Weyl.card_activeRoots
declarations.statement: ∀ (d r : ℕ), r ≤ d → (FreeEntropy.Weyl.activeRoots d r).card = r * (2 * d - r - 1) / 2

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Weyl.card_activeRoots_real
declarations.statement: ∀ (d r : ℕ), r ≤ d → ↑(FreeEntropy.Weyl.activeRoots d r).card = ↑r * (2 * ↑d - ↑r - 1) / 2

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Weyl.descending_factorial_product
declarations.statement: ∀ (d r : ℕ), r ≤ d → ∏ i ∈ Finset.range r, (d - i - 1).factorial = ∏ k ∈ Finset.Ico (d - r) d, k.factorial

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Weyl.descending_row_sum
declarations.statement: ∀ (d r : ℕ), r ≤ d → ∀ (f : ℕ → ℝ), ∑ i ∈ Finset.range r, f (d - i - 1) = ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico (d - r) d, f k

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Weyl.errorScale
declarations.statement: ℕ → ℝ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Weyl.errorScale_tendsto_zero
declarations.statement: Filter.Tendsto FreeEntropy.Weyl.errorScale Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Weyl.log_active_denominator
declarations.statement:
∀ (d r : ℕ),
  r ≤ d →
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range r, ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico (i + 1) d, Real.logb 2 ↑(j - i) =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico (d - r) d, Real.logb 2 ↑k.factorial

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Weyl.log_product_asymptotic
declarations.statement:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} (s : Finset ι) (f : ℕ → ι → ℝ) (slope : ι → ℝ),
  (∀ i ∈ s, 0 < slope i) →
    (∀ i ∈ s, Filter.Tendsto (fun (n : ℕ) => f n i / ↑n) Filter.atTop (nhds (slope i))) →
      Filter.Tendsto
        (fun (n : ℕ) => Real.logb 2 (∏ i ∈ s, f n i) - (↑s.card * Real.logb 2 ↑n + ∑ i ∈ s, Real.logb 2 (slope i)))
        Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Weyl.log_row_denominator
declarations.statement: ∀ (d i : ℕ), ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico (i + 1) d, Real.logb 2 ↑(j - i) = Real.logb 2 ↑(d - i - 1).factorial

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Weyl.mem_activeRoots
declarations.statement: ∀ {d r i j : ℕ}, (i, j) ∈ FreeEntropy.Weyl.activeRoots d r ↔ i < r ∧ i < j ∧ j < d

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Weyl.normalized_product
declarations.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → ℝ) (t : ℝ), (∏ i ∈ s, f i) / t ^ s.card = ∏ i ∈ s, f i / t

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Weyl.qmdl
declarations.statement: ℕ → ℕ → (ℕ → ℝ) → ℕ → ℝ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Weyl.rootDenominator
declarations.statement: (ℕ → ℝ) → ℕ × ℕ → ℝ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Weyl.rootDenominator_pos_of_ordered
declarations.statement:
∀ (d : ℕ) (μ : ℕ → ℝ),
  (∀ (i j : ℕ), i < j → j < d → μ j ≤ μ i) →
    ∀ p ∈ FreeEntropy.Weyl.activeRoots d d, 0 < FreeEntropy.Weyl.rootDenominator μ p

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Weyl.rootLeading
declarations.statement: ℕ → ℕ → (ℕ → ℝ) → ℕ → ℝ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Weyl.rootLeading_eq_qmdl
declarations.statement:
∀ (d r : ℕ),
  r ≤ d →
    ∀ (x : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ),
      (∀ (i j : ℕ), i < r → i < j → j < d → x j < x i) →
        (∀ (j : ℕ), r ≤ j → j < d → x j = 0) → FreeEntropy.Weyl.rootLeading d r x n = FreeEntropy.Weyl.qmdl d r x n

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Weyl.rowL1
declarations.statement: ℕ → (ℕ → ℝ) → ℝ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Weyl.rowL1_eq_zero_iff
declarations.statement: ∀ (d : ℕ) (ω : ℕ → ℝ), FreeEntropy.Weyl.rowL1 d ω = 0 ↔ ∀ i < d, ω i = 0

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Weyl.rowL1_int_zero_or_one_le
declarations.statement:
∀ (d : ℕ) (ω : ℕ → ℤ),
  (FreeEntropy.Weyl.rowL1 d fun (i : ℕ) => ↑(ω i)) = 0 ∨ 1 ≤ FreeEntropy.Weyl.rowL1 d fun (i : ℕ) => ↑(ω i)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Weyl.rowL1_nonneg
declarations.statement: ∀ (d : ℕ) (ω : ℕ → ℝ), 0 ≤ FreeEntropy.Weyl.rowL1 d ω

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Weyl.rowL1_zero_or_one_le_of_integral
declarations.statement: ∀ (d : ℕ) (ω : ℕ → ℝ), (∀ i < d, ∃ (z : ℤ), ω i = ↑z) → FreeEntropy.Weyl.rowL1 d ω = 0 ∨ 1 ≤ FreeEntropy.Weyl.rowL1 d ω

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Weyl.row_denominator
declarations.statement: ∀ (d i : ℕ), ∏ j ∈ Finset.Ico (i + 1) d, (j - i) = (d - i - 1).factorial

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Weyl.row_difference_le_l1
declarations.statement: ∀ (d i j : ℕ) (ω : ℕ → ℝ), i < d → j < d → i ≠ j → ω i - ω j ≤ FreeEntropy.Weyl.rowL1 d ω

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Weyl.spectral_sum_split
declarations.statement:
∀ (d r : ℕ),
  r ≤ d →
    ∀ (x : ℕ → ℝ),
      (∀ (j : ℕ), r ≤ j → j < d → x j = 0) →
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range r, ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico (i + 1) d, Real.logb 2 (x i - x j) =
          ∑ i ∈ Finset.range r, ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico (i + 1) r, Real.logb 2 (x i - x j) +
            ↑(d - r) * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range r, Real.logb 2 (x i)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Weyl.sum_activeRoots
declarations.statement:
∀ {M : Type u_1} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] (d r : ℕ) (f : ℕ × ℕ → M),
  ∑ p ∈ FreeEntropy.Weyl.activeRoots d r, f p = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range r, ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico (i + 1) d, f (i, j)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Weyl.twice_active_row_count
declarations.statement: ∀ (d r : ℕ), r ≤ d → 2 * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range r, (d - i - 1) = r * (2 * d - r - 1)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Weyl.weyl_product_ratio
declarations.statement:
∀ (d : ℕ) (μ ω : ℕ → ℝ),
  (FreeEntropy.Weyl.activeProduct d d μ / FreeEntropy.Weyl.activeProduct d d fun (i : ℕ) => μ i + ω i) =
    ∏ p ∈ FreeEntropy.Weyl.activeRoots d d,
      FreeEntropy.Weyl.rootDenominator μ p / (FreeEntropy.Weyl.rootDenominator μ p + (ω p.1 - ω p.2))

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Weyl.weyl_ratio_deficit_from_rows
declarations.statement:
∀ (d r : ℕ) (μ ω : ℕ → ℝ) (b : ℝ),
  0 ≤ b →
    (∀ (i j : ℕ), i < j → j < d → μ j ≤ μ i) →
      (∀ (i j : ℕ), i < j → j < d → ω j ≤ ω i) →
        (∀ (i : ℕ), r ≤ i → i < d → ω i = 0) →
          (∀ i < r, i + 1 < d → b ≤ μ i - μ (i + 1)) →
            (1 - FreeEntropy.Weyl.activeProduct d d μ / FreeEntropy.Weyl.activeProduct d d fun (i : ℕ) => μ i + ω i) ≤
              ↑(d.choose 2) * FreeEntropy.Weyl.rowL1 d ω / (b + 1)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Weyl.weyl_ratio_eq_one_of_rowL1_zero
declarations.statement:
∀ (d : ℕ) (μ ω : ℕ → ℝ),
  (∀ (i j : ℕ), i < j → j < d → μ j ≤ μ i) →
    FreeEntropy.Weyl.rowL1 d ω = 0 →
      (FreeEntropy.Weyl.activeProduct d d μ / FreeEntropy.Weyl.activeProduct d d fun (i : ℕ) => μ i + ω i) = 1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Weyl.weyl_ratio_eq_one_of_zero_rows
declarations.statement:
∀ (d : ℕ) (μ ω : ℕ → ℝ),
  (∀ (i j : ℕ), i < j → j < d → μ j ≤ μ i) →
    (∀ i < d, ω i = 0) →
      (FreeEntropy.Weyl.activeProduct d d μ / FreeEntropy.Weyl.activeProduct d d fun (i : ℕ) => μ i + ω i) = 1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.Weyl.weyl_ratio_pos_le_one_from_rows
declarations.statement:
∀ (d : ℕ) (μ ω : ℕ → ℝ),
  (∀ (i j : ℕ), i < j → j < d → μ j ≤ μ i) →
    (∀ (i j : ℕ), i < j → j < d → ω j ≤ ω i) →
      (0 < FreeEntropy.Weyl.activeProduct d d μ / FreeEntropy.Weyl.activeProduct d d fun (i : ℕ) => μ i + ω i) ∧
        (FreeEntropy.Weyl.activeProduct d d μ / FreeEntropy.Weyl.activeProduct d d fun (i : ℕ) => μ i + ω i) ≤ 1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.Below
declarations.statement: {d : ℕ} → (Fin d → ℝ) → MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℂ → Prop

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.Below.mul
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {a b : Fin d → ℝ} {p q : MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℂ},
  FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.Below a p →
    FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.Below b q → FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.Below (a + b) (p * q)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.Below.prod
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {I : Type u_1} [DecidableEq I] (s : Finset I) (a : I → Fin d → ℝ) (p : I → MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℂ),
  (∀ i ∈ s, FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.Below (a i) (p i)) → FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.Below (∑ i ∈ s, a i) (∏ i ∈ s, p i)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.IsAlternating
declarations.statement: {d : ℕ} → MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℂ → Prop

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.IsAlternating.coeff_eq_zero_of_eq
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {p : MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℂ},
  FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.IsAlternating p →
    ∀ (m : Fin d →₀ ℕ) (i j : Fin d), i ≠ j → m i = m j → MvPolynomial.coeff m p = 0

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.IsAlternating.coeff_permutation
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {p : MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℂ},
  FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.IsAlternating p →
    ∀ (m : Fin d →₀ ℕ) (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin d)),
      ↑(Equiv.Perm.sign e) • MvPolynomial.coeff (Finsupp.mapDomain (⇑e) m) p = MvPolynomial.coeff m p

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.IsAlternating.coeff_permutation_ne_zero
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {p : MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℂ},
  FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.IsAlternating p →
    ∀ (m : Fin d →₀ ℕ) (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin d)),
      MvPolynomial.coeff (Finsupp.mapDomain (⇑e) m) p ≠ 0 ↔ MvPolynomial.coeff m p ≠ 0

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.IsAlternating.ext_of_support_orbit
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {p q : MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℂ},
  FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.IsAlternating p →
    FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.IsAlternating q →
      ∀ (m₀ : Fin d →₀ ℕ),
        (∀ (m : Fin d →₀ ℕ), MvPolynomial.coeff m p ≠ 0 → ∃ (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin d)), m = Finsupp.mapDomain (⇑e) m₀) →
          (∀ (m : Fin d →₀ ℕ), MvPolynomial.coeff m q ≠ 0 → ∃ (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin d)), m = Finsupp.mapDomain (⇑e) m₀) →
            MvPolynomial.coeff m₀ p = MvPolynomial.coeff m₀ q → p = q

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.IsAlternating.mul_symmetric
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {p q : MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℂ},
  FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.IsAlternating p →
    (∀ (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin d)), (MvPolynomial.rename ⇑e) q = q) → FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.IsAlternating (p * q)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.IsAlternating.support_injective
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {p : MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℂ},
  FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.IsAlternating p → ∀ (m : Fin d →₀ ℕ), MvPolynomial.coeff m p ≠ 0 → Function.Injective ⇑m

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.alternant
declarations.statement: {d : ℕ} → (Fin d → ℕ) → MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℂ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.alternant_alternating
declarations.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (a : Fin d → ℕ), FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.IsAlternating (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.alternant a)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.alternant_coeff_permutation
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (a : Fin d → ℕ),
  Function.Injective a →
    ∀ (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin d)),
      MvPolynomial.coeff (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.exponent fun (i : Fin d) => a ((Equiv.symm e) i))
          (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.alternant a) =
        ↑↑(Equiv.Perm.sign e)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.alternant_expansion
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (a : Fin d → ℕ),
  FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.alternant a =
    ∑ e : Equiv.Perm (Fin d),
      Equiv.Perm.sign e •
        (MvPolynomial.monomial (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.exponent fun (i : Fin d) => a ((Equiv.symm e) i))) 1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.alternant_highest_coeff
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ),
  Antitone mu →
    MvPolynomial.coeff (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.exponent (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.shiftedHighest mu))
        (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.alternant (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.ascendingHighest mu)) =
      ↑↑(Equiv.Perm.sign Fin.revPerm)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.alternant_homogeneous
declarations.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (a : Fin d → ℕ), (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.alternant a).IsHomogeneous (∑ i : Fin d, a i)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.alternant_laplacian
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (a : Fin d → ℕ),
  FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.laplacian (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.alternant a) =
    ↑(∑ i : Fin d, a i ^ 2) • FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.alternant a

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.alternant_support_orbit
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (a : Fin d → ℕ) (m : Fin d →₀ ℕ),
  MvPolynomial.coeff m (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.alternant a) ≠ 0 →
    ∃ (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin d)), m = FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.exponent fun (i : Fin d) => a ((Equiv.symm e) i)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.ascendingHighest
declarations.statement: {d : ℕ} → (Fin d → ℕ) → Fin d → ℕ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.ascendingHighest_reverse
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ),
  (fun (i : Fin d) => FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.ascendingHighest mu ((Equiv.symm Fin.revPerm) i)) =
    FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.shiftedHighest mu

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.ascendingHighest_strictMono
declarations.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ), Antitone mu → StrictMono (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.ascendingHighest mu)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.below_denominator
declarations.statement: ∀ (d : ℕ), FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.Below FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.staircase (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.denominator d)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.below_one
declarations.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ}, FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.Below 0 1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.below_rootFactor
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ},
  ∀ r ∈ FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.positiveRoots d,
    FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.Below (fun (i : Fin d) => if i = r.1 then 1 else 0)
      (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.rootFactor r)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.canonical_denominator_character_alternating
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ),
  FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.IsAlternating
    (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.denominator d *
      FreeEntropy.LieCharacter.character (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.canonicalWeight mu))

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.coeff_euler
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (i : Fin d) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℂ) (m : Fin d →₀ ℕ),
  MvPolynomial.coeff m ((FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.euler i) p) = ↑(m i) * MvPolynomial.coeff m p

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.coeff_laplacian
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (p : MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℂ) (m : Fin d →₀ ℕ),
  MvPolynomial.coeff m (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.laplacian p) =
    ↑(FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.exponentEnergy m) * MvPolynomial.coeff m p

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.coeff_mul_at_homogeneous_degree
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (p q : MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℂ) (m : Fin d →₀ ℕ),
  p.IsHomogeneous (Finsupp.degree m) → MvPolynomial.coeff m (p * q) = MvPolynomial.coeff m p * MvPolynomial.coeff 0 q

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.coeff_mul_highest
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (a b : Fin d → ℕ) (p q : MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℂ),
  FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.Below (fun (i : Fin d) => ↑(a i)) p →
    FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.Below (fun (i : Fin d) => ↑(b i)) q →
      MvPolynomial.coeff (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.exponent (a + b)) (p * q) =
        MvPolynomial.coeff (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.exponent a) p *
          MvPolynomial.coeff (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.exponent b) q

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.coeff_product_shifted_powers
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (a b : Fin d → ℕ),
  MvPolynomial.coeff (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.exponent b) (∏ i : Fin d, (MvPolynomial.X i + 1) ^ a i) =
    ∏ i : Fin d, ↑((a i).choose (b i))

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.coeff_translate_alternant
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (a b : Fin d → ℕ),
  MvPolynomial.coeff (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.exponent b)
      (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.translate (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.alternant a)) =
    Matrix.det fun (i j : Fin d) => ↑((a j).choose (b i))

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.coeff_translate_monomial
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (a b : Fin d →₀ ℕ) (c : ℂ),
  MvPolynomial.coeff b (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.translate ((MvPolynomial.monomial a) c)) =
    c * ∏ i : Fin d, ↑((a i).choose (b i))

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.coeff_zero_translate
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (p : MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℂ),
  MvPolynomial.coeff 0 (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.translate p) = (MvPolynomial.eval fun (x : Fin d) => 1) p

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.denominator
declarations.statement: (d : ℕ) → MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℂ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.denominatorWithout
declarations.statement: {d : ℕ} → Fin d × Fin d → MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℂ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.denominator_alternating
declarations.statement: ∀ (d : ℕ), FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.IsAlternating (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.denominator d)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.denominator_character_eigen
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (p : MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℂ) (c : ℂ) (n : ℕ),
  ∑ i : Fin d, (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.euler i) p = ↑n • p →
    FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.denominator d * (MvPolynomial.C c * p - FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.laplacian p) =
        ∑ r ∈ FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.positiveRoots d,
          FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.denominatorWithout r * (MvPolynomial.X r.1 + MvPolynomial.X r.2) *
            ((FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.euler r.2) p - (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.euler r.1) p) →
      FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.laplacian (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.denominator d * p) =
        (c + ↑(d - 1) * ↑n + ∑ i : Fin d, ↑↑i ^ 2) • (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.denominator d * p)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.denominator_cross_radial
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (p : MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℂ),
  2 *
      ∑ i : Fin d,
        (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.euler i) (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.denominator d) *
          (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.euler i) p =
    (d - 1) • (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.denominator d * ∑ i : Fin d, (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.euler i) p) +
      ∑ r ∈ FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.positiveRoots d,
        FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.denominatorWithout r * (MvPolynomial.X r.1 + MvPolynomial.X r.2) *
          ((FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.euler r.2) p - (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.euler r.1) p)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.denominator_euler_cross
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (p : MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℂ),
  ∑ i : Fin d,
      (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.euler i) (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.denominator d) *
        (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.euler i) p =
    ∑ r ∈ FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.positiveRoots d,
      FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.denominatorWithout r *
        (MvPolynomial.X r.2 * (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.euler r.2) p -
          MvPolynomial.X r.1 * (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.euler r.1) p)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.denominator_highest_coeff
declarations.statement:
∀ (d : ℕ),
  MvPolynomial.coeff (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.exponent fun (i : Fin d) => d - 1 - ↑i)
      (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.denominator d) =
    ↑↑(Equiv.Perm.sign Fin.revPerm)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.denominator_homogeneous
declarations.statement: ∀ (d : ℕ), (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.denominator d).IsHomogeneous (∑ i : Fin d, ↑i)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.denominator_laplacian
declarations.statement:
∀ (d : ℕ),
  FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.laplacian (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.denominator d) =
    (∑ i : Fin d, ↑↑i ^ 2) • FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.denominator d

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.denominator_mul_staircase_coeff
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (p : MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℂ),
  MvPolynomial.coeff (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.exponent fun (i : Fin d) => ↑i)
      (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.denominator d * p) =
    MvPolynomial.coeff 0 p

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.denominator_product
declarations.statement:
∀ (d : ℕ),
  FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.denominator d = ∏ i : Fin d, ∏ j ∈ Finset.Ioi i, (MvPolynomial.X j - MvPolynomial.X i)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.denominator_roots
declarations.statement:
∀ (d : ℕ),
  FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.denominator d =
    ∏ r ∈ FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.positiveRoots d, FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.rootFactor r

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.denominator_staircase_coeff
declarations.statement:
∀ (d : ℕ),
  MvPolynomial.coeff (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.exponent fun (i : Fin d) => ↑i)
      (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.denominator d) =
    1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.dimension_eq_GT_of_character_identity
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (p : MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℂ) (mu : Fin d → ℕ),
  Antitone mu →
    ∀ (dimension : ℕ),
      (MvPolynomial.eval fun (x : Fin d) => 1) p = ↑dimension →
        (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.denominator d * p =
            FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.alternant fun (i : Fin d) => mu i.rev + ↑i) →
          dimension = Fintype.card (FreeEntropy.GelfandTsetlin.Pattern fun (i : Fin d) => ↑(mu i))

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.dominant_casimir_unique
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (nu chi : Fin d → ℝ) (c : Fin (d - 1) → ℕ),
  (∀ (j : Fin (d - 1)), nu (FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.right j) ≤ nu (FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.left j)) →
    (∀ (j : Fin (d - 1)), chi (FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.right j) ≤ chi (FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.left j)) →
      nu - chi = FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.offset c →
        FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.casimir nu = FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.casimir chi → chi = nu

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.dominant_shiftedEnergy_unique
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (nu chi : Fin d → ℝ) (c : Fin (d - 1) → ℕ),
  (∀ (j : Fin (d - 1)), nu (FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.right j) ≤ nu (FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.left j)) →
    (∀ (j : Fin (d - 1)), chi (FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.right j) ≤ chi (FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.left j)) →
      nu - chi = FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.offset c →
        FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.shiftedEnergy nu = FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.shiftedEnergy chi → chi = nu

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.eigenpolynomial_support_energy
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (p : MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℂ) (E : ℕ),
  FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.laplacian p = ↑E • p →
    ∀ (m : Fin d →₀ ℕ), MvPolynomial.coeff m p ≠ 0 → FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.exponentEnergy m = E

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.euler
declarations.statement: {d : ℕ} → Fin d → MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℂ →ₗ[ℂ] MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℂ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.euler_monomial
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (i : Fin d) (m : Fin d →₀ ℕ) (c : ℂ),
  (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.euler i) ((MvPolynomial.monomial m) c) = ↑(m i) • (MvPolynomial.monomial m) c

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.euler_mul
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (i : Fin d) (p q : MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℂ),
  (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.euler i) (p * q) =
    (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.euler i) p * q + p * (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.euler i) q

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.euler_prod
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {I : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq I] (i : Fin d) (s : Finset I) (f : I → MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℂ),
  (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.euler i) (∏ a ∈ s, f a) =
    ∑ a ∈ s, (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.euler i) (f a) * ∏ b ∈ s.erase a, f b

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.euler_rootFactor
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (i : Fin d) (r : Fin d × Fin d),
  (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.euler i) (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.rootFactor r) =
    (if i = r.2 then MvPolynomial.X r.2 else 0) - if i = r.1 then MvPolynomial.X r.1 else 0

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.eval_one_of_alternant_identity
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (p : MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℂ) (a : Fin d → ℕ),
  FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.denominator d * p = FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.alternant a →
    (MvPolynomial.eval fun (x : Fin d) => 1) p = Matrix.det fun (i j : Fin d) => ↑((a i).choose ↑j)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.exponent
declarations.statement: {d : ℕ} → (Fin d → ℕ) → Fin d →₀ ℕ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.exponentEnergy
declarations.statement: {d : ℕ} → (Fin d →₀ ℕ) → ℕ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.exponent_apply
declarations.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (a : Fin d → ℕ) (i : Fin d), (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.exponent a) i = a i

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.extraction_eq_binomialDet
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ),
  (Matrix.det fun (i j : Fin d) => ↑((mu i.rev + ↑i).choose ↑j)) =
    ↑(FreeEntropy.GTDimension.binomialDet fun (i : Fin d) => ↑(mu i))

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.highest_alternant_support_orbit
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ) (m : Fin d →₀ ℕ),
  MvPolynomial.coeff m (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.alternant (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.ascendingHighest mu)) ≠ 0 →
    ∃ (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin d)),
      m = Finsupp.mapDomain (⇑e) (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.exponent (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.shiftedHighest mu))

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.laplacian
declarations.statement: {d : ℕ} → MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℂ →ₗ[ℂ] MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℂ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.laplacian_monomial
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (m : Fin d →₀ ℕ) (c : ℂ),
  FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.laplacian ((MvPolynomial.monomial m) c) =
    ↑(FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.exponentEnergy m) • (MvPolynomial.monomial m) c

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.laplacian_mul
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (p q : MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℂ),
  FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.laplacian (p * q) =
    FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.laplacian p * q + p * FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.laplacian q +
      2 * ∑ i : Fin d, (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.euler i) p * (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.euler i) q

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.laplacian_sign_smul
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (s : Equiv.Perm (Fin d)) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℂ),
  FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.laplacian (Equiv.Perm.sign s • p) =
    Equiv.Perm.sign s • FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.laplacian p

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.monomial_exponent
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (a : Fin d → ℕ),
  (MvPolynomial.monomial (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.exponent a)) 1 = ∏ i : Fin d, MvPolynomial.X i ^ a i

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.offset_eq_zero_iff
declarations.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (c : Fin (d - 1) → ℕ), FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.offset c = 0 ↔ c = 0

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.offsets_sum_zero
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (a b : Fin (d - 1) → ℕ),
  FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.offset a + FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.offset b = 0 → a = 0 ∧ b = 0

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.permuted_exponent_energy
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (a : Fin d → ℕ) (s : Equiv.Perm (Fin d)),
  FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.exponentEnergy
      (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.exponent fun (i : Fin d) => a ((Equiv.symm s) i)) =
    ∑ i : Fin d, a i ^ 2

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.permuted_power_product
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (a : Fin d → ℕ) (s : Equiv.Perm (Fin d)),
  ∏ i : Fin d, MvPolynomial.X (s i) ^ a i =
    (MvPolynomial.monomial (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.exponent fun (i : Fin d) => a ((Equiv.symm s) i))) 1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.positiveRoots
declarations.statement: (d : ℕ) → Finset (Fin d × Fin d)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.rootFactor
declarations.statement: {d : ℕ} → Fin d × Fin d → MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℂ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.rootFactor_mul_without
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ},
  ∀ r ∈ FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.positiveRoots d,
    FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.rootFactor r * FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.denominatorWithout r =
      FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.denominator d

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.shiftedEnergy
declarations.statement: {d : ℕ} → (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.shiftedEnergy_eq
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (x : Fin d → ℝ),
  FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.shiftedEnergy x =
    FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.casimir x + (↑d - 1) * ∑ i : Fin d, x i +
      ∑ i : Fin d, FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.staircase i ^ 2

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.shiftedHighest
declarations.statement: {d : ℕ} → (Fin d → ℕ) → Fin d → ℕ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.shiftedHighest_cast
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ) (i : Fin d),
  ↑(FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.shiftedHighest mu i) = ↑(mu i) + FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.staircase i

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.shiftedHighest_energy
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu : Fin d → ℕ),
  0 < d →
    ↑(FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.casimir fun (i : Fin d) => ↑(mu i)) + ↑(d - 1) * ↑(∑ i : Fin d, mu i) +
        ∑ i : Fin d, ↑↑i ^ 2 =
      ↑(∑ i : Fin d, FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.shiftedHighest mu i ^ 2)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.staircase
declarations.statement: {d : ℕ} → Fin d → ℝ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.strictAnti_exponent_unique
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (mu m : Fin d → ℕ),
  Antitone mu →
    StrictAnti m →
      (∃ (c : Fin (d - 1) → ℕ),
          ((fun (i : Fin d) => ↑(mu i) + FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.staircase i) - fun (i : Fin d) => ↑(m i)) =
            FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.offset c) →
        ∑ i : Fin d, m i ^ 2 = ∑ i : Fin d, FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.shiftedHighest mu i ^ 2 →
          m = FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.shiftedHighest mu

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.sum_offset_zero
declarations.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (c : Fin (d - 1) → ℕ), ∑ i : Fin d, FreeEntropy.CasimirWeights.offset c i = 0

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.sum_positiveRoots_pairs
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (f : Fin d → MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℂ),
  ∑ r ∈ FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.positiveRoots d, (f r.1 + f r.2) = (d - 1) • ∑ i : Fin d, f i

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.sum_positive_root_first
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (k : Fin d),
  (∑ r ∈ FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.positiveRoots d, if k = r.1 then 1 else 0) = FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.staircase k

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.translate
declarations.statement: {d : ℕ} → MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℂ →ₐ[ℂ] MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℂ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.translate_C
declarations.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (c : ℂ), FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.translate (MvPolynomial.C c) = MvPolynomial.C c

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.translate_X
declarations.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (i : Fin d), FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.translate (MvPolynomial.X i) = MvPolynomial.X i + 1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.translate_denominator
declarations.statement:
∀ (d : ℕ),
  FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.translate (FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.denominator d) =
    FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.denominator d

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.translate_monomial
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (a : Fin d →₀ ℕ) (c : ℂ),
  FreeEntropy.WeylCharacter.translate ((MvPolynomial.monomial a) c) =
    MvPolynomial.C c * ∏ i : Fin d, (MvPolynomial.X i + 1) ^ a i

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WordTypes.ContentInvariant
declarations.statement: {n d : ℕ} → ((Fin n → Fin d) → ℂ) → Prop

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WordTypes.ContentInvariant.permute
declarations.statement:
∀ {n d : ℕ} {v : (Fin n → Fin d) → ℂ},
  FreeEntropy.WordTypes.ContentInvariant v →
    ∀ (w : Fin n → Fin d) (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)), v ((FreeEntropy.WordTypes.permuteWords e) w) = v w

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WordTypes.ContentInvariant.tensor_action
declarations.statement:
∀ {n d : ℕ} {v : (Fin n → Fin d) → ℂ},
  FreeEntropy.WordTypes.ContentInvariant v →
    ∀ (A : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ),
      FreeEntropy.WordTypes.ContentInvariant ((FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.matrix n A).mulVec v)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WordTypes.Words
declarations.statement: {r : ℕ} → {n : ℕ} → (Fin r → ℕ) → Type

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WordTypes.all_word_probability
declarations.statement: ∀ {r n : ℕ} (x : Fin r → ℝ), ∑ i : Fin r, x i = 1 → ∑ w : Fin n → Fin r, ∏ t : Fin n, x (w t) = 1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WordTypes.content
declarations.statement: {r n : ℕ} → (Fin n → Fin r) → Fin r → ℕ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WordTypes.content_permute
declarations.statement:
∀ {n d : ℕ} (w : Fin n → Fin d) (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)),
  FreeEntropy.WordTypes.content ((FreeEntropy.WordTypes.permuteWords e) w) = FreeEntropy.WordTypes.content w

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WordTypes.empirical
declarations.statement: {r : ℕ} → (Fin r → ℕ) → ℕ → Fin r → ℝ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WordTypes.empirical_monomial_pos
declarations.statement: ∀ {r n : ℕ} (lam : Fin r → ℕ), 0 < n → 0 < FreeEntropy.WordTypes.monomial lam (FreeEntropy.WordTypes.empirical lam n)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WordTypes.empirical_sum
declarations.statement: ∀ {r n : ℕ} (lam : Fin r → ℕ), 0 < n → ∑ i : Fin r, lam i = n → ∑ i : Fin r, FreeEntropy.WordTypes.empirical lam n i = 1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WordTypes.entropy_exponential
declarations.statement:
∀ {r n : ℕ} (lam : Fin r → ℕ),
  0 < n →
    ∀ (x : Fin r → ℝ),
      (∀ (i : Fin r), 0 < x i) →
        Real.exp (-↑n * FreeEntropy.FiniteConcentration.kl (FreeEntropy.WordTypes.empirical lam n) x) =
          FreeEntropy.WordTypes.monomial lam x /
            FreeEntropy.WordTypes.monomial lam (FreeEntropy.WordTypes.empirical lam n)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WordTypes.entropy_exponential_of_support
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} (lam : Fin d → ℕ),
  0 < n →
    ∀ (x : Fin d → ℝ),
      (∀ (i : Fin d), lam i ≠ 0 → 0 < x i) →
        Real.exp (-↑n * FreeEntropy.FiniteConcentration.kl (FreeEntropy.WordTypes.empirical lam n) x) =
          FreeEntropy.WordTypes.monomial lam x /
            FreeEntropy.WordTypes.monomial lam (FreeEntropy.WordTypes.empirical lam n)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WordTypes.monomial
declarations.statement: {r : ℕ} → (Fin r → ℕ) → (Fin r → ℝ) → ℝ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WordTypes.permuteWords
declarations.statement: {n d : ℕ} → Equiv.Perm (Fin n) → Equiv.Perm (Fin n → Fin d)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WordTypes.positionEquiv
declarations.statement:
{n d : ℕ} →
  (x y : Fin n → Fin d) → FreeEntropy.WordTypes.content x = FreeEntropy.WordTypes.content y → Equiv.Perm (Fin n)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WordTypes.positionEquiv_apply
declarations.statement:
∀ {n d : ℕ} (x y : Fin n → Fin d) (h : FreeEntropy.WordTypes.content x = FreeEntropy.WordTypes.content y) (t : Fin n),
  y ((FreeEntropy.WordTypes.positionEquiv x y h) t) = x t

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WordTypes.tensor_entry_permute
declarations.statement:
∀ {n d : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) (x y : Fin n → Fin d) (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)),
  FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.matrix n A ((FreeEntropy.WordTypes.permuteWords e) x)
      ((FreeEntropy.WordTypes.permuteWords e) y) =
    FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.matrix n A x y

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WordTypes.tensor_vector_contentInvariant
declarations.statement: ∀ {n d : ℕ} (v : Fin d → ℂ), FreeEntropy.WordTypes.ContentInvariant (FreeEntropy.TensorPowers.vector n v)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WordTypes.type_probability_le_exp_neg_kl
declarations.statement:
∀ {r n : ℕ} (lam : Fin r → ℕ),
  0 < n →
    ∑ i : Fin r, lam i = n →
      ∀ (x : Fin r → ℝ),
        (∀ (i : Fin r), 0 < x i) →
          ↑(Fintype.card (FreeEntropy.WordTypes.Words lam)) * FreeEntropy.WordTypes.monomial lam x ≤
            Real.exp (-↑n * FreeEntropy.FiniteConcentration.kl (FreeEntropy.WordTypes.empirical lam n) x)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WordTypes.type_probability_le_exp_neg_kl_of_support
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} (lam : Fin d → ℕ),
  0 < n →
    ∑ i : Fin d, lam i = n →
      ∀ (x : Fin d → ℝ),
        (∀ (i : Fin d), 0 ≤ x i) →
          (∀ (i : Fin d), lam i ≠ 0 → 0 < x i) →
            ↑(Fintype.card (FreeEntropy.WordTypes.Words lam)) * FreeEntropy.WordTypes.monomial lam x ≤
              Real.exp (-↑n * FreeEntropy.FiniteConcentration.kl (FreeEntropy.WordTypes.empirical lam n) x)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WordTypes.type_probability_le_one
declarations.statement:
∀ {r n : ℕ} (lam : Fin r → ℕ) (x : Fin r → ℝ),
  (∀ (i : Fin r), 0 ≤ x i) →
    ∑ i : Fin r, x i = 1 → ↑(Fintype.card (FreeEntropy.WordTypes.Words lam)) * FreeEntropy.WordTypes.monomial lam x ≤ 1

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.WordTypes.word_probability_eq
declarations.statement:
∀ {r n : ℕ} (w : Fin n → Fin r) (x : Fin r → ℝ),
  ∏ t : Fin n, x (w t) = FreeEntropy.WordTypes.monomial (FreeEntropy.WordTypes.content w) x

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.achieving_error_of_estimates
declarations.statement:
∀ (δ : ℕ → ℝ) (C : ℝ) (k : ℕ),
  (∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, 0 ≤ δ n) →
    (∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
        δ n ≤ 2 * (C * FreeEntropy.Weyl.errorScale n) + 2 * FreeEntropy.Concentration.tailBound k n) →
      δ =O[Filter.atTop] FreeEntropy.Weyl.errorScale ∧ Filter.Tendsto δ Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.exists_canonical_group_unitary
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H]
  (R : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ) →* Matrix H H ℂ) (J : Matrix (Fin n → Fin d) H ℂ) (hJ : J.conjTranspose * J = 1)
  (hJR : ∀ (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)), (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalRepresentation d n) U * J = J * R U)
  (mu : Fin d → ℕ),
  Antitone mu →
    FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.tensorDegree mu = n →
      ∀ (v : H → ℂ),
        v ≠ 0 →
          (∀ (i : Fin d), ((FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.restrictedGenerators R J hJ hJR).E i i).mulVec v = ↑(mu i) • v) →
            (∀ (i j : Fin d), i < j → ((FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.restrictedGenerators R J hJ hJR).E i j).mulVec v = 0) →
              FreeEntropy.LiePBW.cyclicSpan (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.restrictedGenerators R J hJ hJR) v = ⊤ →
                ∃ (W : Matrix (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex mu) H ℂ),
                  W.conjTranspose * W = 1 ∧
                    W * W.conjTranspose = 1 ∧
                      ∀ (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)),
                        W * R U = (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.irrepMatrix mu) U * W

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.exists_canonical_lie_unitary
declarations.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} {H : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H] (R : FreeEntropy.LieMatrixCasimir.Generators d H)
  (mu : Fin d → ℕ),
  Antitone mu →
    ∀ (v : H → ℂ),
      v ≠ 0 →
        (∀ (i : Fin d), (R.E i i).mulVec v = ↑(mu i) • v) →
          (∀ (i j : Fin d), i < j → (R.E i j).mulVec v = 0) →
            FreeEntropy.LiePBW.cyclicSpan R v = ⊤ →
              ∃ (W : Matrix (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex mu) H ℂ),
                W.conjTranspose * W = 1 ∧
                  W * W.conjTranspose = 1 ∧
                    ∀ (i j : Fin d), W * R.E i j = (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.irrepGenerators mu).E i j * W

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.exists_sector_canonical_unitary
declarations.statement:
∀ {d n : ℕ} (i : ↥(FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.Sector d n)),
  ∃ (a : FreeEntropy.Occupation.Occupation d n),
    Antitone ↑a ∧
      ∃ (W : Matrix (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.IrrepIndex ↑a) (FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.SectorSpace d n i) ℂ),
        W.conjTranspose * W = 1 ∧
          W * W.conjTranspose = 1 ∧
            ∀ (U : ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin d) ℂ)),
              W * ((FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.physicalDecomposition d n).representation i) U =
                (FreeEntropy.ExteriorRepresentation.irrepMatrix ↑a) U * W

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.l1_surplus_eq
declarations.statement:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} (s : Finset ι) (target part : ι → ℝ) (n : ℝ),
  (∀ i ∈ s, part i ≤ target i) → ∑ i ∈ s, part i = n → ∑ i ∈ s, |target i - part i| = ∑ i ∈ s, target i - n

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.log_correction_tendsto_zero
declarations.statement:
∀ {ε : ℕ → ℝ} {γ : ℝ},
  Filter.Tendsto ε Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
    0 < γ → Filter.Tendsto (fun (n : ℕ) => Real.logb 2 (1 - ε n / γ)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.memory_log_bound
declarations.statement: ∀ {m h ε γ : ℝ}, 0 < h → 0 < γ → ε < γ → h * (1 - ε / γ) ≤ m → Real.logb 2 h + Real.logb 2 (1 - ε / γ) ≤ Real.logb 2 m

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.nonnegative_ereal_liminf_of_eventual_lower_bound
declarations.statement:
∀ {a : ℕ → ℝ},
  (∀ (η : ℝ), 0 < η → ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, -η ≤ a n) → 0 ≤ Filter.liminf (fun (n : ℕ) => ↑(a n)) Filter.atTop

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.optimal_memory_converse
declarations.statement:
∀ {memory targetDim : ℕ → ℕ} {L error transferError : ℕ → ℝ} {γ : ℝ},
  0 < γ →
    (∀ (n : ℕ), 0 < targetDim n) →
      Filter.Tendsto error Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
        Filter.Tendsto transferError Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
          Filter.Tendsto (fun (n : ℕ) => Real.logb 2 ↑(targetDim n) - L n) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
            (∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, ↑(targetDim n) * (1 - (error n + transferError n) / γ) ≤ ↑(memory n)) →
              0 ≤ Filter.liminf (fun (n : ℕ) => ↑(Real.logb 2 ↑(memory n) - L n)) Filter.atTop

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.optimal_memory_converse_eventually
declarations.statement:
∀ {memory targetDim L error : ℕ → ℝ} {γ : ℝ},
  0 < γ →
    (∀ (n : ℕ), 0 < targetDim n) →
      Filter.Tendsto error Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
        Filter.Tendsto (fun (n : ℕ) => Real.logb 2 (targetDim n) - L n) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
          (∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, targetDim n * (1 - error n / γ) ≤ memory n) →
            ∀ (η : ℝ), 0 < η → ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, -η ≤ Real.logb 2 (memory n) - L n

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.orbit_memory_scalar_bound
declarations.statement: ∀ {p₀ p₁ γ δ m h : ℝ}, 0 < γ → 0 < h → p₀ - p₁ = γ → p₀ - δ ≤ p₁ + γ * m / h → h * (1 - δ / γ) ≤ m

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.paddedRow
declarations.statement: ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℤ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.paddedRow_gap
declarations.statement: ∀ (n x y ε k : ℝ), n * (x - y) + 2 * ε ≤ ↑(FreeEntropy.paddedRow n x ε (k + 1)) - ↑(FreeEntropy.paddedRow n y ε k)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.paddedRow_normalized_tendsto
declarations.statement:
∀ (x k : ℝ) {ε : ℕ → ℝ},
  Filter.Tendsto (fun (n : ℕ) => ε n / ↑n) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
    Filter.Tendsto (fun (n : ℕ) => ↑(FreeEntropy.paddedRow (↑n) x (ε n) k) / ↑n) Filter.atTop (nhds x)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.padded_bottom_surplus
declarations.statement: ∀ {n x ε a : ℝ}, |a - n * x| ≤ ε → ε + 1 ≤ ↑(FreeEntropy.paddedRow n x ε 1) - a

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.padded_difference_dominant
declarations.statement:
∀ {n x y ε a b : ℝ} (k : ℝ),
  |a - n * x| ≤ ε → |b - n * y| ≤ ε → ↑(FreeEntropy.paddedRow n y ε k) - b ≤ ↑(FreeEntropy.paddedRow n x ε (k + 1)) - a

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.protocol_roundtrip_error
declarations.statement:
∀ {S : Type u_1} {T : Type u_2} [inst : PseudoMetricSpace S] [inst_1 : PseudoMetricSpace T] (A : S → T) (B : T → S),
  LipschitzWith 1 B → ∀ (ρ : S) (τ : T), dist (B (A ρ)) ρ ≤ dist (A ρ) τ + dist (B τ) ρ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.theorem1_achievability
declarations.statement:
∀ {d r : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r),
  ∃ (memory : ℕ → ℕ) (E : (n : ℕ) → FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel (Fin n → Fin d) (Fin (memory n))) (D :
    (n : ℕ) → FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel (Fin (memory n)) (Fin n → Fin d)),
    Filter.Tendsto (fun (n : ℕ) => Real.logb 2 ↑(memory n) - FreeEntropy.Weyl.qmdl d r s.eigenvalue n) Filter.atTop
        (nhds 0) ∧
      (fun (n : ℕ) => FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.mixedWorstError s n (E n) (D n)) =O[Filter.atTop]
          FreeEntropy.Weyl.errorScale ∧
        Filter.Tendsto (fun (n : ℕ) => FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.mixedWorstError s n (E n) (D n)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.theorem1_achievability_of_estimates
declarations.statement:
∀ (d r : ℕ) (row : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (x : ℕ → ℝ) (memory : ℕ → ℕ) (δ : ℕ → ℝ) (C : ℝ) (k : ℕ),
  (∀ (i j : ℕ), i < r → i < j → j < d → x j < x i) →
    (∀ i < d, Filter.Tendsto (fun (n : ℕ) => row n i / ↑n) Filter.atTop (nhds (x i))) →
      (∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, ↑(memory n) = FreeEntropy.Weyl.activeProduct d r (row n)) →
        (∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, 0 ≤ δ n) →
          (∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
              δ n ≤ 2 * (C * FreeEntropy.Weyl.errorScale n) + 2 * FreeEntropy.Concentration.tailBound k n) →
            Filter.Tendsto (fun (n : ℕ) => Real.logb 2 ↑(memory n) - FreeEntropy.Weyl.rootLeading d r x n) Filter.atTop
                (nhds 0) ∧
              δ =O[Filter.atTop] FreeEntropy.Weyl.errorScale ∧ Filter.Tendsto δ Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.theorem1_achievability_of_quantum_estimates
declarations.statement:
∀ {d r : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r) (memory : ℕ → ℕ) (δ : ℕ → ℝ) (C : ℝ),
  (∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, ↑(memory n) = FreeEntropy.Weyl.activeProduct d r (s.targetRow n)) →
    (∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, 0 ≤ δ n) →
      (∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
          δ n ≤ 2 * (C * FreeEntropy.Weyl.errorScale n) + 2 * FreeEntropy.Concentration.tailBound (r * (r + 1) / 2) n) →
        Filter.Tendsto (fun (n : ℕ) => Real.logb 2 ↑(memory n) - FreeEntropy.Weyl.qmdl d r s.eigenvalue n) Filter.atTop
            (nhds 0) ∧
          δ =O[Filter.atTop] FreeEntropy.Weyl.errorScale ∧ Filter.Tendsto δ Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.theorem1_converse
declarations.statement:
∀ {d r : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r) (memory : ℕ → ℕ)
  (E : (n : ℕ) → FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel (Fin n → Fin d) (Fin (memory n)))
  (D : (n : ℕ) → FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel (Fin (memory n)) (Fin n → Fin d)),
  Filter.Tendsto (fun (n : ℕ) => FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.mixedAverageError s n (E n) (D n)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
    0 ≤
      Filter.liminf (fun (n : ℕ) => ↑(Real.logb 2 ↑(memory n) - FreeEntropy.Weyl.qmdl d r s.eigenvalue n)) Filter.atTop

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.theorem1_converse_of_estimates
declarations.statement:
∀ (d r : ℕ) (row : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (x : ℕ → ℝ) (memory target : ℕ → ℕ) (δ e : ℕ → ℝ) (γ : ℝ),
  (∀ (i j : ℕ), i < r → i < j → j < d → x j < x i) →
    (∀ i < d, Filter.Tendsto (fun (n : ℕ) => row n i / ↑n) Filter.atTop (nhds (x i))) →
      (∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, ↑(target n) = FreeEntropy.Weyl.activeProduct d r (row n)) →
        (∀ (n : ℕ), 0 < target n) →
          0 < γ →
            Filter.Tendsto δ Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
              e =O[Filter.atTop] FreeEntropy.Weyl.errorScale →
                (∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, ↑(target n) * (1 - (δ n + e n) / γ) ≤ ↑(memory n)) →
                  0 ≤
                    Filter.liminf (fun (n : ℕ) => ↑(Real.logb 2 ↑(memory n) - FreeEntropy.Weyl.rootLeading d r x n))
                      Filter.atTop

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.theorem1_converse_of_quantum_estimates
declarations.statement:
∀ {d r : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r) (memory target : ℕ → ℕ) (δ e : ℕ → ℝ) (γ : ℝ),
  (∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, ↑(target n) = FreeEntropy.Weyl.activeProduct d r (s.targetRow n)) →
    (∀ (n : ℕ), 0 < target n) →
      0 < γ →
        Filter.Tendsto δ Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
          e =O[Filter.atTop] FreeEntropy.Weyl.errorScale →
            (∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, ↑(target n) * (1 - (δ n + e n) / γ) ≤ ↑(memory n)) →
              0 ≤
                Filter.liminf (fun (n : ℕ) => ↑(Real.logb 2 ↑(memory n) - FreeEntropy.Weyl.qmdl d r s.eigenvalue n))
                  Filter.atTop

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.theorem1_converse_of_uniform
declarations.statement:
∀ {d r : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r) (memory : ℕ → ℕ)
  (E : (n : ℕ) → FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel (Fin n → Fin d) (Fin (memory n)))
  (D : (n : ℕ) → FreeEntropy.Channels.MatrixChannel (Fin (memory n)) (Fin n → Fin d)),
  Filter.Tendsto (fun (n : ℕ) => FreeEntropy.SchurWeyl.mixedWorstError s n (E n) (D n)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
    0 ≤
      Filter.liminf (fun (n : ℕ) => ↑(Real.logb 2 ↑(memory n) - FreeEntropy.Weyl.qmdl d r s.eigenvalue n)) Filter.atTop

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.theorem1_converse_with_spectrum_gap
declarations.statement:
∀ {d r : ℕ} (s : FreeEntropy.FixedSpectrum d r) (memory target : ℕ → ℕ) (δ e : ℕ → ℝ),
  (∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, ↑(target n) = FreeEntropy.Weyl.activeProduct d r (s.targetRow n)) →
    (∀ (n : ℕ), 0 < target n) →
      Filter.Tendsto δ Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
        e =O[Filter.atTop] FreeEntropy.Weyl.errorScale →
          (∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, ↑(target n) * (1 - (δ n + e n) / s.gammaX) ≤ ↑(memory n)) →
            0 ≤
              Filter.liminf (fun (n : ℕ) => ↑(Real.logb 2 ↑(memory n) - FreeEntropy.Weyl.qmdl d r s.eigenvalue n))
                Filter.atTop

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.transferred_code_error
declarations.statement:
∀ {S : Type u_1} {T : Type u_2} {M : Type u_3} [inst : PseudoMetricSpace S] [inst_1 : PseudoMetricSpace T]
  [inst_2 : PseudoMetricSpace M] (A : S → T) (B : T → S) (E : S → M) (D : M → S),
  LipschitzWith 1 A →
    LipschitzWith 1 E →
      LipschitzWith 1 D → ∀ (ρ : S) (τ : T), dist (A (D (E (B τ)))) τ ≤ dist (B τ) ρ + dist (D (E ρ)) ρ + dist (A ρ) τ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.typicalWidth
declarations.statement: ℕ → ℝ

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.typicalWidth_div_tendsto_zero
declarations.statement: Filter.Tendsto (fun (n : ℕ) => FreeEntropy.typicalWidth n / ↑n) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.typical_gap_lower
declarations.statement: ∀ {n x y ε a b : ℝ}, |a - n * x| ≤ ε → |b - n * y| ≤ ε → n * (x - y) - 2 * ε ≤ a - b

declarations.name: FreeEntropy.typical_gap_upper
declarations.statement: ∀ {n x y ε a b : ℝ}, |a - n * x| ≤ ε → |b - n * y| ≤ ε → a - b ≤ n * (x - y) + 2 * ε

dependency_policy: Direct edges are constant references in the compiled ConstantInfo type and value (including opaque values), plus inductive/constructor/recursor structural references. Self-edges are omitted. Project membership is determined by the defining Lean module, not by spelling. Compiler auxiliaries are not silently bypassed: every project reference resolves to declarations or auxiliary_declarations. The latter also includes source-defined structures, private helpers and instances outside the audit's public declaration list. Reverse references are limited to these indexed project declarations. Module imports are a separate relation, not proof dependencies.
